Before exams, the resources and tutoring is very pitiful and very limited, AND she gives us more homework and quizzes right before the exams. This one class takes up so much time.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The professor gives virtually no feedback and the grading is horrendous. I get zero grades on assignments that I didn't know we had that were not on the syllabus. Exactly what this class wants from me is incredibly unclear and I can't find what I need on blackboard.
reviews.rating_tags: So many papers--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: I love her so much; she articulates her class effortlessly and is a great human for chem and life. Stay on top of all the readings, and do and redo all hw and all practice problems you can find; If you are unsure of small things, ask because it will make everything else make sense. Her whole setup was incredible to prepare us for everything.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lots of homework

reviews.comment: took in the fall and got a D, retook this past semester got a C. each unit goes by super fast so stay on top of material/each topic or you WILL fall behind. didn't learn much from her and depended on online videos (she provided a lot of resources tho). each exam covered around 15 units each (3 exams)+cumulative gets math-heavy after first exam.

I have taken CHEM101 with this professor twice now, to say that she mostly relies on tests to make up the final grade would be an understatement. The exams make up 60 percent of your grade in total, so if you are a lousy test taker, you will fail no matter how well you do on the other assignments given throughout the course.

When I originally signed up for this class, plenty of other students granted hearty endorsements to this professor. To my dismay, she decided to run a "flipped classroom" this semester which meant she didn't teach the material in class, just practice. The worst part is the exams, few of the questions are close to the homeworks or practice problems.

The format is reversed, you learn outside of class with lecture videos, and then practice during lecture. About halfway through the semester, it becomes more efficient to just skip lecture and study for exams rather than actually actually show up and do a meager 3-4 practice problems PER class. Respect for Bass though, helping about 300 students.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Caring

reviews.comment: Great professor. Given the sheer size of the class she really does make an effort to help students. Class content is very straightforward and she was great with communicating any changes in assignments. No office hours but she offers other resources. Lecture was mostly practice problems but she explains stuff if you ask her to.

while she's inaccessible outside of class, she does walk around the hall during lecture and is willing to answer your questions during and after class as well! the material is hard so you need to put in effort to get a good grade and she's provided a lot of good resources to help you learn so make sure you can self study and do lots of practice!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: You'll have to teach yourself but it's more of a problem with how the curriculum is set up than with the professor herself. Pretty good at explaining the problems we do in class, and ended up rounding up my grade which is great.

You have to teach the material yourself by watching the prerecorded videos, practice questions on Aktiv homework(has 3 attempts). Make sure you know the concept and how do the math problems before class because the lecture summarizes what you read & are just extra practice questions. Tests were much more difficult than practice questions we learned

Great professor, difficult class. Exams reflect hw+discussions and there are always more practice problems on aktiv. Read textbook, watch the lectures, attend class- all will help to learn the content. Only hard work+significant effort will result in a good grade, so be prepared for a challenge! Manageable to do BIOL141 at the same time.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: bass explains chemistry concepts eloquently and clearly in lecture, in which attendance is graded. Aktiv homework usually takes 30 min-1hr to finish. on average, exams are moderately difficult. only problem is that bass is inaccessible-she can't have office hours.

I wish UMBC offered another 101 chemistry professor, she is awful. she taught nothing during lectures it was just 50 minutes of solving problems even if you did not understand it. her 4 exams were completely different from the practice which makes no sense. she overcomplicates exams questions and makes a 101 class so hard.

Don't listen to the people who have given low rating's. They're just a bunch of freshman complaining, that think college is going to be easy like high school. Dr. Bass is an amazing professor whose caring but her class is very hard and requires you to be focused and do all your required work and assignments on time. Also STUDY hard before exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She doesn't teach at all, whatsoever. You have to teach yourself and then go to lecture so you can get participation points. And all you do in lecture, is complete participation points. Why are we all wasting our time in class and outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Nice and caring teacher. But, it doesn't make up for the lack of "teaching". Entirely way too uptight for a level 100 class where we don't actually learn anything. You have to teach yourself all the material. Most of the test questions contain problems that weren't even reviewed in class, the textbook, or homework. Mentally draining class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Caring instructor. But with the number of students in CHEM101, there isn't much she can do for individual students. Lots of homework, and online tests that are all or nothing for points. Flipped classroom means a lot of time will be spent outside of class. Lectures were mainly there for practice.

Changed in-class participation to require attendance codes and discussion got changed from being online to paper on the 10th week of the semester. Very uptight for a 100 level class. Annoying. Lots of work. Reverse learning style; you learn the material yourself anyways so there is no incentive to attend class other than a few example problems.

There are four online exams and 1 cumulative in person exam, with 2-3 homework's and reading quizzes a week. She expects you to be familiar with the class content before class; lecture is treated as a review and polling questions are used to apply that knowledge and practice the material. LA's help in discussion, ask questions!

Dr. Bass is an amazing and kind professor. Be ready to work with people in lectures to answer clicker questions. There are graded on correctness, but that is about all that is stressful in the class. She goes over material very well, and is very approachable and accessible after and outside of lectures.

I got the opportunity to see Dr. Bass in person, even though this class is online and she is very nice. She genuinely cares about whether you pass, and will offer you solutions to help you succeed in the course. Dr. Bass tries to do her best to provide plenty of practice problems. 
The LCPs can be stressful, SI Pass can help with that. 
Good luck!

Professor Bass is an incredible Professor! She really cares about how well her students perform, and provides so many resources for help and extra practice, which I found really helpful! The only downside is that the lectures were online, but despite that I found Chem Talk to be very useful.

I had her when the exams and lectures were online and discussion was initially in person but they allow us to call in. Never met her, but she was very clear and good at explaining during chem chats. Exams matched the homework questions. Should be easy if you know how to take notes

I took this class twice and know professor Bass wants her students to succeed. Although the material is hard at times, it's easy to pass her exams as long as you read the chapters & go to lectures. The discovery isn't helpful & some exam questions aren't ones that are gone over in lecture. She's always available for questions and helping students.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I was explaining that as a matter of a few seconds ago: almost two and a half months into the semester, I am keeping track of my grade on blackboard and what I thought was an A dropped to a merely but futile C. I think that is quite the drastic change, and simply just unacceptable and inexcusable. Seriously!? What kind of professor pulls this?!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: What really sucks is for one; how the learning checkpoints are constructed. It truly sets limitations on what can be accomplished in the class efficiently. Secondly, you know how normally a class, when your grade is posted on blackboard, the fraction that is next the the 'My Grade' panel, is actually your grade? Well surprise! It's not.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Worst professor I've taken. CHEM talks were not at all helpful. Lasted at least 30 mins and didn't cover all subjects for the LCPS (exams). Problems on the exams are harder than the homeworks. I've attended tutoring sessions, chem talks, etc. and still got a C in this class. Only take it AT YOUR RISK. She's nice, but I wouldn't recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Bass gives a lot of chances to make up for the quizzes with the crazy amount of extra credit she gave out. The final was very simple and sometimes she would even throw in a free point here and there in the quizzes. My grade went from a D to a B because of all the extra credit and the final. She also responds to emails very quickly.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Not a lot is required in this class but you need to do a lot of work to pass. It's a tough topic and I think Dr. Bass does a great job of teaching it. She takes time to go over specific questions and gives extra practice and plenty of resources to do well. I would highly recommend attending every Chem Talk you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Amazing, down-to-earth professors! Always took the time to explain any questions we had and grading for all assignments was clear. Her lectures were really interesting and helpful and responded fast to emails. Offered extra credit opportunities and really treats you like a human being which is a breath of fresh air :)

If you suck at tests, you're screwed. The 5 exams and then the final are pretty much all that matter. I did horrible for the first few but my grade was saved because I did amazing on the last few and the final (which replaced your lowest exam grade). The chem talks were such a snoozefest and the homeworks were the most helpful in my opinion.

Chemistry isn't my strong suit, but thankfully in Dr. Bass's class you get several learning options that are not mandatory: lectures where you can ask chat questions, learning module videos you can go over and over again, textbooks, teaching assistants (?) who run tutoring sessions, and finally groups of peers you get broken into. Really nice lady

Dr. Bass is truly an amazing person. As a professor, she's okay; I think if the class wasn't online, it would be better. She is approachable and never makes you feel like you're not learning. She knows what is best for the class and goes with that. Plus the CHEM 101 Homework app is amazing and actually makes learning chemistry a lot easier.

Chem 101 was taught by 3 professors (Bass, Hamilton, Carpenter). Dr. Bass is very kind and approachable. Her lectures (CHEM Talk) were practice problems (notes taken ahead of time). Questions about content or tests could be asked on discussion board and answered quickly. Workload was decent but manageable. Answered all questions asked in class

Terrible teacher. Learned nothing from her and shes gives very little time for the exam. 30 minutes we section is fine for the first few exams but should not apply to the multiple step math based problems. Will NEVER recommend her to ANYONE EVER.

Her lectures are not at all helpful (online) and her Chemtalks aren't that useful either. She goes over incredibly easy problems and the hw problems are easy also, but then when you go to take the LCP(exams) they are HARD! I find her to be extremely confusing and I feel like she's genuinely not a quality teacher.
For the ones who are saying CHEM101 is difficult, its not if you read the textbook, do your homework and pay attention to her chem chats. You guys just like to complain when you put no effort in.
She taught chem as best she could. Do not rely on her to follow her own syllabus mainly her grading rubric. she completely nulled out any extra credit I earned and refused to bump up my 89.4.

Dr. Bass is very nice but being nice doesnt make a good instructor. The discussion groups werent useful for learning due to other students wanting to rush and people Not working together cohesively. Dr. Bass also teaches concepts and learning strategies which is fine but they arent useful for the quizzes which make up most of the grade.

Dr. Bass is nice but I wouldnt take her again unless she was my last option. She focused a lot on cheating instead of teaching and went through so much effort to keep an online class from cheating that she made a lot of mistakes on the quizzes she created. She and Dr. Hamilton created their own periodic table which caused more confusion.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Took Professor Carpenter's CHEM101 class and failed. Took Professor Bass's class and got a B. 10/10 recommend taking Professor Bass's class. She is the best!

Classes started as synchronous, but switched to asynchronous halfway through. We went from having group discussions/labs to doing them completely by ourselves. We were told to talk to our fellow classmates which wasnt very helpful when were all trying to learn new material. Lectures were essentially YouTube videos, but with less explanation.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Listen up, chem 101 can be very challenging especially in this pandemic but Dr Bass was such a great teacher! If you truly go to chem talks and si pass review sessions you will find it is doable! She is very supportive and cares about all her students. One of the best Professor hands down.

Dr. Bass was honestly super considerate despite the panoramic. I have never taken chemistry before so this class was insanely difficult for me, but with enough practice problems, taking notes from lectures and the book, and going over practice exams and her 3x a week "Chem Talks" I was able to do well. + She gave extra credit, practice exams, etc.

Chem 101 was definitely hard but Dr. Bass gave you everything you needed to do well. The chem talks, discussion board, CHEM101 assignments and the discovery all help you for the exam. The practice exams is near identical to the real exams and she tests on application not just facts. Overall a great teacher 10/10!

Dr. Bass is excellent. You can tell she's very passionate about chemistry & genuinely enjoys working with students. She was very accommodating for online school. She extended deadlines, gave EC & dropped low test scores for us. That being said, you still have to work for your grade. Do your homework, study for tests, go to CHEM Talk! She's great!!
Chem is not an easy class but she made this so bearable for students! She was very transparent with us and made sure that we were successful in this class!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This class was by no means easy but it was clear that Dr. Bass cared about her students' success, even though there were 700+ of us. It was easy enough to get questions answered through the discussion board and/or during "chem talks", which were optional review sessions she held three times a week. Workload wasn't too bad and the tests were fair.

Absolutely Amazing. Accessible anytime. In fall 2020, lectures were pre-recorded due to 727 students being in the class. Prof Bass made the best out of it by having "chem talks" 3 days a week, on the topic of the homework that is due that night. HW is due MWF weekly, but is on Chem101 app/website and not overly hard. Very organized as well.

I had more mental breakdowns than I've ever had during my undergrad, and I'll been in college for four years. Most tutors are terrible, don't listen to any of them. But Prof. Bass makes you work hard for the class through hard work, so do those practice problems!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Super organized and straight to the point. Everything prepares you for the exam

She's a really cool prof. While she wasn't our original professor, she was able to take charge of the class while still ensuring that we were learning despite having two courseloads. Her lectures were information and easy to understand and she's a very nice person who cares about her students.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Pre-corona, she was wonderful! She took the class's feedback, helped us understand the material, cheered us on, listened to us. It made the class easier. Post-corona, she knew it was hard but she also adapted! Yes, the material got harder, but she was accommodating and became a lil more lenient with assignments so that we could learn it thoroughly.
Overall pretty good prof. She gives lots of extra materials to help students. She does not round up. Was stuck with a 89.7 (B). An average professor but very organized.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The Chemistry Department at UMBC is phenomenal, with people like Prof. Bass here. Her lectures are kept short but straight-to-the-point, and the assignments help us better prepare for the exams better. On top of that, she is extremely generous with extra credit; she basically does not want to see you fail. I would definitely take her class again.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Bass is amazing. In a class of 300, she actually cares about each individual and wants everyone to do well in the class. She offered extra credit for every exam and she was available for office hours and other out of class help. She even had occasional sessions on Friday's for extra help as well as online office hours.

Dr. Bass saved my grade in CHEM 300. She teaches the lab half in the Fall. The lab sucks and will take a huge chunk of time but is the really easy juxtaposition to the terrible class. She really cares about her students and even tried to help us rectify our problems with the lecture. Go to her office if you have ANY question and you'll be fine.

I had to take this class for my psych B.S. and it was painful. Dr. Bass is nice, but I feel like she would be better if she actually taught instead of giving clicker questions the entire time. The course demands more than your time and money, but your soul. Worship your textbook. Overall, not awful, but would not want her as my professor again.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: CHEM101 has a terrible reputation due to Carpenter. But Dr. Bass is a gem and really cares about her students. She engages with any student with difficulty and thoroughly explains the content. I enjoyed her this summer session. Im bummed she wont be teaching 102!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Chem101 is an extremely difficult course. Now that Bass has completely taken it over, it has improved. Although difficult, it is possible to pass, just be prepared to dedicate your semester to this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: tries to get by on smiles. students like her regardless of how much they hate the class. I don't get it. She IS the course guys. Horrible materials and very mandatory. Nothing but graded HW and quizzes. A true weeder course. "there will be no curve!" then when 40% pass.... ok curve. Chem dept. step back and look at yourself. Miserable

CHEM101 at UMBC is notoriously a very challenging course, but taking it with Sarah Bass was actually somewhat enjoyable. The course is naturally pretty work heavy, between two different online components, additional practice problems, and very tough exams, but you can always go to Bass for help. Overall, take Bass over anyone else.

Bass SERIOUSLY cares for students. If it were her class exclusively, I think more would pass. Her rep is lowered due to Carpenter. Bass helped me with the course but also w/ IRL issues, and had lots of hope in my ability to improve. This is an extremely rigorous course, and while things can be improved (+I failed), she makes it a bit more bearable.

Test heavy. Studied super hard still didn't get good test grades. Not Bass's fault. Dr. Carpenter makes the tests and it is definitely not a 101 level course. Dr. Bass is super nice and cares but it's the tests that count. Despite years of student complaints, UMBC does not care enough to figure out what is wrong with the CHEM 101 and 102 class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: The course is very rigorous and demanding as it is but Dr. Bass really cares for all of the students and her office hours are great as she is very friendly and explains things thoroughly. If you don't understand a problem, she will go over it and provides many resources and opportunities to get help. Just make sure to do the ALEKS and don't rush!
Her exams are considerably easier than Carpenter's. Know that she's more than willing to help both inside and outside of class. She's more approachable and cares about her students.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: She hardly lectures. You expected to know a lot on your own. Discussion seems useless too . Bottom line, expect to do lot of work on your own, which is fine, but if you are not going to lecture in class then it defeats the purpose of going to class . Way too much material for 101 level, way more complicated than needs to be. regret taking it.

Her lectures are garbage, but graded. You don't leave with any more information than you entered with. She presents problems, and you know them or you don't. They aren't gone over, at least to any depth. Must be trying a different teaching method than in the past. The other reviews do not match my or my classmates experiences.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Chooses not to lecture in favor of just doing in class quizzes. Caring maybe, but its an online course with mandatory graded attendance. Tons of at home work. little in class lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: She is very nice and easy to follow. She thoroughly explains the examples in class and answers questions. I highly reccommend her. In CHEM101/CHEM102: She does NOT write the exams. The exams are poorly written as some questions are above and beyond the skill level that the book has prepped us for other questions are on target.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Would take again

reviews.comment: A really great professor! Explains the concepts really well. Although, the exams are extremelyyyyy difficult. You really have to work extra hard to know beyond the concepts. Plenty of trick questions, so be sure to read carefully, you will have plenty of time during exams.
Bass is great. She cares about her students, she explains well, Carpenter is ruining Bass's reputation.

Very nice, very smart, and cares about her students. However, she makes the exams MUCH harder than they should be for a 100 level class that most freshman have to take even if they aren't majoring in anything remotely related to chemistry.

Professor Bass is a very kind and intelligent teacher. She cares whether or not we understand the concepts, even though there are 300 of us in a class. However, the Chem 101 exams are extremely difficult. If you want to pass, you must attend all mandatory classes, stay on top of reading, and do practice problems.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: i had never taken a physics class before this one, and I am honestly heavily unmotivated and living on a prayer in this class. she always rushes through the lectures so it is hard to fully understand most of the time. i wish i would've taken this class at a CC and transferred the credit over. also 8am quizzes every friday are very annoying (online)
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I've never taken physics prior to this class so I was extremely worried but it ended up being one of my favorite classes and Dr.Lili is one of my favorite professors! She really wants you to succeed and the only way you will is with PRACTICE. Do all of the homeworks, REDO them, and you'll get As on exams.

She seems like a nice person but she's hard to understand/communicate with. I haven't taken physics since high school, and this class was really tough. I barely passed. Save yourself the trouble and just take it at community college. I found organic chemistry easier than this class. The exams were at 8am, and it was really tough if you commute >1hr

Honestly, the class is pretty straightforward. The class had a lot of work involved with it, but the lectures helped you with the homework, the homework helped you with the weekly quizzes, and the weekly quizzes helped you with the Exams. Ultimately, Cui was a good professor and explained things pretty well.

I took this class with knowledge of physics already from high school. She teaches very terribly and will look down on you if you ask questions. She doesn't really teach in lecture, rather just reviewing. There's 3 HW a week plus a quiz at 8 am every week. I would not recommend this teacher if you are completely new to physics.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Lecture is similar 4 hw quizzes + exams.When you ask something, she makes you feel dumb for asking. You have 2 exams + final. Hw 3x/week, not bad, just do it in time. Quizzes 30 minutes 4 10-12 questions is insane! worth 30% big chunk of your grade 2 drops 4 the quizzes but if there is a class-wide technical issue those will be a part of your drops

She makes sure to integrate practice materials for students, which is helpful. The homework, exams, and quizzes are fair and representative of her lecture slides. I appreciated this and recommend her physics classes. The lectures and the textbook are good resources. She is passionate about her students' success and understanding.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr. Lili makes physics digestible with clear lectures. While the frequent 8am quizzes and heavy homework load can be stressful, it all helps you learn. Studying with unstuckstudy alongside the textbook and practice problems is a huge lifesaver.

Her time management skills are horrible. She'll rush material at the end of lecture, so it ends up being poorly explained. Quizzes are also 30 min, which isn't enough time. HW is 3x/week. She can also can be very condensing. If you have a strong foundation in physics, then you'll do fine. If not, I recommend taking this course at another university

Dr. Cui gives a lot of homework, 3 per week and they are each 20 questions. Plus 1 quiz per week. Her lectures rarely line up to the homework and she moves really fast. Basically her class is difficult unless you have a very good background. She was very nice but the lectures seem more like a refresher course compared to a lesson.

Dr. Cui was the best professor I have had at UMBC, she is very kind and is accessible outside of class. She does a great job explaining things but it really helps if you actually show up to class. If you do, I don't think that you should struggle in this class.

Dr. Lili is by far one of the best professors I've ever met. She gives you the roadmap to succeed! The lectures relate to the HW, which translates directly to the quizzes which translate directly to her exams, and you get a formula sheet. I don't understand how anyone can fail this class. She is amazing!!

Dr. Lili is a great professor who cares about her students and she makes it clear what you need to know to do well on weekly quizzes and 2 midterms with a final that are pretty straightforward. You can also use one piece of paper to write anything for exam. very helpful! As long as you pay attention in class and do the homework you  will be fine!

Lili is honestly great. I had her for both PHYS 111 and 112 and her lectures are great. Her lectures directly reflect what she expects and the examples she does in class are very helpful for homework. The quizzes are exactly like the homework and the exams are like the quizzes. It is NOT hard to do well in her class imo.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Lecture slides are critical and HW is heavy/hard. Grading incl. weekly reading quizzes + weekly concept quizzes. Attendance/participation by live app in lectures. Comprehensive exams - no curves. Lab isn't very exciting, but is required (TA taught). Final is heavy (20%). Get ready to study a lot! She does allow a note page (both sides) for exams.

Very straightforward class, mostly algebra and trigonometry. Attendance is only 5% of your grade so missing class is fine. Lab was not enjoyable for me at all, mandatory 2 hours of filling out a word document with unengaging carts and sensors. Not the best communicator but don't take it personally and ask for help when needed and you'll be fine.

Dr. Lili explains well how to do the problems in class which reflect the homework and weekly online quizzes but she would go through them way too quickly. All the exams reflected the material but the cumulative final was brutal because these questions must have been randomly generated with no practice exam so you don't really know what to expect.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I love Dr. Lili. She is one of my favorite professors I've ever had. She is clear on where she pulls material from on exams and quizzes, which makes this class incredibly easy. The material is tolerable because her best quality is her ability to teach. I enjoyed her lectures, the material, and her presence. I will miss not having her anymore.

She was a great professor.  Her lectures were great and taught everything you need to know for tests.  She gave examples in class and they were basically the same problems that would be on homework and exams just with some numbers changed.  She explains everything pretty clearly, so if you come to class often and take notes, you can't go wrong.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The assignments and exams are good but her teaching style is awful. When you go to office hours she scrutinizes you for not knowing how to solve something.

She is great at lecturing so attend all of her lectures. most of the questions on the exam will be similar to practice problems in lecture and the online quizzes. Only negative really was that every friday there is a online that has to be done at 8 am, and you can not miss them unless you want a zero.

A typical intro STEM class at UMBC; a lot of busy work and takes a lot of effort. However, going to lecture, attempting the homework, and asking questions makes it difficult to fail this class. She pretty much tells you everything you need to know in class. She does go through things quickly though.

Dr. Cui is a great professor! She makes Physics easy to learn and study. I recommend following her study plan and reviewing previous quizzes and homework for the exams.  Dr.Cui is very organized and accessible outside of class. Although she can be strict, her teaching method was very helpful.

Dr. Cui specializes not only in Physics, but in Teaching Physics, and it shows. A potentially difficult topic is broken up into easily digestible chunks and the in-class questions keep people engaged. I wish every class was taught the way Lily taught.

The Professor explains the material somewhat well and the homework is based on the previous lecture. The 8am quizzes are simple and you have to understand all the questions on the homework to do well on the exam. Overall the class isn't that hard as long as you keep up with the material
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Cui is one of my favorite professors, despite her being a bit strict and assigning frequent homework. In comparison to other stem courses I've taken, this one isn't challenging. Go to class, try on the homework and quizzes, and you'll be fine. She states clearly where she gets her exam material from which makes it a lot easier to study for.

Amazing professor. Great and straightforward lectures. She makes physics so easy to learn and she knows it very well too. The only thing stressful about this class is the 8 am quizzes every Friday and the immense amount of homework she gives u. I ain't gonna lie, even though it's a lot, they're very helpful. Her exams are super easy too!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: There's work every other day, quizzes on Friday and the lowest scores are dropped but don't slack off. This is a fairly easy class if you keep up with the textbook and lecture. The Professor teaches well and attendance is mandatory for clicker questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: 8am quizzes every single week was a pain, homework 3 times a week, but the quizzes had the same questions as the ones on the homework, just different numbers. Lectures were kind of boring to go to but you need to for clickers. other than that she was great. I don't understand the other reviews saying she is arrogant and condescending, she is not.

Lectures taught exactly what you need to know for the homework. Homework was just like the quizzes. Allowed a cheat sheet on the exams. Class is pretty straightforward. 3 homework per week which can be annoying. Plenty of resources for the class. Reading the textbook is not necessary.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: if you get an answer wrong in class and she doesn't respond by being condescending, go buy a lotto ticket.

She makes a lot of mistakes, is arrogant, and extremely strict . Even if her mistake is screwing up your grade. She does not care and will not fix it. 

The only professor/teacher in my life I've genuinely disliked as a person.  College is hard enough, Cui will make it way harder than it has to be. Especially for a 100 level course lol.

she's a good professor, she knows her material and teaches well. lots of homework, 3 a week, weekly reading quiz and weekly 8am tests. but if you do the hw and study there is no way you will not pass. attend her office hours and on your own time do practice problems. she also allows you to make cheat sheets for midterm and final which helps a lot
So so arrogant. My god. She definitely knows her stuff though.

As a professor she is not the best, if you could take someone else do it. She speaks in a condescending tone when you ask questions or need clarification. She does not respond to emails so you would need to find her.  The class itself is easy but having her as the lecturer makes it harder than it needs to be, YouTube will be your friend.

Not a hard class if you're willing to put effort. Dr.Lili is very helpful and she has 2-3 office hours per week to help so please take that opportunity. Definitely a lot of hw but they're very helpful to study for the weekly quizzes. Seriously, her quizzes are very straightforward. Amazing and funny professor!!

Dr. Lili is very nice and gives you many opportunities every week for help sessions. It's honestly a LOT of homework though, due 3 times a week. The labs get a bit annoying too. Uses clickers, only grades for participation though. Midterm and final, and you have to do well on each Friday quiz in order to pass the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Lili is a great professor! She has a strong accent, but she's really easy to understand nonetheless. She's super nice and gives great lectures. She really wants students to succeed and gives you TONS of opportunities to get extra points, every reading quiz and homework gives you 3 attempts so you can learn from your mistakes. She's wonderful!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I don't know why she has a bad rating, she's such an awesome prof. Her BB is so organized, lectures are interesting and quizzes are all based on the hw and lectures (expect the same type of Qs). Recorded lectures, slides posted after but clicker questions used for attendance. Quizzes are open-note, cheat sheet can be used on final and "midterm".
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Completely understanding when emailing her about an accident when submitting an assignment. Humorous and interesting lectures, has MANY resources to aid in learning, sends out weekly reminders about every assignment, and all the work assigned is helpful to your Friday quizzes. One thing to note is that she does often rush through the slides end.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Best professor Ive had this semester! Lots of homework but 3 attempts are given and it really helps you understand the content. Textbook only needed for reading quizzes, lectures are super important to understand for passing the class.

It's easy to get an A if you put in the work and do the HW, all quizzes are drawn from lecture and HW. Lectures were also entertaining, you can tell she loves physics and wants everyone to participate in clicker questions. Make a study group, go to office hour, SI pass and you'll pass. Don't fall behind on anything bc theres a quiz every week.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She was not accommodating at all, through communication barely responded to emails and if she did it was a very condescending tone. The material isn't hard it's really the professor that makes the class worse; get a group of friends and create a study group you'll receive more information that way instead of actually learning something in the class
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Cui is very clear in her expectations and straightforward in her lectures. Just about all the material you need to know can be found in her lectures, and the quizzes and homework were just variations of problems that had been taught. Solid class, would recommend.

Dr. Cui is very knowledgeable and a good lecturer. Participation in class is necessary to pass. This is a hard course, so make sure to take advantage of any and all SI PASS/OH sessions. The quizzes draw from hw and discussion problems, and the final exam draws heavily from the quizzes. Start hw early or you won't finish it.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Phys112 is already an easy class, but this course became stupid easy online. Just know the formulas and how to use the right hand rule. The final was basically the same questions as the quizzes (and the quizzes were basically the same as the lecture-follow ups/clickers and labs)

For her online class, you will have a reading test, two chapter tests, a quiz, a lab, and homework on Pearson every week. It might sound like a lot of work, but I would say it really is not as bad as it sounds. In fact, there is only one exam, final, that counts only 10% of your grade. If you do well on your weekly assignments, you will be fine.

10/10. She breaks down concepts flawlessly and if you are confused, she is really helpful in office hours. Workload is heavy but I can say besides the lab, the extra work is super helpful. Reading is only necessary for the prequiz bc lectures are thorough and explanatory. Maybe she was different in person but virtually 10/10 and a sweetheart!!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Lili is an amazing teacher. I took physics with her because I needed the credits to graduate and I would have never given physics another glance but she has a way of breaking down everything that makes so much sense. Especially for someone with no physics background prior to taking her class. Overall the sweetest. An amazing professor
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Took Lili for 111&112 - was amazing for both! 1 of my fave profs I've had at UMBC. Fair amount of work to do, but do it all, its an easy A. Redo the lecture notes, weekly quizzes, & old exams & you'll ace every test. Cares about her students & wants everyone to succeed. Holds office hours & review sessions. Lab can be annoying. Overall 10/10.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Great professor. She's very reasonable and communicative. She makes sure that you know the material and provides great resources and support for you to succeed. Lots of HW, labs, exams, quizzes, etc though. She may go fast in her lectures, and not finish everything in one class. However, class isn't hard if you put in a little effort.
She explains the material but can be so mean. I went in for office hours to ask for help but she like scolded me because I didn't draw the graph neatly. It really made me upset and sad the whole day.

Overall, she was not a bad teacher! Very calm, and as long as just show up, use the clicker, she gives full credit for that. It was definitely hard to understand her. Had to do a lot of independent studying. I did not do very well on my 2nd and 3rd exam. Final was in the 60s range. I still got a C in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Cui is a very hardworking prof who will literally spend hours w you outside of class explaining a concept. She gets a bad rap sometimes because she is hard on her students and wants them to put forth as much effort as she does. Not afraid to yell, thats for sure. Labs/HW are a pain, but tests are very doable if you do the practice exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Very rude and condescending, does not curve even an 89.8%, bad professor. Outside of that the material is easy and her exams are similar to past exams. She's also not very bright as she re-uses EXACT questions from two years ago, unaware that a good portion of students have old exams. Get yourself 2 year old exams and you're golden Bad professor

Prof Lili is very energetic and knows a lot about Physics. She expects a lot of work from us, with weekly quizzes, online homework, and lab work. She goes quickly through her lectures, with a lot of material to cover, but she makes sure you understand the concepts. She also brought in Dr. Leupen to further explain physics to us using biology.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: In order to pass her class, you need to go to it everyday and write down everything. The material is not easy but she give great explanations in class. Her tests are easy if you GO TO CLASS because they are based on the power points. The great thing about her class is the little amount of time she take to grade the exams.
Shes awesome! Her explanations are super clear, shes far more helpful than the textbook. She really makes an effort to help you pass. I very much enjoyed this class.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Lili is awesome!! She lays everything out really clearly, and takes time to explain more complicated concepts. She really cares about her students and wants everyone to pass. She gives you all the tools you will need to do well. Her exams are very straightforward and if you have paid attention and done your homework you will pass.

Her lectures were pretty difficult to understand, so I had to review her lecture notes. Her exams aren't hard if you studied. Her final exams aren't anything extremely difficult. If you work hard, you will get an A in this class,just depends how much effort you put into this class.I will only take her again personally since I know how she works now
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She is probably the most degrading instructor I have ever had. Makes you feel dumb and does not a good job of explaining concepts. Exams are difficult. Does not curve or give any type of extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Lili is a genuinely sweet professor who wants to see you succeed. Yes, she can be loud at times but that's just how she is. She is a very kind person who is willing to explain concepts again to you (not that you will need it because she's very clear in lectures). She encourages questions and participation and admires students who work hard.

Cui is the real deal. She gave me the best advice a teacher has ever given me - "This is supposed to be a struggle." It helped me realize I'm not dumb or incapable, but that learning is SUPPOSED to be uncomfortable and challenging. Her class is a real charcter-builder. It will feel like pure suffering but stick it out and you'll be better for it!

I'm pretty sure the three good reviews on here are written by Dr. Cui, herself XD She's probably the worst teacher I've ever had at UMBC. She gets extremely offensive if you question her during her lectures and her tests are way too difficult. When the average test score is a 65% then you know it's not the students but the teacher that's the issue
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Cui is my favorite teacher so far at UMBC! I don't see how anyone could find her to be rude, she extremely sweet and really cares about your success. If you participate in class, this course is a breeze. Her exams are easy; they are pretty much straight from the lecture slides but with different numbers. I can't wait to take 112 with her!
Good at explaining concepts but exams are very hard. Exam averages are in D range. If you approach her with questions, she will just say, "You should already know this". Don't recommend her.
If I have to hear her make the same Swimming analogy one more time I am going to jump from the top of the Library. Class is easy but do yourself a favor and find a different prof.

I had her this semester for 111, and I don't know what people are talking about when they say she is rude. She is a very sweet professor, and genuinely wants you to succeed. You can tell because she makes her exams very straightforward. If you understand every lecture slide, you will get 100 on the exam - that simple. You can talk during quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I don't usually post stuff on teachers like this but somethin she said in class today rubbed me the wrong way. Some girl asked her a question and her response was "This is a waste of time" I don't know what kinda teacher says something like that.
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She is extremely unprofessional and even condescending when students ask her questions in class. Stay away from this rude woman at all cost
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Every other word she says is "YAAS?" It is literally the most annoying thing in the world. Lady, expand your vocabulary, you're a professor for God's sake.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: This class requires a large time commitment between the weekly discussions, quizzes, and homework assignments. Attendance is mandatory due to clicker grades. She does not curve anything, but there won't be anything on the exams that wasn't on the lecture slides or in a homework problem. A single note card is allowed on exams, which is a godsend.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: PHYS121 with her is cut and dried. Do the online prelectures before every class and the homeworks every week. Lecture clarifies the online content. The exams are exactly like questions she goes over in class. The only thing that's sort of difficult about this class is the volume and and frequency of homework activities.

Did not use the textbook. Prelectures and homework online . Her lectures are helpful, she puts up lecture outlines. Open neighbor quizzes every Friday. 3 exams and final. She does not curve at all. This class also had discussion which is conceptual but helpful.

This class requires a lot of your time and energy. If you slack on things, then you wont learn and you wont do well. I found that the best way to study was to go over old quizzes and exams. She puts the hard questions on the exams and really tests you knowledge. So make sure to study hard! Great and cute personality.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Physics is a challenging course that requires a lot of effort from both the student and professor.  Dr. Cui understands this and is strongly devoted to holding up her end of the bargain while encouraging us to hold up our end.  This class is not easy, but if you go to the lectures, get help, and do the work, you will be just fine in this class.

Good teacher, if you put in the work and do the homework and come to class prepared, you are set up to do well. Dr. Cui understands that Physics is a subject where you can often fool yourself into thinking that you are prepared when you are not. She stresses the importance of solo practice to understand the concepts. The discussion material is good
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I'm a biology major and absolutely hate physics. She made me somewhat enjoy it. She was an amazing professor and always explained everything. She gave you all the materials and more to succeed and learn the material. The exams are straight forward with no tricks. Homework didn't help me but it helps your grade. I would highly recommend to anyone.

Take the class with the intention of actually learning the material instead of relying on a curve people! This is basic physics, not rocket science so just put in the hours, show up to class,read the book and ask for help when you need it and you are fine. If you take pride/interest in what you do it all works out. Great Professor!

Exams are only hard if you let them be. Dr. Lili actively encourages use of study groups, S.I. sessions, TAs,  and office hours. Her exam questions are very similar to the past exams and the homework/quizzes she assigns. As long as you read the book and actually do the homework you should be fine.  I liked her humor and approachable personality.

Literally the worst professor ever. She doesn't explain anything clearly. Unfortunately her accent is a barrier and she is even harder to understand when she's yelling at us for not being able to immediately grasp concepts. Ridicules students who do not understand things. Be prepared to teach yourself.
I don't think she was a very good teacher. She's nice but hard to understand. Tough grader too. Wouldn't recommend

Dr. Cui is nice and her lectures are somewhat helpful, but attendance is mandatory due to clickers, and occasionally she'll yell at people for talking. I wish she made lectures optional. However, she does try to make the class fun and cares about everyone. The final is insanely hard, though, and she refuses to curve it.

Dr. Cui's accent makes it difficult to understand her at times. However, if you read ahead of class and put a decent amount of effort, the class is not hard at all. You're even allowed to have note cards with formulas on it. There's no reason to be getting lower than a B in this class unless you didn't put the effort/time needed.

Lecture is completely useless. She doesn't give examples to questions assigned for homework, and neither does the textbook. Some of homework questions are plug and chug, but the harder ones are impossible to figure out by yourself. Hard class already, she just makes it 10x harder.

Take the negative reviews with a grain of salt. I really liked Dr. Cui. There is a large volume of information to absorb, but she explains what she wants you to know, and she stays on topic and does a lot to try and prepare you for her exams. The questions on the exams follow from the type of questions you receive from the homework assigned.
She has an accent but eventually it becomes easy to understand, make sure you understand every question from the reading quiz because she might not bring any of the questions up again until the test

She is impossible to understand. Its hard to concentrate on the material when you're too busy deciphering her English. Exams are far more difficult than anything problems she goes over in lecture. Tough grader.  Unless you're the best world's best independent learner, do not take this class.

I loved Dr. Cui; she was so nice and always so happy!  I thought she did a pretty good job of explaining things.  I also thought she was funny, in her own special way.  The exams were challenging, but fair (the average was almost always a 75).  She has a heavy Chinese accent which some people hate, but I thought it made things more interesting.

Terrible professor. As a  terrible accent making it hard to understand her. Also, she skips over key concepts. You have to look at the book and learn on your own. She also makes the homework 10x harder than what is in the book, often leaving you with no idea on what to do.

Attendance is mandatory. Prof. is not clear on what exactly to expect on actual exams and does not cover some important concepts in class thoroughly. Hard on grade; there is no curve even with two exam averages in the 60s. Study using the learning goals and the book to understand the concepts fully and do well on exams.

Cute. She's great! I hated physics before her! She made it very tangible. Exams are kinda a crunch.make sure and read the questions properly! Do the past exams. She's really down to earth. Clicker quizzes every Friday you can do with friends. Pay attention in class you'll be fine. Would recommend her! Good luck!

Awful professor for 112. Doesn't curve, even though the average for one of our exams was a 63% (the other exams weren't much better). Explains basic concepts pretty well, but the exam questions are about 10x harder than anything she explains. Also talks down to her students regularly. Avoid this professor like the plague.
too hard on grade

She's pretty nice and helpful. Has this positive attitude most of the time. Like she always say in the class, you'll have to work for your grades. This is not that bad of a class. If you work hard enough, you'll earn a good grade. For exams, study everything esp past exams. IMPORTANT TO SHOW UP IN CLASS

Lili has a strong accent but it is understandable. Her teaching is all over the place—even if you pay attention in class and take down everything said, she will undoubtedly have left out a few key pieces of information that you will probably need for the homework and exams. Sweet woman but not great at teaching physics.

She's very enthusiastic in class and I can understand her at times. But I feel like the way she teaches is different than that of the book and when doing the homework it's more related to the book than what she teaches.

Dr. Cui is without a doubt one of my favorite professors at UMBC! She's very enthusiastic, extremely approachable, kind, and even funny! I had her for 121, and although her class was hard, it was very doable. Dr. Cui is a great person and an amazing professor! I would wholeheartedly recommend her to prospective students!

Dr. Cui is one of the loveliest people I have met at UMBC. She is brilliant and enthusiastic, and will do as much as she can to help you. I enjoyed both 121H and 122. I giggle at her silliness all the time; her English isn't great, but this doesn't affect her teaching effectiveness, but rather makes her highly amusing. My favorite professor so far!

Love this professor. She is every nice and helpful. Very smart and knows what she is talking about. Go to class, pay attention, and study and you will get a good grade. I got an A in 121 and a B in 122. Highly recommend her.

Dr. Cui is the most amazing Physics professor I have ever had. She is adorable, interesting, and loves interacting with her students. I wish I could have her again for 122H. I'm not even a Physics major, and I still loved the class.

Let me start off by saying I got an A in her PHYS 121 class. She is a below average professor and probably the worst one I've had at UMBC. She is unclear and akward. She regularly asks a 300 seated lecture questions expecting a response. She often pauses and asks (in a 300 seated lecture hall) why someone is talking. Thankfully I studied hard.

She is not good at teaching physics. You will have to learn the majority of the subject by reading the text and by using the discussion board for online homework. She is not a very approachable professor and often seems to be temperamental. Although she mentions that she is willing to help you, it sure doesn't seem that way when you talk to her.
She doesn't understand the nature of physics, and will fail you on an exam for no reason.  She also likes to yell at her students in the classroom.
Thick accent, very hard to understand, and she relies heavily on the book. As long as you can learn by yourself you will be fine, the book is helpful, she is not.

LOVEEE HER! Omg where do I even start. She is so sweet, offers a lot of extra credit work. We're almost finished with the course but she is by far the best professor I've had this semester. Her class consists of quizzes, participation points for the webex meetings through Slido, discussion posts, and a final project. 10/10 recommend her.

Dr. Cho is such a kind professor. She genuinely wants every student to succeed and she gives more extra credit opportunities than any other professor I know. She isn't always responsive over email but other than that, she's amazing and I would highly recommend taking her course.

Professor Cho was a great professor. The only thing that knocks it down to a 4 for me is that she is not great at responding to emails. I sent multiple emails over the course of the semester that never got addressed. Other than that, very easy going professor and simple assignments. Would recommend

So caring and understanding to students. We are graded by 5 quizzes, participation, discussion posts every two weeks or so, and a final project. I really recommend her, and she gives out so many extra credit opportunities!!

not only is professor cheah hilarious, but charismatic and super intelligent. she is amazing and i'm looking forward to having more classes with her in the future and maybe even participating in her lab because she's just that great!
Nice professor, very passionate about the topic, and encourages participation.
Dr. Cheah is very knowledgeable and passionate about the topic and makes it interesting with lots of examples.

Professor Cheah is great; she is extremely lecture-based, and you can tell she is passionate about her work. Her lectures can be a little boring, but they are important to attend. There are 3 quizzes (done in class), discussion posts for homework, and a final project. She is a very late grader, and that is the only annoying thing.

Professor Cheah is very nice and understanding. She does take attendance, but is willing to work with you if you let her know that you're unable to make it to class. Tests are online but done in class, and otherwise she is very anti-technology in the classroom. Very clear lectures and assignments. Make sure to study and you'll do great!

I loved this class! I wish it was in person so that I could interact with Dr. Cheah more. She had a lot of experience in the topic area, and her lectures were really interesting. She was also accommodating and took care to respond to questions. Most lectures were asynchronous, with set live classes with discussions. Great class and prof.

I liked the layout of the class as it was flexible. Nearly all lectures were async but they were boring as she was monotoned and read off the slides. Live lectures were group discussions. Exams were long but not hard at all as long as you do study guide. 1 single final essay, but it was frustrating to do. wouldn't take her again.

3 assignments that were either based on an article or a video but they were easy. A couple live classes where she goes over the assignments. Lecture videos had questions in them that had to be answered. Posted study guides that reflected the exams. Had a final paper based on a video which was easy. Discussion board were extra credit. Really nice.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: very nice person and you can tell she cares about the subject

Very clear grading criteria, assigned reading 100% helpful and relevant to course topic. The people who say she jumps around a lot were not paying attention. She teaches cultural psychology and developmental psychology and no concept in those fields are independent of each other. It is so interconnected that she HAS to jump around to fully explain

I don't understand the previous comments considering there were many people in my class who were disrespectful to her. She is a nice teacher who offers some of the most extra credit opportunities I've ever seen in a 300 level course. She offers clear criteria on what to expect. You can get an A if you just try. It was not a difficult class.

Cheah was passionate about the material, but since lectures were difficult to focus on I got less out of the class than I expected. Many concepts and studies are over explained, leading to students tuning lectures out. Your grade is det. by 3 exams, few assignments + a final paper but there's lots of EC. I never touched the textbook and did fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Cheah is a decent she is nice, but her lectures are heavy. She puts way to much on her slides and flies though it quickly. She jumps from topic to topic it seems as she isn't prepared. She does offer a variety of extra credits. BUT her study guides are not helpful and it's given 5-7 days before the exam. She takes forever to return grades.
Class is boring, but you can get an "A" if you need one. She give way many extra credits and you can earn all of them if possible.

What an amazing professor! Her lectures were so awesome. She is a really talented lecturer who keeps you interested. This was her parenting class. She is very knowledgeable about the field but encourages students to offer their perspectives. Although you have to work for an A, she offers a good amount of extra credit. Highly recommend!

I don't understand the last two comments AT ALL!  I LOVE this professor and the topics that we covered in class. I enjoyed going to every class and thought that her lectures were interesting.  She also encourages participation in class, which makes it interesting.

Horrible. First off, her TA was only proficient at English which has a strong  impact on this course when SHE is grading your final paper. Second, this class is a complete waste of time and expect to learn nothing. The teacher is nice but extremely dull and leaves you wanting to lick a homeless mans feet rather than listen to her lecture anymore.

I took this class because I heard great things about Dr. Cheah.  I was not disappointed.  The class was really interesting, and Dr. Cheah is very dynamic, caring, and knowledgeable.  You need to work for this class, but you will definitely learn something that you will actually remember even after the class ends!

Great professor! Really helpful and nice. Tests are easy if you study the study guide. One 8 page paper and some take home assignments. Gives LOADS of extra credit. Extra credit totals to 15% of grade. Very interesting material and reading the book is not mandatory.
Very interesting material and knowledgeable prof. If you attend class, study using the exam guide, you'll learn a lot and do well.

I took this class last semester and really enjoyed it. The material is very interesting, and the prof. really knows her stuff and encourages great discussion. If you study you will do well AND you will learn a lot. I would definitely recommend this course and prof.

She was a pretty easy going professor. First exam is hard but after the first one exams are pretty easy. Give small extra credit through out the semester. have one small group discussion  based on assigned article. lecture using powerpoint. One 15 page paper. Easy to talk to about grades and assignment.
This was the parenting class.  The prof is very easy going and ready to explain everything.  Greatest prof ever!
Very interesting class and really nice teacher.  Very helpful and cool.
This prof is great.  She is really nice and helpful.  Her courses are very interesting (I've taken two).
This professor follows what others say. Does not have any opinion of her own and is extremely biased. People think she is nice but she is very fake and will be rude if she feels like it. BE WARY!
SO friendly/nice/approachable. Exams are very easy and shes an easy grader for the paper. Take her!
Fantastic teacher.  Love her!  Take her course.
My favorite class and the teacher is great.
Awesome prof and class!

Good personality.  You need to read the text and read the lecture notes to do well on her exams.  She'll usually available to help you if you need it and was generous with giving some extra credit.  Note though:  you're gonna have to write a 10 page paper for this class!

Awesome professor, nice, clear and helpful. Her exams can be a bit hard, so in addition to studying the notes she puts on BB, reading the book is important if you want to do well. There are inclass assignments, and sometimes she give extra credit questions during class.
liked the course and teacher very much
REALLY INTERESTING COURSE.  EXCELLENT TEACHER, COOL MATERIAL.
Very interesting course - have to study and attend lectures, but the material is interesting. She gives good hints, and is very helpful and nice.
Great prof - don't know where the weird comments are coming from as everyone i know in the course loved it and the prof.
Great prof - definitely one of my favorites.  She's kind, helpful, and really cares about her students.  Very interesting class.  Highly recommended.
i agree. she seems nice but she is biased, artificial, moody and weird.

I have no idea why anyone would call her a biased hypocrite. She is extremely nice and a good teacher.  Unfortunately, some of the class content overlaps a great deal with psych 100 so you may be especially bored at times if you are a psych major (or very good in psych).  Some interesting material though, but you do need to study.
biased hypocrite
sweet but careless teacher
No Comments

Friendly and funny professor.  She seems very interested in the material and encourages lots of class discussion.  Exams were multiple choice and pretty tricky; make sure you study the text extensively and take good notes, especially on case studies and experiments.  Highly recommended!
My friend took this in the Fall and recommended it to me so i took it in the spring of 2005. i really liked the course, and the prof is very nice and interesting.

I didn't think her test were that hard (you do have to study) and the class average was a B-, so it couldn't have been that hard. She's very helpful and funny. Gets the class to particpate. Highly recommended.

She's a really great teacher. She really cares about her students and is fun. Her tests are tough, but you just need to go to class and take good notes.  She gives you tips during the lectures. One of my favorite profs!
Tests are hard, you have to know the studies like the back of your hand, but she's nice and tries to make class interesting.
She is a good teacher. She's young and she tries to make class fun and interesting. You have to take good notes in the lecture, because a lot of the material on the test isn't covered in the book.

Sweet teacher, not a difficult subject HOWEVER she makes the exams EXTREMELY difficult.  On a multiple choice test she will make choices a. and b. be practically the same thing and choices c. and d. practically the same as each other as well. Very hard.

Fall 2025 | Dr. Carter is very nice and supportive. She provided lots of resources to help students try different approaches to writing. She did not make anything unnecessarily required, giving students the freedom to explore resources they found helpful/interesting. Very lenient grader, readily available during office hours. Highly recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is the best English professor she is very kind and understanding, there are only a few essays for this class and they are all open-ended prompts, so they were interesting to write

She is genuinely the nicest person i have met since I have been here. Love her class. Guided us through our assignments and offered great advice. Someone already said it but yes she occasionally has candy for her students. I would love to take another class with her in the future if the opportunity is presented! Seriously, take her.

TAKE ENGLISH WITH DR. CARTER!! she's actually the sweetest professor ever, super easy-going, brings candy to class, and has these cute little activities as writing prep for major assignments. you can tell she really cares about her students and gets very involved in your writing process if you ask! 100% recommend!!

Professor Carter is always willing to help, provide feedback, and make sure everyone feels at-ease. She checks in with students periodically to make sure everyone is on track with their assignments. For Professor Carter, you are a name. Not a number. She goes above and beyond with lectures and activities, plus she brings candy to class!
I think she was one of the best professors I've had in college. You can write about what you like and so there's a lot of room for creativity. Definitely an easy A.

She is so nice and caring! There isn't a lot of heavy homework until the last couple weeks. But those assignments were a part of one big assignment and help to do the final paper. She tries here best to make the class engaging and fun and is so willing to help you anyway she can. TAKE HER CLASS. She's so great.

She was a great teacher for English 100. Her lectures were very easy to understand and we did a lot of group discussions and group feedback. We had several essays to write, and she was very helpful when I asked for assistance. Our last essay was a research essay and she even gave me some suggestions for some books. Overall she was very kind.

i love prof carter! all the reviews are accurate shes one of the best at UMBC! so so sweet she truly cares about her students and what they have to say. u can write about topics u want! def would take her again if i could!!!

Shes very caring, gives candy on special occasions, lenient grader but also gives good feedback. There is 4 papers to write, all about 1000 words, and a research paper, 2000 words U GET TO WRITE ABOUT THE THINGS U WANT! Highly reccommend, and would even waiting another semester if u couldn't get her as ur ENG professor

Professor Carter was very nice. The feedback she provided on assignments was very valuable. The assignments themselves are easy. There is quite a bit of writing in the class though but nothing unmanageable. Overall, it was a chill and easy class.
She is such a sweet teacher. She clearly cares about her students. She gives candy too! Love her!!
One of the best ENGL teachers. She is so nice and sweet.

Honestly she's one of the best English professors at umbc, she's very lenient and understanding. The class was fun because she let us mostly write about topics we were interested in. I would take her again if I could, 10/10 recommend.

She's a very sweet person and the class isn't hard at all. You will have to write a couple of long papers, but you basically have the freedom to write about anything you want. She is also very caring and lenient.
Very nice professor! She gives us extra days to submit our papers and is lenient with grading.

Very kind teacher! I felt bad not going to office hours since they were so early, I would've loved to talk to her more. She loves establishing a connection with students and she wants her students to get along and succeed. She asks if anyone needs clarification and will gladly give feedback or explanations.
One of the nicest professors at UMBC. Understands that students are busy with major-related courses and does her best to accommodate the workload accordingly. Lenient with grading and helpful.

Professor Carter is very kind. The readings she gives are helpful and assignments are not hard at all. She gives the hardest stuff at the beginning of the semester so that you have more time to focus on other classes at the end. She is very considerate and approachable.
best english professor!!

This. Professor. Is. Amazing. I am still currently taking her class and I have no complaints. This class is an easy A if you just put in the work. I have had 0 exams so far, mainly just papers, which is perfect since I am not the best test taker. She truly cares about all of her students and she loves what she does. Sweetest soul ever.
If you can take her as a professor, do it!! She is so sweet and understanding and very lenient with deadlines! She also gave candy on the first day!!

Professor Carter is such a lovely person, she truly cares about her students and wants them to succeed. I would totally recommend her for any student that wants a hands on instructor that will focus of them individually.

Carter is an incredibly sweet and approachable professor who brings candy every class! The workload for Eng 100 is very manageable and is comprised of three papers, one annotated bibliography, and one group project. Super flexible and understanding. Has a very laidback atmosphere. Would def take her again.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Really sweet professor and the exams questions are taken from the textbook and she lets you have a note sheet and you can get some of the points back. She also brings candy to class and is easy to talk to!
she is the sweetest person you will meet!! always ready to help

Very easy class, can find textbooks for free online. One research paper, a group project and exams are open note and she takes the questions from the textbook and it has the answer key. Very nice Professor and class was easy.

Professor Carter is quite literally the easiest and sweetest professor for English 100 ever! Work comprised of three papers, one annotated bibliography, and one group project. She brings candy every class, and the workload is exceptionally manageable because she is very flexible and understanding. Take her!!
Excellent teacher, brings candy to class every morning. Very relaxed atmosphere. Almost suspicious how nice she is! If you have to take English, she's the way to go.

I was struggling a lot with attendance and turning in work on time. Professor Carter is very understanding, sweet, and flexible. She also would bring candy to classes every morning, and is overall cheery. The class requires some reading and one group project. I really recommend any class she teaches.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Chang's teaching style is very fast and technical, and his notes are worthless. He's condescending when you come to OH with a question about the difficult homework. I'm not sure what happened after 2020, but the reviews from then DO NOT reflect his current behavior. The course itself is hard, but he makes it harder than it needs to be.

Awesome professor. The course content is extremely valuable if you want to go more in depth with CS, specially if you're interested in compilers. Course is only as difficult as your schedule, make sure to read the textbook and learn Haskell. The exams are reasonable and the homeworks can be challenging. Do the practice questions in the textbook :^)

definitely very exam heavy but prepares you well and provides practice exams. lectures are helpful and hes generally a very lenient chill professor. he gave us extra credit and is lenient with the grade cutoff, which helped me get an a. he also grades very fairly.

Kind and funny professor, but has very high expectations. Homeworks are difficult, so going to office hours is a must. Most of your grade is 6 quizzes and the final exam, which are similar to the homework. Overall a hard class, but doable if you put in the time.

CMSC 331 is an objectively tough course.  Regardless, he cares about the class and teaches well (although a bit boring sometimes).  We use Haskell as our programming language, and some of the homeworks are a bit difficult.  The slides will be your best friend for exams.  Utilize office hours and any external help if possible.
