reviews.comment: She was an amazing professor and knows how to teach difficult topics easily!

Truly one of the best professors she deserves a raise! She makes accounting easy to understand and enjoyable to learn. Exams are take home, and homework is due every Sunday at 11:59 PM, which gives students flexibility. Honestly, I couldn't ask for a better instructor.

Professor Kelly is great at teaching, she breaks it down and goes over questions similar to the HW & test. There was EC for all tests, & she dropped the lowest test and HW. I suggest going to the lectures until you are confident in the material, and even then, keep going, she gave EC one time for showing up. Tests are way easier than homework.

Prof. Kelly is awesome! I dislike accounting but I can admit she is a great teacher who's clearly passionate. The weekly workload consists of watching a recorded lectures that's around an hour, homework on Pearson, and a discussion board. She makes going to class optional but I'd still recommend it

Prof Kelly is a great ACCT prof. Her online class was clear, and lecture attendance was not mandatory, just watch a video every week. 4 exams, HW every week, and a project at the end. Helpful tip: work on the project every week starting early. You will thank yourself later. Would def take her again for an ACCT class.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Great professor! Very helpful and easy to reach out to if you need help understanding something. the class isn't that  hard either. takes attendance once a week. really cares for her students
So nice and actually cares about her students and the content she teaches!!!!! Take if you can 100%

I love Professor Kelly! She is so kind and allows for a lot of room to bounce back if you fall behind in her class. There's extra credit assignments that help a lot with boosting your grade. The tests and all home works are online so it's all easy.

Class was asynch, but was set up really well. Prof had required lecture recordings to watch, but they were really helpful to understand material. Grade is based on weekly reflections on lecture, homework (unlimited attempts on Pearson), study plan (on Pearson), 3 exams (on Pearson), and a final exam. Gives extra credit if you do the test reviews.

Very nice and understanding of her students. She takes attendance on random days, but if you miss it, you can watch her vids to make up for it. Gives out random points. Tests are online and don't require a lockdown browser, and she gives you a couple of days to do it. If you get 75% or more on exam reviews, she adds points to your test.

She is great. Little skeptical when she said that it was her first class as a professor, but she did not disappoint. Exams are simple and straight out of the text book and lectures are very engaging and interesting. Shes young so she relates to her students unlike other professors
The tests are pretty easy if you pay attention to the material, and you have unlimited tries on the homework. Super nice, best ECON teacher I've ever had.

She is a great professor! She responds to emails so fast its amazing! Her attention and care towards students is unbelievable! Even though I hate accounting, she made it less painful. Everyone please take this professor!

She is really understanding, and she cares about your grades! She gives out extra credit before the exams and if you do well on them she gives you points towards the exams. attendance really matters in this class if you want to pass and review the material is necessary. Overall I would definitely recommend taking.
Very kind man, class is straight forward and he gives many resources to prepare for exams

Very sweet professor. His in person lecture are review of the main lessons which are online on Panapto. Increase the video speed to at least 2x cause he talks super slow, listen carefully and takes notes. A tiny / fair of effort will really help you understand the class.

Prof. P is a little boring most of the time. The grades are mainly HW and MC exams. I feel like the HW helps you prepare for the exam pretty well. It's a very calm and easy macro-econ experience. Do the HW, try on the exams, and an A should be within reach.

Professor Palmateer is a very thoughtful, available professor. Textbook optional as prof posts video lectures on blackboard. Four easy (if you attend lecture) multiple-choice exams. Must do most extra credit for any grade impact. Extra credit is a great study tool for exams, so I recommend doing it. Highly recommend it for an easy Macro experience.

This class is super easy if you just show up and pay attention. Palmateer is super nice and chill and the way he weights the midterms makes it really easy to do well. There's a lot of homework assignments so pay attention to due dates.

The professor was nice and not strict. He taught the class very well to understand the contents. The class was neither hard nor easy but it never made me feel overwhelmed. The homeworks really helped with studying for the exams.
Relatively easy if you watch the videos and do the work
He makes economics very understandable and his lectures make a lot of sense. He's very clear in his expectations.

For his online class, he records his lectures and also holds a live session every week. You will have required assignments every week and he gives students optional assignments for extra credit. Three exams and a final as usual. Exams are multiple choices. If you do your homework and understand your lesson, you will be fine.
Lectures were extremely boring and dry, but maybe it is because I am not an Econ major. Tests were very hard, but he offered enough extra credit that I passed.

reviews.comment: Gave us extra credit (2%) for doing course evaluations, on MyEconLab you can redo each problem up to 3 times, tests aren't bad and always had two extra credit questions, takes attendance at random

reviews.comment: Nice Professor. There were a lot of little tests here and there but if you study moderately, you will find them easy. He tells dry jokes in class and takes attendance randomly. Also curves.

Great professor! Lectures are straightforward with everything you need and tests are very easy and every test has super easy extra credit questions. Theres also other extra credit options and homework is easy. Very smart and friendly I would love to have him as a teacher again.
Great teacher, very understanding, honest opinions and lectures are up to date.

One of the best professors at UMBC. Professor Palmateer is very easy going, and good at explaining course materials. You should pass with an A or a B if you go to every single lecture. He gives out extra credit for attendance so make sure you go to class . You don't even have to read the book if you go to class. Overall one of my favorite professor
Very good, kind, and knowledgebale professor
Professor Palmateer is a great professor! He explains all material very clearly and the exams aren't too bad. He compares topics to everyday life to make it more easily understandable.
Hope you like food conversations.....

Joeg can teach! Doesn't just read the slides but works out example problems on the board, and will answer all your questions. ATTEND CLASS, start the weekly hw early, test prep with the slides. I found the textbook necessary for figuring out the tougher hw problems. Dropped lowest-scored question on tests, dropped lowest-scored quiz, test, and hw.
Kind professor who cares about his students. Knows his stuff and exams were fairly straightforwards. Lectures are boring.

Attendance mandatory. Prof. Joeg knows the content by heart. passionate about his work and will ans. each Ques. if asked. Course itself is extremely hard but he makes sure he responds back and help in any way possible. Writes on board using a chalk and shows ex. to problems. Has a discord channel which is helpful. 

Quiz grades are lower in class

Lectures are tough to absorb. His live coding in class is pre-written, so you can hardly call it live; other profs do it from scratch. When I'd ask questions about CS (ex. about stack/heap) somewhat outside of class' scope, he'd say "you'll learn about that in 3XX/4XX." vs entertain the question. He types slow. Not for the lecture-oriented learner.

Fantastic professor. His lectures can be a bit dry, but very informative. You can tell he cares for his students and wants them to succeed. Very responsive out of class and on discord, he also drops the lowest question from the 4 question quizzes. I'd highly recommend him for 441, know the material and it's an easy A.

This class has tough material but Prof Joeg makes it easy to understand. The last few weeks of content were more difficult than the rest (Turing Machines and onward). He is very lenient on quiz/exam grading and wants students to focus on learning rather than grades. Just show up to class and do (and understand) the homework and you'll do well.

Be prepared for his thick accent and a few boring lectures, but Prof. Joeg is a great instructor who gives clear expectations on projects, is always around to answer questions, and uses curves to help through such a draining class. My low grade was from struggling with the course material itself and not from Joeg, so I HIGHLY recommend him for 441.

Nothing comes off as a surprise in this class. The quizzes and exams are very straightforward. He usually gives students the topics the quiz covers a week in advance. Papers (projects) are straightforward as well. But more importantly, He's always there to explain concepts thoroughly and cares for students.

I skipped 201 with a test credit so I was worried I would be behind in this class, but Joeg explained topics straightforward and the live coding activities were helpful. The projects aren't too difficult because the rubric shows you exactly how they will be graded and you have plenty of time. Easy A if you don't slack off and do the extra credit!

reviews.comment: This isn't an easy class and there were times where I understood absolutely nothing from his lectures, however he is very accessible outside of class. I personally don't think I would've gotten an A in his class had I not been going to his office hours weekly so make good use of that!

Professor Joeg is a qualified teacher with experience that he often relates to the content of the course. Joeg reads off of the slides, but he is a very knowledgeable and experienced, and will gladly answer your questions. I appreciate the energy he brings to the classroom even though his lectures can be boring. Also, do not prioritize the sample exam they give you when studying for exams.
He's the best 202 Prof. make things easy to understand

Professor Joeg is definitely a good lecturer. Concepts are explained very clearly and he gives many examples. Do not be afraid to ask questions, he will be happy to address them. Hes rude and doesnt give extensions for severe injuries or sickness no matter how bad.

Prof. Joeg really cares about his students learning the material so they can use it when they enter the field. The lectures can be hard to sit through, but there's no need for a textbook if you do. Peatross is an amazing professor. He genuinely cares about your future and helps with CPA, resume, and business skills. You will do well if you memorize his PPTs, MCQs, and HWs. No textbook. He tells you what is on the exams exactly. Personality is straightforward, funny, and real.

John was the best professor I've had at umbc. Homework due every week, 2 quizzes, semester long project, a midterm, and final. He tells you exactly what will be on the quizzes and exams. Take this class!

Very outgoing and kind professor who wants to make sure everyone succeeds in the class. Promotes class participation for an active lecture environment, which makes actual classes more interesting. There are a few big group projects, but as long as you are willing to do the relatively few assignments and come to class, you will do well.

The kindest professor Ive ever had. There's a textbook but you don't need to read, he will teach everything during his lectures. He's really kind and cares for his students. Dr. Lee is very knowledgeable and nice, but his style of teaching is very textbook and you won't understand anything if you aren't diligently paying attention at all times. I'm taking CMSC 313 with RJ, and he's doing a wonderful job in his first semester teaching it. He explains concepts clearly using slides and his iPad, offers extra credit, and makes sure we know what's on the midterm and final. He's funny, engaging, and highly recommended!

Cannot recommend RJ enough. Awesome understanding guy. Took both 449 and 426 with him and they were awesome. If you review the slides on your own, no need to come to class. Participation activities REALLY help with understanding and applying the course content. He makes everything really intriguing - and he is very knowledgeable

Bro is the professor you want for all your classes and that bum gave 1 star cuz the class itself is hard. Very worst prof kindly avoid him and take another course instead of this. Tough assignments

RJ is by far one of the best, if not the best professor I have ever had. He engages with the students, is always available on Discord, and is super helpful when it comes to homeworks and assignments. Great lectures, homework was reasonably challenging but engaging and informative. Only tests are midterm and final, which pull directly from lectures and homework. Cool guy all around.

Greatt professor that is super available outside of class. Gives demonstrations and helps with the homework, provides lecture notes and recordings, very friendly. He also bought snacks for the class multiple times. Not much more you could ask for in a 400 level class.

RJ was pretty cool. He's relatively young so he's very relatable, while also being experienced enough to be knowledgeable on the subject matter. I felt as though his grading criteria was very fair and anytime I got points off for something I felt like it was entirely justified. Definitely recommend.
He's just extremely epic all around, nothing bad to say. Worth taking for electives even if you're not interested in the course material.

RJ's currently a PhD student, and is super knowledgeable about most things cyber. The class is pretty easy as long as you attend lectures and pay attention. Amazing professor, he is the only reason I continue to be mech E after failing physics and calc 3
Great professor, although I have been having a tough time with chem, physics and calculus 3 he is the only reason I have continue to like MechE

Great professor!  Had him for 110 & 220.  Got C's on both first exams but still passed both courses with A's.  It's hard to fail, easy to get an A or B if you put in some effort.  Would take again! Awesome professor. Class is a free A if you give any sort of effort. Gives extra credit on every exam, including final. Going to lecture is important, notes can get kind of messy. One of the best professors I have ever had. He is always willing to help you out even outside of class. He is a very caring person and wants to help you succeed. Take him whenever possible!

Washington is a super chill prof, he cares a lot about his students' success (he even moved back an exam from Thurs to Tues when he was told that a majority of the class had a physics and chem exam that Fri). If you go to lecture and do the HW's, you'll do well.

best professor I ever had. he is a very caring professor and understand what students go through and how tough the major sometimes can be. Prof. Washington is a genuinely down to earth guy and really cares about his students. I love taking his classes, he makes homework and exams fair and reasonable. Great guy, please take his classes.

Lectures slides were confusing. Fair on explanations (in lecture/responding to questions), sometimes messing up examples in class. Not enough homework to make me learn material. Exams were easy.
Not a mean person. Just needs to work week-to-week preparation of explaining material

The best parts of this course are how organized the lectures are and how thorough the HW is. I just skipped watching the recordings and read the lectures and did the HW. That being said, exams are very easy if you do and get the HW.
While relatively little time was spent, the material was easy to assimilate -- this class was very time efficient.

He's a really nice and caring professor, just show up and pay attention. If you don't understand something just ask, He will explain it to you in depth. Tries to make lectures funny and not so boring or talking at you. Goes through many examples. Makes reviews and homework a lot harder than exams to readily prepare you.

Absolute worst professor I've ever taken in my entire life. He and his TA's take at least two months to grade anything, and when they do they leave zero feedback. reviews.comment: I'll put this simply - take this professor. He is one of the few people who wants to see every student get an A. Curves exams if the students have problems with it and gives extra credit. Puts practice exams online. Nice guy, and he is available outside of class to help. Only a few quizzes, and homework isn't bad. Take this professor
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: He grades so fast. I literally took the exam this morning, and got the grade back the same day. He's also really laid back and funny, so you should take him.

Professor Leips was very straight forward about what would be on his exams. He clearly explained everything and was easy to access outside of class. Overall great professor, I really recommend taking him.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: really good professor! He makes everything so easy and the lectures are fun. His exams are also straight forward. His office hours are also very helpful.I would recommend him for BIOL 142!!!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Single handedly brought my grade from a C (thanks to Bernie Lohr) to an A. Very knowledgeable, great lecturer. Take notes at lectures and you should be good. He tends to go a little fast but do not be afraid to ask him to wait a minute or go back and explain something or so you can finish note taking on a slide. Office hours are also very helpful

Prof. Leips was knowledgeable on the subject of Ecology, but I struggled to stay interested in his lectures. The transition from Dr. Omland to him was quite difficult, as he ran the course quite differently than we were used to compared to the first two months of the class. Tests were difficult.

reviews.comment: Pretty nice guy, but his lectured tend to be kinda boring. I appreciated that he really did seem to care about the class, and was willing to carefully explain things to students. reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: DO NOT BE AFRAID TO SAY "can you give us a min to copy that down?" If you dont he'll zoom past. He wants people to call out as I found out in office hours, but people are too afraid of "holding up the lecture for others" FoodForThot: if u think its fast I guarentee that AT LEAST your entire section thinks its fast. If u r confused, someone else is.

Very nice and the tests are much easier than bio141 and also bit easier than omlands. He curved the final (5%) which helped a lot of people. Textbook isn't 100% necessary, just good for back up / clarification. He also offered a little extra credit throughout the course so pay attention to that.

At the end of the semester, people were begging for a curve because that's how bad a lot of students did on the final. Becareful when you take him. But he knows how to explain the material good though if you go to his office hours.

Leips is awesome! When I took this class, he covered the ecology portion of the class and had very easy exams. I got 100% on both of his exams. If you're a Bio major you have to take him anyways but don't worry he's great. He's a really nice guy and is really interested in his field.

I liked this professor but his lectures are kind of confusing. He often made us do group work in the lecture hall which was weird but were easy grade points for the day. Exams were moderately difficult - he gave a lot of extra credit exam points. He's a cool guy but make sure to thoroughly review the book because the lectures slides were unhelpful.

Dr. Leips teaches the second half of BIOL 142 which is the ecology topic. He makes a topic which has a potential to be very boring, to be quite interesting. Sometimes is bad on posting things to Bb a little late. Other than that he is always willing to help you outside of lecture.
Dr. Leips is a fantastic teacher... he breaks down difficult material into concise and understandable concepts, is passionate about ecology & evolution, and cares about his students.

Definitely overrated. He is not very helpful. He's likeable alright, but as a professor you will not learn much. There's so much math and he only goes over things once. He's very bad about posting the power points and he goes so fast!

I'm taking a writing intensive course with him and Omland. I'm rating Leips right now because I just love him so much. His class is hard but if you talk to him more for help or just in general, you're more likely to get a better grade. He's a golden brown fox if I've ever seen one. He is not a silver fox bc his hair isn't grey and he's not that old

He co-taught this class with Dr. Omland.  Dr. Leips taught the ecology portion of this course, which involved a lot of math.  His exams were fairly difficult and I thought they were a bit difficult to study for.  He's a nice guy though and also uses a lot of real life examples.  He also puts funny stuff on his exams.

I don't even remember what this guy taught. I probably missed most of his classes. Still got an A in the course, so w/e. But that says a lot, when you teach 1/3 of a course and I can't even say what your lecture topic was! Something about marsupials, that's all I remember. lol
entertaining and funny, managed to make even the most boring subjects somewhat interesting. very difficult tests.

Dr.Leips is the 3rd Eco/Evo prof. and he covers ecology. His lectures are very clear, and he is among the most approachable profs. I have ever had. However, he moves through lectures at lightening speeds, so RECORD them. His tests are fair, but difficult. Study hard for his half of the final; there is a lot of math(growth rates and such).

His portion of the class' exam [5] is SO hard. I recommend that one be the one you drop, because Mendelson and Omland's exams are easier. To reiterate, drop Leips' exam and don't put in the effort to study for it; wait to learn all the content for this exam for the final. Leips is a cool chill guy though. Attendance isnt mandatory- skips CPS a lot.
2 descriptions: difficult exams and boring lectures.
No comment. Good, learned what I was supposed to and he was funny.

He knew the material well but I sometimes found it hard to know what he wanted us to know. His exams were slightly difficult but not unexpected or unfair. He seemed willing to help those who asked. Used CPS and groupwork to get students in class.

I thought he was the most boring out of the three profs for this course. Lectures are clear, but for some reason I had trouble staying awake in his class. Do the reading and listen to lecture audios before the exam in case you missed something. His tests were pretty hard, but the guy knows his stuff. Good looking, too.
This guy can be judgmental and intimidating if you dont know as much as him. Really play favorites towards those who are on his "level". Overall knowledgeable but subjective.
He was the 3rd teacher of the class, exams were not too bad, just a lot of math, but he provided the formulas.
Really boring lectures & hard to stay awake in class...he was the 3rd professor of the class. Exams were hard.
He's my favorite professor! :)
The 3rd teacher of the class , Ridiculus Exams avoid
Great guy. good lectures but tests are kind of hard if you have no clue what's going on.
Best prof ever! highly recommended and not bad to look at!
one of 3 professors, hes ok, his presentations are online, material is simple but you have to study! go to class for participation! go over practice exams!

Nice guy but tests are very hard. Grades completely based on tests. The lectures (material, not the instructor) are rather boring, however he only teaches 1/3 of the semester. Other teachers are more interesting. He DOES offer a curve.

Very good teacher, clear in what he teaches and doesn't complicate things in the exam. Very professional, good sense of humor and excellent knowledge in the subject. May not attractive the class with different accent or joles, but his way of teaching is very clear and understandable. Recommended!!
Yeah, this is exactly what you want in a biology prof - very knowledgable, good sense of humor, approachable and very helpful.
Awesome teacher.  Very passionate about what he does, and really cares about his students.  Very helpful to students, but why don't they change the class time already?

He loves teaching ecology, but teaches so slow that it gets really boring (especially at 8:30). Very passionate and always willing to give help when you need it. Nice guy. Exams are pretty hard. Teaches class with Freeland (Freeland teaches evolution part of class).

He is suuuuuuuuch as nice guy and a great teacher!  He really cares about what he teaches and understands the students so well.  Overall very very friendly guy and great teacher.  Really cares about the environment and is dedicated to breaking society's misconceptions about it. TAKE IT!

Good teaching, and though some people found him boring i was engaged.  Possibly because he's a member of the tag team duo of freeland and leips, the hottest bio 301 teaching team on the planet :)  seriously though he's good. take his classes.
Seemed willing to help a lot. Very interested in what he teaches so it can be interesting at times, but definitely has his boring moments.

Teaches the Ecology portion of Ecology/Evolution.  Possibly the most boring prof, but at least he tries so hard.  Willing to help if you can stay awake for his explanation.  Easy, passionate about his work and occasionally funny.

Super interesting and valuable class discussions and readings (there are a lot them). Be prepared to engage in important conversations about current events. She can be a tough grader and isn't very gentle or accommodating about things if you make mistakes or miss something. I would not recommend this class if you have anxiety, social or otherwise.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Discussions were the highlight of this class. There were a lot of readings but as long as you came mostly prepared, you'll get a lot out of the class in terms of writing and new perspectives. I would highly recommend taking this class despite the workload because it was the most engaging English class I've ever been in, even as a quiet student.

A lot and I mean a lot of readings, I found myself nervous before class because participation in discussions is mandatory, so if you're shy, keep that in mind. That being said, Dr. Tracy is very passionate about the class, kind, and provides a lot of support when it comes to writing papers.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: Overall she was a great professor, but walking into her class every day, I and my other classmates were definitely feeling anxious because she is really intense. reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I always find my self shaking before going to that class.She requires a lot of participation in discussion so if ur a shy person be ready to speak up.Besides from that she's a good teacher her teachings are interesting.A lot of reading but she really opens your eyes on how the world really is! Gives you feedback and isn't as much as a rough grader.

She's very knowledgable and passionate about what she teaches. A bit pretentious, but you can tell that she really cares about humanity and its future. Selects a wide range of topics and texts for the class. You'll learn a lot. She has clear guidelines about what she wants in assignments, and adheres to them. Stay engaged and adhere to guidelines.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Amazing professor. Clear grading criteria, not too harsh of a grader if you communicate and apply feedback. Extremely helpful if you seek help when you need it and overall just a great professor. Highly recommend taking her class if you actually want to learn.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

If you have to take English 100 as a GEP and want an A do not pick Tracy unless you put effort into the course.

reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Tracy is very respectable. Personally, I don't like English as I am a STEM major. She does make you read a good bit, sometimes too much. Dr. Tracy is a nice and cool person and as a professor not that bad. lectures are interesting and she likes when people participate in discussions. she is a tough grader though, she is heavy on correct format and even though she leaves feedback on assignments it's sometimes hard to follow. also if you're sick she will not let you make up work.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: She is one of the best english professors, the way she taught made hard topics not only understandable but enjoyable. Professor Tracy looks for participation and engagement throughout class. If you have a hard time writing, she will help you if you go to office hours or email her. Lastly, be prepared for a bit of unusual, but funny medieval talk.
amazing professor, super easy class, an easy A

Take into account that he's definitely very knowledgeable & that'll he'll probably improve in future semesters as he stated he was rewriting material for two classes. Professor doesn't stay on topic during lectures and doesn't teach what is actually on the homework and exams. Homework assignments have unclear instructions, yet the professor is a tough grader. This Professor is horrible at teaching he spends way more than half the class Yapping and clearly did not know what class he was teaching at the beginning of the semester. the professor teaches outside the curriculum and made no effort to teach us the C language or ASM but however expects us to know how to do it on Homeworks and Exams.

love her shes so sweet and cares about student success, but i would say for a class like psyc309 the amount of work assigned is a little unnecessary. i was not expecting the class to be assignment-heavy because the concepts are easy, but most weeks we have had more than two assignment due. overall, i would take her again, but she does assign a lot.

She's a really nice professor and her assignments aren't super hard at all. Some are a bit tedious though, like the graphic organizers. Made me feel like I'm in high school again. Sometimes lecture was boring though, but other than that great professor.

Professor Rose is a great teacher, she is clear and passionate about her work. She is overall a good vibe. I would def recommend her, she is understanding and as long as you complete the work you will succeed. Everything is open note

this was a very easy A. Just make sure you do the work before its due and tests and exams are open note. She is also very nice!
Easy A, material is not difficult just a lot of reading. Exams are open note/internet. Attendance is apart of grade.

reviews.comment: A couple synchronous online classes, most were asynchronous. If you're not a test taker, you still should be able to pass. Lots of reading. Homework- you were able to do some of it till you got 100%. Uses online homework software and quizzes. Do the homework and you'll pass. When the Prof would lecture, she was pretty straight forward and nice.

I did her online class and it was super easy. The course work is not that bad as long as you complete it before the deadlines your good and having a good schedule is important too. Her lectures are pretty nice too and you have to join the class in order to get your attendance points. Exams are online too and its open note. 10/10 class
Very straightforward class and easy going class. The prof is very helpful through email and class. Once you understand the format of the work during unit 1 then it's as simple as can be for the rest.

A lot of work however she is very kind and makes the work easy and accessible online. She gives clear deadlines and clear work instructions which makes the class easy. Exams are open notes and the classwork is fairly easy. Prepare for a lot of notes.

Very enthusiastic and made online meetings the best possible. Exam after each unit, but they are not too difficult as long as you take notes/study. Has extra credit opportunities and gives a grade for participating in meetings (which were only before each exam). Easy to reach out of class and the assignments themselves were easy.

Very kind and enthusiastic. She made all the difference (engaged well) because paying attention in an online class is already hard enough. SO much reading though, but you can work on assignments for each unit at your own pace so I guess just manage your time responsibly. 3% extra credit to your final grade, open note exams and no final :)
Participation matters and she's extremely judged and almost fake as an individual towards her students.

She is rigorous with grading and very condescending.Selfish and honestly narcissistic because she will tell you she understands your situation but will not compromise with you. For a class that's about caring for students with disabilities she should be more empathetic with her students' success.

reviews.comment: Dr. Rose is clearly passionate about psychology & you can see that through her lectures/lecture videos. She is energetic, helpful & provides plenty of resources to help you succeed. reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Fully online except for a couple of synchronous lessons. A lot of information though.

Easiest class yet. Mandatory attendance; only a participation grade from poll questions. Exams cover exactly what's in the textbook- be prepared to read! Every unit's hw is 3 chapters, 3 mini video quizzes, 100% on 3 Inquizitives, and sometimes a lab(s). Exams are open note + multiple choice so you're always guaranteed to pass.
Professor Rose was an amazing teacher. The class met once before every 5 exams. Those are the times mandatory for a grade. All of our assignments were simple and to the point.

This class was perfect for me. You do everything on your own time. Rose is super sweet, great at teaching, and you can tell she really enjoys it. She's got the enthusiasm of a real teacher, not just a professor at a research university. Everything was easy, there's just a lot of content to cover.

Class was fully online. Assigned 5 units with 3 chapters in each one. Super easy as long as you do all the work she assigns and the material isn't difficult. Extra credit opportunities were available to raise grade by 3%. Professor responds to emails pretty quick. Overall a great professor.

I freaking lovee Dr. Rose! Not only is she extremely relatable, she helps you to fully understand what you are trying to digest! She offers great feedback and genuinely cares about your education, wellbeing and if your fully understanding the content at hand! Beautiful spirit! She responds to emails in a timely manner and will take time with you!

Absolutely the most amazing professor ever! She answers all her emails within a day. The readings are little intense, but she has unit reviews and peer mentors to help you throughout the semester.

reviews.comment: I loved this class. Very easy. Also, she cares about her students and will further explain if there are questions. Make sure you go to class though. Lots of online work, but it's easy and fun. I highly recommend this for a GEP which is what I did. Tests are also fairly easy.

Overall easy hybrid class. Meet once a week to take a group quiz and listen to her lecture. Most of the time there were guest speakers in-class. She's very knowledgable and a great resourceful person in the psych department. She gives very good feedback on each online assignment and is always eager to remind students on upcoming assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Rose was a wonderful professor and I would take her courses in the future. She is very knowledgable and delivers material in an understandable format. Group quizzes are given so it is important to show up to class. It was easy to get in contact with her through email.

She is by far, the fastest emailer east of the Mississippi. She clearly lays out what she expects, reminds the class of due dates and issues, kind and respectful. She will likely respond to any question/concern you have within a hour.

reviews.comment: Easy and straight forward class. Study the resources she gives you.

Dr. Rose was a pretty good teacher in my opinion, she explained the material well and expectations were very clear. As long as you turn in all the work, it shouldn't be too hard to get an A. Assignments were always straight forward, never took me more than an hour and always got an A. The paper's requirements were also well laid out.

I could have taught this course. She had one essay and four short discussions. The rest of the work came to a total of (no joke) over 1,000 multiple choice, matching, etc, questions. These questions were generated by the online textbook and from online exams. This was a time-consuming, joke of a course.

Great professor! The structure of class was go over the chapter with slides, take notes, group activity that you would turn in, more notes, and then we'd leave. I had it as a hybrid course, and we had a chapter test every week along with a few other assignments due that week online. Read the textbook and listen to the lecture, and you'll get an A.

Hybrid class. Do online work and complete in-class activities to the best of your ability. Study for final, it coves a lot of information. The teacher is great and knows a lot about child psych. She wants students to succeed.
Overall very easy course. Make sure to do all online work as it is 60% of final grade. Lots of extra credit possible.
Took this class online which chapter exams and the final (an essay) were duable without technically having to read that much, if at all. Easy A.

Interesting

reviews.comment: Hybrid class. Submit work on time and get an A.

While this course was my only 8:30 class,  I surprisingly enjoyed this class. She was the most engaging professor I've ever had and I genuinely looked forward to going to class. Please do the extra credit- it helps so much. While this class was a hybrid, she explained material so well in lecture. She is possibly my favorite psychology professor.
Hot, friendly, amazing lecturer, gives fun activities in class, easy grader, enthusiastic about the subject and encouraging!!

Dr. Rose is very passionate about Psychology and you can tell by her vocal tone during lectures. She's willing to help! Go to lecture because there are clicker points and you actually learn a lot! I loved Dr. Rose! Her lectures were very on-topic and clear. It's easy to learn in her class as long as you show up for lecture.

Taking this class with Dr. Rose was great! Even though it was at 830, the lectures were always interesting and fun. Dr. Rose really cares about your understanding of the courses and will be happy to help answer any questions. I'm really glad I took it with her and I'm thinking of now adding Psychology as a minor
Great class.

I have her now and she's an awesome professor in the sense that she is very nice and she really strives for class participation.  Exams aren't too hard at all but only a small portion of the material is covered in class. Online labs and practice exams are your best friend for this course.  She'll randomly throw in clicker questions so go to class
She is really nice. although she can be strict, I enjoyed her teaching style.

Ms. Rose was an awesome professor. She is very nice and tried her best to make everyone understand what is going on in the course. I had her for both PSYC 331 and PSYC 332. PSYC 331 was tough with the stats but she help us understand the formulas while PSYC 332 was great. NO EXAMS, just a Final Paper. Make sure to go to lab to get easy points.

I had her in the spring. The course was challenging but she tries to keep things simple and interesting. Dr. Rose was very helpful both in class and during office hours. She also provided lots of extra credit opportunities. I highly recommend her for this course.

Amazing professor. She is honestly a breathe of fresh air, material can be intimidating sometimes but she has so much patience and likes to make sure everyone is on the same page. I would not recommend taking these classes with anyone else! I wish she taught each class that I need, I truly miss her!

The class itself is INCREDIBLY boring but she seems to try her hardest to keep students interested. Lecture/lab could be incredibly irrelevant and repetitive at times but they provided easy points. Final project was pretty easy.

While the material itself is pretty easy, she's actually one of the worst professors I've ever had here. For 331 she's not awful, but 332 is one of the most frustratingly confusing classes. She doesn't tell her TAs things, won't put important information online and is overall incredibly obtuse to deal with.

Took 331 with Ms. Rose, couldn't have been more pleased! PSYC 332 with her is the opposite. Lecture is 331 all over again, and a waste of time, other than a few formulas you'll need for SPSS. There is a big research project due at the end of the semester, they will not let you get ahead on it or give you the info. needed. Back to back due dates.
She is patient, and encourages us to raise questions all the time. Most importantly, she is the the hottest teacher ever. Everyone should take her class.

PSYC 331 is easily the most hectic and stressful psychology class a student can take. However, it's also probably the most helpful with its implementation of statistical formulas when it comes to performing experiments. Rose helps make such a dull class interesting. However, the TA (Julian) was very bad which can make or break this class.

I took PSYC 331 with Laura several semesters ago and she was still just as fantastic as everyone else described. She is sweet, encouraging, and pretty. Her lectures are thorough, clear, and straight forward. She teaches very well as a grad student. The TAs Barb Sara and Krista were great as well. Very good class.

Great teacher. Lectures with power points. Online worksheets, lecture material, and section over view. Very clear on what you'll need but exams are still challenging. Getting an A isn't hard, if you put the work in. Helpful TA as well.

Awesome teacher. Lectures are accompanied by a power point and she makes it very clear what you need to know for exams. Labs are extra credit and can be very helpful, but they are taught by the TA (who may not be the best...) Exams are very easy if you pay attention. Offers study guides and a lot of extra credit opportunities.
Super cute teacher and very smart, you will have to work for a good grade but she makes it very easy to obtain

horribly structured class. you will have to dig through lecture slides, announcements, and the syllabus to find directions for a singular assignment. She makes directions very confusing and projects are badly structured as well. Her class isn't impossible, but it's one of those classes that is so rough it will make you re-think your major.

She isn't a bad professor at all. However, this class is heavily group-project based. Most of the solo work is only homework. For exams, it was lockdown browser and in person. Exams were majority portion of your grade. If you study the slideshows VERY WELL, you will pass this class. Her slides are literally the same on exams, all multiple choice.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: AVOID HER AT ALL COST!!

I was nervous for this class after seeing the reviews on here but it ended up being my highest grade this semester. All you need is minimal effort to do well. Tests were straightforward and fully multiple choice, the answers lined up well with the powerpoints. Group project can be rough with others, so take charge. Very little and easy homework.

Class is incredibly difficult to focus on and actually attend, she spends a full hour and 15 mins explaining something that could be explained in maybe 20 mins. Assignments are incredibly confusing to complete, expectations are unclear, you will hunt through five different files to piece together the expectations for a basic homework assignment.

The majority of your grade is earned on three exams; the rest is the group project. The hardest part of this class is finding companies to work with to get the needed information for your semester-long project.  As long as you can find the companies needed and study for the exams, you should be ok.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is horrible. You can read the book and attend every class and still fail exams. Her power points are useless and exam questions don't even match them. If you're BTA it's honestly one of the hardest courses you'll take, try to read the book to semi understand what is going on in the class

Honestly the worst Information Systems professor I have ever had. Everyone fails her exams. She is horrible at putting grades in. You never know what your grades are because she doesn't input them in. The whole class fails exams but she curves them. If you have to take this class for your major beware and know it's going to be awful for IS 202

All graded at the end of the semester, even after the semester ends. Rubric is kinda vague and impossible to gain points back. Don't know what your grade is. The project determines the whole thing. Hard to get useful feedback on each part of the project before the grading is done, so theres no way to fix it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: truly a shame that a fascinating class is being taught by an arrogant professor. I was very excited to take this class but from the very beginning, she was very passive-aggressive and made herself unapproachable. I would have better luck teaching myself the content than going to her office hours just to be met with such a condescending demeanor.

Professor Kahl is not a good professor. She is passive-aggressive and her teaching style will not help you learn anything. Some exams contained information that we had not learned which made the exams difficult. She grades the group project deliverables harshly and doesn't submit grades until the end of the semester. Don't recommend her.

Her teaching style is boring and confusing. She never explains anything clearly including lecture, group project, and exams. You have to basically memorize her incoherent lectures in order to pass the exams (1st exam was 100 q/1 hr). Please choose another professor if you can for this class.

I had her for IS 202 in the fall of 2022, She was and is hands down the worse professor I have ever dealt with. She would have a "Study session" for the exams that would go over the PPT and then have completely different questions on the exam DO NOT TAKE, AVOID AT ALL COST, if you value your mental health.

Please do not take her class. She is a very mean-spirited teacher who will not help you at all. Lectures are all over the place. Will lecture about everything but what you need to pass the test. If it is between her and not taking the course. Plan to take it next semester or during the summer.

I think she's an okay professor, personally not my favorite. There's 3 exams and a group project that lasts throughout the whole semester. Exams are hard so make sure you take the time to study!!! She will call you on the spot to participate and if you don't know the answer, she'll make it seem like your stupid for not knowing.

3 Exams worth 60% of your grades / Group project was 30%
The rest is just showing up and doing small assignments. If there was a different professor, I wouldve taken them instead.
It's just not worth it.

I took her class virtually in Spr2020. I had a hard time finding out who my groupmates were via BlackBoard and email. Then when I found out, the "leader" kicked me out of the group instead of trying to reach out to me in the first place! Prof didn't help at all, was unresponsive to emails, and didn't even grade my deliverables without a team!

Lectures are unnecessarily complicated but the textbook/material is usually pretty easy to understand and not bad. Her powerpoints will let you know which sections to skip. Hope you get a good group for the group project. She teaches like we already know what she's talking about (even though we haven't learned it yet) but is a nice person.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Professor Kahl would try her best to explain your questions if you ask. The way she set up this class is very hard to get good grades. Pray for that you have nice teammates, if they dont work, and you dont want to do everything all yourself, you fail the project. Study the slides for the Exams. Grading system is a mess.

Kahls teaching style can be described as seamlessly switching between speeding through very brief notes and ranting in an attempt to teach material, but falling short of successful. She says there wont be trick questions, but there will be. She includes new info on tests and is also poor at responding to emails. Her grade book is never correct.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This was my experience in her online class. Material is easy, but don't try to wing it. You have to attend lecture; sometimes she rambles and sometimes there's actual information. Hope for a good group that works and talks to each other, for the project, so it isn't on a single person to do the entire project. Good luck, you're on your own.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Group projects

reviews.comment: she made it the most difficult class i've taken at umbc. avoid her if you do not want to have to retake the class again or have a bad experience with online classes. i was taking about 26 credits and i passed all 23 except hers, despite everything being online, & some having the same reqs. as her class. i dont recommend.

I had Professor Kahl for both IS 202 and IS 440. I really like her as a Professor and as a person. Very nice and enjoyable to talk to. Group projects was really difficult because group members were never on the same page. The course is basically a capstone course, so the material itself is not difficult, the group projects make the course difficult

The class is similar to IS 300. Stay away from the 3 hr lectures, they're just a drag. The prof tries to make it entertaining with a few stories and real-world examples. The 2nd exam is normally the hardest but was changed due to COVID. The virus also made the group project harder. You'll need to interview & find improvements for a real business.

So the class isn't that difficult, but Professor Kahl made it a lot harder than it needed to be. The group project is a systems analysis and technical proposal of a real company - requiring you to meet with managers and observe the company - but this was made difficult with Covid. She's not very lenient and lectures are boring. Read the book!
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Group projects--Tough grader

reviews.comment: You got to pay attention in lectures. You got to attended it can boost your grade at the end. You have a group project, which sucks, but make sure you organize the group and take charge for a good grade Three test, ten homeworks, paper, group proposal-project. Theres deadlines for the group project so its not the bad just stay on top. Good class
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Margaret Kahl is hands down one of the rudest professors you will have the displeasure of attending class with at UMBC. reviews.comment: This course was not designed to be an easy A however Prof. Kahl will help you out if you truly put the effort in your studies for this class. Study well and you'll pass.

reviews.comment: Dont take her class. She thinks that students are only taking her class in the school and give them a lot of work to do. During test if you move your to stretch she will fail you. She also checks your hats, shoes, clothes to make sure you are not cheating. You want to fail so definitely take this class.

FEW examples of materials taught, that end up being on the test. Powerpoint uses detail to a minimum. I suggest communicating with her after class for extra help AND using your group for studying. PAY ATTENTION and stay on track. You'll need to do research on the side for all the topics on the powerpoint to learn it all.

reviews.comment: Lots of work. Take the group project seriously because is 20% of your grade. She is not a bad professor but she is not the best either. Make sure you read the book and take notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: This class is much easier than her 202 class. Whatever she has on the board will be the free response on the exams. Make sure you read the textbook if you want an A. Take the group project work very seriously because she is a tough grader. Also, chose a good group because you will be working with them a lot throughout the whole semester.

Most challenging class for BTA majors. I received an A but had to work very hard. The exams consists of MC, T/F, and a max of 3 open response questions. The diagrams she works through on the board are always the free response questions. If you want to get an A, go to every single class, understand the diagrams, and READ THE BOOK.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: I think she's a great teacher, nothing like the reviews I initially read. People are paying so much for college that I think they want to be handed a grade these days, but she simply expects you to give her class a fair amount of effort and her expectations aren't unreasonable. The book helped me, I aced the last two test. Just study & give a care.

After reading the reviews on here, I was tempted to drop her class after the first day. Ms Kahl is not a hard professor but you have do your work. She is really nice and easy going. I am glad I didn't  drop her class because the class is easy if you do your work. You have to read the book to do well on the tests. pick good group members. NO FINAL.

It's so ironic how she is so strict on plagiarism when  she copies the PPT slides online. Overall, she is a great professor. Very boring class, you cannot use electronics at all in class- she will call you out for it.  lecture heavy and tough grader. Study and do your work, getting A is very attainable. Choose group members wisely as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Course materials include 3 exams, which mostly consist of free responses that of potential ones will be given in class, 2 projects, and 5 assignments. She gives lectures only for chapters 1-4. Remaining chapter lectures are given by the groups of students through presentations, as part of their current event projects. Grade A is fairly attainable.
Worst professor ever. DO NOT TAKE!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: 3 exams, everything is off of the ppts. MEMORIZE the ppt, she loves lists. All her exams are just list stuff & compare to a real topic, so if there is a list make sure you know it. Shes a strict grader & there is group work so make sure you have a good group. Avoid if possible-doesnt teach, just reads off ppts. Attendance is mandatory, but useless.
I didn't pay to have students in the class lecture me about course materials.
her exams too hard and everyone failed the first exam because she does give a study guide. i managed to get a B by getting a 75 on first exam and A on the second exam.

reviews.comment: She reads directly from the slides and does not input anything meaningful.  She makes the class much harder than it has to be.  Read the book yourself in order to do well on test, her lectures do not prepare students for whats on the test.  Do well on the group project,it will help your grade. It sucks that shes the only teacher for IS 202,440.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Kahl is a very boring professor, She does not use blackboard(strictly email only), her lectures are all just reading the power points, she doesn't add any input besides stupid stories. Always takes attendance so definitely show up. Overall, she's not that bad in comparison to the other professors. just go to class, study for the exams and your good

Avoid at all costs, seriously. Her lectures are about 20 slides long each, and she makes it take up the whole 2.5 hour class period. Her lectures are her talking without actually saying or explaining anything. Tests are insanely hard and the group project is graded like a grad level class. Thinks she's God's gift to the Earth.

Lecture slides and whatever little actual "teaching" she does will not help with tests.  Be ready to actually look (read: READ) at the book for specific details on lecture slides, they were on the tests.  Very anal personality,  but a necessary evil to BTA majors as the only professor for IS 202 and IS 440 during Fall and Spring semesters.

Terrible professor. She only reads off the slides. Expects students to read the chapters but exams are 100% based off her slides. She does give points back for any questions that majority of the class gets wrong on.
Do not take her. Very hard grader. Barely teaches. All lectures are from powerpoint...

She obviously doesnt care about this class. If she was a good professor she would know the material. Instead she reads word for word notes that she has straight from the book. Drones and boring. Will tell you words and concepts, but will not define or go in depth. She said exams wont be tricky. I studied very hard as a 3.4 student.I found it tricky

Do yourself a favor. DO NOT TAKE HER CLASS. On the day of the exam she decides to send an email out to everyone to bring a folder to class as a divider to ensure nobody cheats! Are we in middle school?? This is ridiculous!

I am an average B student and this class is honestly not that bad, but the professor makes it harder than it really is. For exam we weren't even allowed to look up because she would assume we were cheating... Is it wrong for me to look up just to think. Just because you look up doesn't mean you're cheating... Avoid her at all cost. Not worth it.

Professor Kahl is a very difficult professor. Either you have it her way or its the highway. Teaches directly from slides and slides are directly from book... Basically paying her to read the book to you. She is insanely strict for no reason and honestly seems like she hates her job. Most likely because she is an adjunct professor.

Be prepare if you take her class. She reads directly from the slides. There are three tests and make up the major portion of the grades. The test is quite hard but if you are study and well prepare then you should be ok. Just the reminder, good luck :)

Tests are a major portion of the grade. It you want an A or B don't screw up on the tests. For group projects divide it up and make sure everyone actively participates, you will have  better deliverable if everyone participates. No extra credit. Attendance matters if your grade is borderline. Class is boring so bring a pillow, jk.

Review materials for tests are not consistent with actual tests.  Some material that is on reviews are not on tests, and material not discussed in review are on tests.  Be ready to actually look at the book for specific details on lectures from now on, they were on the tests.  If you even look up from your test, she will give you a warning.

Didn't learn anything in this class. Would not take a class with her again. Do not use your phone in class or she will yell at you, and she is looking. Don't buy the book, it's all from the powerpoints. Her tests have you apply what you learned to real-life examples, so you have to make sure you understand everything or can BS pretty well.

She's not the best but she's not the worst. You don't really need the book. The info on the tests come straight from the PowerPoint's and class discussions. Make sure you ask any questions that you have in class because she's really bad about responding to emails. Overall, she's not a bad professor. I would recommend her.

Professor Kahl is very nice. She reads directly from the slides, and you need to ask her questions to clarify. No need for the book. She also either takes forever to answer emails or doesn't reply at all.

Very simple instruction. Class instruction is somewhat boring when she's only teaching from the PowerPoints. Study the PowerPoints PRIMARILY, but still read the book. The tests are EASY. 20 MC and 2 essay questions (usually). The semester long project requires WORK! Make sure you have a good team and you got an easy A. I ashamed I didn't. Good luck
THE VERY BEST PROFESSOR THERE IS IN Info Sys. This is the 2nd time I had her (IS303) and she is awesome. Easy A if you study the slides for the exams because the book isn't needed.
The silver fox is the easiest teacher i have ever had at umbc. take the easy a.

This professor is awesome. She is the easiest professor ever. You don't need the book! Don't buy it. Also, you can A's the exams by studying the slides and the notes taken in class of things she write on the board. I hope she is the same way for IS440.

She takes a bit of getting used to. She likes to do pointless activities sometimes but sometimes they help (quite a few are things you do directly on the exam!). The exams themselves are from from her lectures/slides. If you are a borderline grade like me, she'll bump you up for attending! DO NOT BUY THE BOOK IF YOU ATTEND CLASS AND TAKE NOTES.

I have had Prof.Kahl for IS 202 and MGMT 210. This teacher is very clueless. She reads straight from the slides and usually has alot of time left. So she makes up dumb activities to do. The project is very boring and is basically a time filler. Honestly she needs some new teaching techniques and a new curriculum.

no need to buy the book even though she tells you that you'll need it. the format of the tests changed, but either way you need to memorize a lot. She is very helpful and just study the power points. our last test was all multiple choice and T/F so i don't know if she'll keep it that way.

Prof. Kahl is a sweet lady, and will tell you exactly what to do to get an A. The course consists of 3 exams and a group project. The exams are directly based off of her lecture slides so DO NOT BUY THE BOOK! You'll never open it. She is a list person, so be prepared for some heavy memorization for the tests. Overall, not too hard for the 400 level

This class required more studying than any other class I took this semester, but was by far the least useful. She's a nice teacher, but her tests are really hard considering the essay questions are random and are about 60% of the grade. Her classes consist of taking notes from her notes. It's very important to write down everything.

prof Kahl is the worst instructor i've ever had. She didnt even bother showing up 4 class half the time, and when she did she was usually late. Didnt learn anything. Subjective grader. Lazy. Makes mistakes on her tests. Lies about having posted stuff online and sending us emails. Unreachable by phone/email. Completely unproffesional.
One of the worst IS teacher.

very easy course! She hands out all of the notes for the course, just read them and you're golden. Do not buy the book, you will never open it. She gives easy exams, and no final. There is a group project that she assigns at the beg of semester. It is VERY easy. She is funny and really helpful too
No need for text book. Really wants students to succeed. Tests are rather easy. Attendance is extremely helpful. One semester long group project- kind of sucks but plenty of time is given

She knows her stuff but she is a very boring lecturer and does not bring much fun to the class. Tests are hard, there are only 2 of them and both contain about 10 chapters of information, be prepared to study your butt off if taking this course.
The class is Very boring :( hated the group project and homeworks are pretty dumb.
She gives very boring lectures and a pretty stupid project, which she said a lot of students enjoyed but that was absolutely not the truth. Not helpful at all.
Very boring teacher, needs to be teaching high school rather than college. Handwriting is hard to read, pay close attention when she gives notes - otherwise you'll get lost.
A very fair grader. The class contains a lot of opinions and group project is easy and fun. Go to class and you will do well.
Great Teacher, Different teaching skills but knows her stuff. Very polite and helpful.
very easy, very clear group projects ,

All she does is read her notes & draw diagrams.  The class is easy and she is a VERY lenient grader on the tests (30% and 45% of your grade).  Not as bad as you may think at first.  Please get into a GOOD group for the project!

She's an "OK teacher."  It seems like she's just making up stuff at times, but she CURVES both of the tests (30% & 45% of your grade) so most people get Bs on each.  The class is pretty boring, but it's not hard.  Make sure you get into a "good group" for the group project (25% of your grade).

I took both her sys analysis classes. It seems like BS, but trust me, it's not. I've been a programmer/analyst for a few years. It comes in handy. Half of IFSM is learning how to problem solve. Her teaching seems like a bunch of retarded buzz words and theory, but that's what it's like in the real world. Get ready for it SUCKAZ!

This teacher does not do her job. She scrawls illegible handwriting on the board but if you don't get every detail you won't do well on the all-essay test. She tries to be helpful but unsuccessfully. A good third of the class dropped in the first week. The only good thing is I somehow swung a B, despite C's on both tests so there must be a curve.

Tries to be intimidating at first. If material is new to you then you learn a lot. I absolutely hated the sememster group project (due to bad group) but admittedly I learned a bit from it. Lectures can be fun. An OK teacher.

Took both classes with her and could not tell the difference between them.She gives identical information and identical examples on both classes.Didn't learn anything in 300!Test stupid unless work in field and can add beyond class level stuff!

I've had better professors...she brings across the materials well...just make sure you jot down what she teaches and you will be fine for the exam...the project is also a no brainer...Overall I give her a B.

Wonderful teacher.  Nice person, and knows what she's talking about.  Very clear about what she teachs and what she expects you to know.  As long as you come to class and take good notes (and study them), you will pass the class.
Very unorganized teacher. Seems like she is making stuff up on the fly sometimes. Didn't learn a thing even though I went to every class.
Doesnt exactly give you the most clearly explained test questions.  Taking notes is important, but doesnt mean you're getting the information that will be on the test.
Assigns a group project the first day of class which is due the following class. Each class consists of a group presentation. Where is the teaching? I pay to be taught....
No Comments

I took night class and her notes were helpful.  Get on her good side early and she'll take care of you.  Exams are essays and PERT Charts, and working out diagrams. Easy, just go to class to learn examples and get in a responsible group for the project.
Notes are not helpful, they are just "outline of the outline" (especially the last few chapters).  Talk too much about her kids and is not knowledgable about the topics.
Types up notes for you.  Favors volunteers to do chalkboard problems.

I am baffled in all honesty that she is a doctor of our discipline. At times when she can simply answer the question she'll tell you she already talked about it. She doesn't cover material that you get tested on. She expects you to read on your own. Turned the class completely online last minute and told people to drop if if they didn't like that.
In any case where a student makes a mistake, sometimes not even their fault, she says oh well and you just have to take a chunk out of your grade.

This prof is about as bad as they get. Her instructions are so ambiguous, she will never clarify and then will take off points for literally every little thing, even when it's clearly her fault. She quite literally will take points off for the ENTIRE class when her instructions are wrong, rather than clarify that she was unclear or made a mistake

Much easier for 421; 3 projects, 5 exams. The last exam is very easy; projects are super easy; professor nice. Lectures were going through textbook; lots of hints of what's on exam. Won't allow pictures in class, so get ready to write! Grading criteria unclear. Behavior also graded. Sometimes, we did stuff like paging & banker's algo on board.
no clear grading criteria made (projects) r. Lectures are okay. Prepared to read a lot
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Course consisted of four tests, and 3-4 projects. The projects had many little requirements and you're forced to start it way before it's due or you lose 10-15% on it. The tests were relatively easy, attendance was 20% of the grade and the lectures taught me nothing.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The biggest issues are with the project. They are documents that are filled with information that is spread out. Requirements are buried deep in there that will make you lost a lot of points if you don't read carefully. She FORCES you to start the projects early or you lose a lot of points. Grading for projects takes forever.

attendance mandatory. Explains projs. in the beginning of class and ans. questions as well. Easier 421 course layout compared to other profs. for sure. Has couple of tests in class on lockdown browser. Projs are lengthy but if instructions are followed then its fine. She does calls out students if instructions not followed. Can explai slides more.

Dr. Larson did not have intense lectures, just covered the essential ethics/writing skills. Not a tough grader, she knows this is a writing class for CS. If you put a little time/care into the hw/proj you can easily get an A. Larson's class is laid back, but that also means you learn less about the subject than other 304 classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: listen to rate my professor. If you can afford to take it another semester with a different teacher it will be far more worth your time. Project instructions are a joke. Attendance is mandatory, However lectures are her reading off of the homework. Doesn't enroll in CMI meaning you MUST purchase the ZyBook instead of it being included in tuition.

Very kind lady and very lenient grader which makes getting an A easy but she doesn't know the course material as well as she should in my opinion. Still overall it was an interesting class with ample opportunities for extra credit. I personally think the only thing missing was just a bit more knowledge on the subject since I felt lost a lot.

Larson is very generous, giving extensions on projects and open to regrades. The only problem I can say is her lectures. Usually, you leave lectures knowing you're gonna need to look more into the material later. One more thing, that's unrelated to Larson, if you're gonna take 421, don't take it with a M-chip Mac Laptop. SO many complications.

She is a great professor. I took 3 comp-sci courses with Professor Larson and I learned a lot. She allows us to be able to understand what we are learning and effort does have to be put in for a good grade. But at this point taking 300-400 level courses, you shouldn't expect easy. I recommend 481 if she is teaching.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Her ethics class was pretty easy. Only had two writing assignments, one research paper, four tests, and a group presentation. She does allow extra credit if you need it. Grading is lenient. However, she is a little disorganized and lectures are not that useful other than for tests. She is a nice person and understanding. Good class with her.

Professor Larson is a great professor for CMSC 304. I would recommend her for this writing intensive course, especially since she is a very lenient grader. Keep in mind that attendance is not mandatory, but there are in-class graded assignments that you must be present to receive credit for.

Professor Larson seems nice at first, but doesn't know how to teach well, and struggles a lot with technology. She doesn't seem very knowledgeable about her subject matter, and seems to not care much about the class and the students.

This is a great class, but Larson is not the right professor to be teaching it. During lectures, it was clear that she did not fully understand the concepts herself and was learning at the same time as us. The projects are not impossible if you have good programming skills with C and Linux, and they don't have a lot to do with the (poor) lectures.

The lecture itself is boring. In terms of a breakdown 10% attendance, 10% exercises, 40% projects, 40% exams. exams are all on quizlet. Every professor gives the same projects which are hard, and the reason for the high difficulty. If you show up and kinda pay attention you will get at least a B. Neso academy is your friend.

If you know C, and know how to read an API, you should be reasonably set for the projects. Tests were a complete joke in comparison, and weighted equally. Lectures were lifeless - she reads straight off the book. I don't think I, nor anyone else, retained any of the material. Somewhat excusable for an elective, not so much for OPERATING SYSTEMS!

Wanted to wait til the near end of the semester to write a review. She structured the class very well and in such a way it took away a lot of the stress of online classes. 5 smaller tests rather than the typical 3 large exams and she wasn't responsible for the projects which were the worst part. Class time mostly felt like a waste though.

Lectures consist of her reading off the optional zybook for about 30 mins, and then a 'breakout activity' with minimal context - rinse and repeat. Tests aren't bad, but they're biweekly. Treat them like quizzes. Projects are insane in comparison. She'll cover locks for 1 lecture, and then say "Write an IPC kernel module from scratch!" Avoid.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This is not a professor you want to take. Class consisted of her reading the book to us. Not even the required textbook, but an optional one. At this point, I am not sure she even knows how to code. She either won't or can't give you details about specifics of examples. The breakout activities usually have nothing to do with the projects.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Has absolutely no idea how to teach. This class has fully made me realize I really pay UMBC just for them to pay professors to tell me to teach myself. Takes very little time to explain very complex concepts, is blind to the situation of her students and overall just shouldn't be teaching. Seems like a nice lady, not a good professor.

Terrible. She placed us in breakout rooms today and my groupmate cried. She thinks she's teaching and just doesn't. She gives you maybe 5 minutes of her basically telling you to google and then shoves you in a breakout room to do an activity you don't know how to do. Very few people are keeping up, she simply just cannot teach. Avoid if possible.

Maybe it's the CMSC department's fault for teaching students C++ and python and then all of a sudden we're expected to know C beforehand to complete projects but this is the worst thing ever. pointless group activities during class and we haven't learned anything in relation to our assignments. Do yourself a favor and look elsewhere

I am less than a month into a class with her. I can already tell you the other review was not written by a student, in fact it mentions easy grading but was posted when we had no grades. She lectures with no slides, and any breakout activities are irrelevant to assignments. We've learned basically nothing related to the current project. Avoid.

She is an amazing professor. OS is a hard class, but she puts herself out there to really give a fighting chance to her students. She uses an online learning service with visuals that is great for learning topics and she is an easier grader that takes joy in students passing. Projects that are the same for all sections may break backs though...
Class is a relatively easy A but you wont enjoy it

speedran unlikability. vague syllabus. arbitrary contract-based grading system. 3 massive assignments due on one day. multiple graded assignments based on AI generated prompts. made fun of a student on day 1. made a race joke on day 2. all assignments are based in google forms, which means the due dates don't appear on blackboard.

Professor Vetter can be unpredictable. Some days she's nice; others she's snappy and passive-aggressive. For 210, an A requires completing the hours-long Capstone Project. Even if you do all the work, get A's on everything, and attend all classes, you still need the project for an A. She mentions this early on, but I think it's an unfair policy.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: You WILL get an A if you put in the time and energy. She can be a nice person sometimes, but the class is overall so weirdly structured (e.g. grade contracts) and can get an attitude. She is absolutely bearable, but if there's a better class/prof then go there. P.S. Do not be fooled by the single review that is "shocked" by the others like I was
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Accessible outside class
