William Smith is a great teacher who makes test material clear from the start. He gives you a cheat sheet for each test and gives hints to the material that will be on them. My main complaint with the course is the TA directed lab time, which is honestly the worst part. Overall, lecture and testing is fine. Lab projects will be a nightmare.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I had Smith Spring 2020. He was one of the professors to handle the online transition well! The other ratings are correct about quizzes/exams, and he gave us chances for extra credit on them too. I will warn: the structure of this class is not good to say the least. Projects have poor documentation. But Smith did well to help us with this!
Cheat sheets are allowed. He tells you in advance what slides are on the quizzes and midterms. He is the best prof Ive ever seen. It is easy A class if you study the slides that will be on the tests.

You are allowed multiple page cheat sheets on the quizzes and exams. You are told in advance what lecture slides will appear on exams/quizzes. The projects were time consuming but very manageable. If you want an easy A take it with Mr. Smith. If you want to learn the material, take it with Mr. Smith.
The best professor ever! Honestly, the best class I've taken. Engaging, clear, and actually makes you think. Not an easy A, but 100% worth it.

I have taken Dr. Rosenthal for JDST321 and JDST323. She makes assignments very clear. You must read in order to pass this class. Majority of presenting is done through PowerPoint and the use of YouTube vids. She will respond to emails, and she does NOT accept any late work.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback
EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Rosenthal is amazing! I took 3 courses with her. Her passion for the subjects shines through in every lecture, making even the most complex concepts accessible and engaging. Students are encouraged to ask her questions. I love her sense of humor too! Take her courses, trust me, you won't find a better professor out there!

Amazing and so sweet. Roni requires a couple discussions, but our homework was watching Netflix. Finals were all papers so pay attention to vocab and grammar (no Google Translate) as well as start early and you'll be fine. She had fun in-class games as well as exercises. No need to ask for Jewish holidays off since class will be cancelled anyway.

Do not skip her class. Roni makes everything looks clear. Homework assignments are optional bonus points and are great practice! You'd never a find another amazing professor like her. Roni you're the best :)
She's funny and respect her students! Although I don't have much background about the Jewish world, she made everything make sense. I've learned a lot from her lectures. Best Professor ever!
No.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Roni is excellent. There are weekly quizzes, 4 Writing Assignments, a Midterm presentation, and a Final Exam. Even if you don't have a Jewish Day School background, you'll still be able to keep up with the class. She makes Hebrew very accessible and understandable. The class atmosphere is very laid-back and comfortable. She recognizes hard work.

An excellent online class, not too hard and yet you do need to read the stories and participate in the weekly online assignments. She's an amazing professor and I'd love to take more elective/culture classes with her.
She is the best teacher. Clear assignments and is a very easy grader.
That's my 4th class with Roni. She's amazing and the lectures were interesting. It's a hybrid class so reading short stories at home and only Thursdays on campus.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: YES! She's just great! She cares about her students.  Only take home quiz :-)
Great class! I Wish I could take more classes with her
I wouldn't take this class with this teacher. Far better instructors are out there.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She is very helpful. You can ask her any question. She has TONS of patience
LOVE HER! She is just 100% AMAZING. Would take all her Hebrew classes again!
Don't recommend unless this is required.
Not available. Not worth the time. Not helpful. I would not take again.

Our class was a melting pot of people of all backgrounds, all gathered eagerly to learn from this amazing person. This semester I worked very hard, but not hard enough That's my fault, not hers'. She is an amazing teacher, and if you work hard you can do very well. Her tests are a little tricky, but she works with you to succeed. I highly recommend
Amazing Professor ever! The class is not easy, but Roni is making it so much better. She is just perfect!!! We all loved her very much!
Not a challenging course. Teacher has know-it-all quality, not recommended.
LOVE HER! Best Professor ever!

Unbelievably nice teacher, she is very patient and accommodating. If you're interested in learning the Hebrew language in a great environment, I highly recommend this class. Especially if you have a great class, including a jokester ;)
Roni is very patient and funny! Buy the book, make flashcards and get a studybudy since she isn't around too much on campus to help you.
A waste of time.

Best Professor! She explains things very well and will help you as much as she can. If you study at all, you can expect to get an A with her. Only 2 quizzes and you're allowed one makeup quiz if you wish. Make sure you buy the book though, she uses it every class.

Very nice, but cant teach. Jumps around a lot and is unorganized, doesn't cover units before exams, gets off topic 70% of the lecture, very vague and unpromising about homework. He'll say there's graded notes on videos, lectures, etc, but doesn't follow through. Exam questions are online and similar to HW.
Took over winter. Class overall was not that hard, it was just time consuming.
Do not take for winter. just dont do it, not worth the money or time

Hard to rate this "professor" as there isn't one. Completely async, Professor Thomas doesn't answer emails. 12 hws, 4 per month, each 60-80 questions so make sure to spread them out bc they take HOURS. 3-4 reallllly long exams, very hard, but just like the homework so if you study those, you'll be fine. One of those courses ya just gotta knock out.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He posts the lecture slides online so you don't have to attend class since attendance is not required. HW is 40 Questions, kinda tedious but you have 3 tries for each question. 3 exams that are 60% of the grade, but use the practice exams as their similar. EASY EXTRA CREDIT that is 3% grade points. Like 87% + Extra Credit is 90% so a mid B to a A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Class was asynch, but he does have combined lectures (not mandatory) that you can attend. Prof posted slides to teach yourself. 16 Homework Assignments with 40 questions each (40% of grade) and 3 Exams (60% of grade) - all on Pearson. Has practice exams that are very similar to exams. Would recommend as a passable 102, just very time-consuming.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Poor communication with students does not respond to emails and when he does respond he barely answers my question or seems condescending. HE ACTUALLY TOLD ME HE HAS MORE PRESSING ISSUES DO DEAL WITH THAN MY QUESTIONS WHEN MY QUESTIONS WERE LEGIT & HAD TO DO WITH MY GRADE/PASSING THE CLASS. If you take it online you have to basically teach yourself

If you have the chance to pick your Macro Prof. Don't choose Mark Thomas. All he does is read off the lecture PowerPoint, to which you have access any time. I essentially had to teach myself. And he is horrible at communication. He responds to emails very late and his responses are very vague. Don't Procrastinate the hw's are long.

The online synchronous classes werent really helpful at all so I stopped going after the first week. Homework is easy to complete but time consuming so dont wait till the last minute. Practice exams are super helpful since nearly half the exam questions are from the practice exams.

Would never recommend this class or professor, both are horrid. I had never seen this professor once, he doesn't hold any sort of lectures or have any videos. Of course, please take my opinions and thoughts with a grain of salt. And if you like a professor who doesn't really offer anything beyond a textbook, he might be your type of teacher.

this class was super easy, but since it was all online you had to teach yourself. You can email him with questions and he'll answer between 24-48 hours. He has everything laid out for you including when things are due!

I am international student, and all my professors gave myself more lectures or stuffs to self teach with than Dr Thomas. I feel like I was been robbed because I paid a lot of money to having professor teaching me.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: If you have an interest in blowing money and completing online courses literally less content filled than the free options online already, feel free to take this bozos class.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Not only was there no single synchronous session for a class listed mandatory attendance, but he also failed to post any materials other than the name of the textbook and some bare bones slide shows. Considering that, he had an awful lot of attitude and ego in emails throughout the semester asking simple and logical questions about class. Whack
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: An asynchronous class that has all work on Pearson my lab. Get the answers for those and you will get an easy A. He drops the lowest exam grade as well

It is basically teach yourself. He puts like lecture notes and it is asynchronously met. Everyone went to bb collab the very first day, but he was confused why everyone did. The 1st exam was easy since it is directly from the homeworks, but the 2nd exam was difficult since there was many parts to a question and some questions were on the hw.

Dr. Thomas is always a solid choice. All of his exams come directly from the homework, although it is a lot of work, so as long as you do the homework (AND TAKE LOTS OF NOTES) you will get an easy A. There are four exams during the semester but he will drop the lowest one. The class is very flexible and his group projects are very lenient.

The worst professor ever. Changed syllabus twice in the middle of class bc ppl stopped showing up. Had to do a mandatory play if we wanted an A in the class, regardless of how we did on the final 12 page paper since its WI. group presentations every class, super boring and a waste of time. take this class if you have to.

Professor Thomas is very funny and extremely knowledgable in regards to history of economic thought. Very reasonable guy! He bought our class pizza :) show you care and ultimately participate in group related work and you will be fine!

So it was an online class with him. The exams were a little difficult because some of the questions were confusing and you didn't have much time. It was nice that he did try to get feedback from students. Wished there were videos and not just textbook readings all semester. Cengage was used for homework, which didn't relate to the exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Prof. Thomas knows what he's talking about and his lectures are very informative. That being said, he wasn't all that organized, and the class was often confused with regards to the grading scheme used. He knows what he's talking about... just take with caution.
One of the most inefficient human beings that I have ever had the misfortune of interacting with. Definitely would not take again.
Took the class during the winter semester, but doesnt post grades concurrently with class. However, he is easy to handle.  Not a tought course. Should get an A.

Very tough class, but great professor. 2 exams (both ridiculously long and hard), hw worksheets (on all chapters and fairly easily), final paper (get ready to seriously work hard), extra credit (none!). Mark Thomas is clear, but I felt  he added too much to the course, particularly the material on the 2008 financial crisis.
Mark is a very helpful. He is easy to talk to and willing to clarify. He's kinda funny and smiles a lot when you ask questions. Pretty cool guy.
Powerpoint slides are very clear and easy to understand.  Memorize and understand the slides well and you should get an A.

Easy to follow and very helpful in class. Outside of class, don't expect anything. Does not answer emails and hard to meet him after hours. Class material can be challenging. And you would either hate or love your group project. Exams are difficult but just study (as in REALLY study) the slides he posts on blackboard and you'll be fine.

One of the toughest econ classes. You can tell that he has a lot of knowledge about the material but class lectures can be boring. Grade is based on midterm (30%), group project (30%), and final (40%). All of the exams are unbelievably hard and you have to study your butt off. He is overall very helpful and knowledgeable.

He is such a funny guy. His sense of humor is different and I think he is a good professor. He can be confusing and I swear he trolls you sometimes but overall his class is easy to pass. Just do group assignments which are very easy and attendance is not mandatory but I recommend it because the online quizzes you take are difficult. He is awesome!

Probably the most boring class I have taken. All he does is reads his powerpoint that has been already been provided. Passing the class is not hard. Quizzes and tests(the only grades in the class) are on a 4.0 scale, not percentage. If you actually want to learn economics do not take this class, however, if you want to pass this is it.
Great professor, if you have questions he'll answer them. Pretty straight forward passionate about his work, not just teaches but utilizes what he knows.
Took as a winter course. Material wasn't hard and had no previous exposure to the subject. All quizzes were online and exams had questions based on the HW/quizzes.

Enjoyed taking his International Trade Theory class. He is very knowledgable and is very helpful if you do not understand something. Does trail off sometimes but pay attention in class, review the practice exams and you will receive a good grade. Would like to take another one of his classes.

His voice is so monotone you will fall asleep, just repeats powerpoints, has about 16 online quizzes and 4 exams. quizzes are pretty easy if you do them friends, and he drops the lowest exam. Just read the book before the exams and you will be good for the class. easy class not hard to get a B or A

Class is boring, most people on PCs. Some irrelevant stories such as Michael Jackson's dude ranch is actually important. Book is useless. Econ quizzes are semi-hard if you understand. Write down most of what he says.His voice trails off so you don't understand what he is saying. Only has one office hour a week.

His teaching abilities are limited the result? A harder than it should be micro class. It is impossible to pay attention to this guy he is hard to understand. Everyone i know thats taking this class has failed the online homework assignments which is 40% of the grade. If you need to take MICRO take it elsewhere.

He was passionate about life but he did not focus that energy into his class. He is an example of a teachers that should be replace by a computer 1) He was always late 2) He used pre-made material to teach this course 3)Aplia, lecture outlines & exams did not match teaching or grading style 4) He did not teach; he read only from the given material

I'm literally sitting in his class right now doing this because he just babbles. Luckily, the class is easy in and of itself, but he really doesn't contribute to you learning it. He posts all of his lectures online so if you have half a brain, you don't need to come to class; even in the winter semester, its not worth the effort.

The entire grade is based on 3 exams. These exams are graded on a 4.0 scale so if you get an 89 your grade is a 3.0. Final grade is .3(Ex1)+.3(Ex2)+.4(Fin). The exams are ridiculously hard and because he just copies and pastes from old exams the questions don't even make sense. Each exam has 'essays' that you have to recall material word for word.

Quizzes are issued via My Econ Lab. There are no HW assignments for leverage so grades are based on all (14 or more)quizzes, 2 midterms, and the departmental final. The online quizzes are difficult and are far fetched from what is taught in the classroom as well as in the book. Take another Prof. if you have the chance to.

His online quizzes were so different from what he taught from class.  It was as if I had to learn what he taught and learn what the textbook teaches you.  This was a definitely hard class; I would not recommend it unless it is a prerequisite.

No textbook offered for class....good-luck....you better take exceptional notes but would be best to just use Google for every question.....all I remember from the class is that he always manages to get chalk all over him...does he not notice wtf....I don't think he has a car either I saw him carrying his briefcase down 195 multiple times...very od
I wouldn't have gotten an A if it wasn't for his Curve
He's a bad professor, I worked hard for this class and still he gave me a D. Take him if you want a D or C on your transcript.
Easy class in a sense that all quizzes and exams are online. Final is not mandatory. Quizzes can get challenging! 2 quizzes due every sunday. Curves. Good teacher but the class gets kind of boring.

Homeworks are easy, you get 2 tries and each try 3 guesses! Quizzes were hard but if you went to class you could use the examples he gave. He was pretty boring but he cared for his class to do well. All exams, quizzes, and homeworks were online(MyEconLab). He gave worksheets that really helped with the final, but you had to be in class to get these

he's profoundly boring. his voice puts you to sleep. stopped going to class after his lame example involving his girlfriend (laura), himself, and smoothies. take another professor. oh yeah, myeconlab rapes you every sunday

took him during summer, and his class is not very easy, all though i got an A+ you have to memorize lots and lots of formulas, if you have an econ major, take him, he is funny, and come to class late, no need of book, he provides power point notes, the test questions are 90% from the notes

He defines concepts well but fails to illustrate the logic behind them.  Obviously, nothing will be taught in great detail.  However, students must understand how concepts work to apply them successfully.  Imagine he's teaching arithmetic.  He defines addition, gives answers to problems, but does not illustrate how addition operates.

Extremely easy class and you don't have to buy a textbook.  He types the notes for you and puts them on blackboard at the beginning of the year, then goes through them in class and adds a bit of material about current economic issues.  If you've had any upper level math, sci, or engineering, this class will be a joke, it's just interpreting graphs.

He's a little spacey, but he's a cool guy if you talk to him. He teaches straight from the powerpoints which can be boring but if you ask him for help he'll help you out. His exams can be kinda hard but he tests straight off the reviews/powerpoints so it's nothing unexpected. His grading system is very forgiving too.

Strange guy, wipes chalk all over himself while he's teaching. If you read the lecture notes you'll be okay, but he's not really a good teacher. It's more of a self taught course, honestly. No homework, only exams...but that can really screw people over if they mess up on one exam.

he's pretty boring, but he is helpful and understanding. he teaches straight from powerpoints, and gives them to you and the tests are directly from the powerpoints. Gives out extra credit too. study and you'll do fine
Good teacher. Gives you all the questions before the exam to assist you in studying. Trys his best to help. Sure he may be mono-tone and boring, but just go to class and you'll do really well.

I think the man is trying to get fired.  He rolls in to class late, complains that the projector is broken, reads off the slides, and takes a month to finish a chapter.  He also kinda has this really creepy stare. He understands econ very well though, but doesn't really care if you find it interesting or not.

Very easy professor. Teaches straight from his powerpoints, which is kinda of boring.  He only tests from the powerpoints and buying the book is a waste of money because he doesnt teach from it or refer to it.

Very easy class.  Yeah he is a little boring but the powerpoints are easy to follow and he only tests from the powerpoints.  dont waste money on the bood and go to every class and you get an extra half letter grade added.
The only grades in the class are  midterm, final, and a webpage. You're graded on the functionality of the site and not on Economics...

OMGOSH!!! He gives Ben Stein a run for his money. He's so boring that you'll end up sleeping ur semester away. I haven't made too many mistakes in my life.. . but taking his class was one of the biggest ones i've ever made. thomas = soul draining

I've taken him every semester because he has a style that is comfortable and easy to get used to. I don't know what everyone else is talking about- I NEVER used a textbook, in fact- don't waste the money. He tells you everything you need to know, just print out the lectures, read through them a day or two before and go to class everyday- def. easy

Terrible teacher...reads directly off of the powerpoint slides, BORING, most annoying voice I've ever heard. Don't need to go to class, just read over the online slides before the test and you will get an A
Good professor, attend class to get the extra credit.

What a BORING class. He talks monotone and makes lame jokes at the board which he laughs at himself. Struggled to stay awake in every class. Tests are hard and have to read the book. Stay away if you can.

omg...i have never had a more boring professor...i struggled to make it to class every day, and couldn't even find the strength to walk through the door sometimes...the class is easy if u like reading the notes...but other than that he is so fricking dry and irritating...he teaches the class so u dont want to go...but takes attendance everyday

Worst teacher ever! Monotone and laughs about his own jokes to himself. Very hard to keep interest and pay attention. Dry material and just not fun. Avoid if you can unless you like learning from the book.
This is an easy class to take. Professor Thomas is funny and friendly and he only teaches in the summer.  His grading is extremely easy, if you try you will pass.

He did not even create his own lecture he read another professors slides in a super boring monotone way that makes you pass out. He is very unorganized and was late for a midterm and the final exam because he had to go make copies... His grading system is hard to calculate on your own i would avoid him if possible... hes not bad for econ 102 though

The hardest part of the course was not falling asleep. He hands out big packets of lecture notes, which are pretty much all you need (the book was useless). We had two tests, both entirely multiple choice. He explains things well, but is very boring about it.

Don't listen to these people.  Yeah, he's boring as hell and deliberately creates tests that are difficult but there are only 2 tests all semester and their curved like hell. You really don't need to go to class anyway. He posts all the problem sets and notes on blackboard and doesn't care if you show up or not. The class is easy.

I thought that this class was difficult.  The prof. wasn't very organized.  This had been the first time he taught the class.  I didn't care for the book or slides (that came with the book).  Test was directly from HW.  Weekly HW was a little long.
The class was so boring.  I did not go to the class except the exams.  But I still passed with B grade.  No need to study at all.  Very easy teacher.
most boring professor i've had, period.  Monotone voice, can't pay attention, makes the course boring.  i keep falling asleep, and half the class is playing games while he is lecturing.
Confusing grading system, but the class is easy, and he really drives home the concepts he wants you to know.  I got an A without even trying...

First let me say i got a B in this class.  But this dude SUX! I hated this class.  This most boring man on the planet. Tests were not hard but the report we had to do came out to be 30+ pages long.  There are much better teachers, find a different one for ECON!
Good teacher, exams are easy if u study only multiple choice kinda boreing and just plain odd i think he may be a loser but he knows his stuff
One of the most boring lecturers I have had the experience of listining to.  If you can make it through his class without falling asleep you must have too much energy.
Very monotone lecturer, but go to class so you can get the problem sets which are crucial for his tests.  Don't even need to get the textbook, just download his lecture notes.
pretty good teacher, but the material is dry and he just makes it drier.  He tries to add humor, but it just doesnt work.  easy A tho, so suck it up and take him.
If you want an easy A this is the class to take.

He is a nice professor. He gives 2 tests and a final and he hands out problem sets, which are straight from lecture and his lectures are online. It is an easy class.  I got an A and you are not required to go to class.

Dr. Thomas Robinson really blew my mind with how great he was at teaching.  He made the class very fun, and designed it to be a good balance between discussions and lectures.  He grades on essays, exams, assignments, and attendance, which is nice.  Gives great constructive feedback and facilitates the class excellently.  So friendly and kind too.

Dr. Robinson is a great lecturer, a funny person, and an excellent speaker.  He is skilled at talking about difficult and complex subject matter and breaking it down.  His classes tend to be essay and exam heavy, but they are usually relatively easy with clear grading criteria, which helps.  He is super friendly, accommodating, and passionate too.

Love Dr. Robinson! He is retiring but I truly loved every aspect of his course. He taught me so much about myself/life. Classes were more of a conversation than lectures. Go to class ask questions and prepare ahead for the exams/project and you are in good hands. He is nice/hilarious and gave me so much energy. Wishing you the best Dr. Robinson

This class was very simple to pass. I think there were 3 exams and 1 paper. The exams match the study guide and slides that he gives you. I found it easy to study because the information was interesting.  I didn't go to a lot of classes but I still passed. Beware of the in-class videos cause he takes attendance for those.

Dr. Robinson is an ok and kind instructor. Pros: Good lectures, gives study guides. Cons: Does not respond to emails, office hours are by appointment only (which requires students to email). Uploads Blackboard documents in rich text format instead of PDF. Documents have green background.

Dr. Robinson is like a sweet grandpa but don't let his demeanor fool you, he's very sharp and will laugh incredulously when you get the answer wrong to an "easy" question! He's particular in grading but fair.
He is really good professor make sure you study because you will need to for the exams most of the time it class was just a lecture and didnt really have any assignments but 4 exam
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I thought he was a really good professor. He was super nice and a sweet old man like a cute grandpa. His lectures werent too boring so I found it easy to pay attention to them and the tests were easy too. Just take a few minutes to do the practice tests he posts and look at the answers because the questions are exactly the same from the test.

The class is graded by 4 exams, these note cards he passes out as attendance (randomly) and a final paper. The exams are easy. As you take notes in class you won't need to study. He's a nice professor and cares for his students, but his lectures can be a little bit boring. Didn't learn anything amazing, but still an interesting, and easy class.

so you have to come to class because every now and then he hands out these notecards and its for classroom points and I barely went so i dont even know what im getting in the class maybe a c? anyway he gives out like three reg papers but the questions are hard af and really confusing so you have to break down every word. if you can avoid him
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Dr. Robinson rambles a lot and has very old-fashioned ideas. Honestly, at times he was misogynistic and generalized a lot of concepts, which is really bad for a class about culture. DO NOT need the textbook at all, don't buy it. It's an easy A but I was hoping to get more out of it.

Professor Robinson was a good teacher, he made the class very interactive and loved to discuss the viewpoints on the slides. He seemed passionate and knowledgeable about the subject. The only thing is that there's only 4 exams and one research paper used to get a grade, but the exams are easy, all multiple choice, the answers are easy guesses.

Dr. Robinson is the best!!! He is a goofty yet intelligent professor and it really made the class enjoyable. The class is easy too! Attendance is based on note cards given before lecture on random days (there were less than 10) to answer a super easy question. I wish I could take him for every class...

Friendly/chill professor. Likes to tell stories/go off on tangents during the lecture. There is a textbook but you don't need it. Grades are  mainly based off of your 4 exam grades so as long as you thoroughly study the review guide/practice exams, you will do well on the exams. No final, just a final paper. Interesting class

All tests are multiple choice and taken right from the lectures. I didn't have the book and I still got an A. No homework. One paper due at the end of the semester. Gives extra credit points for attendance on random days. He's kind of boring but the material is pretty interesting. Participation isn't mandatory but its helpful to make class fun.
I loved Dr. Robinson. This class was by far one of my favorites. He gives you practice exams that are VERY similar to the test. Simply going to to class and listening will get you an A.

Dr. Robinson  is the most boring professor I have ever had. We didn't do anything in lecture, there was no structure or point to his class. Dated and vague slides, irrelevant and basic movies. I have no idea how he could be rated so high.

Lectures are lively and fun. Professor posts lots of notes on Blackboard which prepare you well if used in combination with textbook. Lectures also help to clarify material. Dr. Robinson is easy to approach if you have any questions or concerns. I highly recommend him for this course.
LOVED Dr. Robinson and the class!  He is funny and intelligent; very easy to get along with !!
Dr. Robinson is one of those professors you will remember.He is very passionate and intelligent. Brings a great sense of humor to class and really helps everyone understand the material.

Dr. Robinson is one of the best professors I have ever had. He is very interested in helping students succeed, and has a deep understanding of Bio-Socio-Cultural aspects of prejudice and racism. If you are interested in gaining insight into psychological aspects of prejudice, stereotyping, and racism, you should take his class.

I love Robinson, he's such a great teacher. He's really intelligent but funny and down to earth when he lectures. AFST/PSYCH 350 was interesting class, and he practically gave exam questions. He emphasises on how the mind and the environment can predispose you to racism but also ways to address it. You leave the class really informed and not angry.

I took STAT 121 with William Slowikowski and had a great experience. He was clear, organized, and approachable, with helpful examples. Exams were fair and the workload manageable. Phones were allowed as graphing calculators, and charts were provided, which made tests easier. He spoke very clearly using the mic, and the lectures were organized.

He is very old and talks a bit slow but is nice. His lectures are ok, but you can skip a lot and still pass. Laptops in class were used during exams to look at charts, which he didn't mind. The discussion portion was not helpful at all, but attendance is not graded. Your grade comes from hw assignments, quizzes every unit, and midterm/final.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The professor was hit-or-miss. His lectures were fast-paced, but the TAs and ASC tutors were super helpful. unstuckstudy saved me with prepping for exams - way better than struggling with the textbook alone.

His explanations weren't as clear, which had me doing lots of self-study. Due to his age, he also did not speak clearly which did not help the situation. Thankfully the material wasn't difficult. However, the grading criteria were clear: 6/8 quizzes graded, 2 big homework, midterm & final. Just put in the effort to study and/or try to pay attention

I had a great experience with Professor Slowikowski! The four week course had clear grading criteria with four quizzes and a final. No homework, but recordings were available for review. Studying outside class was crucial. He's very nice and approachable, though sometimes slow to answer emails, adding a fun twist. Highly recommend!

Even though attendance is not mandatory I would highly recommend going, as long as you pay attention TRUST ME you will pass this class easily. Understand what is going on the first week and everything will become easy from there.

You should take Prof. S for MA215. He explains material well, and what's in lecture is exactly what's on quizzes and tests. Quiz just about every week, and 2 of 8 are dropped. Lecture normally ends early. Overall, the class was a 10/10 experience.

Prof Slowikowski is a really nice professor but his lectures weren't really helpful to me. He was always going so fast which makes it harder to take notes and learn the material at the same time. You are required to use tophat as it is where your hw assignments will be.

He's honestly a sub-par lecturer. His lectures didn't really help me, so I didn't go. My TA's quiz corrections are also messy and confusing. Some of the concepts are difficult, but not impossible. The ASC tutors for this class were extremely helpful and are helping me survive this class. Also make sure you sit in the front, he talks really low.

Professor Slowikowski is one of the best professors I have taken. He explained his lecture clearly so everybody could understand what he was doing. If you take good notes in his class, you will pass the class. His notes is the exact same thing as the quizzes. He doesn't change it.
Best math professor I've had at UMBC. Very old school with his ways but explains the content well. Highly recommend
Though attendance isn't mandatory I would highly recommend going so next class you wont be lost. Quizzes are exactly like the questions he goes over sometimes its the same one from the book.

Professor Slowikowski is pretty much your average professor. Quizzes are easy, just pay attention in class and do the homework and reading assignments that he assigns on TopHat. Definitely ask questions in class if you have them because he will go more in depth. The TAs are nice and easy to reach outside of class.

He is older then my great grandparents. He doesn't know how to add grades into blackboard so you don't know your course grade the entire time. He doesn't grade any papers and leaves that to his TA's. The TA I had didn't know English and graded awfully. I am already preparing to retake this course.

Not much to say really. He is fair. You get what you put into this class, he makes the material very digestible and doesn't bog you down with too many assignments. Pay attention, take notes and follow along in lecture and you'll do well. Skip class and you'll miss a lot of valuable info though. Assignments are all old school paper style.

Professor Slowikowski is a very patient person. He always took his time to explain things, and he was excited when we asked questions if we got confused, I am terrible at math and have hated every math professor I have ever had, but he made the class somewhat enjoyable. The way points are broken down, it is pretty easy to pass the class.

Stat isn't easy for me, but Prof. Slowikowski is pretty good at explaining. Lectures could be a bit dry, but really he goes through each problem step by step. Exams weren't that bad. Writing down the problems as he went through them really helped me.

He was a good teacher and explained the material very clearly. Math is not a strong suit for me but he made these concept fairly easy to understand. I would have rated him higher but he made so many mistakes when making the exams and quizzes that made it impossible to get the right answers. He did fix his mistakes as well our grades in the end.

I can tell Professor Slowikowski would be a good professor in person, but online was not his strong suit. As for work we only needed to complete the online homework and the weekly quizzes. You need to read the textbook to understand anything, which I find is better than trying to understand his lectures. Finding outside tutoring is recommended.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Prof Slowikowski is HiLaRiOuS!!! He makes difficult statistic concepts easy to understand. You can hardly fail his class unless you dont do practice problems after class. His quizzes are not hard. As long as you do your part go to class, study, do practice problems you will get an A.
He made all the quizzes and exams but if you work as a class it wasn't hard to pass it.

Reviews mislead me, didn't really like him. IRL lectures i did well, good at teaching but after covid very hard. lectures did not relate to test or quizzes and made it very hard. It a fairly ok class but you do need to work for it, very hard after going online. TA's are no help and are terrible. No extra credit or curves, but he does his job.
He is a really nice guy. Its a hard class but if you pay attention, ask questions, and stay in top of the homework you should be fine. He is funny and super sweet.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lots of homework--Caring

reviews.comment: Attend class, write down everything he writes, and you will be fine. Read the syllabus CAREFULLY. The class is quite boring but his lectures are easy to follow. He also held multiple review days for the final which will help you.

He's dry, but his lectures are straightforward and reflect very well on the quizzes and exams. I would advise taking detailed notes(basically everything he writes) in a notebook for every class, and study them. I received a 95% overall, and the final exam was straightforward but long! he has a pretty funny sense of humor.

Super nice guy. You need to keep up on the reading for each class, but he's very good at explaining and simplifying so we understand. Tests every week, so make sure you're always prepared. Lenient grader.
Grade is made up only of quizzes + tests. Hw is bonus points. Lenient grader. Great lecturer, teaches everything you need to know for the exams. One of the few profs at UMBC that teach

l will say this professor is very dedicated to his work. his lectures are pretty clear and concise. His quizzes and exams are pretty straightforward and come right from your lecture notes so there really isn't any surprises. i use the textbook for extra practice to supplement my studying and do each book problem.

I took MATH215 in the winter with him and the experience was well worth it. I learned a lot despite retaking the same course and did better on my quizzes than in my previous class with that other guy -_- Slowikowski knows how to teach and review for exams. He will answer questions and help you understand the material.
Professor Slowikowski is a great professor period. Get your work done and youll do great.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Coming from someone who is terrified of math, Slowikowski made statistics palatable. Though it got really difficult around halfway through the course, as long as you attend class and maybe look through the textbook when you need more information on a topic, you should be fine. Very accessible, hangs around after class in case anyone needs to chat.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Slowikowski gives good and thorough lectures that require note-taking. He's also really approachable and will help you outside of class/in his office hours!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Gives a quiz a week on Fridays, but they are graded fairly easy and it is a nice way to review for future tests. He is a really nice old man and teaches the content really well(as math teachers go). 3 Tests overall and they are hard, but he lets you make and use a formula sheet.

Im generally an A/B student, got the IB diploma with no Cs even, but I know Im going to get a C. The exams have wording thats confusing, the TA doesnt help, the teacher talks too softly and doesnt go over things as much as he should. My advice? Go to class and read the book. If you dont teach yourself, you wont pass. AND BE IN A STUDY GROUP!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Friendly old man. Loves kraft mayo and ford trucks. I took AP stat senior year so I already knew everything so the class was super easy. I didn't pay attention in lectures and did fine.
Awesome professor! Explains material very well but there is a quiz almost every Wednesday so going to the lectures on Monday are essential although technically not mandatory.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This class is terrible. There is a lot of material that is covered very quickly. We have class every Monday and Wednesday. There are quizzes nearly every Wednesday, leaving little time to breathe. Discussion sessions w/the TA are worthless because he and the TAs barely communicate at all and my discussion is on Wednesdays right AFTER the quiz.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: He teaches old school with a blackboard and chalk, but it's effective. Most people skip his class and can maintain B's but the class is pretty worthwhile so just go. His exams are fine. His quizzes are easy, but they're worth about 25-26 points with 4 questions, so if you don't mess up then you're good.
he is a great professor . he is old school. You will have to do with paper and pen. essay grader all you need to do is to take note and review it for the quizzes and the exams.

One of the worse professors I've ever had. He's very old school, chalk board, type. This wouldn't be so bad if he actually was more organized w/ his "notes" on the board. He's hard to follow & understand. His notes aren't clear enough to follow for studying after class. We also had nothing else to help our grade but quizzes/tests. Avoid if you can
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: "Old-school" chalkboard lectures and homework assignments out of the textbook. A nice change from everything being online. I still don't know how to pronounce his name, but I know the MA215 material.  He seems like a genuinely nice guy. Speak up if you have questions, he's hard of hearing.

He's such a sweet professor! Attendance is not technically mandatory, but going to class helps! He sometimes does math magic tricks during class and it always makes my day! If you do the homework and attend discussion you will pass the weekly quizzes with ease, the two lowest quiz scores are dropped! The exams are worth a lot of points so study!

Prof. Slowkowski is a super clear, easy to follow professor. He does not overcomplicate the content.I recommend reading the textbook because if you understand the material from there you really don't have to go to his lectures. However, if you are unclear on anything the lectures will help. Do well on quizzes and exams bc they're the only grades!
Great teacher! I took 215 with him and I really enjoyed his class. He lectures clearly. His tests and quizzes covered all topics said in class. He grades fairly as well. Take 215 with him if you can
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: I have taken this class with another professor and was failing. This professor is absolutely amazing. He makes the content so easy to understand.  I was really worried about this class, but I'm glad I took it with him. Quizzes and exams are right from the lecture material. Don't bother with the book. No surprises. Final is a departmental exam.

While not a bad professor, the classes are often enormous, and he is a quiet speaker.  I could hardly hear him half the time.  I've had him in two math courses and I've struggled to get Cs in both ( and I'm usually straight As.)  Be prepared to teach all the material to yourself, and only show up when there are quizzes by the end.
Boring, unclear lectures with quizzes and tests every week.

Professor S, was amazing. He explained everything out very well if you didn't understand. I don't like math AT ALL. He made it clear and gave a short problem after every example he wrote on the board to make sure you UNDERSTOOD IT. Just do the practice pages he give you and you're good!
Nice guy, jokes around with the class. Tries to make statistic interesting. Lectures are long and boring.

Loved this professor. He is a hilarious guy with many jokes. Statistics is not a difficult class to understand so the material, quizzes and tests are very easy. If youre not a math major  but not a math credit, this is the class for you

Everything but the exams and lectures were done online. He has a completely different teaching style than what you're taught online which makes his exams very difficult. He briefly reviews formulas in class but expects you to already know them. Overall, he is not helpful. Good luck if math is not your strong point. I wouldn't take him again.

This class was fairly easy. Don't get me wrong the material is not that simple. You do have to study and sometimes for a couple of hours especially if you do not know anything about statistics coming into the class like me.  Overall, I recommend the taking the class with him. He's fair and the exams and quizzes are easy if you study.

OMG so easy. Hes a really good teacher. Some of the stuff might be confusing, but when you go up and talk to him about it he is really helpful. HW online thats not checked for accuracy. Quizzes every week are nice so that you know if youre getting it or not. 3 exams, lenient on partial credit. Yea, Id recommend him

MAKE SURE YOU HAVE A STUDY GROUP, and at least a couple of smart people in it, and review 45 minutes before every quiz. I got C's and D's on my quizzes before I did that, then I started to get all B's & up. He's a chill guy, but he's hard to understand when he just lectures. He curves pretty generously as well ;D

Very hard to understand, roundabout lectures, unclear expectations. The material itself is easy but what's in the book, what's taught in class, and what's on the quizzes/tests are all completely different.

Horrible lectures, TA's never taught what the professor mentioned, Unorganized, non supportive. The department is not worth it ( at least for lower levels) and most people cheat in this class anyway. I say go to a different school or branch to get a better chance to pass and graduate.

This class was fairly ez & this is coming from sum1 who is terrible @ math. I do advise you sit near the front, he has a soft voice which made staying awake a bit hard. The TA i had was awesome, what i didnt understand in lecture, i learned in discussion. The quizes were ez, as well as the midterm. The final was very difficult so study a lot!!

He is an excellent teacher for this class. Despite what one of the people on here said, the TAs were incredibly helpful. They covered exactly what would be on quizzes and exams in discussion, it's just that people never went. As for the cheating that was mentioned on here, the TAs were well aware that it was going on and wrote down names...

If you need the STAT121 class, look no further. The man is very helpful, and his exams and quizzes weren't even hard. Make notes of the terms, and any examples he gives in class. Also, keep a list of the formulas, as most of them will be on the cumulative final. TL;DR: TAKE HIS CLASS!

He's so sweet!  Very charming and engaging.  He's just a cool, laid-back dude. The exams are challenging if you don't know exactly what you should be studying.  If you have the concepts down though, you should be good.  His personality makes the class enjoyable.

I signed up for his class because none of the Math 151 classes fit my schedule, and I was really surprised by how great a teacher he is. He's a really nice guy, and explains everything in detail. He can be a bit quiet, so sit close to the front. I feel like he doesn't get the respect that he deserves; he uses jokes to make math more interesting.

He is always at least 7 minutes late to every lecture. His quizzes are fairly easy but he makes test much more difficult. During his lecture, he goes over problems straight out of the book. He tries to keep students engage by telling drinking jokes. If the class is ready to leave, everyone stands up and leaves, and he doesn't say anything.He's okay

He's really slow. Homework is always assigned chapter ahead of his lectures, which is annoying. Quizzes are easy, exams are a bit tougher. He's way to quiet though, very hard to hear him. He never answers his emails and is often off his schedule. A very nice old man, but not a very good professor.

Old guy, but is slightly funny. Should at least skim the book a bit if you want to get an A in the class. Not too hard, and a lot easier than Ms Tighe but you don't learn as intensely as in Ms Tighe's class. I took calc AB in highschool so not too hard but there are new materials learned in class. I feel as if my class is a little behind...

I HATE Math but needed it for general requirement. Prof. Slowikowski made a boring subject very interesting. Likes to make jokes and tries to engage his students. Doesn't really say anything when people talk over him, which is annoying because he deserves respect and it's usually the same people that ask questions he just answered.

He is very straightforward, and his quizzes are easy. Tests are not bad, either, but you need to prepare more on your own because he does not cover topics in class with very much depth. The final exam is a killer, though (b/c he's not the only one writing it). All my classmates' had expressions of panic when we first saw it. It was gruesome.

I really love this man! He such a good professor. He is very witty and a little sarcastic. But for the most part he explains everything so that when its time for an exam or quiz you will be okay! Wish more teachers taught as well as him!

You definitely want to take him if you dont want to put too much effort in the class, you are guaranteed a B in the class if you do very well on the exams and quizzes. although you may be a lil disappointed on the final exam because tighe is very hard. He is quite easy but not as hard as tighe. But goodluck staying awake in class.
Decent professor that takes a lot of time returning material and is hard to reach. Useful and effective when teaching and tests are pretty good. may sometimes fall asleep.
Bad teacher, does not give any help. Talks to the board and doesn't explain anything. If you haven't taken calculus before take professor Tighe.
Slowikowski is really nice, easy going professor. He tests on exactly what he teaches in classes and is straight forward. This is an easy class, and doesn't require too much work.
Easy Prof

Slowikowski is a really good teacher... if you can stay awake in his class. He tries to make class interesting with jokes, but his voice will put many to sleep. Thankfully his exams are easy if you study and he grades easily. The final is not made by him and many have trouble with it. I think he curves a bit even though he says he does not.
Definitely try to get him as a calc teacher. Tests are straightforward :).. He's a really good teacher.

Calculus isn't fun or easy but it comes very close with this professor. He's very nice, very clear and easy to understand in his lectures. He lets you know exactly what to expect on exams, so there aren't any surprises. Definitely recommended.

If you are not a math person, take this guy. He is extremely nice and his tests are extremely easy. You have to study, but the tests are straightforward. No tricks. Take notes in class, sometimes he asks the same problems on the test that he went over in class. Drops some quizzes and HW's. There is no excuse for getting at least a B.
Great professor! His lectures are very clear. The exams and quizzes are very much doable which goes hand in hand with his lectures. Recommended!

This is one professor to try to get. He's super nice and friendly. He goes over the material very succinctly and tells exactly what is going to be on the tests. His class is easy because he lets you know exactly what material is going on.
Definitely try to take this class.  It is not hard because tests come straight from what he goes over in class.  He is really nice and friendly.
BEST prof. in the math department. This guy is crystal clear on what you expect to see on the test. Basically tells you what's on it before each tests. Highly RECOMMEND!

I didn't pass this class. I am really bad at calc and just gave up after doing horribly on the tests. I don't know how everyone else finds it so easy because I just couldn't get it. He is a really nice guy though, I just don't understand calc.

Mr.Slowikowski is an awesome guy. He is as friendly as anyone can be, and he teaches well. I would recommend that everyone sign up for this class. I just cannot emphasize how great this guy is in all ways... he is an extraordinary teacher. You will not regret taking this class, unless you are the kind of person who regrets taking amazing courses.
awesome teacher. straightforward class. only reason it was EASY is because there was never any question as to what you had to know. great professor.

Eh. If this is your last math class then go on and take him because he is easy, but if this isn't your last math class then you will have troubles later on. Honestly, the only time I really ever learned was in discussion. His class is straight from the text.
Very simple class if you understand all the tests you have to use and when to use them.  No homework, drops a test or two.  Go to discussion, it helps.
Wonderful teaacher.  Learned alot.  Quizzes and test straight forward.  Very easy.  ALways there to help even when not office hours.

Class is easy, lectures are clear (he simplifies the textbook), and funny.  Often uses spare time to show interesting math concepts.  Drops 2 lowest quizzes, 3 exams plus final.  Exams are somewhat tricky, just do a lot of practice problems to get an A. If you suck at math or just want a straightforward professor, take this guy for precalc and calc

he was a good teacher. his examples were clear but he would only do about 1 to 2 examples. the reason why i got a b was because i didnt do the hw problems. since it wasnt required i didnt have the patience to attempt the problems.
Attendance is important, his notes are neat and clear. HW counts as part of the grade, quizes every monday(mostly). I did not take the final and still got a B, so not that bad.

Awesome teacher! We did 10 quizzes, he drops the 2 lowest. Questions on them were basic, he didn't try and mix you up with numbers, he tests you on your knowledge of the procedure. Three exams, a lot of the exam questions were almost identical to questions from the past 2 quizzes. Final exam was made by another teacher, was difficult.
He really goes above and beyond to help students

best teacher ive had. easy to understand and very helpful. the math department is doing away with not taking the final but it used to be that if you had a 95 you were exempt from the final. im taking him for calc also. homework is not mandatory in pre but is helpful in understanding material
Very good instructor.  One of the better one's I've had at UMBC.  Throws some curves on the exams so you need to know the information, but the way he teaches the material that was never a problem.

Level headed teacher, focuses on key concepts.  He's never too stringent.  Tests and quizzes are just right difficulty.  Homework is a bit annoying, you have put alot of time into it.  Watch out for chapter 4 "Optimization problems" and chapter 6 "Shells and disks."  Those are a bit of a killer. ;)

If you have a choice, def. pick Slowikowski for calc 1. His tests and quizzes are extremely easy and how does not assign much homework. He is a great professor and if he was teaching calc 2 i would def. pick him again! If you have a 94 at the end of the semester then you dont have to take the final! overall, great professor and easy class!

I wish everyone could have him as their math prof. Very helpful, patient and nice, even when I had this very stupid girl in my class who asked the MOST redundant questions. Willing to stay after classes, etc. Easygoing, and always level-headed. Wierd sense of humor but then he's a math PhD

AWESOME GUY!  Not a typical math professor at all; he's more like your grandfather.  Likes to talk about sports and non-math related things to ease up the class.  You'll love his class, it's really clear and he actually breaks down the material for you.  Grading is very fair; the final is brutal but there seems to be a curve.  Highly reccomended.
Very easy going. goes over information slowly. class is very fair

best teacher ive had.....his 152 class in my opinion is a little bit easier than 151 but his explanations are very clear and the tests are fair.. too bad he doesnt teach calc 3 becuase i would probably take it with him

This professor is completely fair.  Homework completely relates to examples given in class, quizzes are based off of examples or homework problems, and the tests well, if you study a good amount for them you'll be fine.  (Prepare to take a quiz every week for the entire semester btw.)  Very kind man who is willing to help you.

I wish he taught calc 3!! Great teacher, especially for people who are not majoring in math. Taught in a very practical way. Tests are straightforward. Some quizzes have problems that were assigned for homework, so if you've figured it out by quiz time you're in luck. Attended every class because his explanations are better than the book.

This class is intended for people who do not really want to be in it, and that is how he taught it.  He took the time to make sure everyone understood and was incredibly helpful.  He slowed down at many points because we just weren't getting the material instead of blazing through and not caring.  Overall, and awesome professor.

Had Doc Slowikowski a few semesters ago for Calc I, and he was ultimately the BEST math teacher I ever had the pleasure of having.  Explains stuff well so it's easy to understand without any of the mathematics gobbly gook, and is ALWAYS happy to answer questions no matter how trivial.  Great guy and hilarious.  He will crush you in poker btw.  :)

Slowikowski is one of the easiest teachers I've had at UMBC. The class was at 8:45 so everyone was dragging but he would start off with some dry humor. Very easy, grading wise. Study the in class problems for the quizzes and study a little for the tests. I NEVER did any of the homework problems and got a 100% in the class. Plus, no final!

Best calc teacher ever.  He's just an all around good guy, all his quizzes and tests are straightforward.  If you can keep an A average during the year you can get exempted from the final.  I'm taking Calc 2 now just because of him.

Really wants you to do well.  His final was incredibly hard, I think I answered half the questions, and still I managed a B with a C going into the final.  Excellent teacher who cares if you understand the material and if you are doing well.  He slowed down our class at times so that we could spend more time on tough topics.  Great teacher.
Took the calculus class. Attendance is not mandatory. Quizzes every friday. Exams are pretty much based on quizzes. No Curve.HW can be a pain. But not as bad as tighe. Take him.

Slowikowski is a funny guy.  He loves math, is very sarcastic and humorous.  He teaches you what you need to know, and prepares you for his quizzes.  Quizzes are straight from the homeworks.  Tests are harder, but he works with you.  Final was hard, but I somehow managed to end up with a B in class.  I would definatly take him again for math!

funny guy. course is hard to begin with so dont expect it to be an easy class unless ur willin to learn. he's a good teacher but uses most of his examples from da book so sometimes u dont even need to go to class. great teacher, he even lets us go leave early
Love the professor. I HATE THE COURSE

Really cool teacher. Extremely clear in his expectations. Tests can be challenging but afterall it is a somewhat challenging subject in my opinion to begin with. If you want you can only go to class on friday when he has all tests/quizzes. Incredibly knowledgable for being a football coach. He also grades easy and curves tests sometimes.

This class starts off easy, but get really hard really fast.  You better get A's on the first exam and the first few quizzes to balance out your grade at the end of the semester.  He is a good teacher, but he always puts tricky questions on the exams and quizzes.  Watch for those...

Precalc was so easy with him.  He explains things clearly and thoroughly prepares you for calc.  No final if you have a 95%!  Also counts homeworks toward your grade so exams aren't worth as much.  go to class and it's an easy b, if not a.

Totally amazing professor! He simplifies the material so it's understandable, his quizes aren't that bad, his tests are very fair. Pay attention in class, take notes, study the notes. Definitely one of the best professors I've had, very approachable :-)
Slowikowski was a good teacher. Very clear in what he was explaining. No suprises. The quizzes are quite difficult, but the test are not so hard. The final...study a lot.

Great teacher for both Math 150 and 151.  Quizzes tend to be a little difficult, and tests are fairly difficult too.  Funny and good at teaching.  Don't come to class sleepy - attend classes and pay attention.
Lets you skip the final if you have a 94 by then, which is well worth the effort.  Easier if you have prior knowledge of calc, but not impossible.  Gets off topic, and entertaining.
good guy, funny at times yet very monotone.  quizes are tough but tests are easy if you study, relativly easy B, hard A unless you study a good bit or are very good at math

Slowikowski is a great teacher.  I took him for math150 and he made the subject very clear.  I'm taking him for math151 and he is awesome. makes some jokes which arent too funny, but he is an easy going guy.  i recommend u take him for both math150 and 151.

cool teacher! tells u whats important and does not waste time on small details. very easygoing, and always happy. he makes college math sooo much easier than it is. i had him for 150, and am taking his night class right now. sooo worth it! take his class if possible/needed :)

This is an excellent professor. The class (calculus) is by nature very difficult but if you are having trouble GO TO HIS OFFICE HOURS. If he sees that you are having difficulty but are trying really hard and you talk to him a lot (so he knows who u r) he will bump your borderline grade up
I have had Mr. Slowikowski every semester since I have come to this school, and I'm taking STAT 351 with him this semester also. Awesome teacher! Very clear and very helpful!
Definitley the teacher you want for math.  Easy, nice person who will always be there to help.  I enjoyed his class and never seen math so easy! TAKE HIM!!!

Mr. Slowikowski was an awesome teacher!!! His quizzes are pretty hard, but the tests are easy, and don't change much from the previous semesters. If you have a 94% or higher, you don't have to take the final. He explains things really well, and is very flexible.

This guy is a great teacher. He's clear, takes his time, and tells you everything you need to know before tests and quizzes. Go the class before Thanksgiving, he gives you bonus points. He is likes football and baseball and is very funny too. Take him.
nice guy, the class material is pretty easy and he goes over it and explains it well.  he lets people exempt from the final and the quiz/test policy is nice.

Great teacher, goes at a good speed and has very in depth notes. Going to class will definitely help to get a good grade. Quizzes are only on about 2-3 sections so its pretty easy. Tests aren't too bad and he usually lets you omit one. Definitely a great teacher!

AWESOME TEACHER!! class is fun and he cracks jokes a lot which helps make 2 hour period go faster! Tests are reasonable and pertain to what he taught.  Very flexible in helping students, and is known to occasionally push back due dates for homework!

Had him for 150 and have him now for 151.  he NEVER ceases to amaze me in that he is everything a good professor should be.  The best math teacher I ever had and damn funny too.  Makes a lot of jokes in class
Wonderful teacher, theres not much else to say.  Very personable, easy to go up to and ask for help.  Loves what he does, and loves to help you learn.  GREAT TEACHER!

Easily one of the best professors at UMBC. It's one thing to know the content, it's another thing entirely to know how to teach; she understands students like no one else. She made a year of orgo so easy to where I questioned why anyone found it hard at all. I hope my future professors can compare to just how incredible she is.

Gierasch is a fantastic lecturer and an inspiring chemist. Her lectures are informative, and she gives you all the tools to succeed. Do all the work before class, come to class with questions and a good foundation, and keep practicing as much as possible until the exam. Learn the content instead of the exam and you will appreciate Orgo even more!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Everyone knows Orgo is hard, but I went into the class thinking it would be the class that ruined my GPA. Dr. Gierasch made Orgo easy to understand and so interesting that it quickly became my favorite class at UMBC. Highly Recommend. 10/10

Orgo is a very difficult class; she made it so easy for me to understand and digest the material. You could see peoples' faces in lecture light up as they started to understand what she was saying. Just reading the textbook is numbing, please make sure to go to lecture. Her teaching style makes this class so much easier.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Pleasant lecturer who cares about students. Encourages setting time aside for HW, reading, and practice problems. Grades rely heavily on exams. Videos are manageable, and she uses tech well. Lectures focus more on examples than on new content. Start using flashcards early, as the material is cumulative. Must keep up with all material consistently.

I learned solely form the textbook. The lectures were all review she didn't even teach anything. Her personality one on one is unnecessarily rude. Just bc your a prof doesn't give you the right to be stuck up. Mark perks is the same if not worse but comparitvielt she's not as horrible at teaching as him

You learn solely form the textbook and her videos on blackboard are useless and so difficult to understand. Lectures are just review questions. 0/10 would not recommend bc it's all self study but she's better than mark perks

Dr. Gierasch was a very nice/friendly person and made a challenging class a little less intimidating. I learned mostly from the textbook though, which were required before each class and then the lectures just ended up being in class questions/polls which didn't really teach us much. Exams were pretty tough too.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Respected--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Prof. Gierasch makes organic chemistry more manageable. Her lectures are engaging, but the class is still challenging. Using resources like the textbook, Khan Academy, and unstuck ai really helped me grasp the material.

Had her for orgo 1&2. The amount of work you put in reflects your grade. If you read the textbook carefully and understand the concepts, the exams aren't bad. Sometimes couldn't follow her logic during lectures but would go back and review all questions covered in class, after reading the textbook. Understand the chemistry instead of memorizing!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I had Dr. Gierasch in 2013 for Organic chemistry 1. She was an interesting professor. She is nice; however, I feel as if her class is a bit deceptive. I remember our second exam well. Everyone did well, the class average was a 78% percent. She was not happy about that. So much so that our third exam was unreasonably difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The class was split between Prof Gierasch and Prof Perks. Her lectures were definitely better and made the problems easier to understand. However, this class in itself is challenging and she would often lecture us about not knowing the material after the average for an exam was in the 60s. Good luck!

Dr. Gierasch co-taught with Dr. Perks and she was much more thorough and creative in the way she presented the material so you can actually understand it. You have to be able to sit down for a long period of time and do a ton of practice questions to fully understand what you are learning because studying for Orgo is not the same as gen chem.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I loved taking both Orgo 1 and Orgo 2 with her. She explained things really well and made clear what the expectations were going into the course. She is available outside of class time and is very responsive to student concerns. The tutoring that was available for the class, which is run by her is also amazing. Highly recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: After taking orgo 1 with her, I thought this class would be easy. However, the exams are 80% of your total grade and there are 3 exams with ACS (orgo 1 + orgo 2 combined) final, not made by Gierasch. It only takes 2-3 wrong multiple choice on an exam to drop down to B. I would suggest to not take any other 300-400 level class along with this.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I had her for both Chem 351 and 352. She is super nice and available for one on one help all the time. Her exams are pretty reasonable. My biggest issue is most of the class is learning on your own and then coming to lecture for review of materials. She explains things well and enjoys teaching chemistry!
Dr. Gierasch co-taught Organic Chemistry I with Dr. Perks. She was a much better lecturer than Dr. Perks. She made the material digestible, which was nice.

Super dynamic and energetic lectures. Very helpful and friendly in answering questions. Makes organic chemistry much more approachable. You definitely need to keep up with the course, but then it flows really well.

She's not the worst at teaching orgo. I learned mostly from the textbook and Kahn academy, however. I've heard she can be rude to students but she seems pretty nice. She's available to answer questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Did not learn a lot from the class and you have to keep up in general with orgo. Exams were very hard so make sure to understand the concepts

Personally the WORST prof I have ever had here and single handedly killed any joy for chem. Doesn't teach jack and just does clickers the entire class 3 days a week instead of teaching content. Also refuses to acknowledge that her lack of teaching is the reason majority of her class is borderline failing. She was also extremely condescending.

She was my anchor even though I failed. I took her with Perks and Gierasch is so sweet and made up for all I didn't understand with him. Retook the class with just Perks but still watched her linked videos because she makes sense. Really makes an effort to know students and is accessible outside of class. Class is hard, but she helps make it better

If you get the chance, take orgo with Dr. Gierasch. She genuinely cares about her students and the class. The class will be difficult but that is to be expected anywhere cause it's orgo. Be prepared to read the textbook and do a bunch of practice problems.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Gierasch is the best professor I've had the pleasure of learn from. She gives good lectures and assigns work that keeps you practicing. Orgo 1 isn't very hard as long as you make sure you understand the practice exams. She also takes student feedback seriously and will implement it mid semester. Class was really fun and I wish I took it sooner.

I had Dr Gierasch for CHEM 351 and 352. She is an amazing professor who knows her stuff and genuinely wants her students to succeed. If you ever need more individualized help, she has weekly office hours which are super helpful. Success in Orgo comes from doing your own practice. If you consistently put in your own work/time, you'll be successful
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Gierasch is a very smart women and knows her material. However, I found her tone to be extremely boring and it was very difficult to sit through her lectures. My lecture session was at 9AM and it sounded like she just woke up to teach chemistry half asleep. It is a challenge to not zone out during her long pauses.
Prof Giearasch was very nice and taught/ explained well, unlike Perks. This class is probably the hardest I have taken at UMBC so far.

Gierasch might seem rigid, but the point is to make sure that we really understand the material. I can for sure say that the depth of my knowledge in chemistry has certainly increased after this semester. Drops homework, ICAs, and PCAs. It is 3 credits but I treated it as if it is a 4 credit course.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: B in 351 and an A in 352. Her classes are structure amazingly. Reading the section before class and taking a reading quiz ensures that you are familiar with the content, and going over the section in class hammers it in your brain. Also doing practice problems in class makes it stick, as well. 10/10 would take again. I still remember everything.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Gierasch was amazing and knows a lot about organic chemistry. She delivered content in an organized and logical manner. Exams were fair and she gave plenty of time to complete them. Organic chemistry is tough but working in groups and asking her questions makes it so simple. Wish she taught CHEM 352 online...

Maybe it's because chem 101 and chem 102 got me accustomed to this style of learning, but I would learn things almost immediately in this class. We would read before class, and during class the prof would make sure our knowledge is solidified. She def cares about her students, and wants everyone to succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great professor, I had her for CHEM 351 as well. She gives you tons of resources to excel in the course. It all boils down to how much effort you put into the class. Her multiple choice exams are difficult. Do well on PCA/clickers, do all the survey's for EC, and put effort into the HW problems and you should do well enough in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She is an amazing professor, even though the class itself is difficult. She gives extra credit for almost every exam and the final and spends time during class on homework questions that went bad. Exams were hard, but each one is weighted differently based on the grade. Take clickers seriously because they can seriously help your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Love her to death!! Best prof on campus!! :)

Do NOT take over summer unless you are mentally and physically ready to work on orgo everyday and use up all your weekends for 6 weeks. Lot of info in little time. Tests were ok. MP were hard, fr a bit better. Honestly, just do the LEARNING OBJECTIVES and do the practice problems. Do more than the practice problems, and you'll get higher than a C.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: As a transfer student, I only had Dr. Gierasch for Orgo 2, because I took Orgo 1 a year prior(!). While I've always liked Orgo, her teaching style took a bit of time to get used to. But, she's an amazing professor, and ultimately, everything she requires in the class is for your benefit. 10/10 would take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Gierasch is a great professor and will answer any questions you may have. She is very respectable and connects the material to real life examples which definitely helped me to understand. The material is very hard and if you don't put in the work up front, you will fall behind which is what happened to me.
