One of my favorite professors, hands down. Dr. G makes it easy for those who follow her advice. Read the textbook before class (it's one of the better ones out there anyway), come to class, then before the exams make sure to do review learning objectives, recommended problems, and old exams (this one especially). Also, goto tutoring or office hours
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Best orgo professor at UMBC. Orgo isn't easy but Dr. G explains the material very well and the book is gold. Read the book, go to class, go to tutoring and office hours and u'll get a decent grade. Read BEFORE class, it help with the clickers. Go to class, you get a good idea of what is going to be on the FR. MC is hard, Focus on old exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: The other reviews are mostly reflective of my experience. A pretty good professor overall. Exams are fair, MC is very difficult but FR is easy. Despite what she says, she gives extra credit as well as a reasonable curve in the end. ACS final also isn't that bad. I needed a mid-B for an A in the class, and I got a 90% on it before the curve.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Gierasch is by far the best teacher I've had at UMBC and probably my school career. She really cares about the kids and wants everyone to learn. orgo 2 isn't bad at all, as long as you grind the work out. If you actually read before class and pay attention to her lectures, it'll be a swift, if not, you can still get an A ( i read once b4 class)

The fact that Dr. Gierasch has such a high rating for such a hard class should speak to her efficacy as a teacher. In class she works through problems very logically, then helps you do harder and harder problems by applying the same basic principles. Out of class the book is very good. Exams can be hard, but a good work ethic will see you through.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Gierasch is an amazing professor! You can tell she really cares about her students and wants everyone to succeed. This class is no walk in the park, and if you want an A be prepared to put in 10-20 hours a week for lecture, readings, notes, and practice problems. Tests are fair and homework/clickers are almost free points if you put in the work.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great professor. She does an exceptional job at making organic chemistry somewhat enjoyable, and she cares about the success of her students. She provides the pieces necessary to succeed, but it's your job to put them together. Work smart and work hard to get an A in her class.

I don't write reviews often, and I rarely give 5's, but Dr. Gierasch deserves it. Organic chemistry will always be a difficult class, so you need a professor who is organized, experienced, and fair. Her class was the most well organized and balanced of any STEM course I have taken.

Your final grade is made up of 3 components: Pre-Class Assignments (PCA), In-Class Clicker Questions, and Exams. The PCAs are only 3 questions that you complete on Blackboard. You get 2 chances, so your PCA overall grade shouldn't be bad. Plus, she drops the 4 lowest PCA grades. For the in-class clickers, you can work with people.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: She is the best orgo professor at UMBC. Smith's exams are all free response and perks exams are written weird. But smith and perk give a bigger curve than gierasch. only curve 65 is C. Read the book for clickers, pca. Go to lecture, she gives a good idea of what is going to be the free response. for the MC do a lot of book problems
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Gierasch is a much more lenient professor than Perks. Perks adds random difficult questions that look like they came from a 50s typewriter. Having Gierasch for 352 was a blessing. Her exams are challenging, but she gives you reading guides, learning objectives, practice exams, and partial credit. She is really sweet, and great at teaching.

Boy, did Gierasch and Perks try to ruin Orgo 1 for a lot of people. The lectures were decent, but the exams were quite difficult, and by far the largest portion of the grade. The average for 3 out of 4 of the exams was 68-69%. That low an average does not speak well to the exams' fairness. My advice: take orgo elsewhere and transfer the credits.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: The content of this course isnt as difficult as people make it out to be. Dr Gierash explains things well but is extremely condescending if you ever talk to her outside of class. Exams are fair but the multiple choice is hard, and there is a small but reasonable opportunity for extra credit. Do all of the practice problems and an A is possible.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: She kinda hands you off to the TAs or assistane. This class isnt hard. Its the TEST. they make it very dificult. Honestly, I would get some things right because I KNEW they were trying to trick me. So I would pick what I wouldve never guessed..

Though many stem professors at UMBC are proficient, Dr. Gierasch really knows her stuff. She implements well her knowledge of the material in a way that is exciting and easy to understand. Her class environ feels homey and more like a discussion and less like a lecture. Regardless, she still manages to cover all the core concepts with few examples.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Gierasch is very nice! Everything in the syllabus is clear and executed well. Orgo is hard, but she makes the lectures interesting. She answers emails in a timely manner and is very approachable. She is a fair grader.
SHE IS DA BEST, literally. You cannot find a better, more knowledgeable, caring and funny chem professor than her. She is everything 3
She is the best chemistry professor ever. Though I am struggling through the course, she has helped me and worked with me so the experience is less painful. TAKE HER FOR ORGO I and ORGO II.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Gierasch has helped me out countless times. I don't even think I'll have my current love for chemistry if it wasn't for her Orgo I & II classes. Didn't do my best in the Chem 351 and 352 of course but still, there is no denying that she is great and goes out of her way to make sure you understand and have help if you meet her. The passion tho!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: As an instructor in Organic Chemistry, Dr. Gierasch is super hot!!  She is smooth, smart, calm, patient, and a highly skilled teacher, while also making one work hard for one's grade.  She is an ideal professor to teach this course! She does not seem to be getting enough recognition as other instructors  in the department who are really not as good

Dr. Gierasch is really inspirational, nice, and always willing to help you-pushes you to work hard!  Lectures are mainly clickers, so get yourself into a study group. Exams were really tough (mult choice + free resp), so don't wait until the day before to start cramming. Had to memorize around 20-30 different reagents used for synthesis per exam.
Excellent but hard professor.  Makes you work hard and earn your grade.

By far the best chemistry professor I have had at UMBC and elsewhere!  Love to see her teach a senior or graduate level course, and I shall be the first one to seek admission into her class!  She is thorough, tough, and fair. She is an asset to UMBC!
She is very nice and willing to help. Her exams are pretty difficult and organic chemistry is already a pretty difficult concept. Helps you try and learn ways you'll remember.

Very helpful and patient to explain things. She really wants people to do well. She puts a lot of time into her lectures and models, and ochem was actually kind of interesting thanks to her. Would take again (except it was pretty hard).

She's the best lecturer. Very funny and enthusiastic about her job, makes everyone like the subject; even though, orgo gets challenging sometimes. I loved her classes. Definitely one of the best profs.
Amazing professor! She's so passionate about chemistry and makes me more eagar to study organic chemistry!!!
I LOVE HER! SHE IS SO FUNNY AND AMAZING PROFESSOR!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
Great professor by any standard.

Wow! She knows the material very well. Honored to be her student. She is way too much for UMBC. I loved her class. Whatever she taught and assigned to read is on the exam. If you pay attention and study, you will get a good grade.

Dr. Gierasch cares about both the subject matter and her students. Her lectures are helpful as long as you read the book ahead of time. She is very willing to help students that are struggling and she is often in the Chemistry Tutorial Center. Make sure you go to lecture and form a study group!

Organic Chem. with Dr. Gierasch isn't easy but she does everything to make it easier. There is a tutorial center to help outside of class and if you read and keep up with the pre-class assignments you will do fine. Definitely not an easy class but if you put in the time you'll get an A.
Simply amazing! Passionate, fun, understandable, knowledgeable, and cute.

Felt in love with orgo when I took her. The best professor ever. Attend class, take notes, do problems from the back of the book and you should be fine. The exams are fair and not that difficult. She is very helpful.

Very enthusiastic,  passionate, and extremely knowledgeable; actually makes you want to learn Orgo (you can tell she 3 Orgo). Office hours were helpful. Class is all clickers and her going over them; no "official" lecturing. This class will require a lot of time outside class. Exams were extremely difficult and detail oriented.
she is very good. try to take her if you can.

Take her! There is no other professor that teaches orgo like her at UMBC. I took orgo 1 with perks and ended up not learning the fundamentals. It is just I didn't like the way perks teaches. However, Dr. Gierasch has different style of teaching. To do well in her class, study everyday and REMEMBER, pay attention to the DISCUSSION QUESTIONS!

I fell in love with Orgo after taking her class and I'm a Math Major! That being said; her exams are not easy and you need to prepare at least a good 3 days before each exam. Got to her for help and practice, practice, practice! She's the best person for the job!
If you are a student who cram one day before the exam, you will be history! Dr. Gierasch is truly the best professor I have ever had during my college years.

Dr. Gierasch is a really good teacher, she is very knowledgeable about organic chemistry. She requires A LOT of out of class work, which is fine by me. The one thing I found is that some times she can be very condescending and that can be a turn off in her class. Her curves are max 2% in general.

Dr. Gierasch is a really good teacher, she is very knowledgeable about organic chemistry. She requires A LOT of out of class work, which is fine by me. The one thing I found is that some times she can be very condescending and that can be a turn off in her class. In my opinion, Dr. Perks is more approachable. Her curves are max 2% in general.
She is the best!

I personally don't mind Orgo as a subject. and Gierasch is a good teacher. But this was difficult. I had a lot going on the first exam, got a C. Then, had a 93% going into third exam and after the final ended up with an %82. she gives lots extra credit but doesn't compensate. I'm a straight A student but first time in my life I was pleased with a B

This professor is not for everyone. Her class requires dozens of hours of work each week and a level of understanding that most students just don't have. Her exams are really tough, there is no curve, and she expects a lot. That being said, she is passionate and knowledgeable about organic chemistry. Most people get a C.

Impossible exams, and nothing relates to the lecture. Her lectures are very clear, and she makes you actually understand; however, she tricks you in the exam so much that it makes it impossible. you might be prepared to retake the class but an A or B is impossible to get.

I really respect Dr. Gierasch since she perfectly teaches her class the real organic chemistry. Only one complaint however is that She should have never allowed other professors to cover the spectroscopy section which was on exam one. That killed most of the students chance of getting an "A" including me. So heart braking and SAD.

Dr. Gierasch is an excellent liaison between the textbook and the students. Be sure to do all of the in/end of chapter problems! Be sure to go to the chem tutorial center for help, or office hours. Exams are hard; however, they can be easy when you over-prepare, starting about a week out from the exam. Final exams are ACS. Curve was 1-1.5%, 3% MAX.

I had another lady professor for CHEM351, who often boasted about herself and some fellowship she got from Govt. She skipped all difficult topics, e.g.  atomic & molecular orbital theory. I took Dr. Gierasch for CHEM352, and what a difference it was! Although she was much harder, but very helpful and fair. Wish I had Gierasch for CHEM351 as well!
Phenomenal Professor! She beats every other professor hands down in teaching this course!! It is a privilege and honor to be in her class!

I had Dr. Gierasch for both 351 and 352, and I cannot say enough good things about her!  She is friendly, approachable, and has a passion for what she does.  She is incredibly helpful and will do anything she can to help you as long as you meet her halfway.  Her tests are incredibly hard though, so be prepared to work for your grade.

Dr. Gierasch is a fantastic teacher! She is extremely organized, helfpul, and fair. Her passion for chemistry is contagious, and her enthusium for teaching really makes her approachable and helps make the material much easier to understand. If you have to take orgo, take it with her. One of the best professors I've encountered at UMBC!
She is a really good teacher, she made orgo actually interesting even though I had no prior interest in the subject. Study hard the tests aren't easy but she doesn't try to trick you either.

After her classes, I LOVE organic chemistry. Most people got D's on exams, but I always got A's. Go in with a good attitude and you will see that organic chemistry is BEAUTIFUL! Dr. Gierasch is really enthusiastic and SO nice. These were my favorite classes I have ever taken. If you had Carpenter for 101/102, Gierasch is really similar, but better.

I love classes that are rigorous to a certain extent. She's literally a professor that expects you to be on your A game every class, let alone exam days. She tests concepts that aren't specific to the chapters being tested! Other than her class bringing down your GPA (as most get Cs), she does know a lot-and expects the same. Take with someone else

Can't do her justice in this textbox. Strives to know any of her students that approach her or volunteer an answer. Not only is she brilliant in chemistry, she is brilliant in knowing how students absorb the material, can't overstate that. This makes her literally one of the best professors out there, and certainly the best I've had in all my years

That woman is a force of nature. She's full of energy, obsessed with Orgo, and speaks chemistry like it's her first language. If you're thinking about taking Orgo, you know you're in for a world of hurt, but she presents the material in a way that's easy to process. This course is a greater challenge for your work ethic than your mental ability.

One of the best science professors in general. I honestly believe she makes organic chemistry seem like the easiest thing ever. Her tests might not be EASY, but they are by no means over-the-top. Plus, as long as you pay attention in class, that is what you will see on the test. A really great chemistry teacher!!
Best Organic Chemistry Teacher there is. You definitely need to work very hard but she is a great teacher and has an extremely organized class.
You will definitely need to put time into the class, its really as hard as you make it. The book is your key to understanding everything. Khan Academy is useful too.

if you read before class,ask questions, memorize/study the material every week, and do lots of practice problems, you can do well. the problem is that that is not practical. its hard to do well in this class because there is way too little time for the tests, and it makes it very hard to show your understanding. its sad b/c the material isnt hard..

Showed me that Orgo gets a bad rap and isn't as hard as people make it seem. If you put in the work and know your stuff, it really pays off. Gierasch pulls some tricks sometimes but it helped me. She has a great attitude about class, is genuinely concerned about how students are learning, and tries to make it as easy as possible. Def recommended!
This Prof is extrememly hard!!! Class test average was a 60% and she would not curve.  Very little extra credit.  Her exams were 60% multiple choice ( a lot of trick questions) and 40% free response.

One of the best professors I've ever had, I hated general chemistry and basically failed 102, but Gierasch turned that all around with an upbeat attitude and energy, its like she transfers the energy onto you. Easy B, exams are EASY if you study, I was shocked, made me realize how smart I am and how much potential I have.

Professor Gierasch is far by the best professor I've had so far at UMBC (third year student). She explains the material very thoroughly. She's full of energy and is genuinely passionate about what she teaches, which makes learning all the more easier. Exams are not easy, but if you do the assigned textbook problems and go to class, you can get a C

Difficult exams but she does give you a learning objective sheet so at least you're guided. Clicker questions are really important! Overall, I think she's one of the best chemistry teachers I've had so far. She's very smart -- went to Harvard!

Go to class, clicker points count.Don't cheat,she will catch you.She is nice,go to her and tutor asap.Read book. Do practice book problems she assigns.Do ACE Organic earlier than day before it's due.Do practice exams.

Definitely read the chapters and take notes on them to understand what you are doing. She kind of expects you to read ahead, and ofcourse no one does, but make sure you take notes in class and review, since she picks up certain points from the chapter that she would test you on specifically. Overall she is quite nice and peppy.

Dr. Gierasch is very smart.  Went to Harvard and is very willing to help.  She wants to make sure you really understand the material. She also is careful to not criticize when you get the answer wrong and that's important when actively learning.

Attendance thru clickers which cushion the grade, yes, BUT does not tolerate malfunctions which hurt my grade and it wasnt my fault.Exams are 60% MC which is not helpful. My advice seek her attention and help early on bc later in semester shes a bit rude to students. NEVER question her tests or time given for them. she gets snappy.

If you must take Orgo II, take it with Gierasch. She is extremely approachable, her lectures are crystal clear, and she provides you with plenty of grade cushion and extra credit opportunities. Her tests were hard---after all, its orgo---but they were fair. Nicest prof. at UMBC, and I am not a fan of orgo.
Gierash was more clearer than Perks but at times she would get confused or mess up on a problem. Go to to her office hours or the chem tutorial center and you'll do find in the class

Dr. Gierasch is very easy and understandable professor and she tries to help out students as much as she can even outside of her office hours as long as you put your efforts into it, I don't think this class is hard at all. Although exams are sometime contains 2-3 tricky questions, if you think about it, you will get it.

Class requires work, but that should go without saying. Dr. G makes it a lot easier, consider yourself lucky if you get to take this class with her instead of other professors. Very helpful, you ace exams if you PUT THE WORK IN, which most people don't want to do. She made me want to minor in chemistry (which I'm now doing).

She is the best professor I ever took at UMBC. I wish she can teach all my chemistry related classes throughout my entire college career. She is definitely good at explaining and her lecture is very friendly and interactive. As long as you print out all the prenotes before class and take notes+do wileyplus ungraded hw, you'll ace the class for sure
Tries to explain thinks in lecture.

Useless professor.  Can't teach straight and consistently messes up equations in lecture then says you can figure it out on your own.  Tests contain material not covered or conveniently skipped over.  Practice exams ~2-3 times easier than actual exam.  Highly inconsiderate and even rude to non-chemistry majors.
Tough teacher but explains very well. Tests sometimes have concepts that are not exactly gone over in class. Exam average for one exam was a 54% hahaha...

She is definitely 'better than average' professor. She is very willing to help students even when students come to see her outside of her office hour schedule. Lectures, however, a little boring and monotonous.
She is one of the best teachers for orgo. She is clear and tells you what you need to know. She doesn't make it unnecessarily hard but its orgo so its going to be a little bit hard.

She's awesome! I expected a difficult class but she made orgo so easy to understand! Exams are straight fwd and have a free response section too! She knows what she's talking about and can explain it all very clearly. I learned tons and did well at the same time :) Take her for Chemistry!!

Pros: great teacher, highly articulate, exams test on essential stuff instead of crazy puzzles and are just like old exams, tons of office hours, easy to follow during lecture. Cons: sometimes standoffish/cold when approached at office.

BEST TEACHER I HAVE EVER HAD. Her exams are not easy but they are very fair and based only on what is taught in class. She is head of the chem tutorial center. Provides previous exams, online homework, homework problems in the book, and flexible office hours. Her grading policy is more than fair, at times I think she is too nice. Amazing teacher!=]

Gierash is the best teacher I've ever had in college. Especially for chemistry she really knows how to explain and simplify everything. I'm actually looking forward to taking organic chemistry because she is teaching it!
She's a good professor and her tests are pretty fair.. She can be kind of rude though.

Very friendly and charming personality.I enjoyed learning in this class alot, she actually does the prblms in class and explains concepts along the way. Instead of pure conceptualization like Carpenter does.CPS used in class, but just for attendance, not for grades. Just follow along in class and you should be ok for the exams.Discussion sucks tho.
She is really good at explaining concepts, although there is not a great curve, and when approached her was very stand-offish and misleading

She is the best professor at UMBC.She is extremely helpful.She wants everyone to pass the class.She has most office hours than any other professor at UMBC.Organic is a hard class to understand, but she available to help you everyday.Not an easy A, with the help of Pro. Gierasch its possible.Class curve is not huge,possibly one exam can be dropped.

Tiff is pleasant but she teaches the easiest problems in class. Everything makes sense then but the exams really test what you know.  I just wish she had taught harder stuff in class instead of expecting you to learn it all from the book's problems. Very helpful during office hours.
wonderful teacher!! attend class, she has group work for credit. very helpful

Orgo is HARD and Gierasch does an excellent job teaching. Her exam are fairly straight forward and her lectures are actually informative.  However, the actual material is really tough and requires a lot of outside study time.
super nice prof. no tricks on exams. strait forward. orgos requires alot of work but shes one of the easier professors you can take it with.
Best Professor I've ever had.  Extremely helpful in class and during office hours.
Very nice Professor, curves a lot at the end. If you do all the homework and study the notes, you will get an A. Very helpful, definitely recommend her class.

Its a chem class. of course youre going to need to put in the extra work! But shes a great teacher, always happy to be there and teach. Study from the book, come to class, do all the groupwork, tests are difficult. I wish someone would have told me to pay more attention to the stuff in the beginning of the semester..it never goes away!
too fast

New at teaching, very obvious.  Makes several mistakes while teaching, and doesn’t catch on to them until the end of class.  Had her twice once for 123 and again for 124, she was the only teacher teaching it.  Huge curve in both classes, even though she claimed there wasn’t going to be one.  Try to avoid her, if you can.

I was in her class, dropped it because I decided not to do the BS but instead the BA in psychology...her class is HARD as any chem class will be, she tries to explan things, her test are KILLERS!! study like its your life, all the answers on the tests are possibilities if you make small errors, tricky tricky tricky!...gives group work & hmwk weekly

Excellent teacher! Highly recommend!! Don't know why the bad comments. I am in her class now & she's great! Chem, esp.orgo, is difficult, but she is the best! Loves what she's teaching, enthusiastic, VERY VERY helpful, answers any questions, doesn't try 2 trick u. Just Pay attention, study hard & use the resources available 2 u, & you'll do well.

I'm taking her now and I HATE her  class....she gives tests with every answer that you could possible get if a mistake was made in her pool of answers on the multiple choice tests which is kinda mean and tricky, she's not very clear in class and isn't around much to help- tells you to go to the tutoring lab! you will use your book to teach yourself

She is an excellent professor. Class is insanely difficult. Study like its your life, because you will think your ready for the exam...but your not, and never will be. Exams are tricky. Not like exactly like the problems in the book. However, she is good and will help. Go to the tutorial lab. It's really really helpful. it's hard, but take with her

Lecture is pretty boring. She tries her best to explain everything but Chemistry is not an easy subject. I don't think she's a good teacher- heard the old teacher Carpenter was really good, take her if you can!

Started off the semester saying that she will not curve. After the first two exams had a class average of around 50% (all exams were like that), she changed her mind. Chemistry is hard no matter which professor you take. I worked extremely hard for this course and pulled off an A. I've seen people who study last minute and fail. Study hard.

She's not a bad teacher. She tries to explain things the best she can, but unless you pay very close attention (which nobody does) or are actually interested in chemistry (which you could be, but the large majority aren't)it will be difficult. CHEM101 is not going to be easy no matter who the teacher is, so don't expect a good grade. she's just meh

Worst teacher I have ever encountered, and very unfair about grades. I failed by a point, and failed due to her error in grading, and she wouldn't let the extra credit I did in class help at any cost. Avoid if at all possible!
very good prof

this class was a nightmare. Teacher is VERY unfair about material on tests. tests more on math problems than course content.  3 hard midterms and weekly quizzes and NO curve.  avoid this teacher at all costs
No Comments

Lectures are long and boring. Three exams and a final, all are very difficult with weekly online quizes that allow you to only get 1 wrong before failing. Study hard and keep up with all homework or you will struggle severely. Good luck

Her class is really boring and she is not very clear on what you need to know for exams. Her exams are extremely hard and nothing we went over in class for review was on the exam and there is no curve! Good luck
uggggggggggg this class broke me
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Guitierrez is helpful and patient. Taking a new language, these were the 2 requirements I needed from a teacher. He gives constructive feedback, he is accessible outside of class, and he enjoys teaching his language. This was my first time learning Spanish and I can converse properly. I am glad I took this class. All in all, A1 prof.

Easily the best Spanish professor for 101. Attendance is mandatory and he expects you to participate in class, but he's super understanding. He will work with you to get an A. Weekly online study plans/quizzes, 5 conversifi sessions, couple of writing journals/exams. Take him!

Not good at communicating about homework due dates. You can check MySpanishLab at the start of the week and see that nothing's due, then check back two days later and see that you missed an assignment. Very frustrating.
A native speaker with sympathy for his students. He definitely tried to relate to us about learning a second language, and was overall very understanding and patient. 10/10

Condescending, arrogant.  Midterm was 40% of total grade, 2 questions. The photocopied exam had a mark that looked like a neg sign, asked him about it during the test and he wouldn't clarify.  I copied it and carried through my work.  He laughed at me when I got my test back with a 50% because my answer was off by that negative sign.  Said "tough"

He seemed kind of mean at first when we had the lectures, but when we started working on the project, he opened up and actually had a great sense of humor.  The project is pretty straightforward, but you need to work hard on the lab reports.  There are no exams at all, so lab reports make up 100% of the grade.
Best Engineering Professor. Tip: Don't play games with him.

Dr. Tasch is very intimidating and comes off as very mean, but in reality he is a fantastic professor. He explains everything very well and will help you if you need it. He has a funny side to him that he shows occasionally. Attendance is mandatory and he does not tolerate lateness or lip. He is extremely smart as well.

Comes off arrogant and mean initially however on a personal level he is a great teacher. Always available for help and has a genuine intest not only in the subject but also in teaching it well so student can succeed.

Great Teacher, He really helped the class with everything, he saw that we were having problems, and he helped us through the bad times, he even gave up a very simple and short final on the problems that he told us to study

"Im not yelling at you Im speaking in a yelling manner"  He honestly wants to see you do well, and is always available, always.  Homework isnt too bad, so long as you actually put a little effort into it.
an odd little man with a funny accent. will occasionally say something funny. Can be condescending at times, but seems willing to help with any difficulties you may have with the material.
He explained it 1 way, and that is it. I did not like him
HARD class + foreign teacher = bad combination

She is an awesome professor! Her stories were very interesting. You need the textbook for the class, but you can buy an used copy. If you put in the effort and try, she will really try to help you out. Do the homework for the class! It has all the answers to everything in her class. I would definitely take her class again!

Professor Uma Saini is a very good professor. I had her for 101, 102, and 201 and got an A every time. She will help you when you are struggling, and she is very sweet. If you take your time and study then you will do great in the class. Its a 4 credit class so you have to put the work in it.
Save your self the effort and time and do not take her class. Take your language credit at a CC or even take a non difficult language.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: She is something, DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS AS AN EASY CLASS. Her grading is very arbitrary, so please save yourself some time and your GPA and do not take this class with her. Even if you know other Indian Languages, she makes the subject herder than it needs to be. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I love Umaji. She is an amazing professor who really cares about her students learning and passing. The textbook is a workbook, so you absolutely need a new copy. She went out of her way to teach her students, and I loved her class so much. Even though I was not very good at the language, she spend to much time trying to help me learn the material.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Type of guy I'd like to get a drink with
Amazing Teacher.

Amazing professor with extremely funny and insightful lectures. Covered all the material needed to pass the class during lectures in a way that actually makes you want to show up. No hw, quizzes are easy, and he pulls exam questions straight from the review guides. Says some wild, out of pocket things but never in a hateful or insulting way.

one of my favorite professors at umbc. he's really funny and each class feels like a stand up comedy show. he skips any unnecessary information and dives right into what you need to know. if you attend lectures and take notes then you're guaranteed to pass the class with an A without doing any of the readings he provides.
Prof. Thomas is an absolute gem - his lectures are equal parts hilarious and insightful. Just show up, take notes, and you'll ace the exams. Unstuckstudy was a lifesaver for exam prep too!

I have long said that you have to take a class with Jim Thomas at some point if you want the full UMBC experience. This professor is by leaps and bounds the best professor I have ever had, and inspired me to pursue further classes in philosophy. There are very few assignments to be graded on, but those few assignments are generally pretty easy.
Absolutely hilarious professor, comes very prepared to each lecture. Just come to each lecture and even if you're only paying half attention, you'll be fine. Actually makes you want to come to class

Best class I've ever taken. Jim is absolutely hilarious, and at the time teaches the material so well. 

Skips all the BS, tells you everything you need to know. There are readings, but if you just go to the lectures, you don't ever have to touch the blackboard materials. 

All you have to do to succeed is take detailed notes and study for exams.
The best professor at umbc as long as you study for the exams your good he makes the lectures enjoyable

My favorite professor and human pls treat him well! Go to all lectures, take detailed notes, and participle bc in lecture he gives you everything to rock the exams. He taught me so much about myself and life, and shared and listened to all views, while never stating his own. He is a role model as a professor and articulates his lessons effortlessly
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Oh my lord, I was literally paying tuition for a standup comedy 3x a week for a semester. This class was the greatest class i ever took, it was so funny and easy. No homework, quizzes were redo-able extremely easy (like meme answers) exams could be answered straight from the lecture, notes needed. A lot of points are him asking for your opinion.

Anyone who's taken his class before knows, that he is both funny and insightful. I took his class for PHIL100 and guess what? I came back for more. Just because. Easily one of the best profs at the school. 10/10 Would take again, so I did

honestly, he is ok. i would not say he's the best prof i had so far. He kind of grades the exam harshly. I really hope to get an A at the end. I did not really like this class maybe it was the subject i hated idk. online class was fine since it was not met at a time, but lectures would sometimes get too long
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Fantastic professor! Explains things in a very funny manner and is such a great guy to hear talk. Despite the classes being online, Professor Thomas handled it like a champ and made even online classes just a pleasure to participate in! I'm taking him again for Phil 152 this winter.
The best professor I ever had at UMBC. There's a reason he has so many good reviews. You MUST take PHIL100 if you get the chance! Hilarious, caring, engaging... the list goes on and on.

He spends a lot of the class telling jokes, and it is sometimes hard to wake up early just to hear him ramble on about random things. It feels like his classes are about 25% philosophy content and 75% jokes about random things. He isn't hard, but he expects you to be able to explain yourself very well. Your whole grade is based off a few papers
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: As long as you go to UMBC, you absolutely need to take at least Phil100 with Jim because it will be the best course you ever take. He puts up notes on the board, which will be on the exam but he also gives a review sheet before which is exactly the same as the exam. HIS STORIES are SO FUNNY and you will literally want to go to class just to laugh.

Jim is the most amazing professor I've ever taken at UMBC, he is so funny and his lecture are so interesting. I never minded waking up at 8 am just to attend his lecture because I just sit there and listen and it is like attending a stand-up while also learning tons. You never have to read anything just show up take notes it and you will get an A!

One of the best professors I've had at UMBC! Knew nothing about philosophy before this class & now I feel like I've learned so much. Loved coming to class not only because his lectures are great and funny, but because it makes studying for the exams much easier. Come to class and take good notes, and you'll never have to read the texts he provides.

Try to take atleast one class with him. His teaching is unique and funny. Even as a person, he's a little odd but he's one of the best profs I had. Tests are based on the things he talks about so write that down. He's an easy grader, if you can prove you know what you're talking about and why. Easy A class with a great experience!

Jim is an absolute gem and one of the most down to earth professors you will ever meet. The discussions he has in lecture pretty much give you everything you need to know for the exams, plus they are very entertaining. I plan to take him again in the future for my Upper-Level Elective requirement!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: The best professor at UMBC w/o a doubt. Loved coming to class just for his lectures.

Not only was Jim Thomas engaging and hysterical, quirky and in-touch, he also taught me things in such a relatable way, that I've managed to retain and apply his lessons 10 years later. As a Biochemistry major, I was interested in philosophy but didn't need it, but it quickly became my favorite class and I wish I had taken more classes with him.
He is an absolutely amazing teacher and his lectures always made my day since they were so good! 10/10 would recommend again!
Jim Thomas is a energetic and very fun teacher.  His lectures really improved my mornings and i strongly suggest this professor.
10/10 would hear his rants again, only class I would wake up at 8:00 to take

Took PHIL399 - Philosophy of Humor. Do anything you can to take this class, it was by far the most enjoyable class I've ever taken. Thomas is literally hilarious (he could easily do stand up) so you'll actually WANT to go to class. The exams and papers are easy if you have well-informed opinions on things. He also seems to care about students.
Professor Thomas is fantastic. If you show up to class he is both funny and gives you all the information you need to do well on your exam.
easily the best prof i've ever had. took a pretty boring subject and made it amazing! i would take any class if he was teaching it

First class with him today. Non-stop jokes, had the whole class LAUGHING hard. Too early to discuss the course, but according to friends that had him, great discussions and lectures. If you follow the material and come to class (optional), you will do fine.

Here's a great professor. His lectures really make you want to engage in his class. He gives study guides which are basically his exams(essay format). There's a final paper and he gives time and feedback. Easy A if you enjoy the subject.

He's a really great guy and a great teacher. Sometimes he can get a little too silly and derpy and takes a few minutes to get back on topic, but he's really very good at what he does and you can tell.
Professor Thomas is so funny and entertaining. His lectures were never boring and he always had a story to tell. Additionally, he does a great job of explaining the subject of Philosophy.

He is my favorite professor by far! Definitely take this class with him! The lectures are entertaining and he explains everything in detail and very clear! By far one of my favorite classes! He gives wonderful feedback on exams and the one essay at the end of the semester! He is very willing to help his students and answer any questions.

HE IS THE BEST PROFESSOR EVER. PLEASE TAKE HIM. WOULD RECOMMEND. He explains everything in a way where you don't think you're learning and every piece of information sticks with you. He makes you laugh and keeps you awake. Attendance is not mandatory, but he makes you want to come to class.

I love this professor! Going to class is like going to a comedy show, absolutely brightens your day. You will actually learn the material through his lectures, he has endless examples to really make you think about philosophy. Go to class and take notes and you will get at least a B. AWESOME PROFESSOR!

Best professor at UMBC. His lectures are basically stand up comedy, and his philosophy of humor class is hilarious. Have taken two classes with him and taking a third before I graduate because he is great.
He is hilarious while still being extremely informative. He knows his stuff and really makes you think about the big philosophical questions.

Absolutely my favorite professor at UMBC. You will have a hard time controlling your laughter some days, his stories are insanely funny. There's 3 exams and a paper. If you show up and actively listen (which isn't hard) you should get at least a B. Take a class with him even if you don't need to because it just brightens your day. Dude is the best.

His hilariousness is only matched by his respect for dedicated students. Beyond his exceptional ability to teach, he really cares for students who love the course material and strive to learn more. Show up to class and participate, and you won't even care about the grade. His presence truly is a present to us all!

Jim Thomas is the best professor that UMBC has. He easily takes dense material like Epistemological theories and breaks it down to where the entire class understands it. I am purposely taking a class of his every semester so I can have at least one class that brings me joy. More professors need to be like him.

Taking PHIl100 with Jim was the best decision I made at UMBC. He makes gloomy days turn into brighter days with his lectures. I did not read any of the outside material however I attended every class. If you show up to class and participate I don't see why you couldn't get an A or a B.

If you go to UMBC, you have to take a class with Jim Thomas. I only took this class as an AH credit, I had no interest in Philosophy, but he really made the topic fun and interesting. The material isn't boring or dry at all and he tells many stories to go along with it. Exams are written so you have to study. But not hard. DEFINITELY TAKE!
Amazing professor. He is hilarious and will make you look forward to going to class. Must take before you graduate.
one of the best I have so far.  Easy class with lone final essay.

The lectures are hilarious if you have any sort of humour. There is no textbooks or books required to read, although if you want to understand what is on the in class papers (the only thing graded in the class) you have to show up.

Probably the best teacher I've ever had. He's funny, interesting, thought provoking, and an absolute genius. If I could have him teach all my classes i would. Absolutely take him if you can even if you don't have to.

No one should graduate UMBC without taking at least one course from Jim. Every single comment here is true: he's smart, helpful, and most of all funny, with a self-deprecating sense of humor. His stories and tangents are hilarious, but somehow end up being related to the material. Best professor I've ever had. You WILL look forward to his class!

This is my favorite class. I loved each and every moment in this class! He is so funny, kind, and thought-provoking. To simply put it: the best three hours of my week! I have never laughed and learned so much at the same time. I am so glad I had the opportunity to be in this class! I hope that everyone at UMBC gets a chance to take this class.
The class is always worth waking up for, even when I only get a few hours of sleep.

Everything everyone says about Jim Thomas is true.  Not only is it impossible to dislike this man, but the way he teaches provokes a lot of thought whether or not you are interested in the material. I learned way more than I expected to.  This class is worth taking even if you don't need it.

BEST PROFESSOR EVER! He somehow gets everyone to learn the material while incorporating stories that really don't have anything to do with the class but are highly entertaining.  He is hilarious and is very smart.  He remembers all of the material he wants to teach and does not need a book at hand. It is really spectacular.

JIM THOMAS=AMAZING. He is super funny and you will enjoy every moment of his class. We have random students show up to his lectures because he is such a great professor. I have no idea why he isn't top rated overall on this website! Take his class!

Seriously the best and funniest teacher out there. No lie. I took PHIL 100 during the Winter session. The way he teaches by  making use of a lot of humor but you still understand everything. He seriously made it fun to learn. I guarantee that if you talk his class you will never stop laughing and you will leave with a wealth of knowledge

One of the best professor at UMBC, got me interested in the subject that i absolutely hated. He has an amazing sense of humor and keeps his lectures extraordinarily interesting. All you have to do to be successful is to show up in class, pay attention, participate, take notes, and study the notes for exams, and work on a project which was easy.

Best professor, no contest. Took his 100 level class and loved it so much i decided to take 373. The material is more serious and pretty confusing. He is still funny as hell but certain days will be more dry simply because the material requires it. Phil 100 was straight forward and easy. This will require a little more work, though it is worth it.
Amazing.

Thomas rules. I'm currently taking his Philosophy of Law class and it is the highlight of my school week. He does not require attendance but I go to class anyway, despite his being my last class of the day! Highly highly recommended!
Hilarious...Simply the best part of my classes all week. I plan to do a minor in philosophy (after having his class) and take as many class as possible with him.
BEST PROFESSOR EASY MUST TAKE BEFORE YOU GRADUATE

Has to be the best professor I have ever had. He makes every class worth your time and makes it enjoyable. If he taught all my classes, college would be so much more enjoyable. He has been the only teacher who makes me want to come to class. He makes the material relatable to anyone and anything. Take any of his classes if you can.
GREATEST PROFESSOR EVER!
JUST TAKE THIS CLASS.YOU WILL NOT REGRET IT BEST PROFESSOR I HAVE EVER HAD.
Best professor at UMBC. You are not a true UMBC student until you have taken one of  his classes.

This is the BEST Professor I have EVER taken. If you do not find is class interesting, I will personally give you your money back. The material is pretty straight forward. The exams make you think: not difficult, but not something you should take lightly. (I took the first exam lightly and ended up with a B in the class because of it.) TAKE IT!

Amazing teacher, hilarious in class. Will keep you interested in the material, and it will be your favorite class of all time. You will want to go to every lecture and actually look forward to taking the tests and writing the paper. His skills are crazy.

people! jim is a beast! mellow accent + hilarious stories that relate to what we're learning = best professor ever! but beware, he's not as easy as people say! i got a B- on my first exam (short answer/essay format) when i expected an A... actually pay attention in class! you might as well anyway: every class is like watching a comedian teach us :D
Professor Thomas has been by far my favorite teacher this semester. Great guy. He doesn't allow laptops in class, but with the way he does the job, you REALLY wanna pay attention.

WOW! Professor Thomas is a great Professor! He keeps the class entertained through his humorous nature and is VERY knowledgeable. I spoke to him after class numerous times and it were as if I was talking to my best friend. Relates to real-life examples and his readings that he assigns are actually genuinely interesting! TAKE HIS EVERY CLASS!
Great Professor! Others should take notes. Awesome class discussions.

You have to take this class before you graduate!  He is the best professor at UMBC! He portrays the philosophy topics in a way that students can relate and understand. I never missed a class. Each lecture was pretty much a stand up comedy performance!  Exams are in essay form, and there is one 3-5 paper. Easy A.

Best prof i have ever had. i took this class over 4 years ago and i still remember his name. he is seriously an amazing professor and you havent experienced the best UMBC has to offer until you take his class!

The first impression I had was Jim Thomas looks very unusual, but through out the semester he proves to be entertaining and humorous, both qualities which made the class not only interesting but made the material comprehensible to many students including myself. I strongly recommend students to take his class before they take any other.
Best class i ever took. Most fun i ever had getting up so early! I am so glad im not the only one that thinks hes good lookin idk what it is but theres something about him!

Jim is a fabulous Professor!   Don't leave UMBC until you've taken his class.  Hands down, best professor.   UMBC should hire him to teach some of the not so good Professors.   They could learn a lot from his style/methods.   Must take any of his classes!

The most interesting and entertaining class i have ever take. I attend a different school now but i will always remember what a great experience i had in jims' class. He made the material so understandable and interesting and i have never found anything to compete. The best professor i have ever had

Jim Thomas is the best professor ive ever had hands down. He makes class very entertaining and you would not think he would be a college professor. He is HILARIOUS and teaches very well while making you so interested in the topic. Exams are very easy, and class is very easy. You won't even want to skip his class, it is too fun!
GREATEST Professor I've ever had in my life. No joke. This guy is hilarious and makes everything fun and interesting. Take him before you graduate!

Jim is hilarious and easiest class I've ever taken. His exams are extremely easy as long as you look over the study guide he pass out. Exam reflects 99.9% of what the study guide shows. Just listen in class & get notes and you can get solid A without any issue. Not much effort necessary for this class and MUST take class before graduating from UMBC

Thomas is HILARIOUS. Every class is like a stand up comedy routine, the professor is very approachable, and the assignments given are relatively easy. A little too easy, and therein lies my only complaint. Thomas is an amazing teacher, but he doesn't goes as in depth into the material as I would have liked, nor is there much class discussion.

He's an amazing teacher. Not only is he hilarious, but you'll actually WANT to learn from Jim. He doesn't care if you come to class, but every seat is usually filled because it's an entertaining, thought-provoking class. I'm a biology major, but this class is by far the best class ever. Definitely recommend it!

He's ridiculously funny, but he panders to the lowest common denominator.  He knows this, but does not seem to care.  Take him if you want easy credits, but do not expect to learn much if you're serious about philosophy.  I took a 300-level class with him and didn't learn anything that wouldn't be covered in a decent intro class.

Phenomenal instructor, best in the philosophy department. Hands down. Every day is a standup comedy routine. This is the third class I've taken with him and a fourth one is coming up in the spring. He cuts down on the dry material and presents it in a fun and memorable way. He cares about his students success. It's a shame that he isn't tenured.

Professor Thomas is one of the best teachers I've ever had.  Thank god I took his class in my senior year as I would have probably changed my major to Philosophy had I taken his class early on.  Every class is like a stand-up comedy routine.  He keeps the entire class engaged while at the same time posing interesting questions. Thanks Jim.
very good teacher

Jim redefines what it means to be a "teacher" at a "university." An outsider might see him as lazy. In reality, he's nonchalant but über caring about his student's success and, more importantly, understanding of the material. He cuts through a lot of BS and presents material in a funny, highly-memorable way. (Note: I also took his 100 level class)

Prof Thomas is the BEST!  Seriously, before graduating, you MUST take his class!   UMBC should ask him to do a Teaching 101 for all Professors on campus to incorporate some of his style in their teaching.   I looked forward to this class, each & every time!   So fun & you learn a lot!  Enroll in it!

really phenomenal professor. I can hardly believe the amount that I learned without even intending to. Redefines teacher. Honestly, I didn't even take the class for credit, just for a break from my other courses
Best class ever. I actually felt like I was missing out not going to class. You'll learn a lot. Go to class, and you'll get an A. This is one class you won't mind going to.

When I read the reviews I had to see for myself if this teacher was as good as everyone said. He was! He can engage his students for the entire class. The class seems like it is 15 minutes instead of 75. Jim Thomas is one of the best teachers I have ever had.
Best professor ever. No matter how bad is the day he lightens up the day with all the real funny jokes which are related to the subject. Highly recommended:)
One of the best professors at UMBC. His style of teaching is utterly honest and humorous. He is one of the few professors that actually makes you THINK. Take this course.

Best and most hilarious professor I've ever had. Has a very natural humor and wit and even though most of the class is spent joking around, he manages to tie all of it back to the subject, which makes the material that much more interesting and easy to understand.
This guy is awesome, you have to take at least one class with him at UMBC. Easy on the eyes too :)

Amazing teacher. Every class was like going to a stand-up comedy show. Laughed so hard it hurt. Tests are easy if you come to class. Makes phil easy to understand, and everything is memorable. Don't buy textbook, everything you need to know is stated in class.

Best professor I've ever had, hilarious and will remember you forever. Don't buy the textbook--not worth it. He's just amazing. If he taught all my classes, college would be a breeze and I'd be set for life. We need more professors like Jim here.

Amazing instructor, the best I've had yet at UMBC.  You don't really need to read the book because he covers everything in his lecture, which while sometimes off-topic are always interesting and usually hilarious.  Very approachable.  A+
hands down, greatest teacher/prof...
sweet

This teacher is one of the most craziest, funniest, and random teachers i have ever had. He'll argue against anything you say, and he will win. but he makes it work. MUST HAVE TEACHER!!!! You should totally take this class before you graduate!!!!
awesome teacher, hilarious. its not mandatory to come but the classes are so much fun it makes you attend everyday!

Awesome guy, and an awesome class.  The way classes should be.  Exams are simple, no stress, and maximum learning.  I'm convinced the guy is a comedian and uses the class to test his material. You really don't have to go to class, but its the highlight of my week when the rest of my classes are CHEM.  Must take before you graduate.

Hands down best prof at UMBC.  Took him my freshman year in 99 and still remember his hatred for hominy, love of guiness, blacking out at concerts and acid trip looking bowls of milk after finishing a bowl of fruity pebbles.  All of his stories help you vividly remember philosophy and always kind and wanting to help.

He is one of the best professors I've e ever had.  Going to his class is like going to a comedy show, he get's the material across in a funny way, and in way that will not put you to sleep.  He is very helpful and understanding.
BEST TEACHER I HAVE EVER HAD! Hands down. Going to class is a pleasure; you learn a lot and have fun the whole time.

Number one teacher. He should be teaching other Professor how to teach. I think nobody should leave UMBC without taking at least one class with him. His appearance on the first page of ratemyprofessor.com as the top ten professor should tell you guys that this guy got something.  AWESOME***
Great professor. Explains everything that needs to be on the exam. Hilarious! Attendance wasn't mandatory but I never missed a class!
a brilliant man and a sensible professor. very understanding and comprehensive. extremely lucid and thoughtful.
The coolest guy ever. Jim is not only a great teacher, but truly an estimable role model.
Make sure you bring popcorn and soda to his lectures.  This guy is an hour and 15 minutes of pure entertainment every single time.

Had him for Philosophy of Humor, Moral Theory, and Intro to Philosophy. Jim is a fantastic teacher whose hilarious stories will make you want to come to class. Lectures are well-prepared. Easy grader; helpful if you need it. You MUST take at least one class with Jim in your lifetime! It will be a joy. One of my favorite teachers of all time.

WOW! Best class I've taken since I started at UMBC!!! (I'm a junior) Love going to class. From the moment he walks in on the first day, he's got the class laughing. AWESOME PROF
Wow. He is a star!!!!
Best professor EVER! He is AWESOME. He is super funny and knows how to teach! Again, he is the best professor!!!!!!
The lectures were hilarious and very informative. He explains concepts very clearly. The man is a professional comedian. A UMBC treasure.

Best professor ever! Just attend his class, he is hilarious, you wouldn't want to miss any of his classes. He is extremely helpful, interesting and really knows how to teach! A++++++++++! He is a cool dude!

I took Evolution vs. Intelligent Design with Thomas.  I am not a phil major but he is the best professor I ever had!!! Once I laughed so much during class I started to tear up! Seriously I loved going to his class everyday and I learned a lot too!  If professors were more like him, college would have been worth it!

There was a point during the semester where I was having a really bad time and all I wanted to do was just go to his class.  I'm not kidding you, he's that funny and awesome.  I really learned a lot.  You can tell he really does take the material seriously and is passionate about it.  Don't bother getting the book, just go to class :-)
He is the greatest philosophy teacher I have had.

Wow, I signed up on here just tell you people to take Jim's class. He is the coolest, nicest dude ever. You can be yourself in class, pop a joke, call him out on BS(he wants you to). Best learning experience at UMBC. I would have loved college if more professors were like him. Most are dull and elites. He rules.
You are not paying for a class...You are going to a stand up comedy show. Dude is hilarious. If you get less than a B, drop out.
Nothing more to say...great class
Amazing, both fun and educational, definitely one of the best teachers I've had
this man is amazing. take this class. seriously.

it's been 8 years since i've had Jim Thomas in intro to philosophy and I still remember his lectures, which were more like stand up routines.  He teaches his lectures well enough for you not to really have to read the book.  He'll say hi to you if you see him around campus and buy him a case of guiness and you'll get an A.

LOVED HIM!Going to class makes a lot more sense when it comes to the exams but his class is so interesting and the man is HILARIOUS that you want to go to class! TAKE HIM! I did't do much to get an A besides take decent notes and listen! He's awesome! He's also understanding and helful! SERIOUSLY TAKE HIS CLASSES!

You can not go thru four years at umbc and then graduate without taking him. He's hilarious, fun, interesting. I thought philosophy was gonna be the most boring class of my life but Jim is awesome!!! Just go to class and listen, at the very least, you'll get a B. if you write a few things down and study for an hour before the exam, you'll get an A.
He teaches college classes like they SHOULD be taught. Take him if you're not even a PHIL major

folks i f u ever think to take a philosophy class in umbc. do not miss jim thomas.. he rocks..ver approachable and funny..just listen to what he says n read his notes u will get definite "A". trust me
i LOVE JIM THOMAS,is he married? haha

Jimo is da man!! Its funny how his classes are divide athletes on one side and the rest on the other. But overall his class is very easy. He had 3 tests and 1 paper each worth 25%. Its almost impossible to get a C in this class, exams are simple and he is very helpful if you need help!
Funniest professor on campus.
Funniest class I've ever had!
JIM ROCKS MY SOCKS!!! SO AMAZING!! ONE OF THE BEST PROFESSORS I'VE HAD DURING MY COLLEGE CAREER!! THANKS FOR SETTING THE BAR FOR OTHER PROFESSORS!!
One of the most interesting professors I had in my 4 years at UMBC. Take him--you'll learn a lot (explains everything very well), laugh a lot and enjoy coming to class!

The BESt'est' professor i've ever had...go to his class regularly..(& trust me, u'll not get bored by ny chance..his jokes mak the class)..and pay attention,then u don even need to touch the textbook..gives out review sheets and the xam will be the same but reworded..he is AWESOME!!!
AWESOME Teacher!

the best prof in school ever. he's little crazy but he's cool.
TAKE THIS CLASS, ITS FUN, EASY, AND WILL BE ONE OF THE BEST TIMES YOU HAVE IN COLLEGE, IF YOU DONT PASS THIS CLASS, THEN DROP OUT OF COLLEGE
Don't miss this class!  Jim Thomas is famous!  Each class is stand up comedy, but I learned a lot too.  He cares about his students, and is always willing to help.

I love this man, if I were a girl, I'd marry him.  The way he teaches is so engaging and awesome that you really don't even need a textbook.  Explains stuff with awesome and HILARIOUS analogies to help you out.  Gives review sheets of what's on the tests and doesn't stray from them.  THE best Prof and a major video gamer.  Simply T-H-E B-E-S-T.
Great teacher
great teacher. grade based on 3 5 page papers and 5 homework assignments. he is really funny and makes class interesting. take any of his classes that are possible

He's an awesome teacher...very amusing and very funny...he gets you through the dull philosophy information!
He's crazey! His personal stories, if they came from another person, would make me very, very wary...but he's just so hot and funny and smart that you can't help but enjoy his class.
This guy is fantastic.  Extremely personable, funny, and intelligent.  Sometimes class is sort of discombobulated, but overall excellent.

This guy's great, I was talking with a friend and we agreed that if Thomas were teaching Physics 431, we'd still find a way to take it him (no, we were not science majors of any type).  He's just that good a professor personality-wise, he knows what he's talking about, too bad he only teaches the lower level phil courses
Funny and easy going. He takes his time with handing back test

One one the craziest prof I had...if you have a chance to take phil 100 with him DO IT! i thought he was on drugs when he first came into class but he ends up being one of the best teachers.  I thik i learned and comprehended the most from him.  The tests are fairly easy but that's because he makes it so much fun to learn!

Everyone should take this professor and this class. This class was the philosophy of humor. His classes are really fun, we watched some kind of comedy (stand-up, dave chapelle, simpsons) every day.

You take a Jim Thomas class.  Doesn't matter your major doesn't matter which class.  If you can take it do so.  He's great and you might even learn something.
Excellent teacher!! Nothing I could say hasn't been mentioned in the previous comments already. Relates the subject matter in a humourous yet engaging way; simply a gifted teacher.

Hands down, Jim is one of the best professors I've ever had!!! He makes his class so much fun to go to. I don't think I ever left his class without laughing so much until my stomach hurt. DO try to take a class with him. Your UMBC experience is not complete until you take a Jim Thomas class!
The best teacher i've had at my six years at UMBC

Jim (dont call him Dr. or Mr. Thomas) was a very good teacher. You get study sheets right before the exam that contain everything thats gonna be on the exam. Very confrontable and a very nice guy. Only one paper, which is very easy as well. Go to class and you wont even have to read the book.
Jim is a southern hick as he calls himself, that makes him cool.  Take the class and enjoy!
Best teacher I have ever had at UMBC. Hillarious but brilliant! the material is interesting and the way he presents it makes it even better...def take this class!

Great teacher. Makes class interesting but is still able to teach you. Found myself getting pissed when missing his class. Very funny and approachable. Tests and paper are laughable. Take any class you can with him. If he only taught bio courses.
Best teacher I've ever had. Im thinking about changing my major because of him. He was funny and interesting, I never wanted to miss a class.

so funny!  Had so much fun in the class, but learned a lot.  would love to take another class with him.  He made the topics interesting with his crazy stories and you didn't really have to spend much time studying for his exams if you went to class.
Great teacher and HILLARIOUS.  Probably, missed his true calling as a stand-up comic, but that works out for us.  Tests can be a little difficult b/c you have to think, which I hate doing.
Great teacher. Crazy as a loon (but it is a good thing).  Funny.  Helpful.  If you can get into one of his classes, take it.
Jim is totally awesome... If you're looking for an AH GFR to take, this is it... Really easy, but I still loved going to class every day. I definitely did learn, but had fun doing it. He's great.
Fantastically funny
I found out why I was lucky to get into his class.  He makes a boring class very interesting.  Although he's a little abstract he might be the funniest guy I've ever met.
Jim is like Chris Rock, VERY FUNNY AND INTERESTING. This class offered me a lot of things to understand in ETHICAL PERSPECTIVE OF philsophy
Very entertaining:)A class i didnt mind going to.
Fun and easygoing teacher. You will laugh so hard that your sides will hurt. PLUS, the humor is unlike anything you have ever heard before!
Jim kicks ass.  He's a great professor: whether you want a class to goof off in or whether you're looking to really learn some philosophy.  He knows his stuff and is funny as hell.
Best prof on campus!  Talks about eating peeps and sleeping with an X-men comforter all class...
If every teacher was like Jim, we'd all be playin GTA3 & drink'n Guiness, Go Jim
No Comments
Jim is the man.  The class you don't mind going to sick.  It changed my life.
JUST PLAIN AWESOME!!!
he's very funny. if you go to class you don't have to read the text at all.
Very funny!
funny, don't buy the book, he'll go over everything
He's great. He's funny, and makes it easy to understand. You'll like him
tells jokes, class is fun, offbeat examples
You will love this class, no final and only 3 tests with an easy paper.
What a great teacher
Best teacher ever

Not sure what all the fuss is about. Ghosh is a nice guy and a fine teacher. Read the textbook and make sure you know how to do the homework. HW Solutions are posted after it is due. If you do the above, you'll do fine on the exams.

Poor professionalism.

Dr. Ghosh is not like any of the other professors that most students have had in chemE. He does not bother to learn our names and only cares about his research and not teaching us the actual content of the class. That being said, the topics in the class are very interesting, I just wish I knew/could apply them.
Ummm, she gives way to much homework than is acceptable for full time students.

She talks down to the students as if she is better than us. She can be rude. If you have a question that she doesn't know the answer to, she will ask one of the students in the class for help. WAY too many homework assignments that are repetitive to the classwork. Homework is worth more than tests -__- Attendance plays a huge part in your grade.

She gives WAY too many in class projects and crazy amounts of HW. Very hard to reach and works during the days. Is a very tough grader and doesn't really help very much!!! ACTUALLY GIVES IN CLASS EXAMS. WOULD NOT RECOMMEND AT ALL.
A personable, and helpful teacher.  Will help if you ask.  Tries to connect material to actual, real life application.  Whichever school has her as a professor will be lucky, students will be lucky.

Would I take it again? Heck no. Unnecessary workload, don't even know why my major (HAPP) need me to take this class. Busy work TEXTBOOK IS YOUR FRIEND in this class, honestly. Follow the book and you'll be fine. The prof can be a pain when it comes late assignments (hypocritical). She can be 2weeks behind in grading, but won't accept late hw...

She was a very nice teacher, everything is on the syllabus and books. Her teaching style can be controversial- if you ask for her help and she doesn't know it, you are on your own. Turn your assignments in! period. She is hypocritically strict, she can be late in grading our hw, but will not accept late assignments, EVEN if it was 1 minute late...
No Test or Exam Just weekly projects inform of homework easy though just follow the textbook steps. Shes really good and fair with gradding. Talk to her if you have any problem she will help
Great class!  Jay always keeps it interesting and he's a great teacher.  Highly recommend.

Had low expectations coming out of HB1 in terms of staying interested and alert but Jay made it really great.  Very smart and had a lot of knowledge to share and did so in an interesting, informative way.  Included videos which were illustrative.  Love love love his self-depricating sense of humor, its funny w/o being pathetic.  Great Prof recommen
Great teacher!  loved his class despite low interest in topic. already signed up with him next semester.
Intelligent and organized presentation of material. On top that, great sense of humor. He also gives interesting examples to hammer home concepts.  He's basically the man.

J is hilarious! He curses a lot and makes research kinda fun. He is aware of how boring it can be but attempts to make a fun activity.  Grades based on a midterm, a final, and a research paper that you write in sections starting the 3rd wk of class. He is very approachable. Exams are a lil tough but you can def get A if u pay attn and go to class

Very intelligent and knowledgeable about the subject.  Teaches all chapters thoroughly via powerpoints and is very clear about what he will test on.  One paper that is done in four sections, fairly easy grader.  Would recommend this professor.
Very caring and lenient, not a lot of work outside of class and doesn't mind your pronunciation. I'd take her for all my Spanish courses if possible!
Took for SPAN101, she creates a really friendly learning environment for writing and especially speaking. Easy to understand and little homework outside of class compared to the other professors.

Took her for spanish 101, goated professor, attendance is mandatory. She expects you to read the textbook but other then that shes a great teacher and is good at understanding. I don't like spanish myself but if i had to take this class again id take her 100%

She's amazing. If you're doing 101 take her. Conversations may make you nervous but i promise you i absolutely did horrible on a couple and still got either an A or B on them. She just wants you to understand what she's saying, not looking for perfection. Participate, I missed an evaluation and she extended it, cause I participated.

She's really good, I'm unsure why she doesn't have many ratings. She was a good professor. The course can be intense at times. The conversations can be intimidating but overall the class was fine. There are just times she can get frustrated kind of easily.

I'm surprised there are no reviews for her! She's a very understanding professor. Although she's a native Spanish speaker, she doesn't make you feel bad for mistakes. She has no control over the curriculum and assignments, but she keeps it as light as possible. Stay on top of assignments, and you'll pass. If you take Span 101, I recommend her!

I can tell the professor is a kind, compassionate person and is passionate about her lectures. She encourages critical thinking and ties what we're learning to real world events. Minimal work and clear instructions on assignments and projects.
She must have improved since these ratings because this class may have been the easiest class I have taken. A LOT of homework, but I would suggest you use "outside" help and you will be fine.

The course is easy but arduous. There is a lot of busy work. She asks that you watch documentaries and read the textbook and articles. The class isn't hard, but Prof Valencia makes it hard and hard to attend. Lectures are boring and confusing; there is no clarity on what we need to take notes on and what we don't.

Great professor! Very nice and would recommend her

I can count with one hand all the good comp sci professors at umbc, and he's one of them!!!

Best class I have ever taken. All I had to do was to show up to class and follow the lectures. The HW are really easy if you follow the lectures and even if you don't you can just look at the slides. The midterm and the final were both take home and we had 2 weeks to do it.

One of the best teachers I've had at umbc. He cares about student learning and tries to get everyone to participate. Slides are informative and exams where entirely online and open book. Great class, great professor 10/10 would take again.

One of the best professors I had at UMBC. He is extremely caring and friendly.

He cares about student learning. He treats everyone with respect.
Attendance is mandatory. Exams and Homeworks test classroom learning. 
Overall, great learning and great experience.
