P.chem in general is a very tough subject. Arnold's a nice guy who wants his students to do well, but does not stick close to the book. HW is hard because information could not be found in the textbook, but it is only worth 2 points each. There is not enough resources to get help if you have a question. Very, very tough class, but curve is generous

Although the final exam was really tough in my opinion, the midterms (4 questions each) are relatively straightfoward. Nobody should have a problem getting a B because he curves the final grades by 10%, i.e. 80  is A, 70 B, etc. I wouldn't worry too much about the ACS exam either because I got 20/30 questions right but got a 90% after the curve.
Good professor, clear lecture. His exam are clear, and following closely the homework and example during classes. If it was not for him, PChem would be very boring and hard to get over with/
Makes a terrible subject like PChem tolerable

He is THE professor to take for non-CMSC-majors who would like to learn introductory computer science (through Python). Any difficulty from the class comes from the required materials for all CMSC 201 students (shared Homeworks/shared Project 1). His projects were extremely relevant to nonmajors, and he wealthily-prepares you for exams. The best!!!

I'm a biochem major with no prior coding experience; he broke down Python so easily and made it so that I caught on quick. He has clear office hours, and the class was small, so asking questions was very easy and inconsequential. Exams were open-note, he prioritizes learning above all else. Easily one of my favorite classes.

Arsenault is a passionate professor who clearly loves teaching computer science. Although he's a bit nerdy, he's very friendly and helpful. He taught Python well, and the exams were fairly easy and similar to the practice exams he posts. The only drawback is that some of the homework and projects can be time-consuming and complex.

As someone who has never coded before this class, the content was a little bit difficult for me even in this intro class, but prof is a very nice guy and he'll really help you if you're stuck. He's VERY understanding when it comes to grading and due dates, just email him and give him a heads up. Overall, a really great prof.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I had him when taking Computer Science 201, and he was one of the best professors I've had. He answers all questions and will stay after class to help with homework or projects if you need it. He also gives out a word document/pdf on how to do an assignment/project step by step and will help if you do not understand it. I would 100% recommend him.

He was a really nice guy. I took this class with no programming experience but he was very helpful if you directly went to him with questions. Class was graded by labs, projects, and tests but there are TA office hours and professor office hours so as long as you use them you should be alright. Try not to procrastinate the projects!

The test makes up 50% of the grade. The answers were not taught in lectures. You need to know the answer by reading out of course material by yourself. the timed test has so many questions one can't complete and after an hour test is automatically submitted.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: No idea how this dude has a job. The TA carried the class teaching and grading. Coding assignments deviate from the book, video lectures feature obscure random details not on exams. Exams are full of misspellings, grammatical errors, and repeated answer options. Exams are a race against the clock (1 to 2 minutes per question) Avoid at all costs.
Too Hard

Was a horrible professor. His PowerPoint slides did not explain the material well at all. He made no effort to explain things in lecture videos. You cannot understand what he is saying in his videos. His PowerPoint slides were literally gibberish and all over the place. I would not recommend taking this class with him.

Professor was unavailable and uninterested in helping. After questions, told students material was already covered or on the internet. Strong Python skills needed for this course, but are not listed as a prerequisite. Sample code had errors, material not updated in yrs. 40% of the grade was on a final. Syllabus just a list of topics.
Great

Self-paced class consisting of a weekly reading, assignment + quiz.  Self-motivation + independent learning is essential. Prof's email/forum communications are vague/short but class expectations are clearly posted. I wish forum discussions were not discouraged so it would seem more like a classroom instead of indep. study. But a good class overall.

any graduate students who would like a somewhat self-paced class, take this. consisted of: weekly discussion board questions to answer, timed quizzes (you can take multiple times though), a large SQL assignment (~20 questions to write out statements) and a comprehensive take-home final. learned a lot (on my own, but regardless). online = $$$$$$ tho
Easy Going Professor, Explains concepts clearly for a really broad topic. Tries to make the most time to meet with his students. Lenient in grading, very approachable and nice.

Dr. Blumberg is the best professor I've taken at UMBC. He's very supportive and very flexible with assignments.  We only had to write 3 major essays for the entire semester and they were all based on interesting pop culture topics. He doesn't provide timely assignment feedback unless you email him directly. Besides that, an AMAZING professor!!

This class is an easy A. You will not learn a whole lot, and as far as my experience, you will only be graded for one assignment out of three by the end. Dr. Blumberg has a focus on media as opposed to books, which is what makes this introductory class more engaging. I never watched Star Trek or Night of the Living Dead until this class.

This class wasn't super difficult but it was so frustrating. There were only three assignments the entire semester with extremely unclear directions. We only get one assignment back with basically no feedback. There weren't really lectures or anything so don't expect to learn much. However, this class is fine if you just need the gen-ed credit.

I really liked Prof Blumberg. He did a good job with the online format providing good online lectures. We only had 3 essays through the sem. He gives you a lot of time to craft your essays, I procrastinated a research paper, but was still able to finish in one night. The only issue is he takes a long time to grade so you never know what you have.

This class was so frustrating. We had three major assignments. Only found out the grade of the first one halfway through the class. The other two, still have no idea what I got. He grades so harshly and doesnt have a clear grading criteria. If you actually want to learn how to write, dont take this prof.

Only graded one essay all year and did not give any feedback. I found out I had received a B when the transcript was released. Got mad when I asked what grade I had received one 2 essays which had no grades on it. Do not take this professor, there are better english proffesors on campus

I loved this class. Professor was very chill and class felt welcoming. Class time mainly consisted of short online work or editing your groups papers. Show up, or you cannot make up the work. Class usually ended 20-30 mins early because it's based on how much work you personally need to do. However, very slow grader. Last "essay" is multimedia.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Blumberg was amazing. Loved going to his class as it was really laid back and he didn't bombard you with work. Also, the essays had really interesting topics. Would take again.

We wrote a research paper on zombies and made a presentation on superheroes. He is a pretty tough grader so make sure you have someone check over your work. He didn't provide a rubric of any kind and his TAs do not look over your rough drafts they way that the prof grades them. I thought English would be an easy A. Not so sure anymore.

Horrible professor. Gave me a C on my first paper because it was submitted as a PDF and not a word doc and didnt say anything about submitting as a word doc in the directions. Assignments are very vague and you get no good feedback. Do Not Take This Professor
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: One of the better professors I've had. He has a good sense of humor and is pretty laid back. He grades pretty fair, and is available to help you both in and outside of class. You have to write a few papers on interesting topics, such as zombies. The final was a powerpoint presentation on who is your hero and why. I totally recommend taking him!
never had grades posted, instructions were very vague, prompts were also very vague and didn't include clear or detailed instructions.

This was the easiest college class I've ever taken. He's a really sweet, caring guy and he is very approachable both in and out of class. There were three pop culture essays and a group presentation but he doesn't give a lot of feedback on them unless you ask outside of classJust hit the word count and have good spelling/grammar and it's an easy A.

Blumberg is a chill professor. He was nice and his essays were more pop cultural and interesting than most English classes. The only problem I had with his clas is that out of everything I did, I only received one grade back the entire semester. I got a B In the course and I didnt know what I got on the last 2 essays. He was decent.

Very nice, passionate teacher. Assigns three pop-culture essays and a group presentation project as the final for the semester. Grading criteria is unclear, he puts red lines on the side of your Word doc essay and then a final letter grade with a sentence or two about his opinion. Take him if you want an easy A. Don't take if you want critique
My favorite professor so far, the Essay topics are awesome and actually got me interested in the class.

Very chill professor. Easy grade, and less work than other English classes. Cool papers on zombies and superheroes. However, you don't really learn anything about writing (or English really). Not clear AT ALL on grading. You submit a paper and he will give you a grade with one or two comments.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Awesome professor! Very gentle hearted and very approachable when it comes to questions. Would take again!

If you're going to take Engl 100, take it with Blumberg. This is not a stressful class at all and writing the essays for his class are very doable. The first essay was on Star Trek, second on zombies, and third on superheroes (presentation multimedia). The other tasks are simple and easy to do. He is very nice and approachable.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Easy a but not clear about his grading system and you don't feedback after your first essay
Dr. Blumberg is the best english 100 professor at UMBC. He is so funny, and he's very open minded about writing and POVs. TAKE HIM! Or you'll be missing out.

Blumberg is extremely knowledgeable but very laid back. There are 3 essays including the final with some in class assignments. He gives great feedback if you go and ask him to evaluate your paper and if you have questions he will answer them. The topics of the essays are also quite different which is a nice change from the regular English essays.

If you need to take English 100, take it with Professor Blumberg. He is the most open-minded english teacher I've ever had. He has a very clear grading criteria, and grades VERY fairly. He's always available to help students with their papers and gives so much feedback. Very great teacher!
Dr. Professor Blumberg is honestly one of the most chill guys I have ever met. The second essay was particularly amazing, as it was about zombies. I wish he taught more English classes.

By far one of the best professors you can get for English 100 at UMBC. He doesn't teach it every semester, but if he does, try to take it. He won't waster your time with unnecessary writing assignments, its just 3 papers and in-class assignments. He's kinda nerdy, but that's what makes him awesome. He might give you assignments about zombies.

I cant say enough good things about this professor. He is very passionate about comic books and is respectful of students' opinion. I'm a bad writer, but I got an A- on both papers. Make sure to meet the minimum page numbers and READ HIS PAPER GUIDELINES. He docks a lot of points off if you dont. Read the material, put in effort, and you'll do well

This class was great. The comics were first superheroes, then the material covered some nice stories that had tragedy in them, like Holocaust and other issues. There are 4-5 quizzes throughout, 2-5-7pg papers, and a final 10pg paper or optional comic creation. I had never drawn in my life, but the comic was fun to draw. Cares about grammer 2

Comic book lit was a lot of fun and, in my opinion, an easy A. But you do have to read the books regularly---he gives pop quizzes---and carefully edit your papers. Blumberg is a stickler for correct grammar usage, hates to have his name misspelled, and will dock a letter grade or two from a paper if it fails to meet the min. page length. Funny guy.
Excellent teacher, especially if you like comics, or english for that matter. He is very easy to talk to and understand and has a great sense of humor

good teacher, knows what he's talking about. For a class about comics, it was some work.  3 papers & a bunch of reading quizzes -grades papers hard but reasonably. Was out a lot for his wedding/honeymoon-sub provided was v. good. Fair bit of class discussion, the readings were good, you have to actually read them, but they're comic books! fun class

He seemed to be kind of stuck up about the comic book industry.  He treats Watchmen like the Bible. And I wrote some kickass papers and got B's. He's definitely the hardest grading english professor I've had.

The best. Has a dry sense of humor, is extremely intelligent and tactful, and will hold extensive class discussions about the most interesting things. Very much a stickler for proper grammar and spelling, so be aware of that when writing essays. He's fantastic!

Easiest class ever, nicest professor ever. She is a literal angel. The workload feels fairly light compared to other classes, and she is not strict on attendance. If you have a chance to take her class, do it without second guessing. No regrets

One of the best professors at this school. She understands the workload of a college student and just genuinely wants you to do well however that works for you. She is clearly knowledgable about UX/UI design. I plan on taking her again for 431!

A literal angel. She is the only professor who actually realizes the workload she gives and organizes the class on bb so it's really simple and easy to understand the timeline for projects. She gives clear grading criteria and excellent feedback. Highly recommend her as a professor. Also had her for the 333 typography class and she was great.

I absolutely loved prof garcia, she was a gem of a teacher and my favorite so far at umbc. Had her for typography1 and she made sure everything was organized and easy to follow along with, as well as coordinated with other professors to make sure not everything was due the same day. The nicest teacher i've ever had. Highly recommend.
One of the best professors. Made the somewhat boring content fun. Easy grader. Would recommend

I liked Prof. DeVos for most of the semester and found him knowledgeable and caring, but I was very disappointed by a moment in class when a Hispanic student shared he had family members who were undocumented and the professor joked “I'm calling ICE.” It made the room uncomfortable and nobody laughed, I lost a lot of respect for him that day.

Overall, I enjoyed taking class AMST 200 with DeVos would take more classes in the future with him, I enjoyed his lectures, although they can be lengthy; they still held my attention. I'd recommend the professor and also the class if you need a culture credit. Overall, pretty easy but with challenging discussions that I really enjoyed.

Easily the teacher that made me most believe how passionate they were about the subject they teach. Projects are high-effort but enjoyable and students are given a lot of leeway. Final exam is intentionally easy and he actually marks the part of lecture slides we should take notes on. Very funny and interactive before, during, and after class.

He's very passionate about the content he teaches, and he's very open to all perspectives. He tried to engage with the class as much as possible, but he doesn't scrutinize anyone for not participating. The projects were easy, and so was the homework. He laughs a lot lol, and most work you do are group assignments.

He's a very niche person... Very cool and has a lot of interesting interests and perspectives. He's a very easy grader as long as you follow assignment guidelines and attend classes. He's also very passionate about the courses that he teaches, which is very refreshing.

Straightforward class short weekly assignments, 4 projects (1 short essay and 3 audio-visual projects) and one open note final. The projects are not too difficult and can be completed in a day and the final was a no time limit-take home exam. He is also a pretty lenient grader, so if you try you'll receive a decent grade.

This professor is really good at explaining within his lectures. He tries to incorporate a lot of videos so its not just him talking, and I feel like this is the only class that I genuinely can connect to the real life world with. He is really well spoken and makes sure that. everything he says is appropriate, and funny! Super empathetic professor!
This professor is the best professor I have had since my Kindergarten teacher. He is so well thorough, he is really good at explaining

Dr. DeVos is by far the best professor I've had in all my college years! I wish he taught every subject. His teaching style is unique and FUN. I took an accelerated distant learning course and his expectations are very clear! Participate in lectures and complete some assignments. He's not a tough grader as long as you show some critical thinking.

i took AMST200: What is an American and AMST365: The American Horror Film with devos! easily my favorite classes i've ever taken. they were fun, got me excited to go to class everyday, and helped me grow as a person (both academically and emotionally). devos is incredibly kind and chill if you're the same. be open and authentic and you'll do well!!
puts on chill guy persona, not actually chill

The professor is amazing! He is funny and cares about his students. This class was graded by weekly assignments (very very easy), two projects (very easy), and a take-home final exam (easy). Would definitely recommend anyone to take this class and him.

This class taught by him was the coolest class at UMBC that I have ever taken. He is an awesome professor and his lectures are very interesting and keep people watching. He has 4 projects and then a take-home final at the end and every night before class there is a small video to respond to. this was an awesome class!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I had him for AMST 200 and he was great! My best professor yet. He's funny and very knowledgable. His lectures are captivating and there are a few small projects throughout the semester that he grades lightly! The final is open note, so go to all of the classes!

I made my ratemyprofessor account just to review Professor DeVos, I had him last semester for History of Music and I genuinely think he was the best professor I've ever had. Very casual and easy to talk to, makes jokes, talks about his personal life sometimes in a way that makes you feel very connected to him. I cannot recommend him enough.
Professor DeVos is an amazing professor! If you are interested in music definitely take this class! He cares about his students and is always willing to help them.
An amazing teacher, really fun lectures

I've never said this about anyone else at UMBC, but DeVos is exactly what a professor should be like. He isn't a person who simply hands out grades, he's a lecturer that incorporates everything for a fun and easy (if you put in the work) American studies course. Any music lovers should definitely take this class with him. 11/10 would recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Inspirational--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: He is a solid teacher. His sense of humor is hit or miss, but the class was very interesting and he delivered it in a good way

Took Professor Anchor for MCS 101 Lab, and she was great! Super easy class, just follow her instructions and read the guidelines for the projects, and you will easily get an A. It was fun using editing apps, and she was really helpful if you had any questions. Definitely recommend her if you want an easygoing professor!

Took MCS 101 with her in Spring 2024. Her lectures were pretty engaging and she would ask the students many questions. There are lots of videos we watch later in the semester. The lab section was not hard as long as you paid attention. Even if you struggle with video editing, this class is easy and Professor Anchor is always willing to accommodate.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This was the second time I have taken a class taught by Professor Anchor and I have greatly enjoyed both. I am not the strongest student but this class was an easy A as long as you turned in the assignments on time. Anchor was very helpful during the assignments and was always very kind to everyone.

If you are into video production or photography , you might like this class. As someone who is into video editing / photography I enjoyed these projects as a break from my usual work , even if they are time consuming. Attendance matters but if you keep up , projects aren't too bad.
Extremely nitpicky when it comes to grading for group projects. Also mandatory attendance is annoying to deal with. Not a horrible person, but I would definitely not take another course with her.

Professor Anchor is a great 101 teacher. She gives relevant information to topics, and the projects and papers that go along with it are based on what was learned in class, especially for Lab. She gives plenty of background for assignments, and plently of time to complete them. Easy course, just sometime lectures are not the most interesting.

Professor Anchor is the only choice for MCS 101 and that's fine. She has structured the class well but there's a lot of work between the lecture and lab. Assignments are easy but require some effort. The textbook is a "required" read before class but you really don't have to. Some weeks you'll need the textbook to do the weekly questions, or not.

Lazy, gives unclear assignments, gives way too many assignments (not little homework assignments, important assignments that will easily mess up your grade), relies on the TA too much (and the TA rarely grades and when she does she does she grades strictly). Another prime example of the average UMBC prof.

Very average professor. Easy class with easy projects and short assignments. She's very nice but her lectures were kind of boring, and sometimes we would just watch online videos for a large portion of the lecture. Not very stimulating, but take it if you want an easy A.

She's a really good professor. I would totally take her again! The projects are super easy, and the work load isn't a lot.  If you ask question she'll happily answer without making you feel like you're  burden.

She's a decent professor, but kind of unclear in assignments. Generally, it's not too difficult taking her publishing class but if you're even slightly unsure about what she expects in an assignment, definitely approach her because there were many times when I thought I did well but actually got a low B or C. Also, come to class!

Ashfia went out of her way to make sure everyone passed and got a good grade. She provides easy extra credit opportunities, is extremely generous in her grading of exams and lab reports and she tells you exactly what to study for exams. Homework assignments are simple and easy to complete. She is also flexible on due dates. Take her, trust me.

I really liked Ashfia Habib when I retook CMPE 306 with her, she clearly cared about her students and really wanted them to learn taking the time to make sure we knew the material. She was a very kind grader showing us exactly how to get points on her tests and giving lots of extra credit, meaning we knew the material important for future course.

This professor was very excited to teach and make sure the class understood subjects and aimed to make students feel comfortable as possible taking this course. She was kind and more than happy to help you outside of class and gave 110% in effort throughout the class. Very understanding and it was a pleasure to take her class.

You can actually pass this class, and understand something valuable with professor Habib. 
Good luck trying to pass or understand anything with any of the other professors!

Ms. Habib is very kind and accommodating. She makes sure that students understand the topics. 

You need to redo your class works and home-works multiple times to be able to get full marks. She provides bonus question which makes it very nice. She tries her best to inspire the class- which I loved very much.

VERY slow grader, projects are easy and sometimes in groups, don't need the textbook much, just show up and participate. looking at other reviews it seems like she is a new teacher and getting better each semester, but still takes literal months to grade. kind person, shares personal experiences but not excessively

This was my second class with Dr. Prowell and I def recommend! Easygoing class with a lot of discussion as a class and in small groups. Lots of case studies and activities in class too. Fun group project at the end. Always checked in with us to see how we felt, gave class time to work on group project, and always answered my many emails.

Dr. Prowell was a great professor but she is a VERY slow grader. There was a big group project at the end of the semester but it helped with the comprehension of what we were learning. The class was good with open discussions. A lot of chapters weren't finished reviewing in class because of roleplay like situational examples of material.

Overall, she was a very enjoyable professor. She was down to joking and had a relaxed atmosphere while still going over material. That being said, she was an extremely slow grader, discussion boards, and group project class time. Class time felt rushed and misused as we ended up chapters behind, and it cut into big group final work time.
Professor Prowell was an amazing professor she always came in a great mood and always open to help out. I would recommend to take this class if you want.

I found Dr. Prowell's class to be very intriguing. Class was always different so we used videos, role plays, and in class group activities instead of just powerpoints. We also had many deep discussions about real world topics related to our chapters. You can tell she's a newer professor but overall very chill, not super rigid, and l learned a lot!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Prowell is a lovely person, but I didn't like her teaching style at all. Instead of using the discussion board in BlackBoard, she made everyone create a Twitter account. She pressured us into trauma-dumping, and she made no effort to control discussions when they started getting aggressive.

Dr. Prowell was awesome! I just had her and she was very flexible with deadlines and just wanted to make sure we understood the material. There is a group presentation at the end of the semester so beware of that for those who are presentation shy! Very understanding professor and I would definitely take her again.

Do the homework, go to the class and do the practice problems with her. Ask questions if you're lost. One of the easiest classes to pass if you just keep up with the content. She gives opportunities for extra credit and is a very clear and concise lecturer.

She is a wonderful teacher who has a gift at explaining things in a way you can understand! I took her 6-week class over the summer and her teaching style really helped me catch up to the level I want to be at mathematically.
Good teacher, clear, quizzes every week, study material on blackboard
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Prof. W was good, not great. The class is lecture heavy, where she goes over all the material, then you take a quiz about once a week. Having a study buddy will help greatly. The material isn't too bad, and the HW can be done ahead of time to avoid having it later. As a prof, she's not too memorable, but the class really isn't too bad.
Take this course!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment:
Explains concepts clearly. She's very personable, stays after class to answer questions, responds to emails quickly, and is a very fair grader. 
Online homework assignments were really helpful and a quiz every week.
She notices who goes to class and will consider that and your quiz/test progress if you're on the cusp of a higher final grade.

Relatively easy math course, she's always there after class to help and is has good lectures. She explains things well and as long as you take notes and do the homework you don't have anything to worry about. There's a quiz every week but they aren't too bad either. I would recommend her to anyone who has to take 106.
Barley any explanation, no real explaining and it's very frustrating, we are left to fend for ourselves

Had us do a graded test on the first day, clearly did not think about students who would potentially transfer the first day. Not only this but several classmates + I did not know where she put assignments and blamed us for missing the assignments. She also just tells us what she did in the problems and not explain them as a professor should.

just make sure you attend class and take notes because her quizzes and test are pretty much the notes but with different problems. it was pretty easy overall, some of the quizzes have extra credit. she's good at teaching too, and her expectations are clear.

Professor Witkowski was the best math teacher I've had in a longtime. She took the time to go over all types of problems in great detail while also providing multiple approaches to solve certain problems. I would 110% recommend for anyone who stresses out about math.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Racist
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: All I can say is thank God she retired. I get that she wants us to understand the content, but she needed to understand that school is not free. We pay for everything, so being harsh was not going to help us at all.

I liked Professor Amy. Do not underestimate her class as I did. She wants you to learn the material, so you need to study hard. She will be retiring soon so this comment doesn't matter anymore I guess. Enjoy the retirement Professor Amy! Good luck!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--So many papers

reviews.comment: I am very surprised by the amount of negative reviews here. Prof was very passionate when I took her class and made sure we understood the material. Her lectures are great if you're attentive and engage in the group activities. The group project looks scary but isn't that bad as long as you follow directions. The hardest part were the class quizzes
She does not care about what students learn and take with them.

She is the worst Professor I have ever had at UMBC. Do not take her!!! She has a bad attitude with her students and is not a helpful professor. She made us work with an actual real company for the group project and does not even show you what parts of the deliverable are supposed to look like or talk through it. She just says refer to the book.

Everhart is a good professor. I ended up having to retake this class and retook it with her again. As long as you ask for clarification on assignments and things she is happy to explain. Bit of a picky grader though. Her tests are hard but if you study well you can get at least a B on them. She tries to engage students during lectures with groups

Good professor. Explains well and tried to engage students. Harsh grader though when it comes to citations. Exams are also rather hard so study a lot. Workload isn't too bad. Ask for clarification when you need it. Key takeaway: CITATIONS MATTER so be sure you get them right and study for exams.

Amy is an amazing professor you just have to talk with her. She listened to me complain about peer evaluations & had her look over my assignment before my presentation and got 100%. All the people complaining probably never talked to her outside of class. 10/10 would take her class again! Just talk to her like a human being and you will pass

I felt that she was unwilling to listen to student feedback about quizzes. Especially when the error was on her hand. Didn't seem to understand the technology that was being used in Blackboard which lead to a lot of confusion for the quizzes. Study for quizzes and make sure you do your deliverable resubmits on the project. She's not THAT bad
complains about grading but she's assigning all that joint. if you take this class, make sure it's the only one in your schedule because it's difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: rude, sassy, doesn't care if you pass or not. painfully harsh on her grading and does not realize her mistakes. yeah, you probably will learn a lot in her class. will you pass though even if you learn? 100% nah.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I think Everhart is an ok professor - she cares about her students and presents lectures professionally - but she's not very interesting or engaging as a person. The class isn't very difficult - you have 4 article reviews, an annotated bibliography, and a debate, not to mention the 4 exams - but none are too hard if you pay attention. Class was ok.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Classes don't have any substance. She just reads off from the slides. Inflexible even when things were tough (The Coronavirus). I would not recommend her at all and Miss Everhard, if you're reading this review, I hope you're having a nice day, but your teaching style needs a lot of improvements.

The best way to describe amy in is 436 is the way a classmate described her, "overbearing and underwhelming" She will take such an easy class and find ways to make it complicated and unnecessarily hard. Put in the work and be prepared and u should be fine, expect her to lowball you and bomb an exam or two
Tough grader, nice professor in honesty. i dont like her style
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Is-300 she seems nice personally, and neat in her work. Teaching, updating syllbus, and handing back student work on time is her quality. But this all are nonsense if her grading style is so awful. Exam covered 60%, and 40% of each exam is explanation and she is awful grading this part. Careless whether you pass or not, that is her awfulness.

Mrs. Everhart is actually a good professor. The workload was not as insane as others have put it. If you have good time management skills, and ask her for feedback earlier before the due date, you will be set. Also it helps to take copious notes of her talking points since they will be on every exam. Reading the textbook and slides are a must.

Lectures were pretty straightforward; ppts and articles. Everhart wasn't 'rude' to any students during my enrollment, in fact the entire class had a nice bond. Debates & presentations are mandatory. Tests on the other hand were a problem. There are book questions & some from class presentations as well. Surprisingly tough & grade heavy, had to WD.

There are debates and presentations and the homework is mainly a bunch of essays. It's not necessarily a difficult class, but she just gives a lot of unnecessary work. Participating is really important too. The tests are a combination of random things she throws out in class and textbook information. So, if you skip class, you might fail the tests.

Very tough grader, 4 tests 60% of your grade, thought I knew the material going into the 1st and 2nd test, and even knew the stuff she said was going to be on the test but ended up failing both test and had to drop the class. Now I need to re-take this class with a different teacher..
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Her attitude towards her students needs to change. Frequently responds to students questions with a lot of sass. She genuinely has no respect for students who ask "stupid" questions. Frequently forgets to explain course items and projects and blames it on her students instead. Horrible attitude and demeanor and does not abide by the syllabus.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Show up to class, ask questions in debates and on presentations. Lectures covered common sense content so were boring but easy to understand. Gives many hints about exam content. Exams consist of short answers and some m/c. Does have two writing assignments and 4 short news article reviews. She was trying a new textbook so textbook wasn't needed.

She's fairly interested in what she's teaching but falls back to PPTs for most of the class. It's understandable, but that coupled with the frequency of writing assignments makes it feel a little tedious. Solid teacher with a decent sense of humour. Would recommend taking this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Hilarious, A professor that will call you out on things that (most professors should) but don't. She comes off as strict, but If you look deeper you can tell she cares and is trying to mold her students to what they will experience in the 'real world' work force. Late? Called out.. You also learn a lot, she gets you used to presenting to others. <3
Loved her class. Exams were fair and she told you what was on the exam. Textbook was not really needed, just go to lecture. A few presentations and some small writing assingments.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Prof Everhart is amazing! Don't listen to everyone else, she does come off as snarky sometimes but that's if you don't get her sarcasm and humor (also if you act up). She's very clear about grading and the assignments are relatively easy. Tells you word for word what's on exams. Material is really easy to memorize.

She is a fun teacher. She may come off as rude or petty but the class itself is not difficult. STUDY THE LECTURE NOTES SHE POSTS ONLINE AND PAY ATTENTION IN CLASS. She literally tells you whats on big parts of the tests. Study HARD for exam 2 (hardest exam). She is very snarky at times but dont get offended, thats just how she is. She means well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: First things first Everhart is the worst. She will let you fail and feel nothing about it even she sees that you put in your best effort. I had her for IS 300 and thought she was alright but for this class AVOID HER BY ALL MEANS.
1st of all she's Rude, her 6 quizzes are 75% of the overall grade. she does not mess around grading. failed both of my quizzes even though I felt like I understood the material pretty well.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Amy is awful. She's extremely rude and has no regard for student success. If she chooses not to like you for some reason, she will fail you. She gave me a 79 and would not round me up because she believed I didn't pay attention during class. I always had my slides open on my laptop. Be careful taking her.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Great teacher. Smart, knows her stuff, will admit when she's made a mistake. She does not tolerate you screwing off during class. Pay attention! The final project is a lot of work but it's not HARD work. She cares about your success and she'll help you out outside of class. Good prof!

Everhart is a good professor and class is generally enjoyable and educational. Her tests are difficult however. In IS436 there were 6 quizzes each worth 12.5% each and the group project. You really have to read the book or spend a good amount of time studying to get decent grades on the quizzes.

Tough grader but she is reasonable and is just looking for quality work. Many student's are not willing to put in the work required to earn a decent grade in this class and are shocked when they get bad grades. Some IS professors let you slide with poor quality work and Everhart is not one of them. If you schedule office hours she is very helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Worst professor ever! Grades really bad and very unhelpful during office hours. If you ask her any question, expect to get a Mean answer from her. Also she likes to embarass students during class acting like she's some kind of class clown. A few students ended dropping her class because of her sassiness
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: She's an ok teacher! You do learn a lot in her class. Make sure  to do good on the quizzes and your project, that's all your graded on. My only complaint about her is that she's gets kinda rude sometimes  when you visit her during office hours. I'll stop by to ask her questions about the class and she'll look down upon u and answer in a mean way
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Don't listen to reviews. If you're not lazy and somewhat motivated she is not bad of a teacher. Just attend class she tells you what will be on the exams. The exam MC comes from the cengage practice quizes and half the exam is just remembering article info. She tells you how she wants things and if you follow her rules you will get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Everhart is a good professor for IS! She does teach the subject well and does stress its importance making the class a bit difficult. But if you come to class and study the powerpoint slides then you should be fine. She can be a tough grader however so be check every little detail. Also beware of semester-long paper which can get annoying.

She is overall a very good teacher. She makes you do a lot of work, though it isn't difficult stuff. 3 exams total, just memorize the outlines she posts on blackboard to the fullest and the presentation articles and you are guaranteed atleast an 80 on the exams. Pay attention in class and she pretty much tells you exactly what is  on the exam. GL.
She's good about teaching you stuff, because she will make you work really hard, but don't expect to get good grade from her, she grade very tough and bad.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Tough Grader--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Good professor but pretty hard. Lots of busywork (papers, presentations, homework) but if you put in a solid effort you'll do well. Very hard to get an A, only 5 out of 40 in our class.

Honestly the difficulty of this class taught by professor Everhart is very reasonable for a gateway. She is straightforward in her teachings and expects you to study and write high quality papers. Don't expect to get good grades with last minute work, put effort into each paper and exam and you will do perfectly fine. I enjoyed her Sarcastic humor.

Okay so there are 3 tests, no final. There is a 10 page annotated Bibliography. There is a group project and she makes you come in to present it during finals week. She is very sassy and not helpful at all. Her sassiness can be funny but when you seriously need help that sassiness will hurt you alot. Her exams are super hard. Dont Skip/Dont Take

Shes a nice person and all, but she doesnt seem to actually know much about the subject material. She just goes by what the book says, so do yourself a favor and just buy the book for this class. Youll need it if you want a good grade. The material in the class is pretty much common sense, but she will WORK YOU TO THE BONE and shes VERY nitpicky

She is very unclear about grading criteria for papers and the group project. She will purposefully ignore any corrections or arguments in regards to questions on exams, even if most of the class did not understand. She speaks in a derogatory manner to students and is not recommended in the least. She will not curve, even if there are no A's.
her test are hard and confusing. you do not need a book. Also,  you will write 10 page annotated BIB. her lecture are long and when she says something is on the test it is really not there

Amy tends to come off as disrespectful when she tries to be funny in class. Can be very vague about assignment expectations, and you must schedule an appointment with her in order to see her grade on your test, which doesn't make sense to me. Easy subject matter, but definitely try and take it with another professor if you can.

90% of class is busy work and offers little or no educational value. Grading is highly subjective, yet she's often vague about her expectations on assignments. Very reminiscent of high school. Disrespectful towards students. Gives important announcements during class that aren't repeated on blackboard, via email, or updated on the syllabus.
How does she have a smiley face? She is rude, unclear about grading, and generally acts like her class is the only class that you have to take. Take with another professor if you can.

Second course taken with her as an instructor.  Great personality as a professor.  Not at all an easy teacher but more or less fair.  If you want to get an A, take notes in her class along w ppts.  Pretty strict on grading papers (Ive lost points simply for APA format mistakes).  Easy to meet woutside of class for help.. not enough students do it
Worst professor!!! Don't take her!!
Average professor. Avoid taking her class if you can.

Just sort of average, and very dry. Not really interested in the material and talked down to the class most of the time. Ok as a person, not so hot as an instructor. Made everyone bored and just wanted to get out of there. Terrible advisor.

A lot of the time she treats the class like 5 year old kids.  She just goes over the power point the book manufacturer provides.  Tests were pretty easy IMO but she could clarify in some questions asked as there could be more than one answer in a MC question.  Ended up with an "A" with moderate effort put in.

Teaches like she's someone's annoying, naggy mother and you're 5. Never clear on anything, her exams are confusing since she makes up her own questions, so they're all like "Which COULD be the best choice?" Use the book to copy Deliverable examples exactly so you don't lose points like I did.

The exams are confusing and the second exam she did not give enough time to complete all of the diagrams. She grades harshly. The final project wasn't too difficult but is very time consuming. Do not take this class with expectations of an easy A.

Awesome person, but not the best teacher. Most of class time is the lectures, which are straight from a power point, which she also post online. The workload and exams aren't bad. She says you need the textbook - you don't. You'll just need to copy 1 case study from a classmate.

One of the best IS professors for this course. She makes the course content interesting with her fun personality and makes the class more lively. There was a total of two presentations, which were not bad at all since she'd allow you to read from the paper. There were not a lot of written assignments and they were very short and easy.

Mrs. Everhart is a great professor, but will work you to the bone. The semester project is time consuming and tedious since you have to constantly redo deliverables while working on the next, so make sure you have a competent group. The exams can be difficult. My biggest complaint is that she goes on with pointless sports stories before an exam.

Mrs. Everhart is good about telling us what we need to know for exams, & her lectures are easy to follow. However, she has an attitude. She is very condescending and not approachable.  She has ridiculous policies.  You have to make an appointment to see your exams. She refuses to pass them back in class. Very nit-picky about written assignments.

Wonderful at teaching. Shows she is really into teaching and will help you. But when it comes to exams, she is very hard. Her exam reviews are not really helpful. It may seem an easy A in the class but exams will surprise you. YOu are lucky if you get B.

She is one of the best professors of the IS department. Really god explaining and what I really like is that her exams are easy if you read and UNDERSTAND the material. They're not trivial questions, you need to know the concepts to apply it to the questions on her exam. As long as you read and pay attention you will be good. Excellent professor

I love her. She'S FUNNY, makes you want to come to class! Very clear on explanations, engages students to participate. Very helpful during office hours, will consider extra credit. Wish she taught 310 too, not tate redding (horrible). Take notes in class and pay attention, you'll pass. Gives study guides for tests, but you need to know A LOT

There's a semester long project for during the first 2 weeks of class, choose your group members wisely. She's expects full concentrations and attendance from her students.  Buy the book! HW assignments are from it, and it'll serve you well when it comes time to study for her exams. 2 Quizzes & 2 exams. Around 2-3 HW assignments. It's an easy B.

If you're late...you WILL be fried. Will not tolerate phones. She's very motherly which makes her very likeable. Her class is simple and sorta easy to pass, but in class instruction is extremely repetitive and boring, so w/o your phone it is HARD to stay awake. She has SOME days when there's an in class activity. Those are always great!

Wonderful for IS 300; 436 is significantly harder. Not easy, but students learn a tremendous amount. Study well for exams (especially DFD & ERD for Exam 1), choose group members wisely (semester-long proj. - design system), and you'll receive at least a B. If you find yourself in an unmotivated group and/or perform badly on exams, prepare for Hell.
Best instructor I've met in the IS department at UMBC. She's interested in the course and her students. Attendance is really important to her. I've taken multiple courses with her, she's great!

She is very nice and funny at times. I'm taking a class with her and I can see she is one of the best teachers for this course. She assigns 4 article reviews and you have to present one to class. 2 case studies and a research paper. Also, 3 exams.

Attendance is mandatory if you expect to get a passing grade.  Assigns good amount of homework, articles, and projects to be completed so you have to put in a good amount of work to get a desirable grade.  She's friendly, has a great sense of humor and is willing to help her students.

As said before, draconian rules. Won't pass back tests, attendance is her pet peeve, will nit pick students for wearing hats, and uses safeassign (horrible way to check papers). THAT BEING SAID, the class is passable, but might want to rethink your options if other teachers are available.

This is truly on of the best professors I've had at UMBC. She is nice and even funny. Also, she brings in cookies when discussing internet cookies. If you have to take IS300 I strongly recommend you take it with her. If you complete everything and study the slides for the exams, you should get an easy A.

Summer IS 300.  Was very clear what you needed to know for the test.  Very helpful if you have questions.  If you do the work, and study what she tells you will be on the test- you will get an A.  Not even that much studying, maybe an hour before the test you study, thats all you need as long as you go to class and pay attention. good teacher!
very nice teacher. easy exams and one paper. I loved her class. don't buy the access book for the lab. you won't need it.

I received a B in the class. The tests are a little hard because she does not post her powerpoints online, so you have to go to class to get them. She's scary at times but pleasant mostly. Make sure you participate in class discussions and buy both books cus you will need them. The lab book is only $30.

Doesn't pass back tests during class.She insists on you scheduling an appointment to her office to view them. Also makes you stay till the end of class when you've finished your tests. Tests are 60% multiple choice & 40% 'short answers'.Guilty until proven innocent seems to be her main motto, when it comes to papers.Ridiculous draconian rules.
Great professor! She truly cares about the students. If you take notes and pay attention in class, you will succeed. Don't waste money on buying the Access 2007 book for lab - you won't need it.

don't buy the Acess 2007 book, because you never use it. pretty easy class. if you read chapter summaries before test and write down important things on PP in class, tests are easy. hard to understand lab teacher
Over all she is a nice teacher and is flexible.
don't take her unless she is the last person on earth alive teaching it. Makes everything complicated for no reason. Easy material, but she is not.

WORST PROF EVER! ITS BETTER TO CHANGE YOUR MAJOR THEN TO TAKE HER! she will roll her eyes on you! if you try to talk to her its pretty freaky..Her test are tough if she tells you something thats going to be on the exam IT WILL NEVER BE on the exam! It isjust a 101 level class and she takes it as its a 400 level.Trust me DON"T take her u will regret

Very good professor for IS101.  She is very straightforward, class is very easy in general.  Basically no homework and tests are very easy.  She is also willing to help you with anything dealing with class or anything school related.  Very nice although strict about deadlines, talking in class, etc.

Proof that home-grown professors are Grade-A. Prof. Everhart is very down-to-earth and just an all-around great professor. Her tests are relatively easy, but you will be scratching your brain on some questions. Her lectures are interesting, and she keeps you interested. Would highly recommend her to anyone starting out in IS.

So Far, The best Lecturer I've had @umbc. Exams are fair, 1 6-9p term paper, 4 article reviews-1 u have to present, & a group project. =! an easy A. She knows how to be mean and nice as well so go to cls. She takes attendance. Grade wise, she gives you what you get! no ifs or buts ... If she is teaching a cls take her !!!!

Fairly simple class; 1 long paper and 4 short article reviews to write (must present 1 of them).  Exams are OK -- MC, TF, and several essays but she's a picky grader.  Group project at the end is simple, but she does take attendance.
She is a nice teacher; I wouldn't go as far as saying she's the best. Very VERY easy class. Just show up and re-read the slides before the exam and you're golden. She loves group work.

she is the best teacher at UMBC. very clear and funny keeps the class interesting it's hard to fail her exam one paper 3 exams very easy read the book no final I really liked. lab is very is too just easy stuff about MS word, access and excel I got A in this class

This is the best teacher I have ever had.She is extremely nice, she knows what she's talking about & she is very helpful.I go to her often to chat.The class is easy and as long as you do the write-ups on time,you'll pass. Make sure you site your well,if you do,you should get 100% of the extra points. The exams are easy just read and listen in class

shes a great professor. really funny. lab work is super easy; only really basic stuff about Microsoft Word, Excel, Access, and Powerpoint. one paper which is easy. 3-4 exams which are straight from the powerpoints. don't buy the book. you don't need it. overall very easy course with a great teacher!

Ms. Everhart's classes are very well structured and organized. She is pretty lenient and will give you extensions if you ask. Our class was pretty straight forward. Exams were slightly hard, but I didn't have the book. still got a B, little effort. A little closed minded though, can be opinionated.

fun and vibrant. passionate and enthusiastic. 3 exams, no finals. one research paper, one group project. 4 article reports, 2 individ present. not hard at all. very interesting material. organized and laid back. fun class. powerpoint lecture. powerpoint/textbook/related readings on exam. exams aren't hard. revise taught material. recommended!!

Easy class, just study the powerpoint slides and you'll be fine. The lab section is a breeze really, just Microsoft Office stuff. Mrs. Everhart is a nice lady for the most part, she has her days just like the rest of us but overall I thought she was very helpful when I needed it and a fair grader.

This is one of the most interesting classes I have ever been enrolled in. The work load is fair and all material has been presented and explained in class. There are plenty of ways to obtain points for those who may not test take well. Ms. Everhart is one of the nicest Profs I've had so far. She makes you want to go to class.

She is a really cool teacher, a lot of fun and very helpful. oh ya and she got jokes lol, but the class was always fun and interesting..she knew how to entertain everyone.. Definately one of the best professors!! Take her class if possible, you will have fun! guaranteed! lol

She's just absolutely awesome, the best I've had so far in college. Her classes are easy and always so much fun, she's very interesting and is very easy to talk to. She gives you help whenever you need, and she's a very fair grader. STRONGLY RECOMMENED!!
Great teacher and very easy to approach.  Exams are all out of the book and powerpoints.  Makes it easier to understand info with good examples

Easy course, seems very interested in the subject. Very easy to talk to, and easy grading. One term paper that she works you through the semester with deadlines. Tests are directly from the reading and the PowerPoint presentations. Definitely recommend this professor for this course. Funny, too, in class and very easy to approach.
She's a great teacher. She's easy to get along with. Funny & quirky. Always available to help. Everything is straight forward.
Ok class and nice professor.  Just alot of work.... paper, abstracts, a group project, and exams.  If you do the work you should be okay.

Mrs.Everhart was a great professor. She helps you if needed, she is always in her office during office hours, her grading is explained clearly, exams are fair and overall she's a great a teacher! I would suggest everyone take classes with Everhart.

Pretty easy class.  You have to know a good amount of material outside of the book for the exams.  Lectures are straight from the powerpoint slides for the book.  I used the book very little, mainly for case studies and class discussions and I managed a B.  This class is a lot of work, I will caution you on that.
BS class.  Needed it for econ major. Just do the assignments and you'll easily get a B. Tests had "trivia" crap on it, so be sure to memorize the names of people she mentions in the slides.

She can be short with you, if you get on her nerves or if she's having a bad day.  She posts the slides she discusses, so its not really necessary to take notes, unless she specifically says that something will be on the test. If you take the Y-portion with Ms. Lewis, you should have no troubles getting an A. Overall, not a bad teacher.

Long as you read the Powerpoints and the vinettes in the text book she assignes youll do fine on the exams. she doent really give out what to study, just alot of information like chapters 4-7 but they are not cumulative so its not too bad.
I don't know what that one guy is talking about, b/c she a a great professor that knows what she's doing and is very helpful with al lher students.  I w uold reccommend her any day.

The class is directly from the book and if you attend lectures and memorize the answeres from the book, you will get an easy A.  There was one paper which you only had to do to get an A.  One test was quite unreasonable, however, she did give a small curve on the test to make up for it's difficulty.  Overall, not a bad teacher.

Presents the material in a very coherent manner, follows the book very well with lectures. Exams aren't that difficult if you actually pay attention and/or read the book. Also, she is very kind and personable.

she is horrible. avoid her if possible. horrible grader, not clear about what she wants on exams, thinks her class is the most important one ever and that you should only focus on it and nothing else. expects WAY too much for 100 level class. worst ever, she should quit or get off the power trip.
She is a great teacher and she is nice as well.  Easy to talk to and she is helpful.  UMBC is lucky to have her teaching and working with students.
No Comments

She is a nice person but when it comes to the subject matter she is very difficult to please. She is very anal and not willing to work with people who don't catch on immediately. She's a wiz at her topic but is not effective at helping others to achieve the same.
easy class. assignments and tests are exactly like what u do in class. she's a very caring professor.

She's a very caring and helpful professor.  Very easy to talk to, if you need any help on advising or anything.  Best professor that I know so far at this school.  Easy class and would definitely take her again.
Coding on exams and project.

VERY EASY CLASS.  A must take for anyone.  The teacher is great, makes the class fun and gets things done as quick as possible.  The scheduled hour and a half class only takes 45 minutes or so each time.  A++!

Goes over PowerPoint each lecture. If you struggle with accents, he has a very heavy accent. Has 2 homework assignments that are like 3 hours worth of work. They are due by midterms, then by finals. If you procrastinate a lot, you will struggle. Would not take the class again due to how much he uses PowerPoint. otherwise fine teacher

Exams are significant majority of your grade, so its important to lock in for those. Study guides are given for each exam, and uses the learning activity concepts for problems on exams. As long as you study for the exams you should be ok

The class is easy for the most part. He explains very well. For the exams, keep repeating learning activities. Most of the questions on the exams are taken from the learning activities with slight changes.

I took AP Microeconomics before in high school. Compared to my Senior year AP, it wasn't as graph heavy, especially as a beginner. If you need help with graphing, watch Review Econ. Econ is a "social science" + working with some numbers and math. He's a really nice teacher, so you don't have to hesitate when picking your classes. :)
Professor Asguest was a great teacher, He made compulated concepts easy to understand and

Take him. he is really good. He is very dramatic but I liked that about him. He is funny too. As for his lectures, they are very easy to understand. If you want to do well, ask questions and focus mainly on the learning activities. Again focus on the learning activities.

Overall, very entertaining professor and interesting class, but only thing is your grade is dependent heavily on exams, so it's kind of unfortunate, so thought I'd be getting A, but I got B. However, exams are not that hard if you pay attention in class and take the answers from the learning activities.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He is an excellent professor. Attendance isn't mandatory but I would suggest attending the lecture, his exams are heavily based on what he teaches during lecture.
If you don't go to class you'll lose points
Pay attention and go over the study materials you should be fine

Great professor as long as you go to class. Class is exam heavy (final and midterms are like 80% of your grade) but all exams are multiple choice and most of the answers are in the learning activities he goes over in class. So as long as you go and pay attention, you can easily get an A
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof Asguet is a great professor. He knows a lot about economics and his explanations were clear, which made the course very easy to understand. There were 3 exams (including the final) which were 80% of the grade, so this meant you had to really prepare for them. Though the exams weren't difficult as long as you pay attention + study.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The accent is the only issue with Prof. Asguet. Outside of that, he's very friendly, his exams are fairly made, and as long as you study and attend lecture, you'll do fine. I never felt bored in his class, and I highly recommend him for economics. I felt like I understood economics after taking his class.

His classes are lecture heavy, but very interactive. He goes through learning activities with the class and expects everyone to participate.

There are few grades in his class, mostly all exams, not much homework, but the lack of assignments makes the value of the exams very vital to your overall grade (kind of sucks).
I took him for MGMT-489, Great professor!
The professor is funny teaches with good examples and grades u well and a quiet interesting class with him I would say ultra easy and one of the chill professors in UMBC.
Awesome professor. He is funny and knowledgeable. Easy course with really engaging and fun lectures. Some of the more engaging ones at the school.

The class just consisted of 3 exams, 1 final exam, and a final report. The lectures were super boring, but they're all of blackboard and attendance isn't mandatory. He is very clear on what we will need to know for all the exams and grades them quickly. All in all a good professor

This professor has no respect for a student's privacy concerns. He grades very, like very late and does not care about any student's concerns. He is always upset when you contact him as if you did something to him to offend him. His instructions are not clear at all. Many have emailed the department about him yet he is the only professor for 440.

She was always available after lecture to answer any questions & even let you get more practice in lab if needed. As long as u put time aside to study for the class u will do fine. Highly recommend!

reviews.comment: Shes the coolest professor I have ever known. Shes very knowledgeable and very approachable. I wish she teaches me often

Lecture heavy. Students end up zoning out after 15 minutes because her lectures are just monotonous and LONG. Usually, she will try to go over 40+ slides a day. I had a hard time focusing on her class because I couldn't really understand her well but again, this is only coming from my perspective.  Suggestion: Just read and you will do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: First the class is huge, making the lectures seem impersonal. Shes always just trying to push through the infromation(wich is not easy might I add). Make sure you do the online quizzes. CAREFULLY. You only get once chance and that can really impact your grade. One thing I hated is that she put things on the test that wasnt on the study guide. STUDY
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Very kind teacher, not boring if you like the topic, attendance is important and checked on but projects were simple and fairly easy.

I loved Proff Ball. The exams weren't too bad, and there were a few projects and quizzes that helped keep your grade up. The projects were fun, and the quizzes were open-note. I loved this class, and Ball was a great professor. She was engaging and fun and gave a few opportunities for extra credit, which was really helpful.

Professor Ball is amazing! She is very passionate about what she does, and genuinely wanted us to succeed in the class. She explains everything clearly and is very approaching, and the material is not hard to learn nor hard to remember for exams. Quizzes are online at the end of each week, and class engagements for attendance are easy.

very easy class, show up and do the class engagements if you know someone in the class, they can just send it to you before lecture ends and attendance wouldn't be mandatory in that instance, easy lecture slides that she thoroughly explains each class, and is very enthusiastic and keeps you engaged, and easy to remember for the tests!
She's absolutely amazing, she's extremely accommodating, kind, knowledgeable, and so much more! Professor Banks deserves the world! I don't have much more to say.

A genuine and kind professor. She interacts with other students to get to know them better. She's aware of her own identity and ensures to be diligent and respectful when talking about other identities. She's also incredibly passionate in what she does. Thank you for your authenticity and compassion, Dr. Banks!

She is incredible, I would take every social work class with her if I could. Very helpful and sweet, she's so engaging that I forget how early it is when class starts. The best quality a professor could have is passion about what they're teaching, and Dr Banks cares so much about what she does. I see it in every class.

Classes were lecture based but heavily encouraged discussion. She was very sweet and communicative. Great with accomodations. Midterm, final and weekly journals on Blackboard. Highly encourage taking the class.

CMSC 491 Mobile Computing: Surface-level Android. Demos lacked depth, making HW hard & requiring self-teaching. Outdated libraries suggested. Difficult midterm (avg ~50-60%), easier final. Exams seemed AI-generated, testing content not fully covered. Felt professor was disengaged.

Group project of 2 people, a few programming projects, and 2 exams determine your grade. Programming assignments were relatively easy to understand. Introduces outside topics such as cloud computing with its relation to mobile computing.

Took him for Mobile Computing. Challenging but interesting homework assignments. One Midterm, one final project. Provided opportunities for extra credit with in-class assignments, which really helped the students actively learn the concepts as well. Overall, a nice professor who cares about the students learning the material.

Professor Banerjee was thrown into teaching this class last minute and honestly, I feel like he did a great job! He was very kind and knowledgeable, and he was very lenient with his grading. Although the class was disorganized, as a Professor he was great. The only downfall is that he is slow at responding to emails and piazza posts.

Random Lectures. The course is not difficult, he makes it difficult by giving more quantity of assignments and skipping basics. Incomprehensible TA. You will not be able to do any other graduate course work if you take his course.

The professor is well versed with his concepts but badly fails at communication with students. Students have to beg for his time which I found to be utterly disrespectful. I would NEVER recommend a course/project/research under him.

Advanced OS was a great course, packed with new and useful information. Concentrated on distributed and parallel programming. You need some background in programming to keep up. Dr Banerjee is enthusiastic and helpful in teaching it. You will learn a lot in this course.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: A very helpful professor. Teaches to his lecture slides, but knows the material well. I highly recommend going to his office hours if you have any issues or confusion with lecture material or projects.

Very nice guy and very good instructor. Slides are very helpful and good study tools. Also not unwilling to curve and help your grade. Attendance is required but the lectures really help. The average on the midterm was low so he gave the midterm again as a take-home test with the potential to boost your test grade by upto 20%. Would take again.
Android Development. Tries to cover most of the topics in android. Must take if you want to do a hands on.

Dr. Banerjee uses a examples a lot in lecture, I learned more in his class in one week than I've learned in other classes for the whole year. He's willing to help and really wants you to think about good design for mobile apps.

He is very good and want to help his students not only pass but understand a class as difficult as OS. GO TO CLASS because if you don't his slides are hard to understand without the in-class examples he gives. Overall, he is a nice guy and a very good professor who happens to teach a very difficult subject.

Dr. Banerjee likes to teach using examples and coding demonstrations which is helpful in the exams and homework. The projects are very difficult but are manageable within the time allocated. He likes to give out candy for participation in the class. Outside of class he will do anything to help his students be successful. If possible take his class!

One of the worse IS professor I have taken. This professor has a poor explanation on his lectures. His study guide does not pair with the exact exam, it will be completely different. DO NOT take this professor
The IS420 course, led by Professor Prakash Bandaru, suffered from unclear instructions, especially in the group project, causing confusion and stress. Other than that, all was good.

The lectures are not too long or boring. Grading criteria sometimes isn't too clear so you may lose points. He doesn't give a study guide for the exams which isn't a big deal but this class has a lot of information so it would be appreciated if there was one. Besides that there's a group project just hope your group actually does their work :)

very clear and easy to follow lectures, 12 homework assignments graded on completion with 1 extra credit assignment, exams were tough but I'm also not a good exam taker but if you attend lectures, take notes as they are written on the board, it should be easy.

Attend lectures, take notes, do problem sets the moment the day they are assigned so the material is fresh in your mind. Both exams have 11 multiple choice and 2 long questions based on the problem sets and lecture notes. Final was cumulative, 21 multiple choice and 2 long questions

Attend the lecture, ask questions, and visit office hours. If you do all of those, it's an easy A. He grades on completion, which means you get full credit for everything. 

12 Problem Sets 
2 Exams 
1 Final Exam
He truly cares about his students. Doesn't give an easy A, but it's not unreasonable either. He takes notes on the board during each lecture so taking notes are super easy.

This might be the best professor I have ever gotten, he was so clear during lectures, which made his lectures very important but also interesting, however the tests were a bit hard but if you go to lectures and take notes its an east A

Professor Berkes is superb! This class was highly theoretical, featuring concepts about the urban economy and how cities exist. Only 6 homeworks, graded for completion, and one easy presentation. Engaging lectures. Two exams worth 50%, easy if you studied notes and homework. This course may implement code in the future. Professor is very caring.

I took this Fall 2023. He was great! He is great at explaining concepts and if you have questions, he will do his absolute best to answer them. As long as you attend and pay attention, you'll be perfectly fine. Most of the work is weekly homework assignments based on the lecture materials and the exams. Just take notes and pay attention!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He's a bit dry, but he'll go through the concepts thoroughly. He'll try his best to make things clear to you if you let him know you're confused. There are a good amount of practice problems every week, graded by effort, but it's for your benefit. The exam questions are similar, so if you keep up with the work, you'll do great in the class

Professor Berkes, knew what he was talking about. There are 12 homework assignments graded by participation, 2 midterms and 1 final. If you fail the first two midterms, good luck. This class really requires you to study on your own and memorize the terms. (There are a lot). There's also no extra credit offered. It helps to go to office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He wants you to succeed and will help you if you need. Very very nice professor

Makes me really sad to write this because this professor is so great but we were cut short by the pandemic. His lectures were SO engaging, I always looked forward to being there. He said this is the last time UMBC is doing 101... Sad... We moved from lecture to just assignments online. If you have the option to take him, do it!

The class is based on 4 exams and one paper. Overall the exam questions were straight from the slides but I preferred to get the textbook to get a better understanding (although you dont need to in order to pass). Pretty easy class if you study the lecture slides well & attendance is not mandatory.

Professor Ozok is an awesome guy. He is extremely passionate and knowledgeable about everything technology. The content is super easy and as long as you glance over the slides you will be perfectly fine. His exam reviews pretty much give you everything you need to know. Take his class, you will not regret it.

Best professor ever! Easy class. Just study the slides and read the textbook. The exams are based off the slides so it's really easy if you actually study. You don't really need to go to class, attendance isn't mandatory! Overall it was the easiest class i've taken so far. LOVE the prof!
