Professor Ozok is an awesome professor! He really does know his stuff about computers and enjoys talking about them and teaching them! He also pretty funny when he explains some of the concepts. The class had 3 exams and they are all based off of slides. Beware of semester long project paper. If you are a tech-savy person then this class is easy

He rushes you on exams and he tells the class his exams are easy but in fact they are difficult. I wish he can give more time on exams and that there were other ways to bring your grade up other than his exams.
He rushes you on exams and he tells the class his exams are easy but in fact they are difficult
He has the greatest accent of all time. Most hilarious and nicest professor at UMBC. Definitely wants you to get an A. Take this class yo

Dr. Ozok is the nicest man I've ever met. He's a big nerd, and clearly loves what he teaches. Don't slack off in this class, you have 3 exams, a paper, and lab assignments. The exams are from directly from the powerpoint, or textbook. Lots of material to memorize!

I don't ever recall looking forward in the week for a class, but with this class I did, every week! The instructor is funny, knowledgeable, dynamic and smart. I never thought I would develop an interest in technology, but he made me develop it! Take a class with Professor Ozok and you will know what I'm talking about! It is too much fun...

Ant is an awesome teacher! He's definitely passionate about his area of study and is willing to help students. The class itself is pretty easy. There are 2 very easy labs, which just involve using Microsoft Office, and 3 exams, plus a final exam and a final paper. And he does take attendance
Awesome professor! So engaged and interested in his courses.
DONT TAKE ANYONE ELSE IF YOURE TAKING IS 101!
Prof. Ozok's great knowledge in what he teaches is only eclipsed by his genuine interest in helping his students.

I didn't have much interest in technology before I took this class, I took it only because it fit my schedule, and boy was it the right decision! I got to know and learn basics of technology thanks to this professor, he really has a keen interest in technology and great knowledge! Now I share this interest too and really want to work in computers!
This guy is GOOD!!!

This professor is responsible for my decision in a career in information technology. He knows how to make classes fun, big time. Brings all kinds of examples (hardware, software demos, videos, news, movies, you name it...) to show us the "fun" side of technology. He knows EVERYTHING going on in technology, and is very fair in exams and projects.

Easy class and very straight forward lectures.  Exams are done in class on blackboard, so you get scores back immediately.  Only two actual homework assignments and a paper,as well as 3 (i think) exams.  Easy A if you pay attention and look over notes for a few minutes, but most people just facebook during class. AND HE DOES NOTICE.

Extremely knowledgeable, passionate teacher and researcher. He genuinely cares about students and their success. Treats students with utter respect and plenty of humor. His technical knowledge is so good he answers any technology question with perfection. Very fair in exams and projects, always open to suggestions for improving class. Great person!
Too much busy work, too many assignments due at the same time.

Very friendly and laid back. Class was really easy, especially for an honors class. Material is almost common knowledge if you are interested in computers at all. Multiple choice exams online. He puts sample exams online as well. You shouldn't have a problem getting an A in this class if you turn in assignments and study for exams.
Nice guy.  Easy class.

Cool professor, very kind person. The material is easy if you have some knowledge and still pretty easy if you are a novice. Tests are very fair. With just a little effort, anyone should be fine in this course.
Very cool teacher, brings lots of examples to class to show you what he's talking about.  Class is very easy, and very fair.  He is always willing to help students out who are having trouble.

Sousedik is a rlly easy grader. Homework, quizzes, and exams are easy A's if you remotely understand the content. Also has a lot of quiz/hw drops. Love this guy, but if you depend on lectures for learning, do not take with diff eq with him. His lectures are boring and his explanations make things seem harder than they are. I recommend tho

The lectures consisted of him just writing the exact example problems that could be found in the textbook. He would teach with his back to the students for the entire lecture, missing students' questions unless they vocally interrupted him. I absolutely do not recommend taking him for 225 there are definitely better professors.

Great professor. You can tell he cares about his students. His lectures consist mostly of problems. So, you will have to do reading on your own to understand some concepts, but the concepts in 225 aren't too difficult to grasp.

Hardest 225 prof @ UMBC but you can tell he cares. Grading dist is rough asf tho and the exams (esp Exam 1 and the Final) were more difficult than they needed to be. He also just copied from the book so there's that.

Sousedik has a pretty dry and quiet delivery at lectures, but he seems to genuinely care about his students' success and encourages to work in groups on hw and to see him in office hours. Sit near the front, read the textbook, STUDY THE HW QUESTIONS for exams (some were copied almost exactly for the midterms and finals), and you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Terrible, unorganized, doesn't know what he is doing with 50 "uhmm's" each lecture. He did so poorly with teaching that the average student in our class is failing. It is so bad he had to drop A WHOLE EXAM out of the 3 we have! I had to teach my self calc 3 with the book and videos. Hopeless and useless, VERY surprised UMBC hired him for Calc 3.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Extremely difficult to follow lectures. His teaching style is to point at pre-written notes and just say the steps of the notes. Doesnt explain things well and is all over the place with his notes and explanations. Tests and quizzes can be very hard. He stated the tests would be based off the quizzes and homework, but they were nothing like it.
He's a sweet guy, but hes quiet you should sit in the from to hear. Homework is roughly 20%.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: There is homework, two tests, and a final. His grading on exam is a little rough. Going to class will help, but I had friends who passed and never went. He a sweet guy but you can't hear him if you don't sit in the front of the class.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: This class was pretty easy. The final grades are very dependent upon exam grades though. Tests aren't too hard; all the problems are straight from the book. Make sure to do homework and practice before exams. He is very quiet, so if you actually want to hear what he's saying make sure to sit in the very front row.

Dr. B is a pretty good teacher but he's quiet. IF you can hear him/understand him, youre golden, but its hard to ask him questions since he gets wrapped up in his lesson. THE BOOK IS YOUR BEST FRIEND. know how to do these problems then your tests should look 80 itll just come down to practice. Lecture is optional but id suggest it. hes a sweet guy

His first semester teaching. Lectures might not be too clear, but read the book and you'll get it. Notes straight from textbook. Attendance - not necessary. He assigns hw weekly and often uses these questions on exams. Exams are straight from the book practice all questions and get an A. Very helpful in office hrs. Sweet guy.
Dr. Sousedik teaches straight out of the book. You really don't have to show up. It's tough though because you only have homeworks and tests. He's a nice guy though.
An easy A if you put in the work. Just finish everything on time. Instructions for assignments are on the syllabus and professor can be reached by email.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: One of the best professors that I have had at UMBC. Wants to get to know you and to succeed in his class. People who end up failing this class are the ones who do not show up to class, it is mandatory!

Professor Beverley is a great instructor! He made ENGL393 much easier to understand with clear explanations and a supportive approach. He was friendly, patient, and always willing to help. His passion for teaching created a positive learning environment. Highly recommend!

SPCH100: Three in-person speeches total. Readings from two books were assigned but not necessary to read and we didn't really talk about them. Laid back class, great practice for public speaking. Don't read from a script, be natural and know your topic. He likes chatting with students about anything from sports to local politics.

Professor Bennett cares about his students. He is kind and understanding. His work is relatively easy, just make sure to do them. We had several papers to do, but nothing we couldn't write about. It was honestly fun. If you need help, ask. He encourages us to ask if we wanted him to proofread or look at our papers and group assignments.

Professor Bennett's class was indeed probably the best class I've ever taken here so far honestly!!!
he is so kind and really care about his students. The course itself is a bit hard but he made it fun and uncomplicated. He is really one of the best! and I would take him again if he is offering any other 300 level courses. Bless him!!!!

Pretty good professor, I just found his lectures to be kind of dragged out and boring (sucked because attendance is mandatory). Couple of biweekly essays, one 10-page essay, and a group project, which is really not bad at all for a technical writing course. He's a very lenient grader and very responsive. Only con is he takes forever to grade.

Professor Bennett's class was probably the best class I've ever taken here. He is very generous when it comes to due dates and wants everyone to get an A. I don't know why everyone is saying the mandatory attendance sucks because it was probably the only class I wanted to attend. The writing can be too much but it's a writing intensive course!
Great professor and overall chill class, just a few papers and a group project. Attendance was sadly mandatory, but show up, do the work, and its an easy A.

Prof Bennett is the coolest prof I've ever had. It is a writing intensive class, so there will be weekly writing assignments. As long as you communicate with the prof and your group and do your work, you will get an easy A.

Professor Bennet is a solid teacher as long as you are fine with mandatory attendance and semi-engaging lectures. He is clear with grading standards and easy to communicate with. He can be a bit stubborn if you want to use software he doesn't know, but can be swayed as long as you deliver good results. I found his class very enjoyable.
one of the best teachers I've had at UMBC. Cares about your work and wants you to become a better writer. Lectures mandatory and kinda long but he makes them go by quickly. take him for eng.

Professor Bennett was really fun and helpful. You'll do quite a few writing but he will not penalize your grade if you are present in every class, doing all assignment on time and participating as he expects you to. He gives you a feedback and let you submit revision as Final portfolio. Its an easy A class if you do all your work and show up.

Professor Bennett is amazing. If you are looking for a relatively easy writing intensive, this is the class for you! The only thing I do have to say is that there were alot of class presentations. Otherwise, if you participate and turn in your assignments, you are guaranteed an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: One of the worst profs at UMBC. I can safely say I learned nothing in his class. I doubt if he even reads the papers that he grades. On the bright side, show up, do all the assignments, and you're practically guaranteed an A.  BEWARE! If you miss more than 3 classes (excused or unexcused) you'll lose 10% off your final grade for each class missed.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: One of my favorite teachers. Lots of papers because its a writing intensive courses. Your grades are based on your final portfolio. Just do everything and attend class and you will most likely get an A. The group project you need to go out and get a real client for. Make sure your group members are not lazy or just do all the work that's what I did

NO LECTURE. Class is once a week. Very few class work and/ or homework. Almost everything is group work during the semester. So pick your group members wisely. you have to write a 10-15 page research paper and it is due last day of class. He barely returns graded papers and doesn't post grade. Show up, do your work and get A
Great professor. I had no idea what was going on in the class but I wrote  the papers and showed up to class and got an A.

No exams, didn't discuss grading policy but I am confident that everyone will pass that attended class on a regular basis. Communicate effectively, and turn in all assignments and you should be perfect.

LOTS of writing. you either get A, B or you Fail. just do everything assigned, and you will get A. Attendance is important. very nice professor, sometimes running late. There's no grading system in his class, but he will have a midterm analysis to tell you how you're doing in the class.  Very picky and has his own style that you must follow.

Whether you've been coding for years or you're completely new to it, Prof. B makes his class accessible for students of all coding levels. His playful, banter with the TA's was nothing less than corny, but made the environment more fun than most professors. During the semester coding project, he always uplifted our work and encouraged us.

Amazing professor and a great person overall. His TAs are also really cool, and his COMP101 class is perfect for any new student at UMBC. It provides a refreshing start to your college experience!
Keep in mind that you need to learn how to code things on your own. TAs will definitely help, but you're mostly on your own.

one of the best professors I've had so far. He's funny, caring, and loves what he does. I definitely recommend taking this class, but honestly, he doesn't really teach you how to code; that's mainly up to you to learn. But take this class; he's awesome.

Amazing professor. He was so incredibly kind and welcoming. I was struggling due to family issues, and he completely understood and allowed me more time for assignments. Super responsive to emails(never took more than 24 hours). The mid-term was the only test. Final was a 2-month group project that is VERY easy if you just do 30 minutes a day

Prof B was such a great professor! He was so nice and understanding throughout the whole course! He really knew how to explain computing to people who have never done it before.The projects can be a little difficult but the TA's are always there to help.  Take this class.

Prof B. was a great professor and really cared about his students. The coding assignments are really easy. There is one pretty important group project that counts as your "final exam" grade, as long as you choose a good group, its very easy to complete. Time management is crucial for the project!
I took his class 3 years ago and still think abut how much I enjoyed it. He really cares about his students. This guy is wonderful and a great introduction to computing.
Great professor. He understands when you have problems if you send him an email. Lectures are amazing along with the Ta's. Just get ready to work in groups a lot.

Had him in fall, amazing introduction to the computing space. His class was fun, made everyone feel welcome, explained things clearly. Cares very much about ethics in the tech space. Challenging projects, but the TAs and him guided me through it. Language we used in class was Processing.
Prof.B is a great professor and a great person. His class isn't that hard as long as you try and understand processing just a little bit. Chill class and great for beginners!

Such a great professor! I was in the most recent semester and I can confirm after reading the rate my professor beforehand and then taking the course they are right on the money. Prof B takes the time to work with you on the content and genuinely wants his student to do well in the class. Although the exams might be difficult so go to office hours!

he ate. best prof ever, so sweet and understanding. exams can be tough but there are so many office hours, extra credit opportunities, and the TAs are so willing to help. so refreshing to have a professor that cares

As someone who had 0 coding experience, the class was difficult. The TAs helped a lot during office hours, but I needed help with everything. The midterm was long and very difficult. The final group project was hard for a beginner, but my group knew coding. If you go to office hours and show that you're trying, he'll do his best to give you an A!

Prof. B is probably a top 5 UMBC prof. He cares more about you understanding how to code rather than if you're perfect at it. You work in table groups, so having a friend in the class helps a lot. The class wasn't crazy hard, but if you don't get help when you need it you will probably struggle. The TAs are always available, and want you to do well

Prof B is very great choice. He is super funny and I looked forward to his lectures every time. The final project can feel stressful since it's what you focus on for the entire second-half of the semester and you are in groups, but other than that, he is very fun and engaging.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: A hilarious professor who makes COMP classes fun. The unique methods through which he explains concepts almost make you wait to attend his class again. COMP 101 or COMP 101Y is an introductory programming class and it is perfect if you take him as a professor

We many coding projects. One that had like four parts and then a final group projects. He was barely in class but when he was he would lecture. Lectures were okay. His TA's were amazing and very helpful. Lots of office hours. YOU MUST GO TO OFFICE HOURS IF YOU DONT UNDERSTAND THE CODE! One midterm, but no final exam, just group project.

He tries his best to make the class easy, however, not all concepts are taught well. If you take time outside the course to practice, it should be easier. For someone with no coding experience, the assignments for this class were time consuming, however the office hours provided were very helpful.  Overall he's a good prof and the class isn't bad.
Overall the class wasn't that bad. As long as you follow the rubrics for the assignments to a tee and pay attention, you should do well.

Prof. B has got to be the best professor at UMBC, he is there for you not only as an instructor but for guidance he will be there to lend an ear even if it doesnt pertain to the class. The class for me was on the easy side because i had coding experience, but what i didnt know he taught very simply and effectively. Best class ive taken at UMBC

Mark Bercyznski is a benevolent professor who genuinely cares about his students, he does go really fast and the class can be very difficult if you do not have previous programming experience. There is a individual project (Galaga type game) make sure to go to office hours. One Group Project (a game depicting college life at UMBC), midterm & final.
He is clear and has a fun class.

I'm writing this review during the third week of having him. Hands down he's one of the professors I respect the most. He has good lectures that keep you entertained, he doesn't give too much work, and he respects students.
Extremely kind man who answered all of the questions I had. The class was easy to follow understand with his guidance. Funny guy who made coding enjoyable.

This was my first COMPSCI class, so it was a little difficult for me given my lack of experience. But Prof. B and the TAs are honestly amazing people and they're always willing to help. The assignments can be difficult but there's help readily available via Prof. B and the TAs as well as plenty of internet sources.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Amazing professor. His discord group makes it easy to ask questions and know when quizzes or assignments are coming up. He's also really good at keeping class fun and interesting while still making sure everyone is learning what they need to for quizzes and exams. Do yourself a favor and take his classes.
The G.O.A.T
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Definitely a professor worthy of praise. I had already come into UMBC with prior coding knowledge but even still, Prof. B. made the course not only easy but also worthwhile. Very passionate about the subject and extremely personable. I cannot recommend him enough.

As someone who came in with little to no coding experience, his class was somewhat difficult. I managed to scrape through with an A but you really need to teach yourself a lot of coding beforehand. If you go to the tutoring sessions, theyll helo you with the assignments, but you really have to learn a lot of the logic on your own.

Prof B is super chill. I have him for 2 IS classes and always finish work early. He gives detailed lectures that actually make sense of the textbook, and the work is engaging but not difficult. I would definitely take more classes from him if I were an IS major.

Beware of my easy rating I have had experience in the subject before taking his class. With that said, I liked him a lot as a person because he made class fun, however as a teacher, he doesn't quite understand the best way to teach programming fundamentals and I knew others that struggled. Class uses "Processing" which is just offbrand Java.

He is one of the best professors to get started in college. The work is really easy if you have coding experience and he genuinely cares about the class and the students. His office hours are the best and he is the most relatable professor, we even talked about certain upcoming video games.
Great Professor complete all assignments and you'll pass. Come in with some coding knowledge

One of the nicest professors I've taken in my college career. While he does have his flaws (such as not being too great with sending out email announcements), he is definitely worth taking. He explains the content well in lectures, but not well enough without outside help. Go to his office hours, though. He is extremely helpful.

Dr. Bengochea-Cohen is a lovely professor. She strongly encourages participation and will call on you if you've been quiet for a while, but will guide you through questions if you are confused. She grades generously and encourages struggling students to come to her for help. Overall a very sweet person!

Instructor was very sweet and understood that most people were taking for language requirement. Class was organized and very helpful. Bengochea can seem a little rough at first and will put you on the spot, but is very lenient and willing to work with students. Class is a free A if you make any effort. No complaints.

She is such a sweet, organized, and patient professor. Spent a whole portion of the class reteaching many of the lessons from FREN 101, which helped everyone get their barring's for the units moving forward. Her lectures were very smooth and you did learn a lot more through the lectures than in the homework, but homework is needed beforehand.

Overall she's a great professor. You'll have a good bit of homework every week, but when exam time rolls around she gives you everything you need to prepare and she goes really light on the grades. As long as you get most of the answer right she'll give you most of the points, maybe losing 0.2 for a misspelling and such. She's great!

Genuinely such a sweetheart. She cares for her students a lot on an individual level, and she's a good professor. It helps that she herself is French, though being French/from a Francophone country doesn't automatically mean the teacher is good. 

She's also very patient and understanding. I've had such a good experience with her! :)
Professor Anne Bengochea-Cohen was a great. She helps you and makes sure you succeed. Overall not a bad Professor for a language
Mrs. Cohen was a very good teacher who made the course very easy and straightforward. She is very understanding and accommodating to students. If you do the homework, this should be a very easy A.

She is an okay professor. I would not say she is hard but i will say it is not as easy as people make it seem. HW was 30% of your grade, quiz was 25%, exams  20%, attendance /participation was 10%, speaking was 15%. 
If you did not have your mic on and speaking in class she will mark you absent and lose points in the participation.

Professor Anne is a great Professor! She will help you understand the materials when you ask her. Attend her fofice hour, she will help a lot! Do your homework, and you will pass! The class is very easy!

Very kind and passionate professor, tons of extra credit opportunities and she did a lot to help students succeed. She explains the material well and concisely and if you miss something everything is on Portails so it's easy to access. Great teacher
She is a very kind professor and teaches very well. Had I been more interested in French, I would take her for higher level courses.

Makes class fun, activities for students to participate in, even if you're randomly called on in class and don't know the answer she will walk you through and explain what the correct answer is and why. Don't think she could make quizzes and exams much easier. As long as you do the homework, you will pass.

She was very nice to us and gave great feedback on pronunciation. I really enjoyed taking her course and learning French. She likes students to do the worksheet she links on blackboard for the day before coming in to class so that it can get finished before class is over. Quizzes and exams are easy enough. She is really helpful and accommodating.
If you go to class and do the work, youll get an A easily.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Participation matters--Caring

reviews.comment: She is a really great teacher! She always explains anything that you can't understand, and she has a great sense of humor. If you ever have any problems, just go talk to her!

Prof Anne is all about participation. Each class has a handout and as long as you come prepared it's not hard and is very helpful in preparing for the 4 quizzes, two exams, and weekly online homework. Show up to class and you'll do fine. Anne is a kind professor and if you're dedicated to the material she is going to do her best to help you ace it.

This was one of my favorite professors at UMBC. She has such a kind heart and her passion for teaching French (she's from France) makes her lectures exciting. She even had us singing French songs! I took 102 and 201 with her. If you do the online homework, read the study guide and ask questions you will get an A for sure.

Amazing professor! The information is tough as learning any language is, but she breaks down the info in a way that makes it easier to understand. Review info outside of class. You learn something every class. Quizzes throughout the semester help to make sure you don't fall behind. Online homework tedious, but easy. 1 midterm and 1 final.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great professor. I learned so much in this class; she is very good at teaching and really wants the students to succeed. She sends emails that tell you what will be on tests and quizzes and studying that really helps. There is a lot of tedious online work outside of class since it is a 4 credit class. Attend class and practice frequently.

Great teacher! She literally tells you on the first day of class that she knows this class is not everyone's top priority so she's not going to stress you out, AND SHE DOESN'T! You still have to study to do well but she emails you the content that will be the on quizzes/tests a few days before, and as long as you study that, you should be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Would take again! Excellent, structured, down-to-earth professor who helps make french accessible.  I enjoyed talking with her after class.  This class can be easy if you pay attention and don't expect the teacher to just hand over the grade.  Exams aren't too hard either.

Spring semester was my first semester at UMBC and taking this course with this professor was one of the best decisions I've made! She is extremely helpful and none of her quizzes or tests are a surprise. But do keep in mind that the quizzes are worth a lot of points, so make sure you do well on them, because it matters in the end for sure.

This class is easy if you show up to class and if you do a little studying. Her exams and quizzes are straightforward and she always gives out extra credit on quizzes. Her lectures are clear and if you attend class, you won't struggle with understanding anything. She's also very nice and helpful. I really enjoyed French because of her.

She's wonderful. You'll have to memorize a bit of vocab, and understand basic French grammar. Quizzes and Exams are cake if you make an effort.  There's two online things you have to buy though, and one of them (Z'y va) is a waste of time. Luckily, she grades it on completion,  not content.  Take this for your language credit.

Professor Bengochea is definitely one of the best professors I've had so far. She's nice, funny, and the assignments are easy as pie if you study the language hard enough. Z'y Va is a complete waste of time, but you sadly have to do it for the course. There are no tests, rather replaced with bi-weekly quizzes. Great lecturer and person!

This professor is an absolute delight. She is incredibly cute and sweet and I admirerespect her a great deal. I also wish she taught higher levels of French. The class is easy but not because you can get away with anything; she just actually teaches the material very thoroughly. Make sure you keep up with online assignments!

I love her! She's so cute and really engages the class, which I find very helpful in a language course. She could be clearer when she gives instructions, but she is from France so she definitely knows her stuff. Tests are easy, quizzes are easier. Show up to class, participate, do your homework, get an A. Pretty straightforward.

I couldn't have asked for a better French professor. She is so cute, and helpful and obviously very knowledgeable considering she is from France. She does expect you to do the work but is so willing to help you if you need it. The quizzes and tests can be difficult if you do not keep up with the work. Just attend class and you'll be fine.

An absolutely wonderful professor! Very thorough and uses exercises to help students understand concepts (i.e. white board activities, games, group activities, etc.). She is incredibly sweet and caring; wants her students to do well. You are always prepared prior to taking a quiz and you know exactly what to expect. Homework is fair and doable!

She's so sweet. I wish she taught a higher level french. When she gets mad, its so funny, and her accent is so adorable. She's a great professor, really helpful, and the tests were easy. Study and do your test zy'va, and centro and you should get an easy A. You also learn a lot because she's a great professor. Wish she taught higher levels

Very helpful, clear about what you need to learn, and a lenient grader. She gives partial credit for things that you get wrong on quizzes and exams. Overall I feel like I learned what I was supposed to to move on to 102, and isn't that what matters?
I've had her for 101 and 102, she is very helpful, and is more than happy to help in office hours if you have problems or questions. Tests are easy but you have to study.

Good Professor, she did a lot of fun and interactive activities in class. My only complaint is that she could be really  strict about really random things such as gum and accidentally mixing up Spanish and French!

Prof. Bhalla is a really enthusiastic when it comes to Asian-American studies, but it is apparent that she is still struggling to adjust transitioning from online to in-person, mainly because not much students want to be in-person. But other than that, she offers many extra credit opportunities and is extremely understanding.

Oh my god, she is an actual gem of a person. The switch to online sucks but she is one of the few professors that is truly understanding and accommodating. No a major textbook, just online pdf's & stuff like that. Very interesting class that she is clearly passionate about.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: i never write these reviews but i just think that professor bhalla deserves more recognition. during these difficult times with COVID, she has been the most understanding, accommodating, caring, and kind professor. she has gone above and beyond to make sure that we are enjoying learning rather than feeling overwhelmed w hw. best prof ive ever had<3

I took Dr. Bhallas AMST 375, 365, and recently completed an independent study. She provides students with the list of assignments and their due dates for the entire semester with very clear instructions for each task. Shes willing to provide feedback and guidance for projects. I found the topics covered in class to be fascinating and eye-opening.

This is my second time taking professor Bhalla, and she is freaking amazing! Key to passing her class: participate in discussions, do the assigned readings and worksheets, take great notes for the final exam and projects (she does not let you use outside sources for anything), and make sure you go to her office hours. She is willing to help student
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Prof Bhalla is a cool person but she has poor time management & gives unequal opportunity for extra credit. The texts are also v long (like a 20 pg PDF which is only 1 of 3 texts you had to read for just 1 class day) & difficult to read. She also races through the PP & DOESN'T POST THEM online while expecting us to know everything on them for exams
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Prof. Bhalla is super sweet and this class was super enjoyable because of her! If you're looking to take this class definitely take it with her. You do have to read a lot and fill out a reading guide that you'll turn in later, midterm, and one big group project, and then final exam. Honestly a super easy class, but pay attention and participate!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Took this class as an "easy A" and to fulfill my culture credit. Class wasn't hard at all, but there's a lot of reading and you have to complete your work her way. Be sure to pick competent people for your group and work on the final project ASAP.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Definitely not the easiest A, but I read every book and still ended up with a 88% in the class. If you read and show up, you're guaranteed to do super well, she rewards effort and participation very generously.

She is an awesome teacher! This class was just a general ed class for me so I was very surprised how much I enjoyed it. If you go to class and listen you will get an A. Her lectures are very interesting and engaging. She is the best professor I have had and the only person I have ever written a review for. You can only miss two classes.

I'm an Asian Studies major, but I was skeptical about taking an Asian American Studies course at first. However, the course turned out to be very enjoyable. She gives many opportunities, few collected/graded assignments, and is very clear about what she is looking for. So long as you pay attention/do reading, it shouldn't be hard to pass the class.

I really enjoyed her classes, the topics were fun and she really cares about her work, like she is enthusiastic about Asian studies and brings up very interesting topics. I honestly loved to take another Asian studies class with her. I think I learned a lot!!  No textbook but she posts excerpts from books that you need to read!

Best professor I've ever had. Never once did I fear I was going to fail. Just read and do the assignments and you'll be fine. I got 100s on everything including the midterm and final. There were only 3 major graded assignments beside the midterm, final, and final project. 100% recommend. Loved her so much I changed my major!
Professor Bhalla is amazing. She is very passionate about the course. The material she decided to cover when I took the course were all very interesting. I would highly recommend taking her course.
Very very hard class
Please take her if you can! She's so sweet & friendly! She's very approachable if you need anything, and her assignments are easy!I wish she taught more courses, I'd definitely take them!
Great course, better professor. Dr. Bhalla is the best

There aren't many independent written assignments (two exams and two journal entries), but there is a considerable amount of short readings to keep up with. None of them are hard, though. There's also a group project, but the difficulty level depends mostly on who you work with. Fair grader. Covers interesting topics. Very kind and understanding.
She was pregnant during our class, but she is the best teacher. I got  100% in the class and I didn't even try that hard. You have some busy work, but they are quick and easy.
Easy course, take it!

The class was interesting, but Professor Bhalla was very difficult.  She expects you to read so much.  You have to read essays AND books.  Combine that with other readings and assignments from a loaded schedule and it makes for a "hot mess".  Avoid taking this class with her, your sanity will thank you.

Professor Bhalla was awesome! I was in her Asian American Studies course. Even if you don't have interest in the subject, you'll end the course learning a lot of useful information. I've had 10 worksheets, 2 essays, and a research paper + presentation. Her teaching style and class material was easy to understand. Plus, she's a cutie :)
Really interesting class! Professor Bhalla truly makes the material interesting and works with the students for an overall understanding. Highly recommended for a general ed requirement.

She is so wonderful. This was the most interesting class I've ever taken. She is very accessible & loves what she does. She makes you think outside the box. The assignments and readings are useful, as well. No busy work here.

I took GWST340 and GWST100 with Dr. Bhatt and she is such an enthusiastic professor! She likes people who participate, so be prepared to speak up during discussions. Homework was easily manageable and she gives study guides on quizzes/what you need to know. Take this class with her, definitely.

Dr. Bhatt is absolutely amazing! Her class is so well put together. There is a lttle bit of everything in her class: 3 Quizzes, 1 Homework a week, some readings, and Final posterboard and paper. She is an great lecturer and she allows for you to learn about the issues from all sides and then come up with your own opinion. Best Professor by far!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She's amazing. Brilliant and articulate in front of class, and clearly is passionate about the material. The class is pretty easy IF YOU DO THE WORK. Show up, be attentive, and you'll be good to go.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She's a great professor. Her teaching methods are so interesting and engaging that sometimes you forget you're in class. She is more than willing to help her students when needed and her class is super easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: HOMIGAWD the class was so easy you literally have to try to not pass. One HW assignment due every week, i did mine all during spring break to get it over with, the quizzes were so straight forward i just looked at my notes the night before to review, but you have to come to class or else you loose points, and she is a sweet lady, TAKE HER

Dr. Bhatt is a great professor! Her classes are heavily discussion based, but she creates an open environment. There is a lot of reading, and then discussing the reading. There is one homework due each week, very easy, and a big research project due at the end of the semester.

I love Professor Bhatt, she is the best professor I have had in my three years at UMBC, and everything that she taught me will stick with me all my life, I learned SO MUCH! I wish she taught more classes!

Dr. Bhatt is one of my favorite professors. You can tell she really cares about the subject and wants to get you passionate about it too. Class participation is pretty big and seems daunting at first if you're not a talker, but she creates a welcoming environment and asks good questions to engage students. Easy A if you put in effort.

Very passionate and knowledgeable about the subject, respectful of and willing to work with a lot of different (and sometimes stupid) opinions, very thorough in teaching the material, expects a lot but actively wants her students to succeed. Also maintains her authority while being super nice :)

Awesome class and awesome professor! Her lectures are well prepared. Class discussions are always interesting and they really make it worth going to class. Quizzes are straightforward if you really understand the topics discussed in class. Take a class with Bhatt, its worth it.

Wonderful teacher! As long as you keep up with the assignments, you will have no problem getting a high grade with her. The assignments are fairly easy, they do require that you do the reading and understand the reading. Her lectures are extremely interesting, it helps if you participate.

Hands down the most interesting class I've ever taken. Her lectures are thought-provoking and you really look forward to each class. The discussion is intense but remember to participate, it's part of your grade! But, she's da best.

Dr. Bhatt is a very knowledgeable professor. She makes class very interesting without a boring lecture style class. There are weekly homeworks graded for participation, a midterm, and a final. If you pay attention in class, you will ace the exams. There are also opportunities for extra credit if you need them.

Dr. Bhatt is an excellent professor! Class is discussion, she keeps class interesting. Not boring at all 2 HW per week (short reading & response) 1 Midterm & a Final. HWs count higher than midterm.Marks for attendance, listen dont have to pay careful attention since most is common knowledge. Just pay attention & do HW you will get A. 2 Extra credit

Great professor! Love the way how he explains things with great examples. Easy to understand lectures. Test questions are very straight forward. Nothing tricky. Replies emails also immediately. Very help.

Really good teacher. He is clear and makes the material extremely understandable and digestible. His tests are straightforward and are based exactly on the review sheets he hands out prior. Would absolutely take his class again.

Very nice instructor and a pretty simple class.  Relies heavily on text, but you can really get by with skimming. He hands out a study guide for exams with concepts to study and even notes which parts are most important.  Uses experience and real-world examples in lectures.  Highly recommended.

I honestly don't see why people are saying this isn't an easy class; everything that's required of you is crystal clear. He's a very nice teacher and uses lots of real world examples to help you understand the concepts better, and as for the assignments and tests, there's  no tricks. He's there to help you learn.

Good professor but do not take him.. he makes the class very hard to get an A in, when if you take it with any other teacher for mgmt 210 its an easy A. Yes I suppose you learn more but everyone knows you in college for the grade not the actual learning experience..

Mr. Bhansali provides short and to the point PP slides and study guides that tell his students exactly what to study. He sets his students up for success. The test does take some memorization, but at least you know what to study! Highly recommend him!

He is a very nice guy and knows what he is talking about. He does give review sheets but it just mentioning what are the important parts of the chaper, so there isnt any questions that you can practice with. He assigns homeworks and gives 3 pop quizes. Also, a huge group project at the end of the semester.
Most of the grade is based on writing and exams and the rest on some presentations. It wasn't so difficult, but wasn't easy either

Prof Ryan is a great professor. All of his grading criteria is highlighted in the syllabus. As long as you read that carefully, you should have no trouble getting a good grade. His exams are also not very complex if you read the book and pay attention to the study guides. Also, his lectures are easy to understand and well planned.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--So many papers--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Had Professor Ryan for my IS300 Summer I session. 6 week compact course...you have to make sure you're on top of your assignments, or else you will fall behind fast. But very doable! Just show up to class, participate in the small group projects, and you should be fine. Tough grader and it's hard to get 100 percent on assignments. But also fair!

i had prof. ryan for both IS 300 and 369. both are writing intensive but it's easy material. the exams in 300 were a little difficult but in 369, there is no exam. prof. ryan is so sweet and funny. he provides good feedback on assignments but he does not allow late submissions. he gives class time to complete assignments which is helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: There are 3 presentations, a few writing assignments, and 3 online quizzes. He is a tough grader, but he likes when you write more and go into good detail. He's pretty lenient with due dates if its a day or two late. This class is significantly easier than the other English WI class. Bill is a good professor and gives good feedback.

Professor Ryan is solid when it comes to teaching the material, and he clearly is passionate about this field. The only problem I would say is that his BB has about 200 random folders, which makes finding assignments very confusing and difficult. He is sort of a tough grader when it comes to the writing assignments as well. mid prof

Great professor! There is 4 article reviews, 4 respondus home exams, and a group project. The article reviews you should write a lot. He is strict on the grades for these cause he wants in-depth stuff. Just write more than you think. The exams were straightforward and he did an exam review in class which is VERY similar to the exam. listen to it.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Test heavy

reviews.comment: IS 300: Prof Ryan was OK. You start getting used to the class by the time it's almost over. There's group work, article reviews, and exams with pretty good study guides. Just put forth a good effort, and a B is certainly possible. Online exams w/ lockdown browser. Attendance was taken every class, that counts towards a participation grade.

Prof. Ryan is a good professor if youd rather read the textbook. Lectures arent mandatory and most of the exam content is stuff from the book. Id recommend just reading the textbook and memorizing the vocabulary for exams. MAKE SURE YOU ASK WHAT HE WANTS FOR PROJECTS. Not a hard grader, just turn in all the work.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: She is a kind person, but I don't feel she teaches the material effectively. She doesn't always take students' individual situations into account, and I found her approach to be unreasonable at times. The course material is difficult, and the class moves at a very fast pace, which made it hard for me to keep up.

Dr. Stanwyck is my favorite professor! She made calc fun and easy to grasp in every lecture. You have homework and quizzes every week and three exams, but the homework and practice problems are essential for studying! She is super loving, energetic, and a great communicator. You will succeed if you stay on top of everything and ask questions.
Prof Stanwyck was a great prof in STAT451. There were weekly homeworks which were long and hard, but quizzes and exams were super easy. She is great!

Very enthusiastic about the subject & cares about students. Takes her time to explain the material. things we don't get to in class she adds them in the quizzes and exams so you have to learn it yourself. 3 exams. quizzes every week. Provides study guide but no answer key. One downside about this class was how terrible and unhelpful my TA was.

She cares and wants students to learn the material well, but this class is HARD. MATH 155 goes fast! Homework and quizzes every week; Dr. Stanwyck doesn't give answer keys to practice quizzes and doesn't hold in-person office hours. If you're okay with that, then she's the best professor that teaches MATH 155, but her teaching style wasn't for me.

Overall just a terrible structured class by UMBC's math department. Goes way too fast and it is the first class I've ever had that hasn't had a single review day for any material before any quiz or exam. No reviews. No extra credit. Discussion is terrible as well. Overall a depressing experience.

Stanwyck remains the goat. She could teach paint drying and I'd be there. Phenomenal lecturer, good notes she uploads from her iPad to Box, thoroughly goes through homework during class, and is incredibly reachable for office hours through her Discord server. Cares about every student's learning experience, and makes lectures lively, 453 is hard.

Makes STATA easy. She cares about what she teaches so her pre-recorded and live lectures are great and helpful, she gives great feedback on homework which is very long but very doable. She has her own discord server for outside of class making it insanely easy to get help. Probably the best teacher in the STAT department.

Legit the GOAT of all math teachers. 451 and 453 are among the most boring and difficult classes in STEM and yet she made it so much easier and fun. Never met someone more passionate and kind to teaching students. The class was hella hard but I would have failed if I took it with anyone different.

I failed Applied Calc twice at a different school. Stanwyck's enthusiasm was a breath of fresh air. The textbook is confusing, but you can rely solely on your notes from class. Just attend every lecture, take good notes, and ask questions. The tests are hard. Quizzes are fairly easy. Do every problem on the review packet. Go to office hours.

Heard a lot of good things about Dr. Stanwyck, but her teaching method was not for me. I don't like the idea of her not giving out the answers to practice quizzes and sample exams to study, cause I'm not sure if I'm doing the material right. Also don't like the "classroom setting" office hours she gives, I prefer to meet with them one on one.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Retook this class after taking it with a horrible professor and Stanwyck made the class a 100 times easier. I did WAY better this time around and actually found myself going to lectures, when they weren't mandatory, because of the way shes able to teach. 100% would recommend and she is very nice to approach as well

Great professor, very accessible outside of class. Genuinely wants you to succeed and is a subject matter expert in math and statistics. Be prepared to study alot though. Her exams were INSANE but she explains everything thoroughly. Probably the best math professor at UMBC.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Definitely easier than MATH151! The class starts easy but requires a solid start to understand later chapters. Stanwyck is encouraging, she makes the subjects easy to understand. HW, classwork & a pretest balance your grade even if you suck at tests. Speaking of, the exams & quizzes were straightforward except for Exam 2 which was unusually hard...
Great professor. Very enthusiastic but no matter how low the class average is on exams, she WILL NOT CURVE. Would take her again, really understanding and always willing to help

I loved Stanwyck! She's my favorite professor I've had so far. She goes very slow and in-depth on the topics so that everyone can understand. The math itself was super easy but got harder closer to the end of the semester. Overall, I thought it was a great class and she made math more enjoyable. Seminars were annoying but easy points.

Dr. Stanwyck is an awesome professor! She really cares for how her students learns and is willing to stop lecture to help with questions. She has a great presence in lecture so it's never boring. However, there are quizzes every week but LAs literally go over what's on it right before it so it's not too bad.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: very nice, makes it easy to take notes by providing structured note sheets for you to fill out along with her in class. The class had a pattern of HW due Tuesday, short quiz on that hw on thursday. The quizzes are not difficult if you complete the hw, and the volume of them can help build a solid grade. Bonus points are often built into tests.

I'm not even a STAT major and this class was just amazing. Be prepared to do the work; Most of it is based on completion, but it really helps in the long run when it comes to the weekly quizzes and tests. Her lectures are amazing, and they're free participation points as well. If you're good at Calc III and need an out of major, look no further.

Prof. Stanwyck is an excellent professor for math and she really makes the subject easy to understand! Even though this was a hybrid class, she taught the subject well. She knows that the Statistics subject is not a easy one but she tries to make it simple. Class had 3 exams and 6 quizzes and lots of homework. You have to spend alot of time on it
This professor is awesome she shows how much she cares for the class and willing to help you succeed.

Liz is absolutely wonderful. This class is difficult and should really be 4 credits, but she still manages to teach well with the time given. She is very attentive to every student and cares about them all. Office hours are crowded, but helpful, and she sends you a copy of all the work done if you go. Homework not graded officially, but do it.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Great math teacher, even if you're not that great at math. She builds in a lot of extra credit into your tests. If you show up to class and do all the work, you should be able to get at least a B.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She is a very good professor, and it's actually fairly easy to get an A in the class. You don't even have to get A's on the exams.  There are so many quizzes, projects, etc. so make sure you do good on those and do ALL your aressignments. I feel like I gained great math skills from this course too.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Inspirational

reviews.comment: Stanwyck is the best. Stat351 hybrid would be intolerable if it weren't for her. The textbook was bad, but Stanwyck makes up for it and really knows how to make things 'click'.

Dr. Stanwyck is one of the best. She really wants her students to succeed. She converted one of our office hours into an extra classroom hour for anybody who wanted to go over more problems. She constantly innovates in the classroom to keep it interesting. And she's probably the nicest person on campus.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Dr. Stanwyck is an amazing professor who really knows her calculus. The way she moves around the class and talks you can tell she's really passionate about what she does. Although there are only 2 exams she gives lots of quizzes, weekly homework, and even projects so that your grade isn't weighed heavy in one area.
she builds in A LOT of extra credit. Shes very upbeat and positive during lectures. I dont feel afraid to talk to her and ask her questions  both inside and outside the classroom.

Dr. Stanwyck is a great! She's super nice and is always available for office hours. She's very enthusiastic during her lectures. Do ALL of the problems from the study guides when preparing for exams; she uses problems from there. If you don't understand an excel project, go and see her. This is a fast-paced class so go to SI/PASS if you need help.

Dr. Stanwyck is GREAT! She really wants to make sure everyone understands what we're doing and is always super willing to answer questions. There are weekly homeworks (not graded) and weekly quizzes as well as group participation work on non quiz days. Not an easy class, but if you do the work, and take initiative to ask for help, you will do fine.

Professor Stanwyck is a must! She really gives you EVERYTHING you need to successd and provides plenty of opportunities to earn extra points. Need help, she is there. Good math teachers are extremely rare, and I wish I had her for when I took Calc 1 & Calc 2. Apply yourself and ask questions, and you will succeed!!!
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She is helpful when you ask, but if you suck at math no matter how hard you try, it's still difficult to get a grade that shows how much effort you put. Almost half the class failed the second exam, I passed yet my final grade is still a 'C' as if I'm like the average student in the class. Grading system sucks, and she won't bump you up.

She is absolutely lovely as a person, so full of energy. Without approaching her, I loved her lectures  because she was so positive. She made me love math even more. If you've done some calc before, and you read the material, you should be good in this class. Everything is made for your success, and at so many levels. It really is an easy A!!

She's not a hard teacher, she's very fair. She wants you to succeed so if you talk to her, she'll be really nice to you and help you calculate a way to pass the class. I really liked her and thought she was really nice, but she's not easy exactly.

Stanwyck is so passionate and excited about teaching. Both classes I took with her were very challenging, but she is very helpful in office hours and gives you a lot of time in class to ask questions about the homework. Sometimes she talks about statistics in a way that is over my head, but other than that she is very helpful and fair.

Professor Stanwyck is one of the best professors at UMBC! She is very helpful and her excitement in the class actually helped me pay attention and learn. I'm not a strong math student but she kept it straight forward and easy to understand. Just study and stay committed and  everything should be okie dokie!

she is the best stat professor in UMBC. I took many stat classes with her. She will help you anytime, just walk in to her office and ask her. She is very patient and nice professor. DO NOT MISSING IT.

Not a good professor. Her lectures are long and boring most students leave early or just don't pay attention because of the way she teaches. Super hard grader no curve at all. If you don't  know stat 100% before entering the class be prepared to spend your whole semester on this class or take a low grade. Take a different professor

Worst professor at UMBC. She's the kind of professor that comes to class teaches doesn't care if people learn and goes on with her day. People would literally not pass quizes and she would blame it on them. Lectures are ambiguous and long. If you can't learn this material on your own then your going to fail this class.
Best teacher ever. Very clear, fair and interesting. Fantastic lectures. Do the work, and you'll get an A.

I read all of the reviews for Dr. Stanwyck on here and I thought at first it sounded too good to be true. However, I was pleasantly surprise this semester as Dr. Stanwyck completely blew me out of the water. Amazing professor, was always there to help anyone who had a question. Everyone should take her before graduating, you won't regret it at all.

I loved Professor Stanwyck! She was one of the nicest professors, I have had the pleasure of meeting. No matter how stupid the question, she would answer quite graciously. I could tell she genuinely enjoyed teaching math.
Excellent Teacher
Amazing teacher! Highly recommended! very interesting as well!

My all time favorite teacher. Extremely inspirational. 451 required very hardwork, but as long as u r trying, she'll do everybit to help understand. Make good use of office hrs. She's kind, generous, caring,  & most of all super-excited for what she teaches. It's just so much fun to be around her. For me, she's a goddess & I'll never forget her..:)
Great teacher. Do the practice quizzes and keep up with the reading. Pretty easy overall.

Her class is very easy, but she moves very quickly. Her quizzes look like the practice quizzes on Blackboard. Make sure to do the study guide for exams because her exams may have questions from there.

Don't take Math 155 or Stat with anyone else. She's AMAZING! She's always willing to help, all you have to do is go to her office. She's understanding, and is always there to help her students succeed!

One of the best professors I've had. She clearly explains everything. Her theory is that people who are bad at math just didn't understand a single concept and never caught up after the class moves on, so she addresses everything really well. She is funny with exciting lectures too.

She is such an awesome professor.  Always willing and ready to help. She employs the "there is no stupid question" mantra and answers every questions as clearly as possible.  She is very charismatic and actually wants you to do well.  Make sure and keep on top of pre-reading quizzes, those add up in the end!

Stanwyck is so nice and charismatic, she wants you to pass. She does move really quickly during the lecture though, but she does stop sometimes and ask if you have questions, but she made it clear what was going to be on the tests based off the discussion quizzes.

TAKE HER! She is one of the most nicest and understanding professors you will ever come across. I took her for Math 155 twice, failed the first time because I slacked off bad, and decided to take her again, and passed with a B! Now I'm taking her for Statistics, and although the hybrid format of the class can be tricky, she's worth it!

Love her! Had her for MATH 155 and have her for STAT 351. She can move really quickly, so make sure to attend lecture and follow what she's saying. She assumes that you know the material and will treat you as such. Very helpful outside the classroom, responds to e-mail quickly, very professional and accommodating.
She is awesome! She makes math fun! Definitely recommended!

I am not a math major nor a math fan at all, but Dr. Stanwyck made this class pretty easy all in all.  She had some issues with class cancellations this semester (three of them), which disrupted the flow, but she more than made up for it with pushing back HW.  Very, very good professor, HIGHLY recommended.

AMAZING professor! I wish ALL of my professors were like her. I'm not even a math major, and seriously feared taking another math class since high school, but I am so glad I did with her! She is very clear, helpful, cheerful, and this experience has helped me realize that I am good in mathematics. Come to class, take through notes, and do the hw!

This professor is just simply amazing. She is VERY helpful and answers emails really fast. Very easy going and understanding. The class is fairly hard but this is due to the class material itself. DO THE PRACTICE SHEETS she hands out in discussions - it will help you in the quizzes and even exams. Online HW is a lot harder than her tests. Take her!
She is really easy to talk to and is very helpful. The content can get confusing but if you do the homeworks and ask for help it isn't too bad. Her projects are fairly easy. Recommended.
She is the best math instructor I have ever had.  1st and 2nd exam were easy, 3rd was very difficult.

She was a great teacher, really passionate about math and always very clear in explaining problems. She is funny and engaging in class. Quite an easy class, do the homework and there is extra credit offered. Group projects can be tough if you have a bad group. If you put a little work, you will get an A!

Love this teacher! She was very clear, helpful, and understanding. She answers any questions emailed to her promptly. A very nice lady. Kind of hyper but it makes the class entertaining. You don't really need your book. I never even opened mine. I highly recommend this teacher!
She's a greater teacher. Just do all your work, go to class and pay attention and study. She gives out study guides before tests. MAKE SURE YOU STUDY THEM. THEY ARE KEY.

One of the best teachers i had. Very helpful. Talks rly fast but very comprehensive. Give you pratice sheets(not graded).  Must study practice sheets. I had a quiz the was exactly the same as the pratice sheet questions word from word. Replies emails fairly quickly. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!!!!!!!!!!!!!! EASY A!!!

This is a challenging course, but Dr. Stanwyck is great. She will answer questions via email and allow you to set up appointments to meet with her one-on-one to go over problems. Quizzes can be challenging, but exams follow the format of the practice exams. She makes the course enjoyable- I highly recommend it to any math/stat major!
good teacher, but hard class, sometimes the exams are easy (if she follows the sample exam)

FALL 2012: AWESOME Professor. If you attend class and take notes, the exams/quizzes shouldn't be too hard. I honestly never liked calc and I ended up getting an A in the course. She goes out of her way to help; utilize office hours and tutoring! (My TAs were horrible though). Didn't use the textbook much because exams are very similar to notes.

Best Math teacher I've had in awhile. If you do poorly on her exams its probably because you didnt go to class or listen. She explains things VERY clearly and makes sure that you understand it. Very passionate and likes to move around when she lectures. Overall, THE BEST

Passionate about the subject and has high expectations for her students. The downside of this is that she often assumes that you are stat wizards like she was. However, statistics is difficult to teach for any professor. She cares for her students and encourages them to come to her office hrs for help. HW is optional, DO IT ANYWAYS.

Careful when taking her class, you do not get curves, last semester about 60% of the class had failed.  the class avg of the first test was about a 28/50.  the 2nd exam was pretty much the same.  She is really difficult but she does try her best to help you in any way possible.

Great attitude, genuinely seems to love what she does and makes it easy for you to love it too.  She was open to meeting outside of class for a little extra help when needed, and was super animated during lectures.  Very hard to fall asleep in her class, which is good because the material is insanely difficult.

Great professor! I was concerned about taking a 400 level compressed summer course, but it was not bad. Weekly quizzes based on the non-graded homework which are not too bad. Liz Stanwyck is energetic and happy to answer any questions! I would recommend this course, she makes what could be a very dry course interesting and engaging.

I had Prof Stanwyck also for Stat so I knew she was gonna be great for math. Her exams match the homework problems online. The only thing I didnt like was going to discussion which the only purpose for it was to work labs.But I would recommend Stanwyck as a professor.

This teacher is the best for this class. Honestly I am bad at math and I had a tutor for the whole semester and I passed the class.The materials aren't too bad and she is willing to help a lot. She definitely notices you in class and it helps a lot if you show up at her office. great teacher easy passing

Excellent in every way.  Organized and on time to every class.  Very energetic about what she teaches.  Crystal clear on every point.  Exams are exactly what she teaches.  She only asks you know the material, she doesnt require you to do tedious algebra on tests.  Excellent class, even if you dont like math you will like her, guaranteed.
She is an amazing professor. Her lectures notes are very clear and she is willing to help. Her quizzes and exams are just like the practice so do those and you will be fine.
Professor is a good teacher, she will help with any questions you might have in the class. Alot of busy work and these labs that take a whole week to accomplish.

Killed my gpa last semester. apparently a good stat teacher, as for calc -.- I missed 6 classes & it hurt me soooo much. it could be just be me but calc with stanwick was VERY hard.. hard to approach her cuz her presence/vibe's intimidating. but she lets you correct some of your midterm for some extra points. quizzes = hard after the first one! >:[
There is no curve, I had an 89 and got a B... not very organized... overall not bad, but not as great as what these guys are saying, if you take her winter class its a blitz and overwhelming at times
Awesome professor. Amazing curve at the end of the class and very easy to get an A in if you try at all.

Awesome professor! Very down to earth and really tries to make sure everyone understands. Her ppts are incredible and do an excellent job of simplifying the book while highlighting exactly what you need to know. She lets you know exactly what you need to know for all quizzes and tests. I will try to take more classes from her in the future.

Liz Stanwyck is an amazing young professor. She is enthusiastic about what she teaches, has great energy and takes time for any student questions in and out of class. I recommend her and praise her to everyone. I will take her again for 453. She is simply outstanding.

I have no words to describe how nice she is. Very clear, extremely helpful, teaches what you need to know in detail so EVERYONE can understand. (YES, EVERYONE- NOT JUST MATH GIGS). Ms Stanwyck, It was a blessing taking your course. THANK YOU!!!!

She teaches the class like an elementary school teacher but with college statistics material.  She's so easy to understand and very helpful.  Her exams are ridiculously easy.  My STAT200 class was so much harder than this one.  If you have to take STAT351, do not take it with anyone else but her unless you want to make things hard on yourself.
She is very good. She is very helpfull and try to make as simple as she can.

Awesome professor! I'm not typically great at math, but she explains everything clearly, answers questions and includes good examples, and makes statistics interesting. I am very exicited to be doing well in her class!
She looks like Donna from That 70's Show. She's always encouraging asking questions and is extremely helpful. I like her as a professor.

Awesome professor. Kept STAT interesting and the quizes and exams we exactly what she taught. A little effort on your part but if you pay attention during class you should be able to easily pass this class with this professor.
She's awesome. Explained the material well and is definitely a class to take.
she will make you love statistics. She explains material clearly and makes everything clear to understand. Gives a lot of review that are helpful. Take this class with her, will learn a lot.
THE BEST PROFESSOR AT UMBC ...
Class is easy; you are allowed to have 1 sheet of notes for exams. There are a lot of E.C. for each exam.  Lectures aren't usually boring, and Birger is a very nice and caring professor.
Professor Birger was a very kind and accommodating professor. I would recommend taking her courses!

Professor Katie is an amazing professor and I enjoyed all her lectures. the exam questions are based on the study guides she gives and you are allowed to bring a cheat sheet. Overall she teacher why well

This is one of the best professors on campus and I've only been here a semester. She's so understanding and so easy to talk to! She's approachable and so sweet.Assignments don't have hard deadlines just turn it in before the exam.She's doesn't take attendance but don't take that to your advantage because you will miss alot. All exams are open note!

Had this professor for PBHL 100 and PBHL 340, and I enjoyed both classes. 
- Both classes had open-note tests on paper, interactive modules, and in-class activities. 
- 100 had case studies that weren't that hard, and weekly quizzes. 
- 340 had an end-of-semester project with plenty of class time to work on it and two papers.

she is so sweet and amazing during lectures there are group assignments during class, which was ok bc u can also work by yourself but we don't know when we will be having them soo just attend everyday. also extra credit is granted for exams only i believe!

Amazing Professor, very clear and easy to understand requirements. Works with students and not against them, very understanding of circumstances. Explains concepts and assignments in great clarity, and provides feedback on assignments. Somewhat writing intensive, however well worth it if going into a public health focused pathway.
Best professor ever. that's all. taker her class for an easy A

Professor Birger was amazing, her class was fun and interactive. Her assignments and tests are easy if you read the book and look through her slides. Show up to class! She does random in class assignments and the grade for those add up!

She is very sweet and easy to follow in her lectures. It's important to complete the assignments and read the textbook so you don't get lost during class. Her lectures support the assignments and they're connected. She uses examples real-world examples during class to make it more relatable for students.
The best. Tests are open note/open book. Extra Credit opportuinities if needed. Great professor. You'll never be confused in her class

To me, her class was kind of boring. I didn't understand any material in that class but I somehow passed that's all I care about. Exams are open notes and the lectures are always posted on the blackboard. But if you go to class somedays she'll randomly do group participation stuff on google docs. She also posts  exam study guide and that helps too.

Professor Birger's lectures are interesting & informative. The tests are open notes plus EC options. The case studies are probably the hardest part, but not too bad; they just require extra reading and some thinking. I can't remember if attendance is required, but go to get notes for the test, as that is where most answers come from.
awesome professor, easy class IF u find public health interesting and are ready to write case studies almost every other week.

Professor Birger is the best professor I have had so far at UMBC. She is clear and concise and it is obvious that she is an expert on what she teaches. I have so much respect for her because of how much she has taught me in just one semester. She is truly just so knowledgeable and so good at teaching and her lectures are so interesting as well.
for a 100 level class there is a lot of work! she's nice but till a lot of work and kinda fast. easy to get lost! Quizzes are online!

Prof Birger was so kind and wants every student to succeed. Exams are straightforward and open note. Information was interesting and I learned a lot through her lectures. Only con is she doesn't respond to emails and takes a bit to grade but nonetheless she's great. Allows you to redo assignments within a timeframe making it easy to get an A.

Professor Birger is really sweet. Sometimes lectures drag on because she really likes to talk, but you will do well in the class as long as you review her slides for the exam and ask questions you cannot answer for yourself on the study guide. She is a great resource and mentor in continuing your college experience if you are Public Health major.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Birger is so nice and easy to approach, and her lectures are interesting and engaging. I took the class for my major, but PBHL100 with her seems to be a good choice for a GEP. There is a final paper, but if you space the work out over the semester it's definitely doable. I will be looking for more classes to take with her !!
Great professor lets you use notes on exams and is very easy on grading. She really cares about teaching and if you pay attention it is easy to pass.

due dates for everything/organized. allows as many notes as you want for exams. very lenient with turning in assignments, gives good amount of time for them (2-4 due each week). there's a final paper (5-8 pgs req) but gives whole semester to do it. heavy-ish writing intensive course. lectures were eh but she's a great professor!

Such a good professor!! I really enjoyed being in her class and she was flexible with you when it comes to turning assignments in late. She is very understanding and cares for her students. There are a lot of group activities so make sure you attend class. She let us join the class through bb collaborate even though it was an in person class.

Very nice and will let you turn things in past deadline, quizzes and modules are easy, finals are harder and you are not given enough time to complete them so work fast, lectures are really boring, class is only an easy a if you pay attention to lecture, nice grader, class seems hard at first but will get easier, so dont feel overwhelmed

Professor Birger is one of the best! She genuinely cares about her students and wants them to succeed. The first part of this class was a little challenging for me, but it got easier throughout. Will take her again for my upper level PBHL classes.
