While Professor Bouton is a great professor, he is a heavy grader. What I mean by this is that you could write exactly what the prompt says, and he'll find a way to deduct points. Make sure to go to class as the lectures are in person and ONLY in person. He does not make it available online. In-person essays are probably due to his A. I hysteria.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Pretty easy class. Lectures are super interesting. Taking notes helps. There were assignments every week, but they were all simple and easy. Attending lectures is important, but I have missed many classes and have no problem catching up. Exams are easy.
Great professor
Great Professor, you don't want to leave his class.

I'm a big fan of Prof. Bouton. He is super passionate and knowledgable about the American Revolution and REALLY loves talking about it. The work load was a bit much but doable and he is pretty understanding with grading. He got me actually excited about American history.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Very passionate about the subject. Very few but difficult homework assignments. Had many essays. Both the midterm and final were timed essays in class. Very lenient grading on said essays.

Attend lecture! He gives key exam examples not in the posted notes. Expect weekly essays. Grading can be tough sometimes. More work than expected for a 100-level class. Main project is a Wiki article, divided into weekly assignments. He makes lecture interesting and engaging but again a lot of work for a 100 level class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This guy is recruiting you to make a lib PragerU by writing video scripts as projects (profiting off students?). I heard that he sometimes goes overboard with politics, but we were discussing off-topic current politics in an American Colonies class. Got a feel that he'd be a biased grader so I dropped. Dr. Kegan is a great professor. She is attentive, helpful, gives so much feedback and answers all your questions. She's very clear when she teaches and her exams are not that difficult. She's also pretty funny and her classes are enjoyable.
Very nice and help full professor.

Professor Kegan's class was beyond enjoyable and I learned so much that I received an A without having to take the final! Most work is online (which is really helpful because most questions are on the quizzes and exams). Best professor I've ever had.

This is the best professor that I have ever had, by far. She's kind and caring and will do whatever she can to help you succeed. The material is easy, as long as you do the work. Her quizzes are like the homework and the tests are like the quizzes. She's always available for questions and just overall a great person. I would take this class again!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Makes more boring statistics somewhat interesting. She is funny, kind, and understanding. Weekly quizzes that you will hate by the end of the semester but are not hard (forces you to study). Clear examples with practice problems just like the quiz so use them! 2 exams that are scantron. Need to study and you will do fine. She can't make it easier!!

Mrs. Kegan is the BEST stat teacher you will ever have. She tries to keep statistics applicable to real life, and posts practice quizzes that prepare you for the actual weekly quizzes. If you appreciate a laid back and independent approach to education, you will like this class.

Prof. Kegan is a caring and funny professor. I have never had a professor be more available outside of class. She presented the class with humor and an approach that made the content understandable. The material is difficult but Kegan makes it easier. Go to class, do the extra credit and the homework as you go. You'll do well. Kegans a good prof

If you're not a math person take this professor! She is understanding and offers a lot of extra credit. I am not a math person at all and was able to pass with a good grade. She will explain anything you don't understand and will go the extra mile to help.
Willing to chat with you about homework without making you feel like an idiot, also the entire course was basically online, but being a hybrid class it made the "lecture" more understandable.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Prof Kegan is amazing. She really cares about you passing the class. She makes it almost impossible to fail. She shows you how to do everything. There are so many things she grades and lets you drop some quizzes too! I don't know how someone could fail this class. If you study and come to her discussions willing to learn. I really enjoyed her class

She made it impossible to fail the class by telling the class straight forward what she was looking for. Gives extra credit for just showing up to class (which is not mandatory) & an extra credit project at the end of the semester. Gave practice final exam that was exactly like the actual final. Great professor who is caring for her students.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Great Professor, She was extremely helpful whenever we had questions. Her quizzes are straight from her notes and the tests are all straight from the quizzes, because of her extra credit, I got an A in the class. Awesome professor with a great sense of humor. Highly Recommended.

Gives extra credit & partial credit. Makes STAT easy for non-math people!! Gives you clear instructions. You can be awful and still pass if you show you're trying. She's funny and very understanding. Helpful and gives great feedback when you ask her. Don't slack, work hard, and ask her for help. I don't know how anyone passes STAT without her!!!

Show up to class! She is so helpful. She makes STAT easy. Gives great feedback when you ask. Tells you every question thats on final & gives you all the equations! She's funny and responds quickly. Partial credit & extra credit! You have to work bc the material is hard but believe me she is the BEST if you are not a math person
Does not give clear instruction. Very brief and unhelpful.

She's great!  Stat is hard. She basically tells you what to look for in a problem to solve it. PLUS TONS OF EXTRA CREDIT. Don't let the comments fool you. If she see's your trying you'll most likely end up with a B. You just have to put effort.  She also has online chats at your convenience at night when you can't make lab hours. TAKE HER .

If you were planning on taking B. Kegan for Statistics, run. Don't walk- run, she is the most unprofessional, unhelpful and unclear teacher I have ever had.  I will most likely end up with a B or C and that's only because I had a weekly appointment with a tutor to actually explain the material to me.  I have more to say but am out of space. Oy!
SHE IS AMAZING! TAKE HER! YOU WON'T REGRET IT!

I took this as a hybrid course as well When material got confusing after a couple weeks into the course it was obvious she was too busy to keep up with students who needed answers to basic questions Only was I ended up with a C was thanks to extra credit I recommend any other professor for Stats since she tends to teach to herself and move quickly
Take her!! She gives out tons of extra credit and the class is easy if you keep up with reading

Toke it as a hybrid course. You really only had to attend class once a week for quizzes but the other day was optional. Lots of extra credit options and grading is fair. Breaks the final exam into 2 parts in order to replace your prior 2 exam grades if you do better. Her personality is great! Just keep up w/ readings & assignments online
HYBRID COURSE- This class met two days a week and only 1 was mandatory to take weekly quizzes. Class is pretty easy as long as you do the online work. She provides summaries of the modules.

This was a useless class, The professor had little time to explain herself and the TA (Navy) or Naveet was the most useless TA I had. She spent more time being inappropriate to students than what she was teaching people. Kinda worried for whoever has to suffer with her as a teacher. Lack of academic support in the stat depo. AVOID!

Professor Kegan was fantastic. I have never had a statistics course before & her Navy (Naveet, the class TA) made the class enjoyable & interesting. I took the hybrid class & the online portion was so helpful. It explained the elements perfectly; Kegan & Navy always took the time to clarify things. I got an A- and didn't have to take the final.

I don't know what professor these people met below me but I never had time to hear from her. I think she's a good professor in a bad system lacking of academic support. The hybrid was horrid and the material never helped. Avoid this class because you won't be helped at all, you'll fall behind real fast.

Hands down the coolest professor at UMBC! She's extremely chill, hilarious, and friendly. Never had any other thoughts. If this course is required, sign up for her class. She tries hard to help us understand the material. Not much math here, just analyzing data. Easy A if you put in just a little effort. The TA is just as awesome. Take this class!!

Kegan was an excellent teacher. Very helpful and very clear if you come to the discussions. A lot of stuff is online. If you keep up with the online assignments and come to class, you'll definitely pass. Great math gen ed class!

Professor Kegan has to be the easiest statistics teacher in the world. Most of class is online, so all of the quizzes and discussions are open book. The tests are prepped with big study guides and the worksheets are not difficult either. If you're looking for an easy Math credit, this is your class. Don't take advantage of how lenient she is.

Kegan was a great professor and the subject is extremely easy. She was very nice, pretty lenient, and always willing to help. She basically ensures that all of her students pass this class and discusses everything that you're expected to know for quizzes and exams.

This is a class for people that already know their way about statistics. If you're just getting into statistics, avoid this class. If you HAVE been around statistics, prepare yourself for differing terminology that will be graded. This is a ridiculously easy course but nothing is actually taught. Very poor quality learning experience.
Easy class. She gives extra credit sometimes, so go to class!! Funny class activities. Easy exams. Take this class and get an A!!!

Very applicable projects. Professor extremely clear and willing to meet with students as needed. Requires a willingness to read and listen. Best class I've taken. If you have a choice - take this class!
She is a really nice professor. She gives you EC only for going to class, and activities are a lot of fun as well. Take this class with her, she is the best!!!

This class was really easy for me. There are 2 exams and a final. The 2 exams, she goes over a practice that is exactly like the real exam. I didn't even have to take the final...I had a really high average before the final. She is really fun and energetic. Take this easy A class!

Great Professor! You will have lots of fun in this class and will learn a lot.  SHe makes the class interesting by having fun activities.  You should either earn an A or B. It is impossible to get anything lower. Take class with her!!!!
She is so nice, always willing to help students who ask for help.
Great teacher, very helpful and generally pleasant.  Gotta stay on the ball to get the A but B's are pretty easy.  Go to class and you'll pretty much never have to study out of class.

The course material was easy enough on its own, but her lectures were very clear.  Fun class activities that remind you of 3rd grade...lots of opportunities for easy points.  Goes over all material that will be tested and very quick to answer students' questions.  TAKE THIS CLASS!

TAKE BONNIE KEAGAN'S CLASS!  She's an excellent professor who knows what it is like to be a stressed-out college student.  It is not hard at all to get an A or B in her class.  I'm so glad I took class with this professor.

I find the material difficult sometimes but he's a great professor. He is very friendly and open to questions + makes sure everyone is on the same page before moving on. he talks about the work he's done in ABA and I think its pretty cool :) just make sure you do the readings and keep up with the syllabus and you'll pass without much difficulty!

Dr. Borrero is one of the most organized professors I've had. His class is extremely well-structured with fill-in-the-blank notes for every lecture. He clearly outlines what to study for exams and quizzes and truly cares about his students' success. His passion and sense of humor make lectures interesting and engaging.

Dr. Borrero is a great professor. Quizzes are super easy and an excellent way to earn more points toward your grade, try to get a 10/10 on all of the CQ's because he doesn't round up grades and a few points are a matter of getting a 69 or 70. Also he is super nutty and is funny ironically and unironically.

Dr. Borrero's lectures are very interesting and he provides guided notes for each lecture to help students. Pacing of the course is good, tests aren't difficult because he tells you what to study. He is also very caring towards his students and is very interested in the topic. This is one of the only classes where I can pay attention the whole time
Avoid this guy at all cost
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I took this as a summer class so the pace was much quicker, but there was a LOT of reading and the material was dense, lots of vocab. You may have to reread sections to understand them. Luckily, Borrero provides very detailed study guides for each chapter. Stick with those and you'll do fine.
He made class enjoyable and easy to learn. If you attend class, you will get an easy A. Definitely recommend and I would over and over again.

I loved his lectures. I was enjoying listening to him. Professor Borrero is very organized and clear with clarifications. I would take this class again. I would also recommend attending to the class because you should follow the lecture and Guided Notes. They will help you prepare for the exams

Everything is clear and direct with Professor Borrero. As long as you attend all the lectures and follow the guided notes provided by him, the class is easy as can be. The lectures are interesting and entertaining as well so it doesn't feel like a drag to attend either. A must have for any class where he teaches.
If you just attend and write Guided Notes diligently, I promise you'll get a good grade. Before you take 4 exams, just read the notes at least one time.

Dr Borrero is amazing! He clearly knows and cares about this topic. There are 4 exams with 4 redo exams. The online quizzes are difficult but you can try many times. Make sure you read the syllabus before you ask him any of those questions. He is strict but understands if things happen so communicate with him and you'll be fine.
Take this class!!
He's amazing! 10/10 recommend!!!!

The only downside to Dr. B is that he doesn't teach more courses! Not the most lenient, but that's because he makes his expectations crystal clear and even tells you "this is on the test, underline it!" Tests are based on guided lecture notes, so you definitely need to show up--but his lectures are great, so you'll want to anyway. LOVED his class!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Amazing professor, used real life and funny examples, made sure you actually understood, fair balance of strict and laid back personality. Material was pretty heavy for me considering working 40+ hours a week and was taking another summer class simultaneously. Wish he taught more courses!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Funny and easy class. Make sure you show up to take the guided notes. Very straight forward.

Dude's class is HILARIOUS. Seriously. And you HAVE to show up, there's stuff on the tests that he only discusses in lecture-- but that's all emphasized and obvious if you show up, so don't worry about showing up and missing the important stuff.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Took him over the summer. The material can be slightly dry at times but he makes it engaging for all students even over a long lecture. One thing I didn't like about him was that he picks favorites pretty clearly, was kind of mean to people he didn't like in class. But fill in the blanks from his notes and the tests are verbatim the same. Gives EC.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Show up and study the guided notes. Leavthred are fun and hes cute lol
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I loved his class, It's an easy A. Do all the homework in the first week of classes, and print out the packets. Then you'll get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Dr. Borrero's lectures were very engaging and he definitely made an effort to keep his students engaged. He sets you up to get an A, all he expects is that you bring and fill out the guided notes in class and study them before the exams. There's no final so the grade is based on 4 exams and more. But the class is an easy A with minimal work.
Very enthusiastic about what he teaches and gives practical examples
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Borrero is hand's down the BEST pysc professor at UMBC. He is so clear with his class, and grading. There is absolutely no way anyone can get lower than an A in his class. He gives unlimited attempts on quizzes (which are from the book) and he has retakes for all of his exams + study guides from lecture(provides lecture notes).
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Borrero is one of the best professors I've had in my four years of college. If you get a change to take a class with him I highly recommend it. You'll learn a lot.

This class was great. Borrero is energetic, funny, very clear, and always willing to help. He is there to teach. He makes you want to learn the material. Gives guided notes which are lifesavers to study for tests. 4 tests, no papers, online quizzes and that's it. Gives remedial exams if you need them. Extremely clear grading system. He is the best!

Dr. Borrero is the best there is when it comes to Learning in psychology. I took his 6-week summer course and while it's very fast-paced and the material is dense (yet interesting), it's so well-organized that it is practically impossible to not get an 'A' if you go to class and keep up with the online work. Yes, he can be a tad arrogant at times.
He is funny, keeps lectures exciting. I would take again with him!
He's very helpful and passionate about what he teaches. GO to class! just study from the notes he gives you. Everything you need to know for the test is on them! He also allows you to retake tests!

Fantastic professor whose lectures are always engaging. He is funny and gives good examples to help you understand the topic. Make sure to pay attention because clicker questions are part of your grade. Lots of opportunities for extra credit, along with remedial exams to make up for lost points.

Very easy class. Lots of extra credit opportunities. Easy exams that come straight from lectures. Attend class since notes are not posted on blackboard. Allows you to retake each exam and takes the highest of the two grades. Weekly online quizzes come straight from textbook and are a little more challenging but you can take them an unlimited amount

Attendance isn't required, but there are questions on exams that you really can't answer unless you were in class. He keeps things interesting, there's pretty much no way to fail this class. You can retake online quizzes as much as you want, and you get a chance to retake all four exams. You would really have to try to fail.

GREAT professor! Expectations are very clear, Uses a lot of pop culture references to make material easy, & he's very funny! Class was interesting & he gives 2 chances on all exams. Book only used for online quizzes which you take as many times as you want. I highly recommend taking him!
Good Teacher. Moves very fast but gives study guide fill in the blank notes for lecture. Need to know the material not an easy A.

Dr. Borrero expects you to work had and know your stuff. He quizzes you and offers extra credit, along with clearly defining his expectations several times throughout the course. Take him if you want to learn something. Not an easy A, but manageable if you dedicate a couple hours a week to study. He is a good lecturer.

Entertaining. Goes fast occasionally. Gives you guided notes. Lots of extra credit and opportunities to boost grade. Enjoyed going to his class. Read directions to tests, he gives bonus points if you follow directions. gives 48 hours grace period for online quizzes even though its do before then. Really good teacher. Impossible not to get an A.

The beginning of the semester he tells you exactly what needs to be done to get an A in his class. If you do exactly that and A is very obtainable in his class. He's a very easy to follow and his energy makes attending class interesting. Attendance isn't mandatory but I recommend being in class because the textbook isn't as helpful as his lecturing

One of the best teachers I've had at UMBC. Makes the class very easy to get an A (12 online quizzes that can be retaken infinitely, 4 exams that can be retaken once each, extra credit, provides fill-in-the-blank notes). Very fun teacher with great sense of humor and great interest in the subject matter. Highly recommended professor and course.

Psych of Learning. Probably the best teacher for it. Makes it easy to get an A. If you don't get an A. You are a complete failure at life. He's open to discussion in class, tests are relevant to lectures, helpful during office hours, and he's funny.

Borrero is one of the best at UMBC! He turns a boring subject into a class you want to attend. Classes consists of guided notes & funny videos. Your grade is a bunch of quizzes you can take as many times as you want & 4 tests (all with makeups if you do poorly) & plenty of extra credit for attending class. Hard not to get an A if you try at all!

Really, really fantastic professor. Fully prepared for every class, provides guided notes, has remedial exams for each exam you take, and is willing to explain for as long as needed until you understand. Also very funny and down to earth. TAKE HIS CLASS!

Great professor. Makes it extremely easy to get an A. He works with you and is open to interaction during lecture. Very welcoming and you can tell he cares about what he is talking about. He wants you to leave his class with new knowledge and works with you if you don't understand. In the beginning he makes it clear what he expects so remember that

Hands down one of the best professors at UMBC. Knows his stuff and also knows how to teach. He's clear, gives every chance he can to give students good grades, such as letting you take each test twice! Class is always fun and interesting too. He is highly recommended to any major.
Hands down, one of the most coherent and respectable professors I've had.

One the best teachers I ever had!! Huge fan!! He explained everything so clearly in class, that when it came time to studying for the exam- I only had to review the information. HIGHLY suggest taking him!!!
Awesome all the way around!

Dr.Borrero is one of my favorite teachers I have had at UMBC! He is very knowledgeable, energetic, caring, and has a GREAT way of explaining things. He is meant to be a teacher! He also is very good at keeping your attention, even though the material isn't that interesting!

He is extremely helpful! He keeps class extremely interesting through a lot of not so interesting material. I laugh a lot in this class. I definitly recommend him, he makes it impossible to fail. He is extremely organized.
Allow me to pile on; Dr. Borrero is a fine professor. He's and enjoyable lecturer so, while attendance is not mandatory, it's recommended. I'd highly recommend his courses to other students.

Definitely one of the best professors I've had!!!He made the class SO much easy and fun.Inspite of being so easy, he provides a whole lot of extra credit and second chances for quizzes and exams. This class is highly recommended.

Definitely one of the best professors I've ever had. He uses really good & easy to understand examples, he tells funny stories, we almost always finished material early, and I definitely feel like I learned a lot. Plus, the class is structured to give second chances for all quizzes AND exams (there's no way to fail!)...great class!

Dr. Borrero is 100% devoted to making a tough text and difficult material understandable and even fun for the class.He spends a lot of time and effort with guided notes, learning objectives, and lecture materials. He puts other boring, unprepared, and out of touch professors to shame. Take this class- you'll love it!
EXCELLENT PROFESSOR, TAKE NOTES!!! AND VISIT DURING OFFICE HRS FOR HELP IF YOU DON'T UNDERSTAND SOMETHING...use your classmates for help too!!!Don't be afraid to speak up in CLASS :)
Funny. Easy. Take this class.
The best teacher I've ever had. Makes the Class interesting and gives many chances to make up bad grades. All Classes should be based like this one.
Great teacher. Funny! Class is usually not boring although sometimes the material is rather dry. Go to class and take notes and the tests are easy.

Weekly or biweekly chapter quizzes online, 4 tests, quizzes and exams can be RETAKEN for better grade, extra points along the way, very funny and you WANT to come to class. New to UMBC but you'll love him. As long as you go to class, take notes, and review notes, you'll be fine on tests. Multiple Choice everything. Lectures never boring.
Very friendly and clear in his lectures.
Took his class at UMBC, he's a great teacher and extremely friendly. Would highly recommend anyone to take his class.

Wonderful Professor, he actually cares about you and is always available during office hours. He is very attentive  to the needs of his students and a good teacher.  He takes his time to listen and answer all your questions.

Amazing Professor. He's about to finish his PHD and genuinely cares so he won't let you fail. Quizes and test are exactly what he discusses in class and will literally tell you exactly what is on the quiz/ exam if you ask.
Class was pretty easy overall, though it wasn't light on work. Participation in the online lectures was graded.

Professor doesn' really engage students or was very approachable. She just meant business when she came to class and completed reviews. You basically have to teach yourself by studying or making friends with a native speaker who can explain things to you. I hated this class but I passed because most of the work was online and I could use translator
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Box is kind and really sweet. You are learning a new language, so expect to do a lot of work. She does not grade harsh at all and understands that we are all learning. You have to attend class because she gives participation points. Assignment HEAVY. 5 Video Conversifi sessions with foreign students (the worst part because I sounded dumb)
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Was in her hybrid class. She went through lecture fast: class participation heavy. Large amounts of homework due hours before class. 4 writing journals that correlates to Fakebook presentation, 4 Conversifi convo's with native speakers (hate it), and 3 exams that are cumulative. Straightforward, difficult, but will pass if you make a study group.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She's really not all that, she runs through lecture, and expects us to follow along, she can be sarcastic when you ask a question, she is a ok grader, but isn't the nicest person, when you ask her a question or for help.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Exceptional professor. She understands how students learn the language so she can help you with your mistakes with ease. Most of her curriculum is not under her control, and Spanish at UMBC is rather difficult but she does a wonderful job helping you through it. Highly recommended. Conversifi is still here but the Fakebook is only 2 minutes.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I took her Spanish 101 class last spring and she was a great teacher. Her slides were easy to follow and every class she started with some kind of music video or Spanish artist. if you miss an assignment you can always make it up at her office hours. Good/ easy professor would take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I had hard time learning spanish but professor Box made it so much better, Yes she is very stric and cold with her lesson but she understand that you are just learning so she is pretty chill. She was also a student so she knows what to expect from the student. Just do the homework and the assignments and you are good to go.

Is not an easy class, however professor Box made is so much easier. She is quick on her lessons but dont be afraid to ask her questions. Overall great professor I would of taken her if she had taught 102 but I think she only teaches 101

I love Professor Box . She is also a student I think working for her master so she understand you when you are having trouble. She is very on point with lessons always follow the study plan that is posted in BB. my Spanish lab is a little too much but she cant control that because is a university had plan it. I would take her if she taught 102

she was very nice, approachable, and organized. she's young so she's not prudy, she grades fairly. there is a lot of online hw but the homework was mostly easy to do, there are clear due dates so there wont be any changes and it will affect your average so you have to do it. overall i would take her again
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor Dunnigan is very kind. The prompt for the final is very strict and it makes it harder to write. So much busy work.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Loved Professor Dunnigan's class! Took ENGL100 in the summer so a lot of essays in a short amount of time but his class was enjoyable. Conversation based class so participation is graded but fairly easy. Gives GREAT feedback after assignment is graded, few pop quizzes about 5 questions per quiz on short reading
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: He never releases a rubric for essays, he just tells you what to write, and that can make things unclear when he grades. There were some essays I believed were better than the grade he gave, and some I didn't even think I deserved an A. He's great with feedback, but only after your grade has come back.

This is relatively basic English course, although high school does not teach you nearly enough when it comes to writing clearly. Thankfully, he gives a run down of all the necessary factors of an essay. He is a patient grader and cares about everyone receiving a passing grade. There are a lot of assignments in general but very completable.

Professor Dunnigan is a really great instructor.  I will say is that his class is writing intensive which is given in any English course but his prompts are very ambiguous and difficult to understand. If anything is unclear just go to him, he clears any concerns up. He absolutely wants you to succeed just be sure to communicate with him.

You are graded on participation, but participating is relatively easy to do and complete. He gives recorded feedback on all major assignments which are pretty useful! He isn't a tough grader if you follow all guidelines. His energy even at 9am in the morning makes classes interesting and the filler assignments, if you pay attention are easy!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Dunnigan was really nice and thoughtful in the essay feedback. He definitely wants you to dig deeper on the topics that you write to make sure that you are understanding all of the different perspectives. Great teacher!

I don't say this lightly: best class I've ever taken. Prof developed this class and it is very important info in today's political climate. There are various types of media (newspapers, posters, comics, etc) from the women, gay, and civil rights movements. I took another one of his classes in a later semester because it was so impactful to me.

Professor Dunnigan's class is engaging, with thought-provoking discussions on the assigned readings. The workload is manageable, and Unstuckstudy proved helpful for essay prep. Stay on top of the work, and you'll do well in this class.

Overall, Professor Dunnigan is not a bad professor. Great sense of humor and applies his hilariousness to the class extremely well. The pop quizzes came out of nowhere with some of the most random quiz questions ever. Was extremely jammed up towards end with 3 papers being due within 1 full month. Wish there was more clarity on how to write papers.

I loved Dunnigan's class! No matter how bad my day was, this class was random in the best way. He values all opinions, whether "good" or "bad," and listens with genuine curiosity about different views. Grading is a bit tough, but as long as you can back up your views, you're good. He's accommodating, open to questions, and always willing to help.

Had Dunnigan for a 7 week summer ENGL 101 class online. Class was easy and he graded on criteria more than anything else. Follow the instructions and you will be fine. He was a slow grader and I often didn't get a rough draft grade back until well after I'd turned in a final draft. But, because he was not a harsh grader this wasn't a big deal.

This class is simple as long as you read the books and participate in class. Professor Dunnigan was always flexible with deadlines with valid reasons (so long as you spoke to him before the due date about any circumstances), and always was willing to read our essays and give us feedback before we submitted.

Course is extremely back-loaded, with only 2 papers due in the first 14 weeks of the semester and 3 papers due in the last two weeks (two of which are 10 pages each). Doesn't give clear instructions for the papers, then takes lots of points off because we didn't write it exactly how he wanted. Feels more like a history class than an English class.
Honestly he's a chill teacher however the quizzes were so random... so it was difficult because it's not like you can study ahead of time because he asks the most random questions ever
Super fun lectures and caring professor. However, he is a harsher grader. There are books to read and essays based on the books. About 4-5 I believe.

I love Professor Dunnigan, he is supportive and caring, and the workload was manageable, with 4-5 essays as the basis for your grade. If you stay on top of the novels and essays and ask for feedback, you will ace it! You do have to talk in class which makes up 10% of your grade but other than that, I would retake this class with him if I could!

His lectures are more philosophical and discussing books than teaching English. Participation is a grade. Try starting on papers early because you need to put a lot of thought into them. His feedback is good but slow because grading takes forever. He gives extensions for the papers if you need, but only for 1-2 days. Overall good prof and class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--So many papers

reviews.comment: I loved going to this class even though it was just an annoying GE credit. I found some of the essays fun to write and I got lucky with the books I got to read. PLEASE participate if you want this guy, he loves it and it gets awkward without anyone participating (you are also graded on it). Felt like a philosophy class.
Chill professor. Typical english class, start your essays early, read the assigned readings for your book, participate in class and you'll have a smooth ride.
His lectures alone are worth taking him for your English credit. Really fun class and the readings were interesting.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I took Eng Composition hybrid class in the fall and I loved it. Professor Dunnigun engages the student by asking different questions that help with critical thinking. Just be prepared to participate, it matters. It is not so hard, you just have to contribute at least one reply for the discussion and you are good.

Hands down the best professor I've had so far. I was dreading this as an online zoom class at first but it was entertaining he made it interesting it wasn't boring. He is very nice and is willing to give early feedback if you email him. I never struggled in English so it was really easy for me. His standards are clear and not difficult.

Professor Dunnigan is a very nice and understanding professor. He chooses interesting books to read and beware of philosophical tangents during his lectures (I happen to enjoy them but I can see how some may not). He gives helpful feedback on every paper and always encourages students to attend his office hours or to email him if any qualms.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Dunnigan is very passionate about his Introduction to Literature course. We read Frankenstein, V for Vendetta, and a Raisin in the Sun. I think there were a couple essays, of which it is very important to write about what you actually think and interpret, not just copy some analysis from the internet. Expect to read and participate a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: Great professor! Really turned your usual English class into something much deeper. Has made great accommodations and easy adjustment for the online format. Really interesting books/ topics discussed.

I took his summer class online and it was not great. His feedback was not clear and did not help towards improving my writing. All of the lectures discussed Philosophy and all assignments focused on writing.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I loved his class! His lectures were interesting and funny and we usually ended early. Really easy class as long as youre a good writer (I put an average amount of effort in and got an A). There were a few 3-4 page papers, a research paper, a final paper, and some other small writing assignments. The books he picks are good and easy to understand.

Mr. Dunnigan is so fantastic! He is a caring, witty teacher who respects his students and tries his best to have us engage. He is also very philosophical, has one thinking of the big questions in life. We do a lot of papers, so beware, but that's expected. You need to participate and come to class! Thank you, Prof. Dunnigan for a great semester!

He is an awesome professor hes relaxed and informal. As long as you read the supplemental readings the night before and the novel readings you can earn an A or a B (depending on how you write). His papers are easy and not long (about 2-3 pages). Take his class!

Dunnigan is a very friendly, relaxed, informal guy. Class was fun a lot of the time, and we got out early often. The grades are paper based - we'd have one big paper due while three others were to be written and due at the same time. The required readings are what's discussed in class, and you get a participation grade based on how often you spoke.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: He either grades really easy, or I'm an amazing writer. A paper I got a B on in HS that I added to he gave me an A+! There are a few papers, each dealing with a different theme/book, but he picks good, interesting books for the semester. Really enjoyed his class, but do PARTICIPATE!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He respects every each student. His lectures are mixed with humor and useful background information. He makes you feel comfortable and enjoyable in class. There is alot of papers and books to read but the books were very interesting and he thoroughly explains the rubric for papers and gives it way ahead of time for you to prepare.

Prof Dunnigan is probably one of the best professors in the english department. Really engaging topics in class and a fair grader. However, one of the books required for class was used no more than 3 times and I paid 35$ for it. We weren't tested on it or anything it was just used for background knowledge.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Somehow got an A in this course, despite taking it in the summer before college. Thought this class was going to be easy, but the fact he drops a letter grade for missing 2 lectures is quite biased. Very tough essay grader. Cool professor but difficult topics.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Dunnigan is hands down the best professor at UMBC! This is not your standard English class. He creates interesting discussions and chooses interesting novels. I recommend him to all my friends and would recommend him to everyone. BEST PROFESSOR!
Great professor that cares and has interesting, engaging lectures. Assignments include minor or major essays, and the final is also an essay. Two main books - a novel and a graphic novel.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: He was the best English professor in my educational career!! His socks were amazing and he made me enjoy coming to class every day at 9 am! But he aint that easy you have to read and talk in class! He's great though 10/10 would recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Professor Dunnigan really knows what he is talking about. As an English major, I was very interested in the book discussions we had in class. Be sure to keep on top of the supplemental readings as they often make appearances on pop-quizzes and exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: So funny and straightforward and keeps the class entertained! pretty hip

He is a very chill and laid back teacher but I don't understand how he grades his papers. I did more writing in this class then I did in my writing intensive class. Class participation is key. Pop quizzes here and there. Make sure you read bc he's gonna ask the most random questions. Keep up supplemental readings, thats the bulk of the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Prof D was pretty chill, class was philosophy heavy. Gives decent feedback on papers, but vaguely graded. You can find all books online. Keep up on reading b/c he gives pop quizzes. Exams are heavily focused on the supplm readings. First 1.5 month was a repeat of ENGL100-fell behind on the syllabus, so last 3 weeks of class was exam, essay, essay.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: He's pretty awesome. Felt lucky I got him for my first semester. As long as you speak up, even a little bit every class, your participation grade will be solid. Even if it's just word, at least he knows you're engaged with the class. The papers themselves aren't half bad either. Time consuming yeah, but it is college mate.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Prof Dunnigan is a cool guy and his lectures were interesting. He is nice and funny when you talk to him personally. His grading is not too bad but it sometimes seems random. HOWEVER, he grades participation very strictly. Be SURE to speak 2-3 times PER class because the participation grade will make or break you.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: My class experience was 3 hours of this man's random opinions of life.  He's funny and cool but spends the majority of the class off topic.  He counts participation and you cant miss more than two classes a semester.  Don't take him.

He's a pleasure to have as a professor. He's hilarious and is really amazing at making lectures entertaining. Overall an amazing person. But make sure you come to class and participate, or you won't pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He's a great guy, pretty interesting too. I would definitely take ENG100 with him again. I took him over the summer if you focus you'll get an A
Gave good feedback on papers and interesting lectures. Also he's very easy on the eyes.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Participation matters !!! To me , his lectures were pretty confusing , he likes to relate everything in book with history or philosophy or  things you never heard of . However , that made the lectures interesting I guess . Have an advice for pre-med ppl , don't take it , choose something more practical ..

I took him for a second time for ENG 392 and he was a great teacher to have yet again. If you need help, he's there and he's very approachable. His comments are entertaining to hear during the small group discussions and he has some pretty good insight. I definitely recommend him as one of the better professors at umbc.

I don't like his grading skills. He doesn't use blackboard and  sometimes he loses his students papers. He never gave me a clear calculation of my grade in his class but was very arbitrary when grading . He's a very chilled guy but he needs to work on his grading. and fix his blackboard use. Also, he is a very disorganized man
Dunnigan is a great professor and his lectures are interesting, He is one of the tougher graders as far as English 100 goes, but then again its English 100.

He grades the first paper easy then as he goes on he grades papers harder. He always offers to read rough drafts and gives really good feedback on them. He's a good teacher, but he takes forever to give you back your workpapers.

Attendance is definitely necessary, if you miss more than 4 classes, you won't pass. There's no leniency for that, excused or not, so go to class! I found his sense of humor hilarious and he's a very nice teacher!

BEST PROFESSOR EVER. His lectures makes you question your current view on religion, government while connecting literature. BIG on philosophy, very chill, open minded, you will NOT REGRET taking this class Frankenstein, V for Vendetta 3 (500-750 word) papers, 2 tests, 3-4 in class assignments AttendanceParticipation mandatory if you want an A
Great professor. Interesting class. Doing the reading and put effort into your work, easy A

She has a particular writing style and she expects everyone to write the same. What she expects is not made clear and you're left confused! I really want to like her, she seems to be really nice. But, I CAN NOT!
yes
He's a hilarious guy and chooses good books to read. Was very helpful with essay feedback if you go to his office hours. Fun guy to talk too.

Best professor I ever had. This is the only class I actually looked forward to attending just because the guy is hilarious and class discussions are fun. The work is easy, all the papers were under 10 pages (usually 7 pages max) and the books he chooses are SO INTERESTING, they're really easy to write papers about. I wish I could have him again.
Would not recommend this professor. Arbitrary grader and didn't update grades until the last day. Plenty of easier teachers you could enroll with.

Buy the books. Go to every class. Exams are based on class discussions and imp. details in books. Not hard if you pay attention. PARTICIPATE! Write 3-4 essays. Give yourself at least 2-3 days to write, edit and re-write. You can also email your drafts for him to edit. He is a fair grader. Doesn't rush class. Pretty laid-back. Do not slack off.

He's a good person, but grades really harshly. All the classes involve lengthy discussions on very detailed portions of books, but tests cover a wide range of poems and topics that weren't discussed. Little feedback, doesn't post grades. Not worth taking Eng 210 with this guy

Great personality! Horrible Professor! He gives almost no commentary on graded Essays besides "more devlopment". I emailed him several times with no reply. He is big on participation with unreasonable expectations. He talks for 80% on the class but wants every single student to participate ever class period. Pre-Medders stay away. Not worth the B.

I would not recommend this professor. While Professor Dunnigan is a nice person, he is not a helpful teacher. He rarely responds to his emails, is unclear about assignments, and an inconsistent grader. Expect significantly more work  than other professors. He is the only English 100 teacher that I know of that is giving a final exam as well.

Must attend class since he does take attendance but class is not at all boring or dull.  Doesn't expect over the top writing skills though you better read and take notes for the exams and papers since its concept questions and no secondary paper sourcing.

So I felt like the class was remedial since I had already taken a couple AP English classes, but I still think the class wasn't a waste of time. The material is interesting and I enjoyed hearing Mr.Dunnigan talk despite his constant disclaimers on things he said not being his actual opinion. He's rather dorky, but it's cute.

Interesting and thought provoking class. Classes almost always discussion and participation is required every class. 5 major essays are the majority of the final grade, fair grader and respects opinion as long as you explain your thoughts. great teacher and easy to talk to!

He is nice and open minded. He says something he always ensures it does not offend anyone in class. However, his grading system is very poor. 10%is in participation which is ridiculous since one kid in my class never raised his hand and blurted out everything. The last essays had  close due dates and disregarding students have other work and exams.
All around solid teacher. Very good experience :) Would recommend

Extremely nice and approachable. The kind of person you want to grab a bite with. Very articulate, and gives mind blowing lectures. However, his grading system is terrible. I had 4 papers and a participation grade. He does not post grades on Bb, so nobody knows their grade thruout the semester. Still, I would recommend his class.

He is by far the best professor I have ever had in my life! He actually makes me interested in the topics he brings up. He also chooses very interesting books to read for class. You will love being in his class!

This professor does not use blackboard and because the majority of the 5 assignments are piled at the end of the semester, you could have a high A and have it drop down to a C after the last day of school. His niceness does not make up for the frustration I've had with his grading system.

I have always loved english so I looked forward to this. We only had a total of five papers all semester, and he piled the last three on at the very end. Rambles on about the most open ended things. Its hit or miss with him, and there is no way of knowing whether he will love or hate your papers. Completely inconsistent. Not profound imo.

He was an amazing professor. He was so helpful and nice. Never said anything negative and had the best personality. He made jokes all of the time, and was super easy to approach. He would even edit your paper before it was due, which I highly recommend. Not too hard on the eyes either!!

One of the best professors I've ever had, and an interesting man. When you first see him, all your preconceived notions of what professors should be go out the window. He's a brilliant, and really gets you think critically. Also, he's easy on the eyes and just has this refreshing youthful charm about him. TAKE HIS CLASS!
best professor i have ever had IN MY LIFE. encourages critical thinking and is really interested in students success. TAKE THIS PROFFESSOR. not hard. just read the materials and participate in class.

He's a fun, easy-going professor. There were three books for my Spring 2011 semester, which were "V for Vendetta", "The Handmaid's Tale", and "Geek Love". There was a 500-750 word paper on each, and a 5-7 page paper at the end of the term. Easy stuff, cool guy.

He's a rambler, but pretty interesting. Unfortunately, the class material itself is pretty boring, so he can only do so much to make it appealing. He normally picks "controversial" books and you write simple essays for them. Longest paper is 5-7 pages at the end of the semester.

Dunnigan sets the standard for what professors AND teachers should aspire to be. Helpful, engaging, intelligent, are a few of the virtues he possesses toward teaching and will do just about everything in his power NOT to leave you in the dust. Neigh sayers of this popular professor should be silenced. His methods should be kindled not killed.

The information he taught was good and innovative. He doesn't keep grades posted. He lied and said that I didn't participate in class enough, although I was one of the many who volunteered to do everything. He isn't very reachable.
WONDERFUL!!!!!!!!

Wonderful Teacher, you do one paper per book plus a research, and then like 2 or 3 like one page things. Class attendance is a must. If you participate are speak up in class everything will go great. Longest paper was research paper, 7 pages (nothing at all) Take him!
Very helpful if you're having trouble and kind hearted.
AWESOME. He is the best. Very helpful and discussions in class were very open and easy to get points. Overall great professor

Take Dunnigan! He is a huge promoter of thinking critically for yourself. Now, unlike the others I didn't have "revelations" towards English (because he never focuses on grammar), but I always enjoyed going and learning something new. Attendance and Participation are MANDATORY. Overall, great class. And.. it doesn't hurt that he's good looking.
Really loves teaching.
he is SOOO Hott!!! and i can't help but pay attention in class and smile : )
This teacher is AWESOME!! One of the best teachers I have ever had. He involved the super orgasm into lecture, thats how hilarious he is!!

He is an awesome teacher and really helpful. You just have to write a lot of essays and he makes you think critically. He is also REALLY hot which makes you pay attention to his class. I have sexual fantasies about this man.

Prof Dunnigan is byfar one of my favorite professors so far in my college career. i don't know what i got yet, as i am still in his class but he seriously makes you think. i learned so much from this class. i came into this class just wanting to get my english credit over with, but he is very interesting..he is pretty hard though on his grading
good
AWESOME TEACHER!! Not as much reading required as everyone has been saying but defiantly manageable. Very interesting lectures and entertaining. Pushes you to critically think. Really cool guy.

AWESOME PROFESSOR! Only class that I enjoyed attending. His grading system is straightfoward, he grades fairly. The lectures are hilarious and you can go offtangent like crazy and get full points. Definently enjoyed having this class and it is a REALLY EASY A!

His teaching is ok. Expect to read a lot. Though he loves to mention how objective he is, this is not a constant truth. He can be insensitive. Things like racism or genocide he will qualify as wrong, but topics like sexual assault or subjugation of women get "all opinions welcome" or "there is no wrong answer". If you're sensitive to this avoid it.

Brian is easygoing and entertaining.  he has great insight and energy to spare.    his books are interesting.  The teacher doesn't force his opinions on you, but rather lets you think about issues for yourself.  He touches on everything from the relative morality of murder, to Malcolm X's change of heart.  Very interesting class.
You could sum up everything Dunnigan teaches in one lecture.  His class should be an easy A but it's a huge a waist of time.

Tries to draw critical thinking from various students, and often does a fairly decent job. He often repeats the same questions in different words however, may just be us not being responsive though. His reading syallabus is demanding at first, but turns out it's not really held to (good thing). Probably 3rd best proff I ever had, love the class.

Took the summer session. I looked forward to his class and did well but I wrote top-notch papers. The discussions were amusing and his grading was reasonable. Understanding person and nice person. You must attend class and do the required reading, though. I recommend him as your professor - you will enjoy his class if you have an open mind.

Quite possibly one of the best professors I have ever had. Immensely interesting, wants to hear other (even contrary) opinions, and loves what he teaches. Extremely helpful (you can email him your papers ahead of time) and grades based on content (even if he personally disagrees). Funny, but he rekindled my love of philosophy. HIGHLY recommended.

LOVE LOVE LOVE him! The BEST prof i've EVER had. I wish he'd start teaching something besides eng100 so I can take him again. He's totally hot (<3), very intelligent and evokes critical thinking. 5 essays, 1 research paper, and participation is vital along with attendance, but with dunnigan you wont want to miss class but rather look forward to it.

By far my favorite teacher.  He is so enthusiastic about his teaching and makes you want to come to class. Be sure to participate, he's really big on that.  The novels are pretty interesting, they are not boring at all especially "The Handmaid's Tale."  No tests, just papers and you can e-mail them to him ahead of time for his feedback.

Very interesting professor. You only have to write about 4 to 5 essays. But what I liked most about this professor is that he grades your essays primarily based on your ability to demonstrate critical thinking instead of minor mistakes such as grammar and word usage and whatnot. You do not have to be an eloquent writer to get a good grade.
He was an ok teacher. There was more reading and writing than in most English classes (We had to read 7 novels and write a paper on each one). If you like reading and writing you should be fine.
talk alot in class and try to write what he wants to hear.
Great class!  Brian will talk about anything and is by far the best teacher I have ever had!

He is a very interesting guy, he talks about new ideas and encourages the student's new ideas. You have to read about 5-7books but they are very interesting also. However, he grades essay in a weird way. If he doesnt like your style, he will not give you a nice grade. But overall classes are interesting.

Less than 25% of class time is actually used to improve writing skills. This instructor basically gets paid to whinge about his political opinions in a required course using straw man arguments and endless rhetorical questions.
Very playful guy. Doesnt take the class seriously and grades papers unrealistically. I do not recommend him.

Everyday is an experience with this professor.  He is all about promoting critical thought.  Your grade is based off 6 papers, participation, and small quizes just to make sure you are reading.  He is an average grader but a very interesting guy.  I loved his class and it was fairly easy to get a good grade.  Just read and work hard on the papers.

The best english teacher at UMBC! He is so interesting, makes the class fun and it never feels like ur in a boring old english class. I took the class as a junior so i've had many manyyy professors and he is def one of the best.

I love this guy/class!  He's totally the best english teacher I have had yet!  The class bring up interesting critical thinking, fascinating ideas and I would definetly suggest it to anyone taking english 100.
Pretty hard grader,but very funny, he tries to make class interesting.  You definitely want him for ENGL 100.  Every other teacher I have heard people complain about

Loved his class.  For English, you want him.  He is a harderish grader, but he makes literature interesting. Once he turned off all the lights in the room, took out candles and we read by candlelight for a class!  Sometimes he took us outside too.

Class is pretty boring but you have to attend because he takes attendance.  Tough grader on papers and class discussion is VERY important (10% of your grade).  No homework except to read the books and no quizzes so you better be a good writer and active participater!
No Comments

Expect to think in this class, grades essays a bit hard. Psych majors will have an advantage during discussions. And he is an interesting character. i.e. "Is this class really just mental masturbation?" need I say more
wow class is pretty boring.  you talk about the same stuff everyday.  he grades essays pretty easy though and there are no tests!
Great teacher. He expects college students to do college work and is big on class participation. Best teacher I ever had.

the stuff you do in this class is nothing like what you should learn in English 100.  You have to read 6 books and an essay for each then a research paper on the 6 books... so if you dont read the books your screwed.. ALSO he takes ATTENDENCE and if you miss 3 you get a grade lowered.. and if you 5 YOU FAIL.. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS FROM HIM!!
One of the best professors here at UMBC.  Keeps everyone involved even though he is a hard grader on essays.

This class is very entertaining.  If you like English and critical thinking then this is the class for you.  Don't hesitate to ask him questions, go to class, take notes, read the books (they really arent that bad), and TRY on the essays.  PARTICIPATION is a big thing but come on thats not that bad... overall AWESOME teacher, I got great insight!
I don't like english, but enjoyed this class. I just didn't like all the reading that was needed.

Prepare to do about 5 essays and 1 research paper. You read about 5 books, most of them are entertaining... like others said very helpful but you have to put the effort into getting your grade.. He is big in participation.  Overall not an easy class but not to difficult. ATTENDENCE is a must

Awesome teacher (even tho he looks like a young punkish guy haha).  Very fun classes.  talks about ANYTHING, no matter how risque.  He even cancels lab mid way through semester.  He's kinda a hard grader on essays, but he's available to check your paper before hand.  He made me like english class!

he is liek a precious young/aging punk. he is so cute and has such cute style! ooh and hes so intelligent and aware of social norms and gender norms.. and he totally is goofy and a werido and makes things fun.. and gets u thinking critically. PLUS hes so down and totally ur homeboy!

He is perhaps one of the best teachers I have ever seen in action.  He makes you think, and wants everyone in class to participate in discussions.  These days stand out. 1. Led the class outside to chat... just because.  2. Turned off the lights and put a candle on every desk inside... to read.
I had him last semester and he's really awesome. Class is fairly easy, but he really wants everyone to participate in discussion. The final paper kinda sucks, but the rest of the semester is fine
focuses a lot on class discussion, but he really wants his students to question and think critically.  Fun class--very casual atmosphere and he doesen't talk down to you.
He is super nice and is always willing to help. He also lets you out early quite often

This was my second course with her, and I had the same problem as last time. We had so few chances to practice what we learned, so I did fine on the homework and pretty bad on quizzes/exams. She's really nice and funny, but I we had more chances to practice the skills that we learned.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: please come to class, it could be the difference between an A and B! Other than that, hws and quizzes weren't too bad but I wish we had gotten more ways to practice in between because the hw wasn't nearly enough for the quiz and she didnt give much to practice with in lecture either. other than that, class was easy.

One of the best linguistics professors in the department. Fantastic lecturer, well organized, and very funny. I learned a lot. Has a zero-tolerance absence policy (so you lose points for every absence), but you can regain some of those lost points by participating in class.

I took LING 210, which isn't listed here. She's good at teaching, but my only complaint is that there weren't very many assignments or assessments. There were few graded things, but each worth a lot of points. That might sound great, but it meant we didn't have a lot of chances to practice the material, and didn't have many things to be graded by.
Shes so fun just do the work

I learned a great deal in her class, she know what she talking about.  That said, she comes off as condescending when asked questions.  her exams are worded very poorly/awkwardly which makes them challenging.  I cme to her office hours once and she made me feel stupid.

Honestly, an amazing professor, I took this class because I needed a culture credit. Best decision I made, I am a STEM major but taking this linguistics class was amazing. Solid lectures, she was amazing at engaging students and often times incorporated her own stories to showcase the ideas. The readings were lengthy, but not undoable. Great prof!

Incredible class. There is a lot of reading to do, but the professor goes over the main points in class anyway. She has some funny stories to share, and there are opportunities to share your own stories as well. There is a scientific research poster, paper, and a few exams involved, but she is a lenient grader imo. Very fun professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Hilarious--Graded by few things--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: I love her. I didn't do well on my final paper and it brought me down a letter grade, so I wouldn't call her easy, but she's a fair grader. She's interesting, encourages lectures, and loves her subject. I was struggling in another class and when she saw me waiting to take the final for it, she came over and told me I'd be ok. One of the best.

Renee is so sweet! This class had no exams, the grade was based on in-class presentations, guided reading questions, assignments called "thinkaloud"s, and a final essay. She is super chill, and an easy grader.
Dr. Lambert was amazing. I very much enjoyed her class. There were only 3 exams and 1 group project. The exam content came from the powerpoints she presented during class.

She takes no crap, leads thoughtful and intellectual discussions, and doesn't hesitate to give her opinion, but encourages you to disagree if you do. Very welcoming, funny, and expects a lot from you. Quebequoise, so she second guesses her english sometimes, but it's not an issue and she's easily understood. Easily one of my new favorites.

Dr. Brewster is passionate about the course content and is very knowledgeable about the material. However, the exams are disproportionately long for the allotted time frame, forcing students to rush through complex, highly specific questions (which are also graded extremely subjectively).

Dr. Brewster is kind, friendly, and passionate about developmental biology. However, she takes a while to grade and exams were inconsistent/very long. Most (except final exam) were long free response and graded subjectively, it was often hard to tell the exact answer she wanted. She had a generous curve and gave plenty of extra credit, though.

She recently switched exams to only 25 free response questions which was very hard. Final was 50 multiple choice questions. Material is rough and her lectures don't really help. Exam questions are very specific and all free response which will take up the whole exam period.

Developmental Biology is a hard topic, but Dr. Brewster makes it interesting and she is passionate about her field. She graded on a point based scale which allowed for more flexibility in receiving a higher grade in the class, especially with all the bonus points she gave out. She really cares about her students succeeding and is willing to help!

Devo is a difficult topic but Professor Brewster makes it very fun to learn. Her exams are fair but you definitely have to study hard. She gives great feedback and a lot of extra credit opportunities. I wish she taught more classes.

Devo class itself is a hard topic. One of the best profs. for it,however. She stresses high understanding over memorization. Is pretty organized and one way that helps to study: use end of lec. learning obj. Look them over while listening to lec. to focus in on the key points.   If you skimp in anyway, youll be lucky if you manage a B.

Quizzes and exams are made intentionally long (around four to five pages per quiz, given 50 minutes to complete) and difficult, problems are dubious compared to other UMBC professors.
Avoid at all costs

If you really want to learn the content, take Tighe. Her quizzes and exams are harder but I learned so much. It prepared me for 152 (currently taking). Suffered through it but it was worth it. She was entertaining and kept my attention the whole lecture. She did take surprise attendance once and it was worth a grade. Actually learned in lecture.
Extremely difficult course, but the professor does everything she can to help you. I highly recommend taking her if you need Calc 2.

Tighe doesn't teach, just does practice problems without explanation or just outright does them wrong. Very disorganized, multiple times she didn't give her TA's the quizzes they were supposed to administer and had to call tech support for very basic issues. Doesn't teach, just does practice problems without explanation or just outright does them wrong. Tbh I learned much more from YouTube and the old quizzes/exams than I did from her lectures but this applies to a certain extent for all calc professors here.What I knock her for is the over-the-top quizzes which were harder than other professors.She is a somewhat snark lady at times but that's negated by how nice she can be outside of class.

Mrs. Tighe is not a bad person but a terrible teacher.  I asked for help multiple times yet still received none.  If you have a choice do not take Tighe. She will belittle you if you do not understand something and instead of helping will ask "Why didn't you learn this in Algebra??"

She makes a lot of mistakes during lectures, gets sassy if you ask questions, AND THE EXAMS ARE DUBIOUS! The exam questions are overly complicated and unreasonable, but at least the exams and quizzes are recycled so study the past assessments.

Guys, I don't think you understand the struggle. She is not even my professor but she makes my final exam and that thing looks awful you will not be able to even comprehend 50% of it. So try really hard all semester.

Tighe's tests are more complex then other calc 2 professors and no longer match her prior year examples. The average score on the second midterm was 50%. Her solution to this was the spend the first 5 minutes of lecture complaining about how terrible her students are.

Class is a mess. No point in going to lectures because she is on a different topic while everyone is trying to study the previous topic for an upcoming test. Harsh grader. Half of the time the practice quizzes for the tests aren't even on bb. Sometimes her lecture notes are wrong. I promise you, you will teach yourself the course. Don't chose her

Skips the problems she can't solve. Horrible notes, can barely read what she wrote, doesn't show all her work. Gets annoyed or frustrated when someone asks a question. Lectures are not helpful and she goes really fast and barely explains what she's doing. Only pro is that she provides past quizzes and tests. But grades barely get updated. Just no

Tighe is a very average professor. She gives good lectures and her notes are easy to follow, but her exams are brutal. I often ever was able to even finish them in the given time, and partial credit is few and far between. My quiz and homework grades were the only reason I didn't fail. She makes Calc 1 a total slog, so try for another prof.

The class average at the moment is between 67% -70%. This says a lot about what kind of professor she is. She is very picky with her partial credit and is a harsh grader. I have to teach myself 90% of the material because her lectures aren't helpful.
Tighe makes a lot of mistakes in lecture. Exams are hard, but it helps to look at the past exams uploaded on blackboard. Really picky on partial credit. TAs in discussion are helpful.

Honestly the only reason I am not failing this class is because I took calc AB and BC in high school. I can always feel the confusion and irritation every lecture. She just goes through practice problems, but she constantly messes up and we have to correct her. The TAs in the discussion are a lot more helpful, and we have weekly quizzes.

She is definitely not nice or sweet. She gets smart when people ask a question she thinks you should already know the answer to. Lectures are very choppy. She has incomplete problems and skips problems that she can't figure out herself. Don't skip lecture bc you'll be more confused when you look at the mess that is her lecture notes w/o context.

Tighe is honestly not a great teacher. She often times will stop answering questions midway if she forgets how its done and moves onto the next problem. If you ask questions during lecture, she asks the student why they didn't learn it in algebra or something. She is very respected though and not too harsh. Just a difficult teacher.

Professor Tighe is awesome!! She really knows her stuff, is super approachable, and gives very good lectures. sure the classes are hard, but if you go to class and have good study habits, it'll be a breeze.

Tighe is really good, I really like her as a professor. She gives off sweet grandmother vibes and has a good sense of humor. The only thing I don't really like about her is her slow grading sometimes. She's been having some health issues so it's understandable but sometimes throughout the semester, we've been held in limbo for weeks w/ exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Mrs. Tighe is a great professor, but she's tough. She makes you take pre-reading quizzes, tedious HWs, and challenging quizzes and exams. She provides a lot of old exams and old quizzes. She has high expectations for students but provides you with a great foundation for Calc 3. SI Pass and Office hours are also extremely helpful.

she may seem harsh and a little scary at first but shes nice & i got the vibes of 'i want u to pass, but u gotta put in the work' from her. like its calc, so ofc it's gona be hard, but I think you hav a chance if you spend ur time on hw, practice problems, previous exams & quizzes + she'll help u outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She is not only strict, but also be mean sometimes.

If you learn best from reading the text then Tighe is the teacher for you. When you come to class it is expected you will be able to do problems from that days lesson. Her teaching method is 70% doing problems & 30% going on verbal tangents. I watched professor Leonard videos all semester to actually learn the material.

Tighe is the best professor I've had at UMBC, period. That being said, she's tough. She makes you take pre-reading quizzes before the lectures, plenty of long HWs, tough quizzes and exams. Sounds awful, but trust me, she gives you the resources to do well. Great lectures, and a fair grader. Going to OH is your key to an A with her. Very accessible.

reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Tighe is a national treasure. She gave amazing lectures and really wanted the students to pass. She was a tough grader and had not time for questions she had already answered so pay attention. If you really don't understand she is willing to work with you outside of class. Her quizzes were the right amount of difficulty.

Tighe makes you teach everything to yourself. What's covered in lectures and on homeworks, is a lot easier than what she tests you on. She's had to curve most of our exams and quizzes because so many people aren't learning what's being tested. She makes a lot of mistakes and expects the students to deal with them, good luck to those who have her.
Bonny is fantastic! I took two courses at UMBC quite a while ago, and she was genuine and accessible. Seems gruff, but is very humorous and quite enjoyable!

Tighe is a great professor. She goes thru lectures quick, but will stop and explain better if you ask. Blank notes, previous quizzes/tests, etc are provided, so there is a lot of material that can help you prepare for exams. She's very down-to-earth and understanding, too.

reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She is a very good teacher, and goes through lot of examples in class, though she sometimes goes through actual notes a little too fast. She told us beginning of the semester "It is not my job to teach you. It is your job to teach yourselves from the book and I am here to give u strategies and guidance." MandatoryAttend ButSheDoesn'tTeachInLecture SheJustDoesTheProblems AndIfAnyoneAsksForExplanation SheTreatsThemLikeTheyAreStupid ForNotAlreadyKnowing "BecauseThisIsSoEasy" (HerWords)
