She has "print out lectures" that she provides, or you print them out and fill in as you go along in class. She has her old quizzes and exams online, so if you go to class, take good notes and study the old stuff, you'll have no issue getting an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Prof. Tighe is overall a great professor, as she goes through step by step explaining how to do problems. She can go through the notes a bit too quickly at times, but if someone asks she can slow down. The tests and quizzes can be difficult, but she provides plenty of practice exams and quizzes online to help. Discussion is also very helpful.

she is great to take her if you can, she is a bit difficult compared to other teachers but other teachers don't teach and she is a great teacher and she makes the final so if you are used to the other professor the final is gonna be hard

She might come off as tough but she is really caring and wants her student to walk away with BOTH knowledge and good grades. Most math professors here only care about grades and if you memorize their exams, you'd pass. Tighe is really focused on making you understand the materials. 100% recommend her!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She's an amazing teacher and gives you absolutely everything you need to get an A, it's just that you actually need to do it

Prof. Tighe is my favorite professor this semester, she isn't easy but definitely wants everyone to succeed. I enjoyed going to lectures and her tests were always fair, she gives you every tool possible to succeed

You need to be willing to dedicate a HUGE amount of time to studying, but Tighe is absolutely the best option if you want to come away from this class with some real skills for a future in Math. reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Mrs. Tighe has been teaching mathematics for many many years. Her lectures are formated incredibly well, and she uploads her notes to BlackBoard. Professor Tighe is a quality professor, explains everything really well. My favorite professor.

Mrs. Tighe is a wonderful professor. I am not the greatest at Math and so calculus 1 was a little challenging. She gives out quizzes that she has used in previous years as practice. She also gives 10% curve on the tests. She is nice and if you go to lectures and do the work, you should pass her class.

I took her because she was super highly recommended by literally everyone on campus, but I ended up dropping. When I found myself taking her class I just couldn't understand anything. This course is fairly easy as Prof. Tighe is very good at explaining calc ii. She posts everything online including lecture notes and old quizzes/exams. Exams are extremely fair but also very long. Apparently the final was curved, but if you spend time to understand the content you won't need it.

great professor. I took her for calc 1 and calc 2 and she breaks it down into simple algorithms so you can use the same patterns for different problems. If you can take her, TAKE TIGHE. Wonderful prof.

She's a tough professor but it's so worth it. She cares if you care and she's really laid back. If you need a calc 1 or 2 professor at UMBC highly recommend.
Personable, invested, thorough. Listens, and is genuinely interested in helping students do well. Excellent!

Not a math person but somehow survived. She expects a lot from her students but gives you the tools you need to be successful. Lectures are interesting and she's a very kind and understanding professor. Do the practice exams to prepare!

Ms. Tighe is an amazing teacher. She is very demanding of her students and really expects a lot. A great professor. She is a bit sarcastic at times, but it is very funny and brings some humor to class. Her teaching is great. She drops quizzes and replaces your lowest exam grade with the final. reviews.comment: Tighe is an okay professor. However, her lecture solutions and quiz keys sometimes give wrongful answers, giving students a higher chance of getting low scores on tests.

Compared to other teachers, Bonny Tighe is the hardest. Her quizzes and exams are longer and harder. Many people fail this course in general and I can tell you taking it with her makes this easier. She is a very good teacher and puts effort into the class, but if you want to increase your chances of passing Calc 2, don't take her.

I failed the class I took with her. I got a D. But she taught me more than most professors and I retook her class and got a B. She helped me understand the mathematical thought process, and not just how to solve math problems. I promise you if you put in the time, you will be on your way to understand math much much better with her guidance.

LOVED Prof. Tighe. While she seems intimidating at first and her humor is demeaning to the unprepared, she is a sweet woman. Never had a professor who made winter hats for her students who came to office hours. The material is difficult and exams are challenging, but it trains you for the final. Take her class, but be prepared to do some work.
She's very funny
If you work through her quizzes and practice exams, you are guaranteed an A. GO TO CASTLE. Develop a relationship with her and your TAs. It may save you on an exam or in my case, a letter grade.

reviews.comment: Calculus II is hard on its own, don't really like the way she teaches it. Lectures are online, so are practice quizzes and tests, they are HARD, be PREPARED. She projects the lecture sheets, goes over theorems, then problems. Terrible way to teach, but passable if that's your thing.

She is an AMAZING professor. In both courses she emailed everyone outlines for the lectures so it was very easy to follow along with what she was saying. The tests were a little long and difficult but it really prepared you for the final exam. In addition to that she posted multiple quizzes and exams from previous years so you knew what to expect.

Print out her lecture notes before classes, they really help you follow along.

reviews.comment: She is by far my favorite professor at UMBC thus far as a college student. I had her for both calc 1 and calc 2, and she made it not only understandable, but fun to learn. Going to her lectures were always enjoyable, and a must. The homework is the hardest you will do to prepare for quizzes, and then quizzes prepare you for exams. Would recommend.

While intimidating at first, she is very sweet, funny, and  approachable. Her exams are very difficult, but as long as you prepare well with the quizzes and practice exams, it'll be better. She talks quickly in her lectures, but if you let her know, she'll go slower. She answers all your questions and offers as much help as she can.

Best Calculus teacher on campus in terms of explaining what to do. However,  she is not the easiest. So you have to make a choice; do I want to pass and not know most of the things for the final or do I want to suffer a little to understand the content. Most students pick the latter; which is respectable.

Probably the best Calculus II teacher at UMBC. Sometimes she goes through her lectures too fast without thoroughly explaining things and you just get lost, but if you do well in her class, you will be very good at Calculus II in general. Sometimes took off points for stupid things, though, like writing "3 + 1/4" instead of "3 1/4".
She is the one of the best Math Professors I've ever had. Defiantly ask for help if you don't understand her and her TAs will work with you. She wants her students to do well!

She is a tough old tigher (: difficult grader, but she tells you what she expects and wont take less than that. Be ready to work but it is very possible to succeed in her class. She is one of the best teachers I have had at UMBC. Would recommend

I LOVE Ms. Tighe. She's the best math teacher I've ever had. Quizzes and tests are straightforward, just practice with the old quizzes and exams and they are pretty much exactly the same, just with different numbers. Final is easy and can replace your first exam grade. Took AP calc AB in high school (2 on the test), but got a 99% in calc 1.
Great teacher. Quizes can be a bit difficult, but exams aren't too bad. Ms. Tighe definitely makes the final exam look like the easiest exam in the world if you do well in the class.

I did not like Tighe at all. Yeah, she gives a lot of examples in class but she goes through them fast, usually skipping multiple steps. I had to do a lot of work outside of class. I honestly hated her sarcasm and pessimistic comments. She's tough, which I appreciate but she's just bad at explaining the material.

Professor Tighe made Calc II a great experience. Her unit exams were tougher, which allowed me to feel more than prepared while taking the final. Her lecture notes were always clear and full of good examples. I always looked forward to her class because of her hilarious personality. Definitely one of the best professors here.

Bonny Tighe is a great teacher. She made it clear that you needed to actually understand the material to pass, so just take the class seriously. Definitely go to lectures because she does lots of practice problems in class. Khan academy videos and the homework website webassign mostly helped me pass because she goes kind of fast over the materials.

Bonny Tighe is a great lecturerboth clear and engaging! This isn't a class that you can get an A without learning the material, but It's taught in a way that makes it easy and accessible. If you put your due in, you'll get an A or B. CASTLE (Tighe's and Prof Nanes Friday coach class) is a great resource, & you just might get a hat out of it!

Mrs. Tighe is one of the best professors you can have for Calc II at UMBC. She is very good at what she does and makes sure you get what shes doing. Dont be intimidated by her, shes a sweetheart; go to Castle on friday for extra help. How to Succeed: STUDY FOR THE QUIZZES AND EXAMS FROM THE WORKSHEETS AND TEXTBOOK.

Her tests are a little bit harder than the other  teachers but that just makes you more prepared for the final. Can seem a bit intimidating at times but don't be afraid to ask questions duringafter class, she'll respect you for it. Make sure to do a bit of studying on your own to get an A. Be sure to stop by CASTLE for math help and a Tighe hat.

She will work you to the bone. The tests are hard, and the quizzes are killer. The thing is, in the 2 classes I had with her, she doesn't make the final, another, easier professor does. So, her students are used to harder tests, and are more prepared for the final. Regardless, I never would have anyone else teach me math.
One of the best professors in the department!
She's amazing. Take her for Calc I, or you will miss out. She is so funny when you get to know her. And if you stay on top of the material, her class will be a breeze.
Good math teacher. She did not make the tests easy, you will need to study. I took AP Calc and still had to study for my A.

Tighe is awesome. The best math professor I've had by far. I took 151 and 152 with her and she is the reason I understood it. If you work hard she will give you the grade you deserve. Her tests are harder than other professors but the final is easy. If you go to class and do the work, it's easy to get an A.

Great Professor! She made the material so easy to understand. She was also funny and easy to listen to. Super understanding. I had a problem with taking one of the exams at the scheduled time and she let me take it a day late (I let her know before hand). With I could have her for calc III. One of the best professors I've had.

She uploads packets of notes that are 'fill in the blank' so that you can keep up during class and listen wo having to worry about writing down EVERYTHING! She will answer questions during class (immediately remembers the students who do!) and encourages office hour visits. She wants you to learn the material and gives every chance to contact her.

I took 151 for the 3rd time wher. 1st time w Nanes & got a D, 2nd time w Dean, got a D. Took it with Tighe, got an A. She makes the material so easy. Quizzes are from lecture notes, Exams from quizzes, Final from exams-study and you'll get an A wher. She seems mean in class but if you see her in 'castle' for help, she is the sweetest person.

Professor Tighe is a very hard grader and the material might be hard for you to understand if you don't go to lecture. She is very fair and open to suggestions. Tests are hard but the large amount of homework and group quizzes definitely prepare you. She is very sarcastic and funny.

Math 152 can be a challenging course for many students. It is especially challenging for those who skipped straight into Math 151 or Math 152.  Tighe gives good lectures (or so I've been told), and the tests are very similar to tests from previous classes. The quizzes are done in groups, and quizzes from previous years are available online.

Ms. Tighe is a fantastic professor, but she expects you to put in the effort to understand the material she presents at lectures. She is extremely helpful if you go to office hours and castle. Her humor is absolutely a plus, and she is very clear cut as to her expectations for the course.

If you want to study really hard and take exams that are not a reflection of her lectures then definitely take her class.  She writes down the procedure of the problem and expects you to write it down. Her handouts are pure laziness on her behalf. She could do a much better job of explaining the material. Nice lady, sucky teacher. NO Ph.d.

She gives printed notes. Exams are harder than the rest of the professors, but she teaches the material very well so you should do fine. Know your algebra and trig. Overall, she made calculus fun for me, I really enjoyed the class.

Her lectures were really clear and on point, one of the best lecturers I've had; she explains things that can be overwhelming in a really simplistic way. She may come of as intimidating, but really cares about her students. Her quizzes are in groups. Exams are tough, but will prepare you for the final. Don't expect this class to be an easy A.

No one has ever explained Calculus in such a simple, easy to understand, and fun way. She speaks in a language that everyone can easily understand and as long as you understand and pay attention the homework, the quizzes and exams are  a piece of cake.

I had Bonny for Math 131 Part 1 and Part 2 (elementary education math  class) This class was not an education class but strictly a math class. She teaches by showing which is the greatest thing a professor can do. She knows math VERY well and knows how to teach it. She has her tangents every now and again but get ready to work in her class.

We don't use calculators because it is all possible to solve without one; unless you are doing the homework because you need to put the exact answer.  She is good teacher, but she makes the quizzes and exams hard.  ALWAYS print out the class material before class, which she sends via email unless you have photographic memory...

AMAZING professor. I had her for MATH151 and 152. Before taking her classes, I HATED calculus, but after calc 1 and calc 2, I left with a love of the subject and a feeling that I actually understood it. Best professor I've ever had.

Mrs. Tighe is a hard teacher, but is also one of the best teachers I've taken. She explains everything clearly. Quizzes are taken in groups. Exams are hard, but if you study hard you can get a B or an A. You will learn a lot in this course. Take her class!!

Very good teacher. Lecture attendance is not mandatory, but highly recommended. Tighe often explains things differently than the text, and her examples usually pop up on the exams. Exams have extra questions, so if you work quickly there is the potential for extra credit. I found weekly quizzes more challenging than the exams. WebAssign homework.

She's a great professor if you're willing to put in the work. She gives 3 exams and a final during a semester and they're somewhat lengthy. Though the exams are all harder than the final, so by the end of the semester it's basically a victory lap.

She is not here to joke around when it comes to Math. She's really nice, really easy to talk to, but she is going to make sure you learn the material better than any other professor. If you want an easy class, don't take her. If you actually want to pass the class knowing the material and get an A on the final take her class.

If you actually do the work and study, easy A. Personally, I am lazy and didn't try too hard. Yet, I will still get a B. Tighe is the best calculus teacher at UMBC; anyone I know agrees with me. She may be the "toughest," but she'll prepare you and you'll be less stressed in the long run. Don't question it: if you're going to take calc, Tighe wins.
She was amazing, and very kind if you went to her office hours for help. One of the best!

One of the best calculus professors you will encounter. Makes a difficult subject very clear and concise. Also keeps the class engaged and has a sense of humor. Excellent professor, I would highly recommend her.
Great teacher, very clear and helpful, quizzes are in groups, and the tests aren't too bad if you go to class and really study the homework and quizzes. Highly recommend for Calc 2

Very helpful teacher, she was intimidating at first but was very nice when I approached her. Her class is tough but if you do all the practice exam/quizzes and go to class you won't have any problem getting an A. Very sassy and funny.

She's the best math professor ever!! Shes willing to help and gives us 5 hours every Friday to do homework with her! She's very clear and really nice. Also gives nice and funny examples to help us understand better. Only thing, goes fast is lecture. But I love her. If you have the opportunity...take her class!!

One of the best teachers out there. She is very helpful and clear in class and cares about your success. Extra credit is available and quizes are in groups with the lowest 3 being dropped and 4 lowest HW's. I also suggest to NOT BUY THE TEXTBOOK because its useless; she provides you with handouts for each lesson that are much more clear helpful

Wow she is simply an amazing teacher. I do not know why she even had some bad comments in the past, she went through a teaching workshop where she improved everything about her class. Her exams and quizzes for 152 are much easier than Brian deans. She answers all questions in class, has great office hours and now offers extra credit in her classes.

She's an excellent teacher - her exams are pretty tough but fair. Classroom is pretty social so it's easy to get into study groups which will help even more. If you take her class over the summer the quizzes are in groups (exams aren't, make sure you know your stuff.) Also, she's super nice.

Tighe is great! She cares about her students unlike any other prof. Calc 1 is definitely hard and it requires a lot of time and effort to succeed, but Tighe is fantastic. She makes it clear exactly what you need to know. Go to lecture, it definitely pays off!

Mrs. Tighe is a great teacher! Calc 1 is not an easy subject but if you go to her for help and really work for it, you should be able to get a good grade. She can be a little rude sometimes but if you work hard, you'll be fine.
I love Professor Tighe.She is always willing to help students and definitely likes to teach calc. Don't show up late to class though because it makes her mad.. all in all I recommend her!

She spends precious class time pointing out those who enter late. She actually STOPS CLASS, therefore limiting her own instruction of the students who are already there. It is unfair to those in class. She spends time telling us how little we know about various topics as opposed to teaching us about said topics. DO NOT TAKE HER CLASS.

Good professor. Kind of sassy, but she's funny. She cares about her students and will help. Her exams were hard in the sense that there were a lot of questions in a limited amount of time. Her exams made the final easy though. I recommend her.

The best math professor that teaches one of the most difficult classes. Calc 2 is brutal, but she does everything she can to help you without watering the material. Go to her weekly study sessions in CASTLE.  They saved my life. If you need more time, she loves helping students during her office hours. She deserves every compliment mentioned here.
A truly wonderful woman who truly cares about her students. I would recommend her to anyone.
Great prof, makes it easier than it has to be,still need to work hard and do well on exams, don't fall behind

I think Bonnie was a great teacher. She is definitely sassy and will call you out if she is in a bad mood and you are texting or "disrupting the class", but I found the lessons really easy to understand. If you are decent at math and attend every class and do the homework, you will be fine. Also we barely used the book, don't buy it.

Probably one of the worst professors Iv'e ever had. Course material wasn't hard, her rude attitude is unbearable and unnecessary. She treats her A+ students much different then everyone else (I'm one). Made the class feel unintelligent by talking down to us for taking MA155 rather then the harder clac. Avoid unless you will be an A+ student.

Shes an above average professor. Going to lectures helps, and she knows her materials really well. Shes funny in class. But sometimes she doesn't very interested in helping student when you tell her your issues.

i love her! i take two class with her and she will help you if your willing to learn and if you let her know who you are. her exams and quizzes are similar to old exams and quizzes and she does post up the old exams and quizzes on BB!

Overall your basically teaching yourself in Math 155. Either you know the material from high school or you dont, if you dont it will be really hard, more than half of her class is failing, while a small percentage is doing good, I would not recommend her as a teacher. She can be very rude and always has a sarcastic comment to say.
LOVE HER!!!!!!! She is amazing in this class and i recommend her no matter what math you have to take - try to get Tighe!!!!

I dont know if its because this is her first semester teaching 155 or if she's just mean but she treats her math 155 students like we're not smart enough to be in 151. She is not very helpful and her quizzes are more like tests. Basically study on your own and you'll pass. Do yourself a favor and take 155 with someone else.

Absolutely not understanding, not willing to help out in relation to personal issues.  Assumes that this is our only class and is unwilling to listen when students have timing conflicts (with a full time job for example).  For the sake of personal sanity, avoid her.

This class is already hard.She was very nice but had a certain way she wanted you to solve problems. The exams were  long and hard to finish. You have to practice alot if you want to finish. She also expects you to read before class so you already know what you go over in class. She left early in the semester due to illness but she was good overall
Mrs Tighe is great if you let her know you

Ms. Tighe is a good teacher in a difficult subject. You pretty much will have to go to lecture and discussion if you want to do well, this stuff is not easy. She does manage to make the stuff fairly clear. Exams and tests can be a little tough, but if you can do well on most of them you will be fine, some of the lowest HWs and quizzes get dropped.

She is the best math teacher I have ever had. The course is a difficult course, but she makes it easier. If you show up to class and do minimal work outside of class besides the homework, you can get an A.

She is very smart and genuinely likes calc. Read the section in the book before going to class. Do ALL the homework (even though she drops 5). Do practice quiz/exams if she gives them. Don't forget to look over your notes before the exam. TAKE GREAT NOTES! I got an A by practicing every old problem, quiz, or exam I could find.

One of the best math teachers at UMBC. As long as you go to class and ask for help when you need it you WILL be fine. She is approachable. Her exams are tough so just beware that this isn't your normal skip catch up class. I would recommend her highly :)

I love Mrs. Tighe! Her exams are pretty tough but her quizzes are certainly manageable in comparison. Although she doesn't curve her exams, she offers several other opportunities for grade inflation. She's intimidating at first, but if you go to her office hours she's super nice and helpful. Very clear and concise, I took Calc 2 just to have her!

I had Raji first but transferred to Tighe and that was such a mistake, kinda. She explains things well. When it comes to exams, it was like I was looking at new material. They really hard. But she missed a few classes and end up leaving in the middle of the semester because she had lymphoma.

i would like her test content to be more challenging and actually have to do with what we learn in class and in the book... btw, the book was useless to me no matter how hard i tried... she was ok but i dont recommend her if you want a good understanding of CALC, esp if youre going to take math in subsequent semesters. mega attitude and not cool :(

lets just say she took the asian out of me. she took my love of math, my straight A streak in math from algebra to pre-calc..AWAY. now thats not right. take gloor (he's a beast) rather than tighe; you wont regret it. i sware you that.

She is a bit overrated. The main goal of her teaching seems to be about solving a bunch of routine calculus problems quickly. The exams are not about a good understanding of calculus either; instead, they test one's ability to do bunch of ugly problems fast. Personally she is very nice, however, I would not recommend her despite all the hype.

I've never understood all of the hype about Mrs. Tighe. Overall, she's an okay teacher. She has an irritating attitude and her exams focus more on algebra than calculus. I earned an A in her class, but I feel like my high school calculus teachers were more efficient and helpful.

Mrs. Tighe's class is pretty hard. She expects you to do your work, study and not slack off. Go to her office hours, she really cares and helps you learn. DO NOT SLACK OFF IN HER CLASS, she knows the people that put effort in her class.

She gives you practice exams and quizzes from last semester with the exact same material that will be on the quiz/exam you are taking. Can't get any easier than that! She does have a bit of an attitude but she's also really nice sometime. She's human so of course she'd have emotions. Duh!

DON'T BELIEVE THE HYPE.If you like learning everything on your own take tighe and don't bother going to class. Wastes 10 min a class talking about non-sense. Only went over examples in reading. Tests are not like homeworks. Good hard calc class with independent thought involved  which I like but the material is glossed over @ best + the book sucks

Overall, she's a good teacher. She could definitely do without the attitude but it's not so bad. She's very clear on what she expects and provides practice exams/quizzes that are very similar to the real deal.

She's a tough professor, but if you do the work (pay attention in class, take notes, homework, study, etc) you'll do well and learn a lot. Also, don't be afraid to go to her for help. She's very willing to aid anyone who asks, and she will usually go over practice problems with you.

BEST MATH PROFESSOR AT UMBC!!!!! She lets you know exactly what is required to know for the exams, gives you plenty of practice exams and quizes, and the problems are similar just with diff numbers. She is very clear, she really cares if you are doing well or not. Just put in half the work she tells you, and guaranteed A!!!!

Very, very, very hard teacher. However, she definitely knows what she's talking about. If you need a good structure and someone to kick your butt in order to learn, shes the one for you. Great teacher, but hard.

I took Math 151 last semester and took this class right after and had a feeling it will be terribly hard course but I just finished and it was easy. Just do all the homework  thoroughly and keep up with A+ on quizzes and the material that she teaches. Reading prior to class helps. Her exams are known to be extremely hard but it's really not.
She is an ok teacher...but she is SO DAMN RUDE. Ive never met someone with as much sarcasm in my life.

Dont' be discouraged in the beginning of the class...she trys to warn people by intimidating them to weed people out. But she is extremely nice and very helpful. Just go to class, listen, and you'll do fine. A lot of people failed the tests, but I think they didn't come to class. Just as many people got A's. Best teacher for calculus

Best teacher I've had, hands down. I hated calculus in high school because I didn't understand it, but the way she explains everything it makes total sense. She's available for  extra office hours to work on problems (which i heard are helpful) and she puts out old quizzes to study from. Seriously take her if you can!

She is the best math teacher ever!  If you have the chance take with her, you will learn so much more than with anyone else.  She makes it so clear what she wants you to be able to do.  Go to her for help, because no one will want to help you more or be able to help you better.  Also the final will be insanely difficult if you haven't had her.

Best math teacher I've had. She is great at explaining hard concepts. She breaks things down and repeats herself so that everyone can understand it. The only downfall is there is alot of online homework that is time consuming. Quiz once a week but if you do the past quizes you'll do good. The homework helps alot to prepare for quizes too

Good teacher as far as TEACHING goes, but shes snarky. If you have a stupid question, she'll make you feel stupid while answering it. Not that I asked any... Her grading system is really fair, but overall shes just kind of rude.

GREAT TEACHER!! At first she seems intimidating but then I just confused that with her bold/sarcastic/funny personality. She always is determined to help you if you ask her until you understand. Great quizzes every week because we can work with a group! She is my favorite teacher so far because it is obvious her passion for teaching!

She was a great teacher. I had her for a whole year of my freshman year. She at first I thought was going to be a little intimidating the 1rst week but then I realized it was just her sarcastic/funny personality. She is willing to help you until you understand. She is really passionate about teaching. GREAT PERSON IN GENERAL ALSO! : )

Took calc in high school, so class was easy for me, but didn't seem too hard. Quizzes were hard, but really helped for exams. Make sure you practice problems. She's very entertaining, good sense of humor. Ask questions, she'll answer and help you out. Loves participation. Some EC in discussion, but STUDY for exams.

I got an A. Bonny Tighe is a very good professor. She makes the lecture material difficult so the exams are much easier. She makes calculus interesting which is hard to do. But you still have to put in work to do well. Make sure you study for the quizzes every Friday.

Her tests had ten questions, each question is half a page of answer.  She curved down and up.  Some people she made 7 into 9 and the others she made 7 into 5.  Chew gum even when lecture.  Lots of homework.  Each homework had at least 30 questions, each question is half a page of answer.  Take her class when you only take one class for a semester
Best math professor/teacher I have ever had

Mrs. Tighe is very helpful and clear. she makes the class not boring and actually keeps everyone's interest in class. her tests are extremely hard but if u go to study sessions she hold every week, it really helps. she gives out old quizes and exams to practice on and you get xtra credit if u do them.  take her over other profs. if u can.

She's funny, but when it comes to the exams, it's a bit tricky.  Actually, it's hard.  Unless you took Calc in high school, good luck studying.  Go to her office hours; she'll help you out (especially when she gives out final grades).

Very interesting teacher, makes learning fun. Although the subject is difficult she goes out of her way to help you. Even has extra study hours where she'll answer any questions you have and even work one on one with you. Other students go to these hours, so eveyone helps each other out. Its very beneficial, wish every teacher did this.
She makes calculus easy, and never hesitates to give one on one help.

AMAZING teacher. very thorough and clear and loves her students. best teacher i have ever had. the class is hard but she provides you with everything you need to get an A. her TA is also the best TA ever. some extra credit is always offered. make sure you go to discussion.

Very good professor.  Gets right to the point with teaching the material, which is VERY helpful.  The course work was hard, but Mrs. Tighe is always available for help. If you have to take Calc II, take it with Mrs. Tighe

I had Prof Tighe for both Calc 1 and 2. And she was awesome through out both. Her class can be difficult but she is always there to help. She can forget things like that she made office hours...but if you remind her and really communicate with her you will have no problem in her class. Go to class, do the homework, and try!

She is a sweet person and really wants to see her students succeed. She presents material clearly and will give diff examples until you understand. She drops a few quizes and homeworks, gives so MANY extra credit opportunities, and gives previous exams/quizes to guide you. Definently one of the BEST TEACHERS i've had here.

She is extremely perky and shows such enthusiasm for calc, that you start to get into it. She explains clearly, and is very helpful if you come for office hours. Posts previous quizes/exams--> if you study those, you'll get an A. She's funny and is the reason that I want a math minor, even though I used to hate math prior to this course.

Textbook not neccesary. There are example tests and quizes online from previous semesters and she makes her current ones exactley the same way (if you understand the practice ones you will pass the actual ones) There is homeowork on mathzone every week. Overall a very good teacher she has alot of energy and a firey personality. (love the red hair)

Excellent lecturer.  She's humorous, upbeat, helpful and expects you to put forth effort.  She is more than happy to help her students in anyway possible such as holding extra help sessions in addition to her office hours.

Nice lady. Loves to help and answer questions. Tests are very long, but she likes to give partial credit. Not too much hwk, and gives group quizzes. I have previously taken Song for another class and I strongly recommend her over Song! SHE'S THE BEST CALC TEACHER AT UMBC

Almost always late to class. Doesnt clearly explain what a section is about -just does lots of easy examples and expects you to catch on. Very helpful during her office hours if you go to them. Posts practice exams- but often makes mistakes in answer key (and when doing examples) Don't take Tighe's class if you dont have all your free time for math

Starting Spring '08, the textbook will be changed. However she was quite easy for Calc 2, there were plenty old exams, quizzes, finals posted on blackboard and if you studied from them you are guaranteed an A. However, now that the book has changed, I doubt she'll post anything online, just like Calc 1.
she's horrible, could care less about her students. she's lazy and pretends to care. average class grade is a D.
She really knows how to teach the subject.  Great at clarifying the hard stuff, while reinforcing the concepts we need to succeed.  Will definitely have her in Calc II!
she doesn't even give practice quizzes anymore..her quizzes are extremely hard. she's tough and seems to NOT care anymore.
BEST TEACHER EVER! You really learn a ton in her class, and as long as you do homework and review her old tests and quizzes, its almost impossible to fail. Good sense of humor as well
My favorite professor at UMBC.  She gave me extra credit for writing the Integral Test the way Mr. T. would.  You have to work hard, but quizzes and tests are related to homework.
She is the best teacher I've never had. If you plan to take calc2 don't hesitate take her
No Comments

i love her to death! she's the best teacher ever! she's so helpful and actually makes sure that students understand the material well and she gives out old exams online so you can memorize all the steps and answers for the exams and quizzes, that's how i got As on all my exams

By far the best i have had. She gives a lot of homework but its only because she wants you to get a lot of practice so that you can do well- calculus II is not easy and the more problems you do the better you become. She drops some quizzes and homework, and is very nice about bad exams (i.e. she gives extra credit).

Calc is hard, she makes it look easy but don't be fooled because it's still hard. Following in-class examples and going over her old exams and quizzes are helpful. Lots of homework. Discussion was useless due to the TA there.

Best math teacher I've ever had. I had never taken Calculus before and I aced out of the final exam. She makes students actually like Calculus. Of course it's a hard subject, but her lectures are great and if you go to class, do the homework, and do the practice quizzes, you can succeed at Calculus.
hes the best teacher ever. i hate math and she made me love it. i highly recommend her. justa side note. dont ever be late for class coz she creates a scene if u walk in wait. love her, shes the best

Great calculus teacher. I took AP calc in HS and got nothing but C's during the whole year (even though I deserved lower). After taking the class with Tighe, everything became much clearer. Know your algebra, do your hw, get help, that's all you really need to do to get an A. If you're bad at math, it'll be a struggle.

Don't get on her bad side.  I actually got a C in the class, but lemme let you in on a little secret.  If you show up to her office hours, and get help every time she has her office open...she'll raise your grade dramatically.  My friend and I were both gettng C's...but since he went to get "help"...his C magically turned into an A.

This was my first time taking calculus and I'm SO glad it was with Mrs. Tighe. She's really really nice, and pretty funny about math. She tries hard to make sure everybody understands what's going on, and has review sessions on the weekends before our exams. Just try and come to class and you'll be fine.

Dr. Tighe has been a blessing to my life.  I entered the class nervous and fearful that I would have to drop.  However, I have excelled beyond my wildest dreams as a result of Dr. Tighe's teaching method. She sincerely cares about her students and resemebles a gentle auntie or nanny.  Make sure you come to class early, she hates late students.

A very motherly professor but full of tough love.  You have to be a self-starter to do well, this isn't a memorization course AT ALL. Know the material inside and out. She gives lots of homework but also long office hours. Be warned, exams are tricky, always from that one problem you skipped on the homework.  So study HARD and you will do well.
Good teacher, but has very hard exams.  However, you'll come out of the class knowing the material very well.

Mrs. Tighe does not seem to buy the idea that some people really are bad at math. My brain does not work that way and her tests are too freaking long for someone like me to do in a hour. She erases the examples from the board before I can finish copying them down. She chews loudly during our tests. All I can do is memorize in her class, not learn.

Mrs. Tighe is the best math teacher I have ever had! She makes a boring subject more bearable, she is also very helpful. She is very upbeat and has the best TAs. I lived in her office, I would sit off to the side and do homework and when I had a question she was right there to help. Mrs. Tighe is the best and I wouldn't take calc with anyone else!

Seems to expect that you already know the material. Assigns homework that seemingly has nothing to do with what she lectures about. I got A's in math before this class; had to drop it because I wasn't even sure I could pull off a C.

BEST MATH teacher ever. I paid $1000 out of MY pocket to take her calc 2 class over the summer. Calc is not easy but when teacher is nice and is willing to help u every step of the way...its much better. DO NOT take calc with anyone else...Tighe for Calc 1 and 2....and any other subject she teaches :)
Average Teacher. She explains everything very clearly; however, she doesn't seem to helpful when you ask a question. Her quizzes are actually sort of difficult as well as her test.
I can't stand her....she's rude and sarcastic.  The class isn't that hard but the bs homework is a waste of time as it has nothing to do with quizzes.
Dr. Capoor is much better. I cant understand this lady.
I had Mrs. Tighe years ago and still remember sitting in her class, actually understanding calculus.  WOOHOO.  She is, like everyone else is saying, the epitome of an excellent teacher.

Wow, I totally disagree with all the reviews. I actually LOVE math, never had any problems with it before, but Prof. Tighe is just a HORRIBLE professor. From the very first day she acts as if you already know all the material and she's just there to review. She's very rude when you try to ask her a question after class and not helpful at all.AVOID!
best teacher at umbc

Best.Teacher.EVER. I had her for both Calc I and II and I am certain that you will not be able to find a better teacher. Her class is entertaining, clear, and casual. Very lenient when it comes to grading and class structure. For Calc II i had a 88%, not only did she give me the A, but I was also exempt from the final. TAKE THIS TEACHER!!!!
All that can be said is she's nothing less than the best.

Ms. Tigh is one of the best in her profession. She is the epitome of what a professor should be. Her method of teaching is very understandable and easy which is further complimented by her warm and approachable personality. She brings out the best in her students as long as they do their part.

She's hilarious, interesting, easy to talk to, explains clearly, and will let you know that you have to be absolutley stupid to not understand that for Calculus you have to study a little bit. She is definitley one of the best teachers I ever had.

She is a really great professor. She is really helpful and witty which makes taking Calculus extremely easy. She is great later on with recommendations and with syce your grade if she knows that you try really hard. Work really hard to get an A and there is no final!!!!

My favorite teacher. She is always there to help anyone who wants it and she will give your grade a boost if you improve in the class. The material is hard to understand no matter who you take, but Mrs. Tighe is the best person to take it with. Highly recommend for any class you can get with her.
Best teacher at UMBC...helps you out and understands what it's like to be a college student.  If you take the class with anyone else you're crazy.
Do not take anyone but Tighe for 151 or 152, she's the best!
I loved Ms.Tighe!!! She was an excellent professor and was a huge help.
Ms. Tighe is the sweetest professor, and very helpful!!! She's always in her office to help or just chat. I would definately recommend her to anyone!!!
great teacher, makes funny jokes to strike interest of class and makes sure that everyone understood the material and was ready for exams

Mrs. Tighe is the best teacher I have ever had.  She is extremely helpful and caring.  She welcomes all her students to her office at any time (not just office hours) for help or to chat.  And she always has candy for you!  Great teacher and person!

This is a pretty easy class...just pay attention and do ALL the problems. The exams are pretty easy as long as you pay attention in class..the only hard part of this class was the final..everything was on the final and its hard..but if you get A's on all the exams you dont need to take the final.
Great teacher! Alot of work though, including weekly quizes and homework assignments.  However, she is an understanding teacher and gives you the grade you deserve.

Tighe is one of the best professors i've ever had. She is clear, helpfull, and very funny. She also is every lax, she almost always lets us out of class 10 to 15 minutes early. Great teacher, highly recommend!
Good teacher, funny, just come to class everyday, otherwise she will know who skips, but shes very helpful and tries to make the class interesting.
No matter how bad you are at math, if you try and come to class (she'll know) there is now way you won't at least get a B. She'll give you an A if you get at least 87 overall.
Great teacher! Class is a little hard, but she tries hard to help you understand it. The best teacher I have ever had!
Awesome professor.  The class is real hard but she does her best to help everyone through it.
She is awesome with help and extra study sessions!
Great Prof. Very Clear, very cool.
GREAT professor. Knowledgable and informative. A++ would take again.
Cool and fun teacher, and easy to work with.
great teacher
great professor! always helps and makes calc easy.
great teacher, really prepares you to go ahead, a lot of hw and often quizzes u
Nicest person you'll ever meet. If you really try, she will not give up on you!
The best math professor I've ever had!
Stupid course, go to lecture, it helps. I didn't . . .
Good person.  Hard course. Puts sample exams on web! Take her!
Will help one to succeed in life realistically

The best CS professor at UMBC, hands down. He is incredibly passionate about the field and makes lectures interesting with relevant facts and history of the industry. He puts learning first and grades second. If you put in the effort to learn and try your hardest, you will get an A. This was his actual policy. Incredible energy when lecturing.
I cannot recommend Burkhardt enough. UMBC needs to hire more professors like him! He's an amazing lecturer. This class is hard. That being said, do your homework and study hard!

This is a difficult class and you will struggle in it. However, the professor is quite good at lecturing and makes the material very understandable. Be prepared to spend some time on the homeworks as they are quite involved. The class is heavily weighted towards tests and even though they are straightforward, you need to be familiar with material.

Hardest Compsci class no matter who teaches it (Coming from someone who took 313, 331, 341, 421, and 449), however the curve he gives is high. Lectures are helpful for the basis of topics, but you should really read the textbook for the chapters needed if you want an A. I got lucky to get a B because of the curve. Exams worth a LOT compared to hw.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This class is not easy no matter who teachers but he is very knowledgeable in all the courses he instructs. Always encourages students to try, don't give up, and not to worry about their grade. Focus on learning. That definitely allowed me to focus more on the subject. Would 100% take again and again.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Best professor I have ever had. I feel like a lot of his low ratings are because the class itself is difficult. If you ask questions, stay focused in class, you will succeed in this course, I highly recommend Burkhardt because I learned so much with him. You won't have enough time to finish exams. Pretty he does this so people can't cheat. Respect.

He writes a lot but like if you just write some stuff down on your notes and then like write down some answers on the hw and tests then you'll be fine. i put like no effort in lmao and i still passed despite basically failing all the hw and tests thanks to how he curves the grades. as long as you show up for class and write something down u gucci

just show up lol. with how he is you can just like "do" the hw and quizzes and still pass with how he curves the grade. easiest class i have ever taken thanks to that. long as you show up and just like write something down on your hw and tests you'll be fine.

Having him as a professor has been so nice. Stuff has been tough at home with all the covid stuff but he's given us 3 hours on exams including the final and if you miss quizzes as long as you email him about it he'll let you take them! With how he curved all the grading none of us in the class failed.

He puts a lot of information into his lectures but if you dont understand it then he will happily meet with you during office hours and explain stuff step by step for hours until you understand. He also curves his grading a lot so even if you dont do well on quizzes and exams its actually very hard to get a failing grade for the class

Even if you dont do well on quizzes and exams as long as you show up and do the homework and classwork you will pass. Its because of the way he grades on a curve making it actually EXTREMELY difficult to fail his class. The other professors are not so kind with the grading. So his class is much easier even if he does write a lot on the board.

Material was presented in a inefficient way. Spend a majority of the time writing notes on the board, rather then explaining. Quizzes have a low class avg 40%. But at the end the curve was 25%> got you a C, 48%> B, 73%> A. Nobody got below a C in my class (according to his email). Overall if you see him writing notes on the board, just drop.

DO NOT TAKE

reviews.comment: i loved her, she was very chill & understanding. she does give extensions on papers & grades things pretty late. exams were online in class & didn't take the whole class.

I don't get why so many people dislike Dr. Burns, she is an amazing professor. We had three essays and two exams (both exams were online, and we had no class that day). Make sure to take notes on what she says because they're helpful for the exams. I typed almost everything she said, took advantage of my notes, and got A's on both my exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Prof. Burns is a great person! She responds within a day to emails and is very caring if you are sick or cannot attend a class. 3 essays, 2 exams, tough grading for both but as long as you try you'll get a B- (all I got and put minimum effort).

She teaches higher levels of English, so if you're taking ENG100 beware. There're 3 essays and 2 exams that determine your grade and it's difficult to calculate, she doesn't use BB, she emails you your grades. Lectures are boring/unnecessary, attendance is taken but isn't clear if it matters. She's very picky abt grammar, she loves semi-colons...
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is very friendly and approachable. She does talk for long periods of her lecture and doesnt require much from students in regards to talking in class. Show up to classes and just completed the essays and you should pass. If you want an A, just reread over your papers and edit before you submit and there shouldnt be any reason you dont get one.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: In the modern era, grades or assignments are online. But this professor has another professor that turns in the graded work online at the end of the semester. Most of the material is submitted to her email. She often loses her student assignments as well grades exceptionally late. Often extend her class periods with discussions with nonsense.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The whole class is just watching old films like Hitchcock, Casablanca, etc. writing 3 papers analyzing these films, open to any topic generally. 2 tests where u define film-related terms and put them in context of the class work. As for Burns, she grades heavy on grammar. The class and the professor - not hard but not interesting at all.

9 hours of mandatory synchronous class a week? in the middle of a pandemic? The work itself isn't too hard but there's just so much of it, she constantly adds new assignments without warning and is unclear about due dates. Also be warned 391 is basically a film class, there's no reading but you'll need to research old movies a lot on your own.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--So many papers

reviews.comment: Great teacher definitely take the class
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She is a very sweet professor. About 4 writings. Maybe 2 online "exams", very easy. Very chill classes. Readings, there are some. Most of the writings are okay, except for one. No final. 5-6 page papers.

Mrs Burns is nice and helpful, but her class is very uninteresting and monotone. She is very unclear about the assignments and their due dates, and it is hard to know what she expects from a paper. The worst are the readings assigned with those papers: very old, long, and uninteresting articles. This could have been an online class
Nice person who cares about her students, but lectures are long and very dry. Assigns a lot of homework.
Dr Burns was a great english professor she cares about her students and wants them to improve their writing

I liked her much more by the end of the semester than at the beginning. She is so helpful if only you ask for help and ask questions in class. She responds to emails very quickly and takes a big interest in your writing. Just make sure you turn things in on time and proof read at least once. She is very nice.
Easy class but VERY boring. Several papers and one in class assignment each week

Nicest woman ever! Seems extremely passionate about English but is extremely hard on grading. I'm currently in her English 100 class and it is very difficult to get a good grade on her paper assignments (All C's), but she is really nice overall.
Love her!

5 essays heavily graded on grammar, but most of the work in class are handouts focused on improving grammar.  Very writing intensive but she's always willing to give you help.  If you like to write, it will be easy.  If not, still an easy A if you proofread and don't procrastinate.
If you have a chance, take Margie's classes because she is really nice, and will go off on stories for hours.  You will not have to do that much work...

Will talk about everythng under the sun, and while most of what she says is somewhat related to the course material, don't expect her to help you with writing past teh grammatical level. Grades papers SOLELY on grammar. Gives far too many handouts. Tests are on definitions glossed over in class only. Too much Shakespeare for a class on writing.

I had to drop out of her class because she was literally failing me. You had to write 5 essays and she was big on grammer. If you had a lot of mistakes you got a c and lower. You got a good grade on your essays if she found it interesting; she didnt care about structure much. Also felt she was kinda bias. I would never take her again.

TAKE NOTES ON ANYTHING SHE LECTURES ON because they will be covered on her definition based midterm.  PROOFREAD YOUR ESSAYS! (5 for the course)  If you have a large amount of simple grammatical mistakes, don't expect a good grade.  She's a good teacher and brings out interesting points about various topics.  Don't expect an A with no effort.

Way to many papers to write, which were completely irrelevant to anything we were learning.  At one point we had 3 different assignments and papers to write at a time.  She grades basically upon grammar.  Mid-term and Final exam were based upon random words that needed to be defined from the articles.

Her class is iffy. I got straight B's on her papers. The papers are pretty easy but check your grammar or she'll hate you. The midterm and final are based on ONLY vocabulary. I failed both the midterm and final but my paper grades pushed up my final grade to a B. Weird. She IS boring and waking up for her class was hell.. but you can pass.

The papers for the most part are pretty easy, and except for a couple of them you can pretty much write on whatever subject you want. That midterm hit hard though, in a class with no text book or lecture schedule, a definition only test is really hard to study for. Now I just write down definition she gives out. Hopefully I'll do better on the fina

Although you can pass this class, it seems as if all the wrong parts of this class are emphasized. For instance, she pays more attention to grammar than the topic of a paper. Not a very appealing professor, and combined with an early lecture time, it gets very tedious. If you miss a class, the videos are available at the library.

I got an A in the class and thought she graded really easy... She teared up papers with basic, and I mean basic, grammar issues but so long as your paper was interesting to read she was nice.  I enjoyed her lectures she obviously knew a lot about the subjects covered. The book is totally boring.

I found this class to be boring, but I went so that I could be counted for in class and to get a heads-up on assignments.  You need to ask if there were any assignments given out if you were absent.  She isn't that bad of a teacher, but she's not very entertaining either.  The most entertainment I got were from some of the films we watched.

Holy crap, she is probably the worst teacher ever. Her grading is down right terrible. First paper we did, I was given an "F" because I had a few grammatical errors (SIX). Second paper I was given a B with MORE grammatical errors. She has a terrible grading style. Her lectures are probably the worst out of it all. SO BORING
No Comments

Probably the worst professor I've ever had.  Instead of actually grading papers, she edits your grammar and says nothing about the actual content.  If it weren't for her tangents, each class would be about 20 minutes long.  I learned nothing in what I thought would be an interesting course.  AVOID HER LIKE THE PLAGUE!!!

Rude to me, lost one of my essays. The exams were basically vocabulary tests. We spent most of the class talking about the novel we were reading and showing us nature videos (wtf). I wouldn't recommend her.

Take her during the summer. The papers are a week apart, but this means there's less on the midterm, and then NO FINAL. easy, easy A. she rambles and can be terribly boring but she's nice, and the class is very, very easy.

It was a composition class right?  Well I felt like I was in a Literature class when midterms and exams came around.  The papers were not difficult, but I thought she was a bit too picky considering she really didn't teach the class any composition.  A nice lady, but avoid her if you can.

WORST EXPERIENCE EVER.  I'm a junior, ive seen my share of bad profs, but this woman is monumentally awful.  Rambles about the library of congress all semester long, lousy unclear exams, AVOID HER AT ALL COSTS!  EVIL!
Boring class, and the papers are on the most boring topics.  Not hard though.

The papers we had to write were dumb, although she wasn't tough on grading them.  The midterm was very stupid-mostly on things completely irrevelant to writing. In fact, we hardly learned anything about composition.  Instead we learned a lot about literature.  Which defeats the purpose of the class.

6 essays, midterm, and final. essays are reasonable and she does not grade harsh. i got B's. the midterm i got an F - she didnt explain at all what was on the midterm/final (format sucks). she is actually really nice. sometimes classes are really easy. usually found myself sleeping in 9am classes.
She was unclear, unprecise and her assignments taught me only to despise Composition.  Assignments did nothing to teach the course.

whoa, i dont kno what theyre talkin about, but i got an A in the class and i didnt show up half the time.she takes attendance but it doesnt count for grade.final and midterm can be typed in class so its easy(since u can use the net). i got As/Bs on papers

I took a risky chance for having her as my english teacher. Because of her, I might have to take english over again in my sophomore year!!! She was such a horrible teacher with horrible paper assignments. i hate her teaching so much! DON'T SIGN UP FOR HER

Yeah.... she is a complete idiot.  The only redeeming fact about being an idiot is that she has a grading scale for the papers that doesn't make sense.  I got a better grade on an essay I know I did worse on.  Easy B for the class.

WORST teacher anyone could possibly have for freshman english...she goes off on tangents and gives the worst assignments...for one essay, we were supposed to relate something in a documentary on animals that we watched to computer technology! WTF?&#63

Was quite an awful experience for me. Not a math person so I was constantly struggling and his lectures were so rushed and unclear. I don't really love being negative like this, but if he does teach again, this is a warning. Take another. I've had a easier time in higher levels of math. Was constantly with groups and tutor to get a passing grade.

A laid back teacher who wants to see you succeed. Do the homeworks and assignments or you'll most likely struggle in this class. A great guy, going to his office hours are a must if you are struggling.

Easy class as it was algebra but I lost my skills after learning it so many years ago. With him, I quickly relearned the math and the quizzes were a breeze. A very chill and nice professor. Definitely would take any class if he was the professor!
Best math professor ever. Thanks for helping me realize I love math!
Office hours were lit, but I almost failed the course. Not because he's a bad prof but I just a lot suck at math. He's a pokemon lover so I guess that compensates for that.

Dr.Bustos just doesn't know how to teach to put it plainly. There were 3 exams that were worth 20%, then a 4th exam worth 30%. The last 10% was participation/attendance which is based on the questions you ask in class and answers (he deems if they are good enough for points), ask him before but I just wrote questions and answers on paper b4 class.

I think Professor Bustos gets a bad rap. This class is conceptually hard (as is any bio class) but he's very lenient and nice. The grading = 4 exams and 10% participation. There is an automatic curve (85+ is an A). Tests are open note and participation is easy just talk and show up. He is very smart. Even though this class is hard I recommend!!
yeah he's terrible

Dr. Bustos's lecture notes were helpful but I found them too concise. So for each lesson, I took my own detailed notes using Lehninger's (I personally highly recommend utilizing the textbook). He is not the most easygoing or approachable professors out there but, he is an expertise in the field and there certainly is a lot to be learned from him.

Class didn't have a real textbook. Instead, prof wrote his own summary text. Worst thing I've ever read. Graphs and formulas are given no context, topics aren't explained with any depth. I brought these issues to him, he has the gall to tell me our generation "doesnt have the attention span" for textbooks. What does he think other classes give us??

Literally the worst. I'm a senior w/ a 4.0 and I loved chem & bio. One week into his class, I'm crying at my desk, surrounded by bio & chem notes from previous semesters and understanding nothing. Spent like 20 hours one week just trying to understand his review material, and he had the audacity to tell me I just wasn't trying hard enough. RUN!

He sets you up to fail then blames you when you do. Lectures have absolutely no clarity, the "textbook" is a crappy sparknotes-esque summary that doesn't explain anything. He puts things on tests that have never been taught! Has an insane curve (42% grade is a C) bc otherwise nobody would pass. Doesn't listen to student concerns. Feeser is better.

Professor Bustos was the worst prof. ever. He is also a very bad man to his students, often lashing out against them. He picks favorites and knows he can't be fired so uses inane methods to run his class. Nothing on the lecture material was on his exams. He had to curve because of how understandably poor his students were doing. Avoid al all cost

Not worth your time if you have a choice. Content from lecture is not on the tests - 4 tests are 72% of your grade. Goes on tangents bc he thinks he's funny, calls random people out to answer questions by jabbing the mic in their faces. Doesnt take criticism and says he can't get fired bc of tenure, people only pass his class bc he curves 20%.

He just reads the packets of lectures, wldnt've complained if it contained all we needed to know for exams(which r hard)(72%). Participation(10%) is on this website that is annoying but not hard(weekly). Mini essays(18%) not hard, annoying bc he writes smtn and tells you to write it a diff way. Learned nothing in this class, not for lack of trying.

Dr. Bustos is the worst professor Ive had at UMBC. Not because his class is hard, but because he is an awful man. He curses at his students and made participation hard for no reason. He yelled at us and has a small precious ego. Students learned nothing. Do not take a class with him, you will regret it.

I hated this class. Exams were hard but participation was harder. He wanted 105 students to participate and each student needs to say different things. If you say the same thing, It won't count towards your participation like what. Hated when people exploded the chat or complained about participation. Would never listen to us-always yelled at us.

I have never been so frustrated with a professor in my three years of college. This class is just a waste of my time. 1 of the worst profs Ive ever had & Im a senior. Extremely condescending. Always said to read the book, but tests were 100% from tests banks (textbook was useless). Material is hard, but he's accessible in office hours and really does care for his students success in the class. If you're confused, don't fall behind, seek help. The textbook helps a lot too.

Dr. Bustos truly cares about his students. He presents the lecture in a style that makes difficult material easy to master. Lecture isn't mandatory, but it really helps. Most of the exam questions are from material covered in lecture. Ignore the negative reviews as those 5 negative reviews likely represent the only unhappy students out of 200.

Any of the reviews before Spring 2018 can be disregarded. Bustos has ultimately changed for the worse by creating unfair quiz policies and showing little to no interest in the course as he solely lectured from the textbook and did not write his exams. He's stubborn and not open to any constructive criticism. Hopefully, he changes next semester.

reviews.comment: Does not write his own exams and does not include anything from lecture. He changes how he teaches the course throughout the semester so hes kinda unpredictable. He will argue with you if he believes he is right even if its about asking for clarification.

reviews.comment: Teaches concepts, tests for trivia. reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: It is a hard course so he understands students cannot memorize all the pathways but you have to try. The fact that he is funny makes the class a little less difficult and best part is his point base grading. If you show up in class as well as get close to the border points say between a C and B, he'll remember you&give you that B. pretty generous!

Dr. Bustos is a very good professor. Though he is very knowledgeable of the topic, he doesn't try to treat students like fellow biochemists. Instead, he makes it very simple for us, probably the simplest it can get. He is not detail oriented and doesn't make you cram the whole book. Also, he actually is funny. Take him, you won't regret.

Bustos liked some more than others. The syllabus was never finished. Class consisted of him going over science articles and randomly calling on students to answer questions. 4 short response/essay exams based off of the articles that were discussed in class, 3 of which were online. Most people got B's. You'd need a B avg on the exams to get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. Bustos may not be the most interesting professor to listen to, I agree and even he himself agrees. Of course, Biochemistry is not an easy course, but he certainly does make it easier with his grading curriculum,make sure to be avg

reviews.comment: You CANNOT find any biochemistry professor better than Dr. Bustos. If you don't get A in his class, I'm sorry but you should quit studying, because he makes it very easy to get A.
He is a great professor

Bustos is a mediocre professor at best, just reads off the slides and doesn't make too much of an attempt to make the class interesting. Although a pleasant guy, he's not very approachable outside of class and is horrendous with replying to email. Finally, his grading system of 68% for an A is absurd, but nonetheless helpful to many students.
His point based grading system is a blessing! Thank you Bustos!
Bustos is a really kind and funny professor. His lectures are long but in the spring he gives breaks, and that always gets me back to focus.

Apart from his fun and friendly character, Dr. Bustos is a very good lecturer and he only asks about topics he has covered in class. There are five exams, each worth 35 points, you could take all and every point will count, but u could as well skip one and still get A. As long as you keep a C or a B in all exams, you get A overall. Amazing!!!!!!!!!

Dr. Bustos is extremely unhelpful.  I have visited him several times at his office to ask questions about the class and he does not want to help you at all.  He is very rude and unprofessional.  I don't even know why he is a professor if he does not want to help students.  I just stopped going to lecture and read the textbook instead.  Avoid him!

NO HW, No Quizes only 5 tests. Very hard. worst teacher i have had. Going to the lecture does not help. reading the book is soo much better than hearing him. he start a new sentence in the mid of the one he is telling and you get lost. doesnt explain clearly. not recommended unless u are willing to self study. I am serious!

He has changed a lot. Dr. Bustos loves teaching and helping students. Yes it is hard but thats because biochem is hard and requires a lot of self-studying. He is absolutely hilarious and makes lectures very interesting. I highly recommend taking his class but you need to study. He read his comments from previous semesters and adjusted to correct

Prof. Bustos is a nice professor. Biochem is difficult, just make sure you go through his ppt and also follow his guide to study, you will B easily. For those who wants to get A, you need to put more time to understand and remember more details about these cycles...

I have no idea about how his lectures were because I always snoozed in class(early 8 AM class!). I am here to tell you how I succeeded in his course. 1st, I read all the assigned chapters myself. 2nd, I answered the study guides he has distributed. I got a B+, almost an A, but hey, I passed. I can't say much about him, I never interacted with him.

He is terrible. The worst professor I have ever come across. He was never prepared for class and didn't teach at all. He doesn't know his materials and he is rude and obnoxious. DO NOT TAKE ANY CLASSES TAUGHT BY THIS PROFESSOR

Barely prepared for class, and not good at consistently grading exams or getting back to you if you have questions. Would rather fraternize with the students than teach effectively. Inflexible on deadlines without reason.

BIOCHEM- he's a nice person, and very helpful. He wants his students to do well, just attend class and study his slides. His slides are clear and he is clear on his exams as well. Biochem is hard, period, but he made it so much easier.
Dr Bustos is very helpful. He knows his stuff, so classes are fun and interesting. I hope he is around for a long time.

He is EXTREMELY rude and mean. He tricked the class for one exam, by telling us the wrong materials that would be on the exam ( the class average for that exam was 40 %). He NEVER replied back to my emails, when I asked him for help. He definitely had favorites. He knew very little about the material taught, but would  grade like he was a genius at
He is my advisor. He is so rude he made me cry.

A pleasant man. An all around lazy, rude professor. Hasn't written a new exam in 10 years, and so his lectures and exams don't always match up. He doesn't let students review exams.The last two weeks are group presentations. Has trouble communcating questions to students. Def plays favorites, so always say a nice "hello" to him;)

Bustos is an interesting guy. I had him for Biochem a few years ago and he wasn't a terrific teacher, but there are plenty of stories about him that you can get from people in the know. Ask anyone in the department about the "fiance" he once brought to a dept. Christmas party, for instance. Fair teacher, odd character.

I would have to say, he was one of the better teacher of bio that I have had...His first two exams were clear, the third and fourth exam have alot of ambiguity...or may be I didn't study enough. But you have to read alot by yourself. AND NEVER TAKE A HYBRID CLASS!
He is a very good teacher. He loves the stuff so it makes the class fun. He is very helpful in and out of class. He won't fail you, he would just ask you to drop the class nicely :)

He reads straight from the power point. To pass this class you must learn it ALL on your own and memorize it ALL. He is very rude to students, he insults most of them. He can't teach at all. Our 1st test was the Mon. after Thanksgiving- 12 multiple choice on 15 chapters! Our 2nd test was 2 weeks later (the final) 80 multiple choice.

Very bad professor. Doesn't teach anything. Tests things that weren't stressed in class. Must learn on your own to pass this course, or get anything out of it. Also, doubts about whether he even graded the final exam (the entire class guessed on most of it

This man reads off power point slides, you learn nothing in class. You must memeorize EVERYTHING. There are never any existing back exams. He is so rude to students, telling them they're stupid. You're afraid to ask questions in class.

He taught us about Latin America and it's cultures since the beginning to present time. We did two presentations. 1st was a country of Latin America and brief information. 2nd on a Latin American country and a specific topic. We had two essays. We did voice threads about each week's topics. Lot's of readings. A final exam. He is amazing and caring.
