He was really chill overall and just a really good professor! Entire class was asynch. and you could complete assignments on your own time (aside from the discussions where you had to respond to others and the live chats, where you talk abt your music selection on bb collaborate). Overall really easy class as long as you read the textbook!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: This class is fully online with posted lectures and readings. The we would only meet when we had to discuss the music of our choice based on the criteria he gave us. I love this class because it was very easy to grasp the concepts as long as you read the book. There was a bit of a memory aspect but everything is in the book. 10/10 would recommend.

He's really a chill guy. Just try to participate in class because that determines how fun it will be. Your grade consists of 6 pretty lax quizzes, and he offers a good deal of extra credit points. Definitely study though because sometimes questions are on small details in the readings. Overall fun class and kept my interest.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I didn't end up using the textbook even though it seemed required, you can just find an older edition online. He answers to emails timely and is understanding/stays true to his words. Just take notes on the video lectures, about 5 pages of notes in 2-3 hours is enough to basically ace each quiz (there's 5 of them). Good winter/summer class choice.
I actually find music theory relatively difficult but online it's pretty doable

As expected of an online class, it's easy and easy to navigate however, I feel like the lectures and the textbooks weren't as much help in understanding the hw. Thankfully, the exams looked exactly like the HW so it wasn't as bad but I felt as if I didn't learn as much. The professor was chill though and engaging enough!

Super easy A&H upper-level credit. Took it over the summer. Dr. Crossland is so chill and fun, and you learn so much about the Beatles. Good amount of reading, but it has the material covered on the quizzes. 4 quizzes (easy), 4 discussion posts, 2 song analysis (5 min presentation over a Beatles song). Totally worth taking!
Fun class. Culturally relevant. Chill teacher. The quizzes were super specific, so be sure to read the textbook.
Very easy winter AH credit. You get to talk about some music you like and quizzes are right from the asynchronous lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Accessible outside class--Respected

reviews.comment: Nice dude. Easy going guy teaching an easy class. He's kinda boring though. The other reviews lead me to believe it would have been a fun class. Lets you out early.

Easiest class I've taken at UMBC. 4 weeks all online and only about 5 hours of work a week. I know all about The Beatles know and had a blast taking the class with him. If you put in the slightest bit of effort you'll get an A. He's also super cool and shares personal stories which are really interesting. Overall happiest a class has ever made me.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: One of the nicest professors I had. He is an easy grader, and wants you to get a good grade. The exams had a word box and had a lot of extra credit. You do need to at least skim the text/attend class to know the exam material. It would help if you are familiar with the music. One partner project, which was an easy A. Would recommend.

He is so hilarious because he has such a dry sense of humor. If you aren't familiar with anything music related and would like to learn, this is the class for you. You may feel a bit overwhelmed during class but overall this class teaches you a lot. Tests are veryyyyyy fair. DO THE HOMEWORK. Fun project at the end of the semester. Attend class!
Very easy going.
Easy A. Do the easy few assignments and keep up with the discussion board posts and live chats and you can get an A easily. 100% take to boost GPA.

Very nice guy, kind of passive. If you don't have previous experience with music, class attendance is a must. A few pages of hw every class, nothing terrible. Fair/ easy grader. Easy A if you put the effort in. Easy B without any effort.

Doesn't ever post anything on blackboard but he does give back exams. As long as you memorize the songs and get all the extra credit you will get at least a B. He seems like a nice guy. take this class if you want an A

I see students here saying Paul Comitz should be fired, and I 100% agree. He's rude, unhelpful, and dismissive, and acts like he doesn't care. He just reads off slides, gets annoyed when asked questions, and expects us to already know everything which defeats the purpose of taking the class. Very unprofessional. Seriously, avoid at all costs.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Plz Avoid this class if you can. Paul Comitz is rude, dismissive, and reads straight from the slides. Asks are met with frustration, and he often cuts students off. Grading is harsh, and the environment is unwelcoming. One of the worst teaching experiences I've had. He's makin UMBC IT Dep. image look bad and for that Paul Comitz shud b FIRED !!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Tbh idk who made him Prof. he don't deserve this job. Shows up late, reads from slides, never returns grades. Gets annoyed if you ask for help. I met him in person few times, I felt like I was bothering him by being in class. Just don't take him. I met him in person few times, Very Very Rude man. Paul Comitz is By far the WORST person / Instructor.

reviews.comment: Always has an attitude in class. Rude when u ask questions, never replies to emails, and explains things poorly. Class is disorganized and he acts like helping students is a burden. Do yourself a favor never take this prof. Avoid at all costs.

reviews.comment: I've had a Terrible experience. Nvr reply to emails, gets MAD when u ask questions, and talks down to students. He is very very RUDE, He's by far the worst instructors I've had, Idk who hired this man as a Prof. Paul shud and NEEDS to b FIRED!!. Not just worst Prof, but worst person as well. i met him in person ngl. Pls avoid this man if possible.
