There was a service-learning component of the class, so she built in days into the schedule where there was no class to make up for the time. Overall, very easy.

I love Prof. MacDougall. She's very sweet and laid back. Her expectations for the class are clear and simple so it isn't hard to follow. You're expected to read only a few novels and write a few papers, not a whole lot. I still send her copies of my papers for other courses so that she can edit them even though she isn't my professor anymore.
Very calm, nice, and understanding lady. Class was not overwhelming or hard. Few readings, mostly discussions and watching movies to later write papers on. Would recommend.
Easy-going and really flexible. Easy grader and a genuinely nice lady.
Shes the best English teacher. Helps you any time you need help, lets you resubmit papers at the end of the semester. Also very easy grader.
She is soooo good. A friend recommended her and I don't regret taking the class

Professor MacDougall is awesome. She's really easy going with her students and let's a lot of stuff slide if you just talk to her about it. Papers were kind of a drag but she made sure you knew what you were doing and gives many opportunities for improvement. Really nice lady.

Prof. MacDougall is great! She helps you out on all your papers and truly cares about your interests. This was a very relaxing class at the end of the day. Homework assignments were short and gives positive comments on your papers along with good constructive criticism.  I would definitely take a class with her again!

AMAZING PROFESSOR!!! I can't even begin to say how great she is. Def recommended for english 101. Super nice and lets you re-do essays at the end of the semester. Just go to class and you'll get an/a A/B.

Professor Macdougall is one of the best intro professors I've had so far.  Makes English very enjoyable for those that are not majoring in it.  Overall her personality is quite pleasant as well willingness to compromise when turning in late assignments.

Professor MacDougall has been one of the best professors/teachers I've ever had.  I have never gotten higher than a B in English until her class; she makes it understandable and actually a pleasure to go to her class. If that does not convince you, she's also extremely easy on the eyes. You will not regret taking her class.

I loved Dr. Stanwyck. Stat is a really hard class in general but she makes it bearable and pretty understandable. She always tries to explain the best she can and is so willing to answer your questions. Super nice and adds 10 points to tests for a little boost.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Prof Stanwyck is an awesome professor. Statistics isn't my strong suit but she was always very understanding and accessible, and had a great sense of humor. She was always very engaging and you can tell she loves what she teaches.

Great professor! It was her first time teaching STAT 350 and she was amazing. I didn't really like the format of the class but her teaching was great. You can tell she really cares and that is something you don't see in a lot of professors at UMBC sadly. I had a great semester with her! Even though she doesn't curve or anything class was still okay

A great professor who is passionate about teaching her students. Class might be a struggle mid-semester if you don't have a strong calculus background but she is willing to take her time to go through each concept

Absolutely an amazing teacher! Accessible outside of class via Discord. Promptly answered questions w/ supporting info/examples to give a better understanding. You can tell she's passionate about the class, making it more inviting and easier to learn. Drops the 3 lowest quiz and hw scores. A difficult class in general but she makes it tolerable.

Loved her! She really made sure everyone knew what was going on in class. She explained concepts well and made it easy to understand. And she's super animated in a way that makes you want to keep learning calculus. There were 3 exams (including the final) and 3 projects. You can skip lecture but attend discussion and seminar because they count!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: She's a great and motivational teacher. Always listens to questions no matter how simple and explains everything thoroughly. Her exams are weird but can score easily.

I had her for MATH 120, and she was very helpful. Her lectures are clear and easy to understand, and she is always willing to help when someone is confused. She is also not too strict about late work, funny, and very kind to her students.

I had to retake 151! She explained everything very clearly and never tried to overcomplicate the material. She's very caring and is always willing to help students. Office hours were extremely helpful and would help walk through the problem and material with you so you have a full understanding. She doesn't post lecture notes in blackboard.

Professor Galambos is a great lecturer, and it's clear that she understands how difficult the subjects she teaches are. There are a lot of homework and reading quizzes on Webassign, but they aren't particularly difficult to complete. Pay attention during lectures, submit assignments on time, and do not be afraid to reach out for help.
Hard to understand, not well at explaining in depth but rather just completes the problems.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr. Galambos was one of my favorite professors during my time at UMBC. The class, although globally structured, was run very fairly. Print out her online notes before class starts. Go to review sessions, and don't fall behind. This class is not an easy A; however, help is readily available.

Yeah i didnt have her for 151, i had her for 120. She's a nice woman but an EXTREMELY harsh grader (if you're 0.0001 off, she marks 0 pts) and sometimes she's just flat out wrong. Had to argue my way into a passing grade multiple times. Really do not recommend

Great professor! Lectures were not attendance mandatory, classwork is assigned in almost every class, and the quizzes and exams are pretty fair. She makes it known that she cares for her students' grades and is accessible outside of class!

She goes through questions way too fast. She does not allow you to turn in ALEKS assignments late. I am very disappointed at the fact that there is no TA for this course. Quizzes every week. but she drops the two lowest grades. Do not take MATH104 with her unless you are good at math.

Lectures were always lined up exactly with quizzes and exams, so it would be helpful to be in class although attendance wasn't mandatory. She is very accessible outside of class and reminds you of homework, quizzes, and exams.
Galambos was a great professor. She explained things clearly and was accessible out of class for extra help. Exams and quizzes were kind of hard but manageable. She's also very nice

Galambos is a good professor yet some of her explanations did not make sense. If you do the homework and practice problems you will be okay. Exams were very difficult and the final was extremely hard. Content is somewhat hard but that is expected.
Took this class during covid and had to download spyware for tests. Listening to this professor is like watching paint dry.

Professor Galambos Is a good teacher. Most times I left class and I was able to solve all the homework problems without help. Don't get me wrong you need to spend time practicing in order to get an A. But that's just how calc 1 is.

She's a pretty good professor, at least on online classes. She explains problems well enough, but the hw on WebAssign explains it better. The pace during live lectures is very fast, so make sure you have your camera open to take a picture of the notes (if you don't want to watch the recorded lecture).

Exams were crazy difficult until she switched to multiple choice questions. Reading quizzes due before each class and a 20 question webassign the night before your first class of the week. Professor Galambos is very friendly in person, but she is pretty difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: One of the most down to earth professors and you didnt need to be buddy-buddy w her to notice. She cared about lectures and to any students who had questions, she would stay late to assist. The ONLY issue I had was that she wasnt flexible w deadlines. I had a doctors note for an emergency w my younger sister and she wouldnt excuse my quiz grade.

Indeed, for exam 2, she did the free-response format. However, after so many people fail to turn them on time, she switches to the online format for the rest of the semester. The exams are not hard, study and you will do well. And remember to do the HWs. Moreover, she gives us a lot of extra credits in the quizzes and exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: During the COVID-19 Quarantine, when universities transitioned online all the other professors had multiple choice exams. Where as professor Galambos elected free-response online exam.

Her lectures were very clear and pace herself to make sure that people understand the lesson. The load of homework is a given. You're required to do them regardless of your teacher. Calculus at UMBC, in general, is hard. Expect to put in the work!

Professor Galambos is not the greatest at giving lectures. But she is very nice, tries to help, and is always pushing for you to come to office hours. Make sure you do online work, I could not log on for the first week and because of that I missed an A. Attendance is mandatory but you will learn the most by going to your TA discussions.
Professor Galambos was pretty entertaining in lectures, yet i feel that the classwork was not super reflective of what would be on the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Galambos is a great professor; I believe this is her first year teaching. She really cares about her students and makes the material easy to understand. Our exam averages range from 75-80%, which is better than other MATH 151 averages. She is also really nice and funny, an overall good professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Writes in pen but makes a LOT of mistakes. We have to correct her work multiple times a lecture. Can't explain anything too well (2/5). She does a lot of over complicating on simple subjects. The TA's are good though. I wish they taught the class.

-Class was actually English 204-
 It is an English class, there will be reading but most of the semester was poems/short essays and stories so it wasn't over the top. We did finish with a novel but it was a very quick read and a very good book. The reading material Dr. Yoon picked was always interesting and she obviously cares about her students.

Dr Perez is awesome! She gives lots of constructive feedback on papers & writes a personal response to every discussion post, so you can tell she really engages with everyone's work. Classes are discussion-based but she never forces you to speak. She also lets you skip a few discussion weeks which is helpful for when you have a really busy week.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Perez is a wonderful professor and just an all around kind person. She is willing to take time with her students and provide extra help if you ask for it. She is generous with her time and knowledge. We tackle some touchy material in her class and she handled it with the right amount of sensitivity. Recommended.

Absolutely amazing and perfect professor. Accommodating, very reasonable workload, extremely interesting topics, kind, just absolutely everything you want from a professor. She is a bit of a tough grader but she makes her expectations very clear and achieving an A is as easy as showing that you care about your work and showing up everyday.

Prof. Perez can shift gears & be flexible when a lesson isnt working, finding new ways to present material to make sure that every student understands the key concepts. From personal appearance to organizational skills & preparedness for each class, her communication skills are exemplary.

Prof. Perez is an exemplary & visionary educator. I appreciate & treasure everything she has taught me. Enjoyed the class & learned so much from it. Having her encouragement & support even when I wanted to give up was invaluable. Her class was one of the highlights of my week - each one brought something new and exciting to learn & think about.

She makes you work for the writing-intensive requirement. 500-word responses weekly, 3 essays, group project. She's strict on grading but gives you plenty of feedback and workshop. Most classes are discussions on readings each day, participation graded. She does a checkpoint halfway through to let you know how you're doing. Overall good professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Close to if not a perfect professor. Her readings are never excessive, and she gives meaningful feedback to every assignment including the small ones. You'll read new, interesting, and engaging texts, and there is rarely a dull moment in the class. You will not regret taking her. Talk to her too, she is such a lovely person and is super helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Quite enjoyable class. It was her first time teaching it, but it was still good. The poetry section is a bit rough unless you really like poetry. Good feedback on the papers, and isn't too strict of a grader. Group project was enjoyable.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: truly my goat, funny guy that offers a good, difficult class that teaches a lot of important subjects.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: He's a pretty good teacher. The class is like an open discussion and you help edit and give suggestions to each others work throughout the semester. Lots of homework, but it isn't awful. You'll rarely receive a 20/20 on an assignment, but his feedback is helpful and he wants his students to succeed. I would recommend this class !!

Prof. Keravec is an accomplished writer in the field of writing for media arts. However, he does not do the best job teaching the class. He has a well of knowledge of the industry of writing and developing writing, but he does not explain concepts nor point students into the direction of fully understanding them. He also seldom responds to emails.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Take him for FIN330! Professor Anoruo understands the lives of full-time working students and parents. I know I won't get less than a B in this class because he made it possible for me to really get through this class. His class materials are extremely helpful! he's awesome!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: AVOID this instructor!  I cannot stress this enough. Learned nothing from him.  He posted power points generated from the textbook, assigned homework from MyFinanceLab, and posted a discussion question each week from the book, but he did not interact with the class at all. Deducted points randomly. Had to FIGHT to have assignments graded.
I took the online Macroeconomics class with Dr. Anoruo and it was easy. I totally recommend this class,It's much faster than the semester long classes. If study, you'll get an A

Professor Anouro, is very knowledgeable in fincance and he took the time to help students learn how to use the finc calculator.  Assignments were easy given from the book and exams where not that bad.  Over all I think he was very laid back.

BEST TEACHER EVER! If you fail his class, there must be something seriously wrong with you. He tells you exactly what he wants on his exams (gives you practice exams). He takes attendance so you would want to go. What I love about him is that he explains everything step by step. Best teacher.
Very helpful. Always willing to help his students.
If only every professor were like Prof. Anoruo.  Everyone should take his class.

You can sit in class, do nothing except hang on aim and still get an A without a problem. Included 4 HW assignments, 3 easy exams, and a project that took about 2 minutes to do. Take him for anything if you want to make your life easier but hurry, his classes seem to get full extremely fast J

His class is easy, then he gives you his test. The first test was missing a chapter that he told us to prepare for, and that we spent most of class time going over, and had problems from a section we were not told to prepare for. The second test about 20 people were still there 35 minutes after class was supposed to be over still struggling to end

Dr. Anoruo is a very helpful professor.  Although at times his explanations may be confusing, he does his best to make the class doable.  He assigns and grades homework, and says on the first day of class that he will not try to make anything difficult for the students.  He even gave a take home exam for the class.  He's also a really nice guy.

Econ 312 in itself it a difficult subject to take at UMBC and if you can get an easy A with Anoruo then do it! I will take any class this guy teaches because it leaves more time to study for other more complex classes like Advanced Accounting. Take him with anything if you want an easy A. No thought process was involved in this class at all.

This man gets my vote for "worst professor ever". He  is unable to explain some of the most fundamental economic concepts, and is bad at explaining those he does understand. The best thing about his 312 is the text; Mankiw is excellent. He is very biased, and his lectures consist of reading Mankiw's PPT slides. He takes attendance. Awful.

This class was very straightforward and easy. The prof is incredibly kind and passionate about this subject. All you had to do was discussion posts, simple quizzes, midterm, and final paper. Had no trouble in this class, 10/10 would recommend :)

Loved this class. There's a lot of reading, but it's manageable if you read a little every day. Quizzes come from the Ayers book, and there is a midterm and final paper. Overall straightforward class. If you want to learn more about the greek and Latin roots as well as a sprinkle of mythology, you'll really like this class. The prof is also sweet.

Erickson was a pretty good lecturer. She enjoyed interacting with the student as much as possible, despite it being an online class. The class was incredibly easy. I read the required readings, but I didn't need too. The quizzes and exams were stupid easy and I achieved over an 100% as my final grade.

Professor Erickson is extremely passionate about mythology and it really shows. I took this class as an easy elective but ended up enjoying a lot of the material. Grades come from discussion posts, quizzes, and exams. There is A LOT of reading material, so you want to make sure you keep up with them and know the gist of what is happening.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: Super easy GEP class. Not any specific textbook, but make sure you have access to several mythology stories. Only about 4 quizzes, and are easy- each one has extra credit. Definitely take if looking for an easy A!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: attendance is mandatory, this class is reading and lecture heavy so go through the slides and you will ace the the quizzes and the tests. she also puts up weekly discussion boards but they are not hard at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Horrible
attendance is graded. Not a hard class overall if you watch her lectures and read the book. Should be an easy A if you pay attention and do the assignments she assigns.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: If you want an easy A, this is the class for you. As long as you watch every lecture (40 minutes avg.) and complete the discussions, you really shouldn't have an issue. Quizzes are easy and extra credit is offered on it, but the "study guide" is really her just telling you the format. Only bad part of the class is all the reading that's required.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Her adaptation to online learning is awful. Shes putting in zero effort, giving us a prerecorded lecture and making us buy SEVEN books, we have so many assignments with NO in class access to her . Zero effort from her side and still expects the students to dedicate their time to her class, yeah no...

Emily was an easy A, need I say more? Class was once a week. Her homework was all based on completion, the midterm was all online, the final writing assignment was a straight-forward opinion essay, and just showing up to class would boost your grade. If you are looking for an easy GEP, then look no further.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Ergun is the BEST professor I have ever had.  Every day I left class more informed and more knowledgeable about the world.  I have learned more from her class than any other class in college so far.  She is an amazing lecturer, and makes every topic fascinating to study.  Because of her I am now minoring in GWST.

Professor Ergun is very friendly, helpful, understanding, and intelligent. She has a bit of an accent but it isn't hard to understand. For GWST there are response papers due every class, and there's a lot of reading. She is very knowledgable in her field.
Wonderful person, really engaging lectures. Does not use powerpoints, which is awesome.

I don't really agree with the comment below. Emek is incredibly open minded and fun to have as a teacher. She talks a lot about her experiences in Turkey, but that is because she is Turkish, and it is what she knows. These experiences are also very relevant! I never got the feeling that she was ****, biased, or intimidating!!

Very judgmental and biased against Americans, Europeans, whites, and the West. Class is "global perspectives on gender and women," but only HER perspective is allowed. Insists that whites don't have the right to help non-white people. Cuts students off; interrupts them, very unclear about grading - totally arbitrary! Inexperienced teacher - AVOID!
Really awesome and engaging professor.  Extremely knowledgeable about the subject matter.  Her papers will make you work, but she is very clear about what she expects.  Very caring.  Take her class!!

I did not know how good it could be until I took this class by Dr. Engel. His lectures are clear and easy to follow, which is a great help on the homework and exams. Grading is extremely fair. Truly cares about his students and gives very good advice.

Best Professor I've had. Took time to prepare slides that were better than the textbook. Very enthusiastic and captivating lectures. Genuinely cares about students succeeding. Very easy to approach during office hours and responds to emails promptly. If you can take multiple classes with Dr. Engel you won't be disappointed.
amazing teacher

Don Engel is a shining star among professors. If you see a chance to get in a class with this professor, TAKE IT! His lectures manage to make something that should be boring, very interesting. Everyone I have talked to about this professor loves him. His grading is fair and he genuinely wants to see every student excel. The class was perfection.

The fact that I'm giving professor Engel a 5 for teaching algorithms is about all anyone would need to know. If you're able to make algo bearable and in my opinion quite interesting, you're quite a good professor. The grading has been quite fair and its not heavy on memorization which I really appreciate.

Dr.Engel is a great professor. Cmsc 441 is a hard subject, but he made it comprehensible and interesting. There is little to no outside resources for this class and the textbook is impossible to understand. Dr. Engel made animated graphic for every lesson in the book. His slides are the only reason I got threw this class. 10/10 class 10/10 prof.

Enszer is a great guy with some humor. He explains chemical engineering introduction the best he can. Don't be bitter if you don't do well because the major is really hard. Be prepared for hard tests but the problem sets are fine
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Cannot say enough good things about Dr. Enszer. ENCH 225 is a difficult course, but he was always available to help, offer encouragement, and he knew exactly what he was doing (even made his own electronic textbook instead of having us buy one). It was an honor to have studied under him.

Dr. Enszer is engaging, invested in the school, great in class, and loved in the department. Teaching itself is really a big love and focus of his and it shows. He's departing for University of Delaware, curse them... and their terrible (y highly respected) Chemical Engineering department.) Our loss will be a fantastic gain for them.

Dr. Enszer is a fantastic lecturer. He is always on time and extremely prepared for class. The best thing about him is that he really cares about what he teaches, so he is always passionate and excited to teach. His doors are almost always open, and even when he is busy, he will listen to his students. UMBC has been extremely fortunate to have him.

He's charming and engaging, and available outside class. But he's also totally a mathematician in how he approaches things - and talks like one. He's put together his own course materials - very economical. And mainly he's clear, but boy does he love matlab and a linear equation. Would take him for future courses. Gotta give love for a gaming geek.

Terrific instructor.  Clear and concise (but we need to get him a new set of dry erase markers).  Do not fall behind in this class or you will falter (especially in the summer)!  Forced to withdraw due to work conflict limiting my available study time; BUT I highly recommend taking this course under his tutelage.

Really great professor with a clear interest in his students. Super organized and prepared. Very engaging when it comes to courses he regularly teaches/designs (i.e. ENCH 225, ENCH 442, ENCH 470). Innovative teacher who knows Matlab inside and out.  If you must learn Matlab (which you will), he is the best instructor for learning this tool.

He is nice and professional. Not very helpful during his office hours though. He is clear in what he wants from you but unfortunately there are no solutions to his in class/text examples. So when preparing for an exam there is no way to check if your answers to the practice problems are correct. Nonetheless, he is  knowledgeable and approachable.
Whoever gave that ENES rating was probably a mechanical engineer.

He's a gem! If you want to learn and understand ChemE concepts, he is your chance at that (you can't escape him at UMBC even if you try). He is clear, concise, always willing to help, and he is very friendly. Go to class, ask questions, study for exams; his finals are usually more difficult. He is a great teacher, but you have to work hard.

He is the worst professor I have ever had at UMBC. He puts the burden of teaching on the TAs and has little relevant info during his lectures. getting answers from him is like pulling teeth from an alligator.

Great professor! He writes very thorough notes and constantly references the textbook. He does examples quickly, so you have to pay attention, but he's very clear about what he expects from you. He's nice, funny but professional and respectful. He's a gamer, insists on earning rather than losing points, is very meticulous and expects you to be too.

Great teacher! He's VERY prepared, always early to class, available for ?s and his notes are exceptionally thorough! He's a nice guy & knew everyone's names (first and last) by the 2nd class. Keep in mind that it was a small summer class, but he really tried to personalize things(eg: made a unique Pandora station based on our class' preferences).

Dr. Enszer is a great professor, and a great person. He will put in as much effort to help you learn as you do to learn. His lectures are extremely clear, and he posts MOST things online. Tests were easy, but the final was very difficult. Quizzes were simple, and homework was moderately hard (but graded differently depending on your TA).

Very strict grader. Most of the stuff in this class you have to teach yourself by doing practice problems/homework. Lectures weren't much help. Put effort in the class and you should get a good grade.
Pretty good teacher. He seems to be almost overly strict and way to shrewd of a grader. You better make sure you study all material, Disc quizzes are easy if you practice. ATTEND EVERY LECTURE.

Great teacher! Very approachable and knowledgeable of course material. Textbook was used to supplement course notes generated by instructor. Heavy empasis on writing, MATLAB coding, and problem solving.  Also, at least 50% of class is devoted to group labs. Attend class, do hw, and ask questions, and you'll be prepared to do well in the course.

Really great. Very clear and helpful about everything but lab reports. A bit soft-spoken - sit up front. Hard grader but very reasonable with what he asks of you. Very young - around 28. Complete dork (which is awesome). Class isn't that hard if you pay attention. Awesome grading system - it's like a video game! (Again, he's a dork.)

This lady is nuts,  she freaked in our class cause we asked her ?too many questions? about things she should have been able to answer.  A normal teacher is supposed to answer you or at least admit that they don?t know something. But this one would rather call you hostile and put the blame on you.

Nice, but down to business. Show her you care and are actually trying, she will cut you some slack and be very willing to help you out, answers email fast. Allows 1 page cheat sheet for exams. Start prog projects early, ask for help, she'll take time to help you. if it still wont work, she'll be lenient Wait til the last minute tho and you'll fail

Grad student teaching IS 147J.  She curved all of the tests we took, programs were really easy, even gave us a bonus test to help our grades out.  Definitely take 147 with her.  Just make sure to be polite and know your stuff...previous programming knowledge will make the first half of the course a breeze.

She's a great teacher who will take the time to break things down and help you in-class or during her office hours.  Even though the class is for people withour prior programming experience, it would definitely be beneficial if you had some.  Some of the homeworks were pretty hard so ask for help.  She will definitely curve the first test.

Greg is a graduate student, so he knows what its like being a student at UMBC. He has clear slides that he goes over, and gives study guides for his exams. He makes it clear what is expected of you. There are only two other assignments, and easy group presentation, and a written paper about a pysch movie. All around super nice guy.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: Greg is the coolest professor you'll ever have. He wants to help his students and doesn't make the course too difficult. Definitely one of the (very) few UMBC professors that I can say I actually like.

Great teacher and intro to psych. Read the chapter before class and keep up with your lab work. I followed the schedule ofr the labs iand it helped get it done before the due date. There are licker questions and class and group work so it helps to show up to class to solidfy the info. But if you miss one class you'll be okay.

Honestly one of the best professors at UMBC. If you're new to psych, definitely attend every lecture and read the textbook. He goes over lecture slides pretty quickly so do your best to keep up. Very friendly and understanding.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Gregory Epstien has clearly had a ton of experience in his feild. He brings his own personal experiences in psychology to class which is a nice touch, however he always has clicker questions, his TA are like watch dogs, he always talks the whole hour and fifteen minutes and sometimes even longer. But if you really like the psychology he is great.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: he's one of the best professors in the psych dept. He goes out of his way to help you even in things not related to class. Lots of extra credit. 1 movie paper and 3 exams. He throws in a quiz whenever he wants so make sure to read. Textbook is needed. All in all he's An amazing professor and his class is great! Take him
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: pretty chill dude. he goes out of his way to help you succeed and has studygroup sessions from his free time. he's a grad student as well so i guess he understands our struggles. cool dude take him.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Interesting class. 3 exams including 1 final, 1 movie paper, multiple in class quizzes at random- to get attendance. If not there get 0. Responds to emails very quickly. Open to suggestions and change. Extra Credit is available. Very clear grading criteria. I would highly recommend and take him again! No issues at all.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Helpful for allied health
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Online lectures can be lengthy, but Professor O'Brien is passionate and helpful. The workload is manageable if you stay on top of it. unstuck study is a great tool for efficient study prep.

Met once a week, 2-hour-long online lectures with a 5-10 min break, and group work at the end of every session. Wasn't too bad as long as you did the synchronous work you a guaranteed an A. 4 exams which had 150 questions- had to do them in 2.5 hours (insane but only downside) overall nice professor she was very sweet and had a nice voice

Online course for 2.5 hours long, 4 exams throughout the semester and they are 150 MC questions for 2 hrs 15 min which is insane. Some material on it we never even talk about. But overall, she is extremely nice and a great professor and passionate about human growth and development! Take this class!

The professor is nice and is very excited about the class. The class consists of each group facilitating the chapter on the day of the class. The majority of the work is online and those are usually quizzes and critical thinking and a project. Overall, the class is interesting and she makes you engage in the discussion we have each week.
very approachable. Helped during office hours and read multiple drafts. if you do the work, you are fine. You learn alot.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She is a super harsh teacher, her critiques are all criticism and not about improving your paper. She's rude over email and is not easy to talk to at all. She is very condescending in her responses when emails you back. I did not enjoy her at all as professor and will avoid taking her classes in the future.

She's a very sweet, kind, and considerate woman. It's best to get on her good side so write a nice email when you reach out w/ a question :) Textbook is included, but going off her lectures work just fine to pass this class with a high B or an A. Kinda dry/bland though, but attendance is needed to do group work.

wants students to do well
Good class

LIfespan is really interesting and she helps by getting you ready for exams

reviews.comment: For an online class, more work was done than any in person class. She's condescending when speaking and gets irritated when the class does well considering her questions all come from online. TONS of group work and will keep you the entire 3 hours. Very monotone and slow and only reads her slides.

Dr OBrien is an amazing professor. Most writing intensive courses make you write a lot of papers; this course only required one, and we spent the entire semester on it. She's a very kind, understanding, and flexible person who was always available by email for anything we needed. Her lectures were also interesting, and she encouraged participation.

reviews.comment: Teaching style was a bit dry, but interesting. You get credit for clickers (not graded on accuracy). The hw/labs took a few hours, but are simple. Read the textbook! Know what it contains well enough so that you have basic knowledge on it. Basically memorize the book if you can. The concept is simple, but you really need to know the stuffs to pass.

reviews.comment: good class in psychology. I am a social work student but really enjoyed this class.

reviews.comment: The class is easy, just lots of online work. The only thing that was kind of tricky were the exams, but going to the peer mentor review sessions really helps prepare for exams because they go over questions from past exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: fun class and just do the online work.

Lectures using powerpoint slides adapted from the textbook that she doesnt share with her students. However, there are various resources available to help you understand the material. Review sessions, etc. If you read the textbook and study the terms you will be fine.
Class was really interesting and had actual cases to discuss. Really good for social work and psyc mental health.

Dr. O'Brien was very disorganized with how she does things and is unclear with how she grades. Her exams are very disorganized and are tricky. It seems like she grades and teaches based on how she wants to, rather than sticking by her syllabus and the textbook. She lectures immensely.

Dr. O'Brien is a solid professor. Teaches using PowerPoint-based lectures (not posted on BB), videos and light humor. Interesting and useful material. Attendance graded by participation (clicker ?s, in-class assignments). 4 unit exams; no final. Read book; some exam ?s are verbatim. Sit in front to avoid disruptive students (talkers, texters, etc).

Dr. Obrien was a nice lady, and she definitely knew what she was talking about. She would occasionally give group work and clicker questions unannounced, so I wouldn't skip her lectures. As long as you read the textbook, though, you should be good.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Easy A, show up to class for group activities and clicker questions (Worth 14% of your grade!), do your homework and you should do fine. The textbook is really nice, and definitely has useful information relevant to the tests, which were tricky, but not impossible. The class was at 8:30 AM, but she showed us interesting videos to keep us awake.

The tests really aren't hard as long as you read and practice some of the practice problems she gives you and the ones in the book and you will do well. Attendance is not a grade specifically but she has group assignments and those are grades (you never know when). Online labs aren't that hard but make sure you DO YOUR LABS (easy A's).
She plays carpool karaoke in the mornings before class starts. Such a sweet professor and wants the best for her students. Is very knowledgable about the topics she discusses. Show up to class!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: fun class discussions. Papers are short and rubric is on bb. Had fun in the course with the topics.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: really good topics ; some boring, but mostly fun. movies were good. make sure you look at paper rubric before submitting. online tests and basically good course. come to class as there are group projects once a week.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: great discussions with lots of reflective writing before class. But there is a rubric that tells you what you should include in the reflection. very open and honest.

She assigned minor reflection posts, due at 8am before every class, and 4 major reflective papers. If you don't write the way SHE expects you to, you will not do well. It was an awful class to take considering her feedback for papers consists of "good job," "poor job," etc. I feel that if I'm not doing well in the class, proper feedback might help.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I loved this class so much. The material is interesting and O'Brien makes it even more interesting in lectures. Her teaching is clear and she has a sense of humor. The work is pretty self-paced and it isn't difficult to get a good grade. Just do the reading (textbook is easy to understand) and do online assignments on time.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: course is easy-just do the work online and come to class to participate. You learn if you read and do the work. some really good sessions. Movies are fun.

Nice and fun prof, You need to either do the reading or take really good lecture notes, pay attention in lecture she will call people out for sleeping or being on there phones in lecture. A fair bit of work but not to bad over all.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I've had Dr. O'Brien for two different classes now, and I still really like her teaching style. She is a very sweet professor, who cares for her students. She is big on discussion and how you can bring your real world experience into the classroom. She might be my favorite professor in the psychology dept!

Great class on problems in teens and college age adolescents. It is writing intensive so beware you write each week and there is a paper. She gives feedback electronically just read the rubric comments. Helpful and wants students to succeed. Good discussions in class.

This is one of the most frustrating professors I've ever had at UMBC. She is a nice person, but her feedback is unhelpful and useless. She will not grade you based on how you write (and help you improve), but rather if you don't write the way she specifically wants (and I mean the way SHE wants), you fail. I would not recommend her as a Professor.
weekly writing but it's ok. It is a process to get to a good paper at the end. Loved the content and felt like grad school seminar.  If you love psyc, then you will love this course.
really good class.  Attendance is more about participation in groups discussing related issues. Sad topics but so much in the news!  I really liked the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: General course in large lecture hall.  she knows most of the students after midterm and likes to relate psychology to other disciplines.  STEM major who did not like the content but liked the course. good teacher
better than my social work class.   come to participate in a really good discussion and see contemporary films.  great class for anyone interested in child welfare.

Weights attendance for WAY too much in final grade. Got A's on all exams and most homeworks but ended up with a C! DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR! If u don't go to class EVERY SINGLE TIME she will pick u out and treat u like crap grade-wise and during class (consistently belittled anything I had to say for in class discussions and ignored constantly.)
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Sweet professor. Her exams aren't overly difficult but there is a good amount of online homework due, as well as labs. If you do the readings and complete all online materials on time, it becomes very easy for you to earn an A. The final exam is incredibly straight forward; I earned a 93% without studying. (You should still study though!)

Dr. O'Brien has decent lectures and is pretty funny. There is group work. She randomly does clicker questions for participation points, so show up to class. Homework consists of reading, labs, quizzes, and tests; exams are taken in class. Don't worry though; there are plenty of review sessions and TAs there to help.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Do the online labs on time. Don't wait until the last minute. Peer review sessions are concise and helpful, and if you have any concerns, go to Dr. O'Brien's office hours because she's such a great person and very understanding. Her chapters take a long time to read, but they're interesting. Manage your time well, and you'll get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: She's a very nice lady. Her lectures were taken straight out of the book, so reading and paying attention to her lectures is good because that will help you out for the exams. The questions are a bit random, but it's really nothing too challenging. She gets you the information you need in a clear manner, and doesn't beat around the bush.

Not a horrible or mean professor, but her lectures were just condensed versions of the textbook notes. The exams were given with not much review material so I didn't know what to study for each one. I think review sessions are a MUST.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: I love Dr. O'Brien. She is very genuine. This class consists of preclass postings, reflection papers, a midterm, and a final.  All of the assignments are easy.  She posts the powerpoints so you do not have to write quickly in class. I highly recommend this class.

She lectures fast but posts power points. Not many exams but definitely go to study session or you'll be lost for the exam. There are little assignments every class to make sure you're reading but they are not hard at all. You don't have to read to pass, but you'll need the book to study.

Dr. O'Brien is very unclear when questions about expectations. Her syllabus contradicted itself and she did not  follow through on things listed within. Class is always rushed and she covers exactly what is in the textbook, but includes attendance in grade. An online textbook is used and graded but does not prepare you for exam material.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Do the online labs, prepare for exams, easy A.
good for gened course. fun class topics
really interesting even though I am not a major.  Funny class discussions and good examples of how psychology fits into everyday life.
Good class, but you have to work. She helps if you need special care. Has lots of resources for students

Half the class is based on participation and online labs. The online labs are easy just time consuming. She does clicker questions and group activities in class. She never tells us whats going to be on the exam, so you have to memorize the book from cover to cover because she asks the most random questions. Her lectures are so pointless.

She is a very nice professor who is passionate about psychology. Easy to approach and talk to if you have problems or concerns. Learned a lot about family psychology through weekly discussion style lectures, textbook readings, and writing assignments.
writing intensive but learned so much! Get ready to discuss and talk about readings. Can't be lazy and allows for different viewpoints.

Lots of small groups, clickers, and labs. Lecture powerpoints are okay, but you have a better chance reading the book and taking notes on your own. Finishing online labs is the key to success. The semester is organized in the syllabus. Keep up and you'll pass. Peer mentors are super helpful.

Pretty easy class and the material is interesting. Attendance is a must since there is usually assignments to do in class and there is also a lot of online work. She's not really a harsh grader though, so if you do all the assignments it should be an easy A.

I found this to be a pretty easy class. People say her lectures are boring, but I thought she was very engaging. If you want to get an A in the course, do these 3 things: Read the book - some MC test questions are random, so knowing the random facts is necessary, Go to class (graded exercises), Ask her for help. She cares and is a good professor!
There are so many resources to help you pass this class.  Had some people in class who really did not like it, but they were not interested in much .
not relevant to my major, but she cares about students learning and tries to keep us interested.
Just go to class, read and do your work.  Learned about pretty interesting stuff
The class is boring and she can't teach at all.
Really a fun course and we learned a lot.  Fun online work and small groups were hilarious.  Good time and good application of concepts.  Liked a lot.

class is too large, but the topics are good.  Learned but had to read a bunch of chapters. Great discussions, but  wish we could have had more time to talk in groups. Liked the balance and not all feminists stuff
good online content and class is fun
class is so easy if you just follow the syllabus. good discussions in class. don't skip class or lose points
Really great class and it is seminar so you have to read and talk. But just a good class to take and fairly easy if you do the work
Loved this class!!!
really leaned alot but wished there were no exams.  Guest speakers awesome and she really knows the field.
good intro class with lots of online learning.  Had a blast in class with groups
Great class to come to.  Enjoyed the reading and class discussions.  Online stuff prepares you for a final but the group work is more important.
Really good gen ed course with lots of online work that helps.  Would take another psyc class with her.
really hard topics and makes you think.  Not for students who like multiple choice.   Really good essay exams. Got to read to the book.
good class, nice person and fun group work. Just do the assignments and study with peer mentors.
really good gened course. Like her and enjoyed the group work.  fun class
great course and you learn alot
good online work and you can sleep in class when not in group.
hard class but most interesting one yet.
didn't think I"d like the subject, but it makes sense.  Good ss course
loads of writing for WI class but really helpful, interesting and great class to end my four years at UMBC.  I wish I had taken her other courses.
Tough class with reading and essays tests, but it's good.  She let's students use books for exams and have input into test content. Great guest speakers.
This lady wants you to do well and will help, but you gotta work. Read and do labs.
really great class and OBrien is very good with helping us understand and relate the text to our families. learned alot
just do the work like they say and you are fine.  great online studying so just come to class and have fun
very concerned about students.  will adapt testing if you ask her.  knows her stuff and brings in interesting speakers.  read the book!!!
clean on what to do.  You have to work but it's all very clear. Learn how to use online labs.
Good class and requires you to work. No loafing but 4 credit A is worth it. learned a lot.

I was so confused about the many non-user friendly layers of the online portion of the class that it was difficult to focus on the content. She words questions on tests in a tricky way and was apathetic when I reached out for help with the homeworkstudying. Psychology is such an interesting subject but she finds a way to make it boring.

In class Dr. O'Brien is very helpful, when it comes to class work. Any questions via e-mail or in class about the final or assignments will either be very vague or not answered. No exams, only the final, which is 100 questions but easy overall. A lot of online work, but not hard. Overall, an easy grade if you do the work. Also, she's very nice.

This is a hybrid classTopic interesting,but Dr. O'Brien presented it in a boring way. The class was easy but tedious and time consuming. She should make it completely online. That 1hr in lecture could be spent doing the online work rather than hearing her summarize the book. But if you want and easy, boring A then this is the class for you.

Taken Fall 2013. Extremely boring. Lectures straight from the book, but mandates attendance. Always fell asleep in class. Psychology is my minor, but I'm starting to regret even that. Online labs are long and pointless; some material from them are not on exams. Take with ANYBODY else but her.
Boring class do not take with her. Some of the questions on the exams you have more than one right answers but she she only give you credit if you choose the answer she picked.  AVIOD THIS CLASS

I took the hybrid psych 100 course.The labs were stupid and time-consuming,but easy.The online exams and quizzes were easy.She is knowledgeable but tough.Exams are easy only if you do the work.Do all the work, review the study guides at the end of each chapter,show up to class and you should get an A. Bring your clicker to every class

Terrible teacher. Attendance is mandatory even though her power points are straight from the book. She has a monotone voice that puts half the class to sleep. She is never able to answer a question unless it tells it to her in the powerpoint. Grades unfairly and shows favoritism. AVOID!

Requires so much useless busy work. It would be so much better if you could just use the amount of time wasted doing the busy work to study. Also, her lectures are useless and not insightful in the least. One of the most useless professors and a waste to the educational system.

very, very horrible class. requires far too much work for a 100 level class. attendance is mandatory, yet everything she says in class is straight out of the book. In order to even begin  homework you must pass a prelecture quiz with a 90% even though you receive no credit for the quiz. I found her very arrogant. Graded unfairly as well. Stay away!

For those who have read the book 1984, this woman would be one of those high ranking officials working for Big Brother. She's one of those psychologists who thinks that anyone who shows signs of embracing particularness and individualism is mentally ill. If you're a PSYC major, choose your leaders carefully. We don't want 1984 to come to life.

You've got to read the book. Everything comes from the book. Going to class is one of the most frustrating things I've dealt with so far in college. It's completely pointless because her slides literally come straight from the book, but if you don't come to class, then you forfeit any group work done that day. AWFUL.

This professor does not connect with her students, nor is she helpful to questions and concerns you may have.  Her exams are hard even though open book the questions have nothing to do with the book.  I would not take any of her classes again.
You ALWAYS have to write in complete sentences even if it's unnecessary.

Not the best professor. Goes over the material too quickly. She has slides but they are pointless because she flies through them and does not post them to Blackboard. The class has a heavy reliance on the textbook. You MUST have the textbook in your lap doing online work because if you don't get it word for word you will be wrong.

took her twice now-psych 200 displayed correct quiz answers as INcorrect online. 465 syllabus is unclear-different sections propose diff due dates and pg lengths. exams are unclear. lectures from nothing-not the book or PP. expects you to have newest book but hers is old as dirt bc she doesnt want to read the new bk and update her notes-lazy/boring
All tests open note from the book. Questions tricky though! Curved at the end of the semester.

For a 100 level intro to psych class Professor O'Brien definitely stresses INDEPENDENT study. Meaning the student is mainly responsible for learning course materials. The student will be expected to read, attend class (only to reinforce difficult materials),and do online homework to ace exams to get a good grade.The workload is laborious but simple

horrible teacher. her lectures put you to sleep. more then half the class skips, you notice that during exams when there is a completely full class. does nothing to help prepare for exams. DO NOT TAKE HER!
Very nice teacher to talk to.

I took her class Spr2010. The A was alot of work for a level 100 class. There were multiple errors in the online hw, which was very time consuming. She has in class group work which is a percentage of your grade.  Her lectures were not very engaging. The work required for the A is not worth the A.

The slides aren't made available online, but the class is based purely on the book. Attendance is only needed for the small groups, which is how she grades attendance. The online work is quick and easy.

coming to class is basically pointless since she just vomits what we learned from the book. actually reading the book is so much easier, and somehow FUNNIER/more engaging than going to class. she goes by lecture incredibly fast, she can be nice but sometimes she can be really ****y, go to class for the group work, and bring a book to entertain you

Clearly this woman has a lot going on with her. She has two sides, one nice and friendly, the other horribly curt and rude. You'll never know what you're going to get with her. Couldn't be happier for the semester to end. I would never take a class with her again. Good thing she's not teaching many classes---not real faculty.

This was an online class, I took it over the summer.  Many of the questions had the wrong answers, and when I asked about them, I was given curt, poorly written, and frankly insulting responses.  It wasn't too hard to get an A, but it was clear that the teacher put very little time and effort into the course, and many things were just plain wrong.
stupid online groupwork was the worst part. Other than that, it was a regular class, go to class, read the text. She puts the posts the powerpoints, which is helpful.

She is a very good teacher. Tests are a little on the hard side, but they are open book. You have to go to class to be able to get the class activity points. Topics are very interesting and lecturs greatly enhance the textbook.

A repeat of every Health Ed class you ever went through in middle school.  Does not make the subject matter in any way relevant to psychology and essentially reads from the textbook or puts on videos. Disrespectful and unprofessional if you seek help outside of class. Also tends to contradict her own syllabus and grading policies.

you have to know the textbook forwards & backwards to get an A on the exams; the online quizes help your grade out a TON! i had a D average on the exams but an A average on the online quizes, resulting in a B. u find out at the end of the semester that the TA help sessions give u extra credit, so go to those!
rude

To get an A you have to agree with all her beliefs and make sure you blog that way as well, or else you will not receive full credit. Although tests are open book they are really hard even if you study, they are not straight forward questions. This class sounded like it would be fun before I took it, discussion was interesting sometimes.

Would NOT recommend- she is  unclear about assignments, refuses to be proven wrong even when you point it out in text, very unhelpful takes forever to respond to e-mails if she responds at all, tricky test questions, got a B but it took an unreasonable amount of effort and confusion

a bit hard to get an A in the course b/c not a lot of points in the class. exam format changed throughout the semester, but it was always open-book. class lectures are generally very interesting if you're interested in gender at all. also, COME TO CLASS. the class assignment may be the diff. between a B or an A :(.

She's an alright teacher with an alright class; not overly tough, but also not overly easy. The homework can be time consuming and sometimes the questions aren't even addressed in the textbook.  I'd recommend taking her.
very good teacher. if you study and try it is guaranteed an A. learn practical things too! films are very interesting

Lectures = boring but go because of group work. Test = easy if you know how to use a book since open note open book. Group project= a real pain. if your group members don't do their work trying to talk to her is pointless because its a group grade. do it all yourself and make it look good. bring a laptop and print and read the slides.

who brings a 100 question on a four chapter test?!?! three test that were almost impossible, one presentation that was not structured clearly.. the class would have been interesting if someone else had taught it...

She is an okay professor. Exams are open note, open book but it does not really help. Grade fairly. Give out a few in class activity and one huge presentation for 10-15 mins. If you do well on this presentation You will do will in the class.

This lady is HORRIBLE she doesn't know anything she is talking about. very rude and sarcastic. she doesn't care what so ever about students grades. she has her favorites in class and doesn't care about the rest. if you try to prove her wrong and even show it in the book she won't drop the question on the test. she is very narrow minded about topics

The majority of lecture was her reading directly from the slides taken from the teaching material provided with the books, verbatim.  Hardly cracked the book, and aced it.  She's a professional with her own clients, but the class was dreadfully boring.

Very hard to fail. She gives 4 tests one is the final. She also uses the online program so there is alot of assignments but all of them help your grade extremely. She lectures out of the book and her powerpoints which she also posts online.Only reason you would have to come to class is the little group assignments she gives for extra points.
Boring lectures, but the class was easy. The online work is time consuming, but a lot of students feel it's helpful in learning the material. If you want an A, you'll have to go to class.

It mineaswell have been an online class.  The stuff we did in class did not help me understand the material any better then the book.  I expected in class activity and learning and thats not what I got.
One of the best teachers Ive had! She is clear, and sweet. Very helpful and her lectures are clear and interesting. Just make sure you read for this class.
She was cool.  the homework will make you want to gouge your eyes out but the lectures are very interesting.
she is ok

Great, Great, Great Professor, and little on the feminist side, but kind of motherly in a way...She is cool, and can teach, people say the lectures are boring, but she knows how to teach..she gives you these hard online quizzes but they help you for the Test...I am now a Psychology Minor Because of her!!
The quizes help prepare for exam but be careful. She changes the wording around. Lectures are BORING!

While attendance isn't mandatory, she does hand out worksheets for participation points. She really likes the online exams, and you have to do 3 for each chapter. All of her powerpoints are online. She taught directly from the book. Very easy to get an A or a B if you did the online work.

Interesting information and she just wants you to learn something. Not big on memorization of facts-allows a lot of open book and take home because she knows whats really important. She wants you to take somethin away from the class, other than just a grade. Definitely recommend class for psych and education majors

way i got an A: read the book, did the online stuff, night before the exam i redid each online quiz from those chapters, a bunch of the questions were almost verbatim from there...boring as hell lectures though, makes u want to sleep, attendance isnt mandatory, but there r occasional worksheets that count as participation points
it was an easy class....very dull. reading thebook got you through it but she was nice, so. extra credit exists!

I'm a psychology major and I hated this class. The notes are available online, she makes you do online quizzes. Her tests are multiple choice. There's no point in going to the lecture. If you want to learn anything not covered in high school psych, don't take this class
Online powerpoint notes that are gone over in class.
A good professor with fair tests (but you will need to study).

This class was great, not to mention easy if you read the text and do the labs.  Tests are moderately difficult, but she gives a study guide and curves.  Plus she offers extra credit for GOING to class and participating in research studies.

If you are thinking "hey this is an introductory course so I won't have to do crap but still get an A" but you are sadly mistaken. Since this is a 4 cred class, you have to put a lot of effort into getting an A. She knows what she's talking about, but the class itself is hard. It wasn't worth taking in my opinion, but I still got my A.

Great professor.  Really wants her students to do well and goes out of her way to assist those who need help.  Classes are mostly powerpoints, which can be found online.  Also uses videos in class, which are nice because they break up monotony.  Online quizzes are part of grade and helpful.  Go to class and read, get an A.  Slack off and get a B.

Very awesome lady, she knwos her stuff and keeps class interesting, uses lots of power points and videos, her tests are fairly challanging but she does let you use your books and notes for part of it! very interesting class highly reccommendable
this class is the only psych class that doesnt grade on quizzes..the grades are based on three exams, on five chapters EACH. which is why just about half the class failed. my advice: STAY. AWAY.
No Comments
needs to open eyes more

Decent teacher. Uses lots of powerpoints and videos. Rather challenging tests, but they are from the book company and most of them are on the online component anyway so you can study them before taking test. Boosts grade if you spend a lot of time online and if you sit in the front row.  I recommend her.

The class was long and kinda boring cause she used A LOT of Power Point slides. Like, 150 for each exam. Very hard to study from that, imo. Exams were multiple choice though with bonuses and there were online quizzes that we could do on our own time (an easy way to make 10 points...AND if you forgot about them she'll let everyone redo them at the end of the semester!)
The class was very interesting, and not hard, but she is disorganized, and tends to go off on tangents
Never went to a class and still passed! She is pretty nice but not leaneant about make-ups or late stuff. The tests are a little hard but just study the online guides.
Easy class... all the exam questions come straight from the online book you have to buy. put in a couple hrs studying b4 each test and you are good to go.

Really, REALLY easy class. You only have to read the slides and most of the stuff on the test is from the practice exams online. Easy A, but class can get excruciatingly boring sometimes. It's an intro class, so don't expect any indepth stuff (at all). She does seem to lean towards humanist psych.
Her 100 course is straight forward, easy A if you have good study skills.  Seems rather biased against evolutionary psych.

One of the most interesting classes I ever took.  She wants it to be an active learning class and it is for the most part.  Open note and book exams just because she wants you to do well. Projects are not hard at all. (Powerpoint presentation about article)

The tests/exams are very difficult and detailed even with notes and the textbook. If you read, you can still fail. EVERYTHING detail is on the exam, no study guide. I would NOT recommand her at upper level courses. You might learn a lot from her BUT have a hard time passing the course. GOOD LUCK!

Boring/pointless lectures, goes off on tangents-confusing, unclear about test material- always a suprise!  Tries to add last minute projects/papers- last week of class!  CLOSED-MINDED and BIASED!  I really regret taking her class- it is a waste of time and energy!

She is a very helpful teacher who uses material straight from the book and online quizzes. If you take all the practice tests, you don't even have to read the chapter.  Sometimes lecture is boring but the movies she plays are hysterical.
A very nice and understanding person. Definitely an easy A.  Just do all the reading and the online chapter tests and quizzes.  Exams arent the main focus, learning is.
No Comments

She's just like any other lecturer, BORING!!! There's alot of material and her lectures come directly from the publishers of the book. Take the optional Pre & Post tests and optional chapter quizes to see right answers. Her online quizes and 1/3 of her tests questions come directly from those.

I don't know why people complain about Mrs. O'Brien. If you go to class and follow along with the reading, you'll have absolutely no problem. This isn't a hard class. She's clear and there's not that much information.
READ THE BOOK.  the tests are the hardest part of this class, so make sure you study everything.  if you did good memorizing junk like names and definitions, you'll be alright.  NOT a bs class.
I never had any problems with her.  This class is a definite easy A.

Good teacher, go to all the lecture, might be a bit boring sometimes, but go anyway, you will learn a lot.  Read the book, it's easy to do well in this class, but you have to do the work and read the book.  Very nice person and very understanding.
VERY UNDERSTANDING AND VERY WILLING TO HELP

She is very lazy. I didn't get the "smart" impression from her. She seems to just use the powerpoints from the book company. She said that stuff wouldn't be on the exams and then there was a whole section on it. This happened on EVERY exam.Nice

she's a smart person- i'm glad that exams aren't the biggest focus, just wants everyone to learn about women (isn't that the point?). yea, u don't have to go to class but its no fun b/c the discussion can be interesting. read the text- its cool.
This class is so boring, she reads the Powerpoints that came with the book word for word and they are online so there is really no reason to go to class, all in all she doesn't really teach

Easy enough class to pass but kinda pointless to go to class.  She uses slides that the book company gives her and you can just read the book to get the same information.  For exams just use the study guide she gives and read the book.

Never in her office during her office hours. The LAZYEST teacher ever. She uses the powerpoints given to her by the book company, which is basically word for word. She skips many slides because the company has too many slides ex: 100 just for one section
take this class! it's so easy, and she is so nice!  very smart lady!  easy easy easy tests easy A!!!!

For Psych of women class, she is extremely enthusiastic about the material. Sweet, kind lady. Exams are essay but they are OPEN BOOK & OPEN NOTE (very easy!). Very interesting class. Actually look forward to going to class!

This is an easy course: 4 multiple choice tests, one short paper. She puts PowerPoints on the web and then reads them in class. Very cheeful and happy to answer any questions. She tells you what will be on each test. Very straight-forward.

Robyn is by far the worst professor I have had at UMBC. She canceled class 9 times and she didn't cancel until 10 mins before class. never returned grades. I got all A's on my papers , attendance, and participation, while turning in all of my homework, but received a B. The grading scale was unclear. She is very rude and shouldn't be a teacher.

She is a wonderful professor who really knows the topic of Gender and Women's studies! Not only is she very knowledgeable but also explains everything in detail and makes everything very clear. She is very nice and understanding and I recommend her for this course! There are some readings but they are all interesting and helpful with discussions!

Robyn Epstein should not be a professor at this school. She assigns ridiculous readings and shows extreme frustration when students do not know how to comprehend. She cancelled class multiple times and took months to grade papers but expected students to be on their tip toes when assignments are given to them out of the blue. Do not take this class
Cancelled class repeatedly. Uncomfortable talking in this class. terrible at getting grades back.

Prof. Epstein is amazing. She is not a hard grader, as long as you make an attempt to engage with the material. You will read a lot, and she will quiz you if it appears no one has read. She's super friendly and understanding. Just come to class, come prepared, and don't be rude. She will call you out on disrespectful behavior. Great professor!

I would never take a class taught buy her again. She is rude, and if your opinion doesn't match her opinion she shuts down your idea. the class didn't have many grades, and she did not give back any feedback through out the course. Overall she is a horrible teacher.
Takes a long time to grade stuff.  Didn't grade my last paper, it really hurt my course grade. Why? Why do that?  Do I deserve that?  Overall, waste of time.

Assignments were relevant and interesting, but the class contribution to discussion was often frustrating and irrelevant, which she would often do nothing about. Lost her temper in a very unprofessional manner on a couple of occasions. Also, VERY slow grader. Hadn't graded last paper when she assigned an essay final. Resulted in NG on transcript.

Professor Epstein was one of my favorite teachers in college because she really cares about the subjects , and because she wants you to learn. She really pays attention in discussion. She also really cares about students. It's true that she does not forgive plagiarism, but she tells you that from day 1.

She can be rude and disrespectful if she feels as though your contribution to the group discussion isn't good enough. Also, the slightest citation error you make on essays she tries to accuse you of plagiarism and give you an F in the course. DON'T TAKE THIS COURSE WITH ROBYN EPSTEIN.
Don't take her class
Awesome professor! Very passionate about the topics and knows her stuff. Assignments are easy to do. Material used was very interesting as well.

Unclear rules. Changed syllabus several times. Changed grading system. Unwilling to sympathize with students. Does not address theories by name or definition. Final paper is about a theory we don't know but we don't know any theories now. Second time I've left this review. She must be deleting. Poor teacher overall.
In this class now- it's totally amazing! Be sure to take this class with Robyn!

Dr Epstein is a great professor! At first, it seemed like the course is too hard and boring, but then you are learning a lot, especially about media. You learn how to really think about it so you aren't just mad or too into it. You can be conscious. I grew a lot with Dr Epstein.

Recommend. The professor is so cool. Class almost always kept my attention and she will meet with you to help any time. I didn't know talking about race and women could be so great. Cool class. Taking her again this semester for AMST 310.

This class doesn't have exam but 2 papers to pass, one is short and one should be 20 pages long. Class is easy and make me feel like wasting bunch of time. If you want to get easy A, don't take this class

Thoroughly designed curriculum that taught us about sexualities, identities, and the politics of sexuality.  I learned about things I never knew.  This class was so cool and Dr. Epstein is an amazing person that teaches you to be curious and accepting of the world and yourself.  Definitely recommend!

Professor Epstein taught a challenging and enlightening course.  Mostly, I learnd to understand race and gender constructions in media.  Overall, she taught us to be more conscience in how we consume culture. This was one of my very favorite courses at UMBC.

The best thing about Prof Brown is that he engages in open dialogue with students and broadens their understanding and perspective within the flow of class

Course isn't very strictly structured which can be both good or bad because there are many tangents and rambling moments

A fair amount of reading is required but it's mostly interesting stuff

reviews.comment: The course is really interesting and he really makes you think. You will not get bored in this class. You cannot write an essay in 5 hours and expect an A. He is a pretty tough grader but gives great feedback and is available outside of class to help you 1 on 1 with papers.

reviews.comment: WAY TOO MUCH WORK for a 100 level course. Expects his students to write papers as if this was a grad level course and the the only course we are taking. He is a hard grader as well and gives points by the decimal. Also not very approachable.

The class can be interesting at times, but it is definitely more difficult than you'd expect for a 100 class. Eric Brown is funny and tries to keep the material entertaining, but don't expect an easy A; the assignments are very time consuming. The readings can be difficult to understand and/or lengthy.
